Entries.Title: Alien: Earth
Entries.Description: When the mysterious deep space research vessel USCSS Maginot crash-lands on Earth, Wendy and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

Episodes.Title: Neverland
Episodes.Description: When a spaceship crash-lands on Earth, a sister searches for her brother amidst an unexpected alien threat.

Episodes.Title: Mr. October
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise between rival corporations, a reunion takes place, and a secret is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Metamorphosis
Episodes.Description: The team returns home with unexpected cargo. An unsettling experiment occurs, and a new talent is discovered.

Episodes.Title: Observation
Episodes.Description: An unexpected connection is formed while a covert plot puts everyone in danger.

Episodes.Title: In Space, No One...
Episodes.Description: An outer-space vessel in peril leads to a dangerous reckoning.

Episodes.Title: The Fly
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise as powerful enemies confront each other, a dangerous plan unfolds, and curiosity leads to deadly consequences.

Episodes.Title: Emergence
Episodes.Description: An escape plan is hatched leading to a breaking of factions, betrayals, and a shocking confrontation.

Episodes.Title: The Real Monsters
Episodes.Description: A new power dynamic emerges.

Entries.Title: The Terminal List: Dark Wolf
Entries.Description: Before The Terminal List, Navy SEAL Ben Edwards finds himself entangled in the black operations side of the CIA. The deeper Ben goes into the 'gray', the harder it will become to not give himself over to his darker impulses. Every man has two wolves inside him – light and dark – fighting for control. Which wolf will Ben Edwards feed?

Episodes.Title: "INHERENT RESOLVE"
Episodes.Description: In 2015, Navy SEAL Chief Ben Edwards and Charlie Platoon wrap up their Mosul deployment, handing operations over to James Reece's Alpha Platoon. Before heading home, Ben and his team track an ISIS leader who targeted his IF interpreter-only to discover the terrorist has powerful, unexpected connections.

Episodes.Title: "THE AUDITION"
Episodes.Description: Al-Jabouri's allies retaliate against Ben Edwards and Raife Hastings for their rogue raid, but a well-timed job offer from an old spymaster could solve all of Ben's problems.

Episodes.Title: "WHAT'S PAST IS PROLOGUE"
Episodes.Description: Haverford's capture/kill of Danawi reveals a new lead—who was he meeting and why? Tracking his money, Ben and Raife team up with unexpected allies, forming a 'sanction team' that soon faces a far greater threat than anticipated.

Episodes.Title: "THE SOUND OF GUNS"
Episodes.Description: As pressure builds to stop the Khalid Network's delivery of Molar's bearings, Ben's team begins to crack. In Geneva, Haverford's Iranian asset struggles to juggle family, country, and a double life working with U.S. intelligence.

Episodes.Title: "E & E"
Episodes.Description: Alone and hunted, Ben pursues his betrayer. Raife interrogates a Khalid Network captive, unleashing his own 'dark wolf' for answers. Meanwhile, Tal moves solo to advance Mossad's true mission.

Episodes.Title: "PAWNS & KINGS"
Episodes.Description: Ben rejoins the team, finding answers that defy belief. In the murky world of black ops, clarity is rare-something Raife refuses to accept, widening the rift between Lieutenant and Chief. Ben must embrace the gray to stop a war.

Episodes.Title: "THE WOLF YOU FEED"
Episodes.Description: Three months after the airfield exchange, Ben lives off-grid in Germany's Black Forest, ready to sever ties to his old life and avenge those lost in Haverford's spy game.

Entries.Title: Task
Entries.Description: In the working-class suburbs of Philadelphia, an FBI agent heads a task force assembled to put an end to a string of violent robberies led by an unsuspecting family man.

Episodes.Title: Crossings
Episodes.Description: Forced back into the field after a family tragedy, Special Agent Tom Brandis leads a new Task Force investigating a string of robberies.

Episodes.Title: Family Statements
Episodes.Description: As Tom's family braces for an emotional court date, Robbie faces a dilemma, and Maeve makes a critical choice.

Episodes.Title: Nobody's Stronger than Forgiveness
Episodes.Description: As Robbie and Cliff try to find a potential buyer, Tom and Grasso level with the Dark Hearts, and Aleah and Lizzie question Peaches' former coworkers. Later, a raid leads Tom to a shocking revelation.

Episodes.Title: All Roads
Episodes.Description: In the midst of preparing for a key operation, Tom questions the loyalty of his Task Force, while Robbie and Cliff plan for their meeting at the park. Meanwhile, Perry searches for answers within the gang and uncovers a shocking truth. Later, Maeve casts doubt on Robbie's exit plan.

Episodes.Title: Vagrants
Episodes.Description: With help from an eyewitness, Tom and his team inch closer to breaking the case. Perry pays Maeve a visit, while Robbie puts his plan in motion. Later, Tom follows a lead that takes him down a dangerous path.

Episodes.Title: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing, there is a river
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: A Still Small Voice
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Chief of War
Entries.Description: With Hawaii's four kingdoms divided by war, the ferocious warrior Kaʻiana embarks on an epic mission to unite his people—as an existential threat approaches their shores.

Episodes.Title: The Chief of War
Episodes.Description: Kaʻiana is summoned back home to Maui where he must decide whether to join King Kahekili in war.

Episodes.Title: Changing Tides
Episodes.Description: Fearing for their lives, Kaʻiana and his family flee O‘ahu. An ally emerges with a promise of safe passage.

Episodes.Title: City of Flowers
Episodes.Description: Kaʻiana arrives in a strange land. Kaʻahumanu takes her place beside Kamehameha.

Episodes.Title: City of Flowers (2)
Episodes.Description: A dangerous power struggle emerges in the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi. Kamehameha wrestles with his new responsibility. Kaʻiana searches for Tony.

Episodes.Title: The Race of the Gods
Episodes.Description: Kaʻiana returns with a warning, and a dangerous competition will determine his fate in Kamehameha's council. Keōua sends a message.

Episodes.Title: The Splintered Paddle
Episodes.Description: Kupuohi tries to keep the hope of peace alive as the drums of war grow louder. Kaʻiana questions Kamehameha's leadership.

Episodes.Title: Day of Spilled Brains
Episodes.Description: A disagreement erupts about how to deal with the arrival of outsiders.

Episodes.Title: The Sacred Niu Grove
Episodes.Description: After his worst fears come true, Kaʻiana suffers a devastating loss. Keōua's call to war becomes unavoidable for Kamehameha.

Episodes.Title: The Black Desert
Episodes.Description: A great battle arrives as Kaʻiana and Kamehameha lead their army against the combined might of Maui and Keōua.

Entries.Title: The Girlfriend
Entries.Description: Laura has it all: a glittering career, a loving husband, and her precious son, Daniel. But her perfect life unravels when Daniel brings home Cherry, a girlfriend who changes everything. After a tense introduction, Laura becomes convinced Cherry is hiding something. Is she a manipulative social climber, or is Laura just paranoid? The truth is a matter of perspective.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Glamorous Laura Sanderson's beloved son, Daniel, confides that he's met someone special. Wanting to impress, Laura meets the beguiling Cherry but soon catches her telling lies and starts to investigate. Cherry hides her humble beginnings as she works and plays amongst London's elite. She does everything to win over her new boyfriend's mother, Laura, but the more she tries the worse it gets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Cherry joins the Sandersons' family holiday, intimidated by Daniel's bond with Laura. As Cherry seeks alone time with Daniel, Laura grows suspicious of her secrets. The tension peaks until a yacht incident unexpectedly brings the women together. Just as they form a genuine connection, Laura witnesses something she was never meant to see and threatens Cherry, who in turn gives her an ultimatum.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Laura digs deeper into Cherry's past as they continue to tussle for Daniel's affection. When Daniel confronts his mother over her behaviour, they have a vicious argument and Daniel spends his birthday with Cherry. With no support at home, Laura turns to her former lover for comfort before a phone call changes her and Cherry's lives forever.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Laura finds proof that her instincts were right about Cherry, and she whisks her family to Spain, spinning a web of lies to explain Cherry's sudden disappearance. Back in London, Cherry's life starts to unravel and she’s forced to move in with her mother. Upset the Sanderson's are callously ignoring her, it's not long until Cherry's plotting to get her life back.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: An explosive revelation shatters Laura and Daniel's relationship, as Cherry must decide if reclaiming him is worth re-entering Laura's toxic orbit. But she's done being pushed around and she and Daniel are more in love than ever. Laura's desperation to win back her son and her obsession with Cherry spiral out of control, as her life unravels, their mutual hatred reaches new heights.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Cherry and Daniel seem blissfully in love, but cracks are starting to show. As Cherry fights to hold on to her new life, Laura discovers their relationship is progressing quickly. A tense visit to Cherry's family brings the evidence Laura thinks she needs to take Cherry down. It looks like Laura's won until the tables turn and a bitter showdown erupts, with Daniel caught in the crossfire.

Entries.Title: Dexter: Resurrection
Entries.Description: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma to find Harrison gone without a trace. Realizing the weight of what he put his son through, Dexter sets out for New York City, determined to find him and make things right. But closure won't come easy. When Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast. As father and son navigate their own darkness in the city that never sleeps, they soon find themselves deeper than they ever imagined - and that the only way out is together.

Episodes.Title: A Beating Heart...
Episodes.Description: Dexter Morgan awakens from a ten-week coma.

Episodes.Title: Camera Shy
Episodes.Description: Dexter tracks down a serial killer in NYC as Harrison spirals from guilt.

Episodes.Title: Backseat Driver
Episodes.Description: Dexter must carefully balance attempts to help get him acclimated.

Episodes.Title: Call Me Red
Episodes.Description: Dexter attends a mysterious gathering as Harrison struggles at work.

Episodes.Title: Murder Horny
Episodes.Description: Harrison's fears escalate as Dexter pursues a dangerous connection.

Episodes.Title: Cats & Mouse
Episodes.Description: As Dexter closes in on a murderer, Harrison faces a crisis of identity.

Episodes.Title: Course Correction
Episodes.Description: Dexter learns unsettling information as Harrison contemplates his future.

Episodes.Title: The Kill Room Where It Happens
Episodes.Description: Dexter redirects his attention as a way to step up as a father.

Episodes.Title: Touched by an Ángel
Episodes.Description: Prater and Charley's revelation forces Dexter to go to extreme lengths.

Episodes.Title: And Justice for All...
Episodes.Description: Dexter and Harrison face the consequences of their darkness.

Entries.Title: Countdown
Entries.Description: When an officer with the Department of Homeland Security is murdered in broad daylight, LAPD detective Mark Meachum is recruited to a secret task force, alongside undercover agents from all branches of law enforcement, to investigate. But the hunt for the killer soon uncovers a plot far more sinister than anyone could have imagined, kicking off a race against time to save a city of millions.

Episodes.Title: Teeth in the Bone
Episodes.Description: Meachum and Oliveras butt heads as the hunt for a DHS officer's killer leads Blythe's newly assembled task force all over LA… and ends with a startling revelation.

Episodes.Title: Dead Lots of Times
Episodes.Description: Blythe's team heads to Mexico to pull off a daring mission for a deadly cartel in exchange for information on the shipment at the port.

Episodes.Title: Happy Birthday Final
Episodes.Description: The team stages a high stakes prison break in an attempt to gain knowledge on the identity and whereabouts of the mysterious Volchek.

Episodes.Title: Bite 'Em Down
Episodes.Description: Still reeling from their loss, the team tracks down Timur Novikov's uncle, Mikhail… and hatches a plan to lure Volchek out into the open.

Episodes.Title: Blurred Edges
Episodes.Description: The team pays a visit to the Belarusian consulate in search of files that could finally reveal who Volchek is… and how far he's willing to go.

Episodes.Title: A Needle or a Bullet
Episodes.Description: The team follows a new lead out to the California desert, where their suspect isn't going down without a fight. Meanwhile, Volchek initiates the next phase of his plan.

Episodes.Title: Nothing Else Helps
Episodes.Description: While the team splits up to pursue a trio of new leads, consul general Astapov's security detail attempts to persuade Volchek to abandon his plans... by force.

Episodes.Title: The Nail in the Chair
Episodes.Description: The team races to try and catch Volchek as he begins to deploy his weapons of mass destruction around Los Angeles.

With their leader fighting for his life and Meachum's medical condition worsening by the minute, the team finally comes face to face with the true nature of their enemy's plans as time is running out to stop him.

Episodes.Title: The Muzzle Pile
Episodes.Description: The task force violently confronts Volchek to save a city of millions. As the smoke clears and Meachum works to resolve his medical issues, a new threat emerges from Secret Service agent Ryan Fitzgerald.

Episodes.Title: Run
Episodes.Description: Shepherd works to decipher the manifesto recovered at Cabin 6 while the rest of the team pursues a suspect on the run.

Episodes.Title: This Is His Signature
Episodes.Description: As another death ratchets up the pressure, the team makes a startling new discovery about their suspect.

Episodes.Title: Your People Are in Danger
Episodes.Description: The team zeroes in on a suspect and moves for a take-down... but soon find one of their own in grave danger.

Entries.Title: The Studio
Entries.Description: Desperate for celebrity approval, the newly appointed head of a movie studio and his executive team at Continental Studios must juggle corporate demands with creative ambitions as they try to keep movies alive and relevant.

Episodes.Title: The Promotion
Episodes.Description: Matt Remick is named the new head of Continental Studios—and put in charge of a project that threatens public humiliation.

Episodes.Title: The Oner
Episodes.Description: The filming of an intricate sunset shot becomes complicated by Matt's set visit.

Episodes.Title: The Note
Episodes.Description: Matt feels nervous about giving legendary director Ron Howard a difficult piece of feedback.

Episodes.Title: The Missing Reel
Episodes.Description: A reel of film goes missing, sending Matt and Sal on a race against the clock to find it.

Episodes.Title: The War
Episodes.Description: Frustrated by her position in the office hierarchy, Quinn wages a war against Sal.

Episodes.Title: The Pediatric Oncologist
Episodes.Description: Matt’s ego is put to the test when his new doctor girlfriend brings him to a charity gala.

Episodes.Title: Casting
Episodes.Description: The Continental team scrambles to come up with a movie cast that won't offend anyone.

Episodes.Title: The Golden Globes
Episodes.Description: Matt tries to get Zoë Kravitz to thank him in her award acceptance speech.

Episodes.Title: CinemaCon (1)
Episodes.Description: When Matt sets out to throw the coolest party at CinemaCon, it backfires in psychedelic fashion.

Episodes.Title: The Presentation (2)
Episodes.Description: If Matt’s team doesn't pull off an amazing CinemaCon presentation, the studio will be sold...to a tech company.

Entries.Title: aka Charlie Sheen
Entries.Description: Actor Charlie Sheen tells his story in this candid two-part documentary tracing his dazzling Hollywood rise, tabloid-topping fall and road to recovery.

Episodes.Title: Part One
Episodes.Description: Rebellious, charming and magnetic, Charlie bursts onto the scene in the '80s. Fame quickly follows, but his fast-lane lifestyle soon turns problematic.

Episodes.Title: Part Deux
Episodes.Description: As "Two and a Half Men" takes off, Charlie enters a self-destructive spiral. Ex-wives Denise Richards and Brooke Mueller shed light on the saga.

Entries.Title: The Pitt
Entries.Description: The staff of Pittsburgh's Trauma Medical Center work around the clock to save lives in an overcrowded and underfunded emergency department.

Episodes.Title: 7:00 A.M.
Episodes.Description: While attempting to distract himself from the anniversary of his mentor's death, Dr. Robby introduces a fresh batch of interns to life in the ER.

Episodes.Title: 8:00 A.M.
Episodes.Description: Robby helps siblings navigate their elderly father's end of life care. Later, Samira fends off cops targeting a woman with a misunderstood condition.

Episodes.Title: 9:00 A.M.
Episodes.Description: Samira does her best to keep Whitaker on the right track. A teen overdose sparks conflict in the ER.

Episodes.Title: 10:00 A.M.
Episodes.Description: Bets are taken on the whereabouts of a stolen ambulance, while Santos learns a hard lesson, and Whitaker helps to tame “The Kraken.”

Episodes.Title: 11:00 A.M.
Episodes.Description: Santos and Collins each deal with moral quandaries. Samira’s careful approach earns praise from patients – and reproach from Robby.

Episodes.Title: 12:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: While Robby handles an ultimatum from the hospital, Mel, Javadi, and Collins each handle unique mother-daughter dynamics.

Episodes.Title: 1:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: After examining an influencer with strange symptoms, Samira pushes back against Robby. Santos contends with a patient accused of assault.

Episodes.Title: 2:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: While Robby attends to an elderly patient with ties to Pittsburgh's history, other members of the team attempt to resuscitate a young drowning victim.

Episodes.Title: 3:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: After a staff debrief from Robby, Dana defuses a waiting room brawl, Whitaker finds common ground with "The Kraken," and McKay faces a crucial error.

Episodes.Title: 4:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: With the Pitt down a staff member, Robby relies on his team to pick up the slack. Later, Santos finally voices her suspicions.

Episodes.Title: 5:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: While Robby tries to keep a developing staffing situation under wraps, Collins guides a surrogate through a difficult delivery.

Episodes.Title: 6:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: When dozens of critical patients flood the ER, Robby and his team struggle to keep up amid quickly diminished supplies.

Episodes.Title: 7:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: As the night shift begins, Robby refuses to give up on a mass casualty victim. Samira and Santos each attempt risky moves.

Episodes.Title: 8:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: While Robby struggles with a loss, Abbott coaches Samira through a risky procedure, and Mel treats a teen with a mysterious rash.

Episodes.Title: 9:00 P.M.
Episodes.Description: Robby resorts to unorthodox methods to convince a father to allow treatment for his son. Later, Whitaker tracks down a missing patient.

Entries.Title: MobLand
Entries.Description: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

Episodes.Title: Stick or Twist
Episodes.Description: Harry Da Souza is called upon to make a problem disappear.

Episodes.Title: Jigsaw Puzzle
Episodes.Description: Harry must deal with the aftermath of the Harrigan family meeting.

Episodes.Title: Plan B
Episodes.Description: Richie makes his move, putting the Harrigans on high alert.

Episodes.Title: Rat Trap
Episodes.Description: Conrad comes to Jan for a favor. Kevin makes a confession to Harry.

Episodes.Title: Funeral for a Friend
Episodes.Description: Kevin and Harry assess scenarios in a search for insurance and an exit strategy.

Episodes.Title: Antwerp Blues
Episodes.Description: Conrad twists the knife as Maeve gives Eddie a lesson in the art of chess.

Episodes.Title: The Crossroads
Episodes.Description: O'Hara points out the elephant in the room. Harry takes extreme measures.

Episodes.Title: Helter Skelter
Episodes.Description: Maeve extends an olive branch. Richie contemplates a new affiliation.

Episodes.Title: Beggars Banquet
Episodes.Description: Tattersall gets Alice's tootsies tapping. Kevin confronts his past.

Episodes.Title: The Beast in Me
Episodes.Description: Kevin takes care of a problem. Maeve spills the tea.

Entries.Title: NCIS: Tony & Ziva
Entries.Description: When his security company is attacked, Tony and Ziva must go on the run across Europe, try to figure out who is after them and maybe even learn to trust each other again so that they can finally have their unconventional happily ever after.

Episodes.Title: No Country Is Safe
Episodes.Description: Their family now in danger, Tony and Ziva must find who is behind a nefarious cyber-attack.

Episodes.Title: No Friend of Mine
Episodes.Description: Tony and Ziva track down the elusive hacker, only to join forces when Interpol closes in.

Episodes.Title: Cover Story
Episodes.Description: Unsure who to trust and framed for a terrorist bombing, Tony and Ziva go off the grid.

Episodes.Title: Wedding Crashers
Episodes.Description: Tony and Ziva use a wedding as an undercover operation to root out their enemies.

Episodes.Title: We've Got Company
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Dark Mirror
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Fire Sale
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: All for the Taking English
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Ride or Die
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Full Circle
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Butterfly
Entries.Description: David Jung, a mysterious former US intelligence operative living in hiding in South Korea, has his life blown to pieces when the consequences of an impossible decision from his past come back to haunt him, and he finds himself hunted by Rebecca, a deadly young assassin, and Caddis, the sinister spy organization she works for.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: David Jung, a Korean-American man who faked his death nine years ago, confronts his past when his daughter Rebecca, now working as an assassin for the private intelligence agency Caddis, is sent to kill him.

Episodes.Title: Daegu
Episodes.Description: David and Rebecca find themselves on the run from Caddis after a tense encounter at a police checkpoint. But their unexpected reunion is complicated by Rebecca's resentment over her father's abandonment.

Episodes.Title: Busan
Episodes.Description: Rebecca, David and his family escape to a safe house in the coastal city of Busan. Family tensions mount as Rebecca struggles with her father's new family. And a shocking revelation about David's past with Juno is revealed during a violent confrontation at a marina.

Episodes.Title: Pohang
Episodes.Description: After abducting Oliver, David and Rebecca use the information they gather from him to devise a plan to go after Juno, taking them back to Seoul, where Gun and Caddis are waiting.

Episodes.Title: Seoul
Episodes.Description: Juno interrogates Oliver and discovers he betrayed her while being held captive by David. Meanwhile, David and Rebecca carry out a PSYOP campaign against Juno, aimed at dividing her and Oliver and bringing down Caddis once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Annyeong
Episodes.Description: David pursues Rebecca after she's captured by Juno and Caddis operatives, leading to a high-speed chase and brutal ambush at an abandoned factory site.

Entries.Title: Outlander: Blood of My Blood
Entries.Description: From the battlefields of World War I to the rugged Highlands of 18th century Scotland, two fated couples must defy the forces that seek to tear them apart, unfolding in surprising and unforeseen ways in this romantic saga that unfolds across time.

Episodes.Title: Providence
Episodes.Description: At the Gathering, Brian Fraser and Ellen MacKenzie meet for the first time and are struck by their strong connection.

Episodes.Title: S.W.A.K. (Sealed with a Kiss)
Episodes.Description: While Henry fights in WWI and Julia works in the censorship office in London, their love story unfolds through the letters they write to each other.

Episodes.Title: School of the Moon
Episodes.Description: Ellen hatches a new plan to protect herself and her family. Julia is forced to make an impossible choice.

Episodes.Title: A Soldier's Heart
Episodes.Description: Henry tackles a challenging assignment in his own way. Ellen learns some concerning information about the family into which she’s expected to marry.

Episodes.Title: Needfire
Episodes.Description: Ellen and Brian attend Beltane. Henry struggles to hold onto his hope. Julia loses allies when secrets come out.

Episodes.Title: Birthright
Episodes.Description: Henry continues to look for Julia until a new discovery threatens to end his search.

Episodes.Title: Luceo Non Uro
Episodes.Description: Lord Lovat goes to extreme lengths to fulfill a prophecy; Dougal attends a clandestine meeting that could spell political disaster for the MacKenzies.

Episodes.Title: A Virtuous Woman
Episodes.Description: At the request of the Grants, Ellen undergoes a test to prove her worthiness to marry into the clan.

Episodes.Title: Braemar
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Something Borrowed
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Runarounds
Entries.Description: Follow a tight-knit group of young adults from all walks of life who come together to form a rock band the summer after graduating from high school. Set against the backdrop of Wilmington, North Carolina, The Runarounds must choose between succumbing to the pressures of real life or risking everything to become the greatest band of all time.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Charlie Cooper and his friends form a new band called The Runarounds right after high school graduation.

Episodes.Title: Morning Glory
Episodes.Description: Charlie struggles with writer's block, and makes a desperate move to spark his inspiration. Pete tries to get the band a gig, and Neil falls in love.

Episodes.Title: (Nice Day for a) Weird Wedding
Episodes.Description: The Runarounds play a hippie wedding, hoping to get the attention of a local record label.

Episodes.Title: Three Grand, Five Songs, Four Days
Episodes.Description: After booking time at a recording studio, the band struggles to keep it together as tempers flare and Bez considers other opportunities.

Episodes.Title: Ride the Wave
Episodes.Description: The Runarounds take a wild road trip over the rainbow that tests loyalties, reveals secrets, and teaches them what it means to make music.

Episodes.Title: Been Caught Stealing
Episodes.Description: The band is in high spirits after their road trip, until they discover all their gear has been stolen.

Episodes.Title: Hypocrites
Episodes.Description: As their new song goes viral, the band gets the attention of a major label. But with the end of summer looming, time is running out for Charlie and Sophia.

Episodes.Title: Kill Devil
Episodes.Description: With a major label interested in signing The Runarounds, the band scores their biggest gig yet to seal the deal.

Entries.Title: House of David
Entries.Description: Tells the story of the ascent of the biblical figure, David, who becomes the most celebrated king of Israel. The series follows the once-mighty King Saul as he falls victim to his own pride. At the direction of God, the prophet Samuel anoints an unlikely, outcast teenager as the new king.

Episodes.Title: A Shepard and a King
Episodes.Description: One thousand years before Christ, Saul, the first King of Israel, loses God's grace and consequently also his own sanity. Meanwhile far away from the palace, the legendary seer Samuel becomes aware of a talented young shepherd named David. One of the greatest stories ever told is set in motion.

Episodes.Title: Deep Calls to Deep
Episodes.Description: Saul's family watches the King's deteriorating mental state with great concern, and is ready to do anything in their power to defend his reign. David is hungry for a life outside of his home, but what he finds beyond the hills of Bethlehem is danger beyond his wildest expectations.

Episodes.Title: The Anointing
Episodes.Description: The court must deal with the consequences of Saul's madness, Samuel is on the run from a sinister agent, and a nefarious shadow assembles a legendary ally in his plan to conquer Israel. Out in the fields of Bethlehem, David has an encounter that will change the course of history forever.

Episodes.Title: The Song of Moses
Episodes.Description: A member of the palace faces serious allegations, that force the royal family to react. Samuel suffers a grave loss and sees himself confronted with the consequences of his prophecy. David discovers a new world where he finds secrets, dangers, but above all, love.

Episodes.Title: The Wolf and the Lion
Episodes.Description: Queen Ahinoam hosts a feast to welcome an important group of guests in her home. The politics at court are full of deceit, and every player has their own secret mission. David learns to navigate his new life and comes one step closer to his destiny.

Episodes.Title: Giants Awakend
Episodes.Description: Dark powers strengthen outside Saul's kingdom as Israel's enemies summon legendary warriors that were long deemed myth. A relationship at court complicates the lives of the heroes severely and Queen Ahinoam must take drastic actions to help the King.

Episodes.Title: David and Goliath (1)
Episodes.Description: Kings, heroes and villains grapple for the crown in a final face-off. War is inevitable and on the ancient battlegrounds the players prepare for a colossal fight that will decide the fate of Israel forever.

Episodes.Title: David and Goliath (2)
Episodes.Description: An epic clash of forces puts a prophecy to a test. One of the most legendary battles in the history of mankind impends and the heroes must face their deadliest and mightiest foes yet. How will the monumental story unfold? Who will be victorious in the struggle for the kingdom?

Entries.Title: We Were Liars
Entries.Description: One year after a mysterious accident left her with amnesia, 17-year-old Cadence returns to Beechwood, an island off Martha's Vineyard, seeking answers. As three generations of the distinguished Sinclair family gather at their private summer utopia, no one will talk about the accident – neither her childhood friends "The Liars" nor her first love Gat, forcing her to uncover the truth herself.

Episodes.Title: Tell Me Sweet Little Lies
Episodes.Description: Every summer, Cadence Sinclair cherishes her time with her cousins Mirren and Johnny and her best friend Gat on Beechwood Island. At sixteen, what begins as their usual summer of mischief transforms when Cadence and Gat fall in love, while adult tensions rise in her family. She doesn't know this fairy tale will end with her alone on the beach, injured and with no memory of how she got there.

Episodes.Title: Wrap Her Up in a Package of Lies
Episodes.Description: Following her mysterious accident, Cadence has suffered a year of illness, amnesia, and loneliness, having had no contact with The Liars. Returning to Beechwood for answers, she finds even her closest friends won't discuss the summer she can't remember. But the island begins triggering memories of Summer 16, starting with a Father's Day celebration marred by rivalry, betrayal, and heartbreak.

Episodes.Title: The Ties Were Black, the Lies Were White
Episodes.Description: Having remembered a family tragedy, Cadence presses The Liars for answers. Mirren reveals a crush gone awry, Johnny recalls an unwanted visitor, and Gat recounts their relationship's painful turn. Tension between the aunts continues to rise, and Cadence suspects at least one Liar is hiding something, questioning whether what happened last summer was an accident at all.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth of You Lie
Episodes.Description: As the Sinclairs prepare for a quiet Fourth of July, Cadence investigates one of The Liars, uncovering memories of last year's crowded celebration. While the Sinclair sisters vied for their father's approval, The Liars navigated their romantic lives and Ed surprised Carrie. In present day, Cadence discovers a shocking truth about one Liar, leading to a confrontation as explosive as the fireworks.

Episodes.Title: Lying Together in a Silver Lining
Episodes.Description: Unsettled by a series of painful memories, Cadence tries to enjoy what's left of her summer – even if it means distracting herself with a potentially dangerous stunt. Despite her best efforts, she remembers a stormy day from Summer 16 when rising seas and frustrations threatened every Sinclair, exposing the family's darker side and forcing Gat and Cadence to confront their unspoken feelings.

Episodes.Title: When Lies Gives You Lemons
Episodes.Description: Unable to continue keeping secrets from her, Gat finally opens up to Cadence about his perspective on the island – one that doesn't always reflect the fairy-tale nostalgia of her own experience. While they head into town in search of answers, Gat recounts his memories of an honored Sinclair tradition – Tipper's Lemon Hunt – and the unplanned visit from his mother that made him question everything.

Episodes.Title: Everybody Knows That the Captain Lied
Episodes.Description: More uncertain than ever, Cadence reluctantly joins Harris on an excursion, triggering memories of their final confrontation in Summer 16. During a tense family dinner, The Liars confront their mothers about family secrets. In the aftermath of shocking revelations, The Liars mourn their once-beloved childhood playground and unite in an attempt to save their fracturing family.

Episodes.Title: My Friends Are Lying in the Sun
Episodes.Description: Cadence devises a plan to trigger her latent memories of the final hours before her traumatic accident, but she can't do it alone – she must convince the reluctant Johnny, Mirren, and Gat to help her, even if it means risking everything. But as the truth begins to come back to her in fits and starts, Cadence realizes that she, herself, has been the biggest Liar of all.

Entries.Title: The Paper
Entries.Description: The documentary crew that immortalized Dunder Mifflin's Scranton branch is in search of a new subject when they discover a historic Toledo newspaper, The Truth Teller, and the eager publisher trying to revive it.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: A documentary crew discovers a historic Midwestern newspaper and the publisher trying to revive it.

Episodes.Title: The Five W's
Episodes.Description: Ned starts slowly with his volunteer crew until Esmeralda forces them to scramble for stories.

Episodes.Title: Buddy and the Dude
Episodes.Description: Ned tags along on Mare's consumer sting story after Esmeralda gets in his head.

Episodes.Title: TTT vs the Blogger
Episodes.Description: Ned and Esmeralda go against a high school blog; Mare and Oscar cover a teacher's last production.

Episodes.Title: Scam Alert!
Episodes.Description: Ned chases a story about a scammer operating through a dating app and learns Esmeralda was a victim.

Episodes.Title: Churnalism
Episodes.Description: Ned takes over Esmeralda's advertorials and assigns the staff to test products themselves.

Episodes.Title: I Love You
Episodes.Description: With Marv camped out in the newsroom, the staff's unresolved attitudes toward authority bubble up.

Episodes.Title: Church and State
Episodes.Description: Mare uncovers a story that pits the Truth Teller against its owner; Ned is embarrassed by his past.

Episodes.Title: Matching Ponchos
Episodes.Description: Ned and Mare take a long road trip to interview a possible cult leader; Ken goes on an apology tour.

Episodes.Title: The Ohio Journalism Awards
Episodes.Description: Ned stifles his desire to win at the Ohio Journalism Awards; Nicole uncovers Detrick's monogamy.

Entries.Title: Murderbot
Entries.Description: In a high-tech future, a rogue security robot secretly gains free will. To stay hidden, it reluctantly joins a new mission protecting scientists on a dangerous planet...even though it just wants to binge soap operas.

Episodes.Title: FreeCommerce
Episodes.Description: On a fresh assignment, Murderbot's newfound free will leads to odd behavior, sparking suspicion from the PreservationAux team.

Episodes.Title: Eye Contact
Episodes.Description: Mensah and Bharadwaj risk everything to investigate a mysterious region. Gurathin goes toe-to-toe with Murderbot.

Episodes.Title: Risk Assessment
Episodes.Description: The PresAux team heads to a new base to search for answers. Murderbot gets tangled up in a SecUnit showdown.

Episodes.Title: Escape Velocity Protocol
Episodes.Description: As an enemy takes aim at Murderbot, an ally tries to orchestrate a getaway. The team grapples with a leadership shake-up and a shocking ultimatum.

Episodes.Title: Rogue War Tracker Infinite
Episodes.Description: PresAux pulls out all the stops to forge a path forward. Tensions mount when trust is tested—and a DeltFall survivor joins the fold.

Episodes.Title: Command Feed
Episodes.Description: A critical setback sends the team into a spiral. Mensah rolls the dice on a tricky procedure. LeeBeeBee changes her tune.

Episodes.Title: Complementary Species
Episodes.Description: Murderbot deals with fallout and detects a critical threat. In hopes of evading danger, the team heads to a new locale full of surprises.

Episodes.Title: Foreign Object
Episodes.Description: PresAux receives a dispatch from a rival group. Gurathin taps into Murderbot's bloody past.

Episodes.Title: All Systems Red
Episodes.Description: Murderbot calls the shots at a critical rendezvous. Gurathin and Pin-Lee piece together a plan. Mensah makes her own move.

Episodes.Title: The Perimeter
Episodes.Description: At the Corporation Rim, PresAux presents a radical request.

Entries.Title: Ironheart
Entries.Description: After the events of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, technology is pitted against magic when Riri Williams, a young, genius inventor determined to make her mark on the world, returns to her hometown of Chicago. Her unique take on building iron suits is brilliant, but in pursuit of her ambitions, she finds herself wrapped up with the mysterious yet charming Parker Robbins aka "The Hood."

Episodes.Title: Take Me Home
Episodes.Description: Determined to complete her newest armored suit, Riri Williams teams up with Parker Robbins.

Episodes.Title: Will the Real Natalie Please Stand Up?
Episodes.Description: Riri's new A.I. dredges up painful memories ahead of her first heist with Parker and his crew.

Episodes.Title: We in Danger, Girl
Episodes.Description: Riri is uncomfortable being part of Parker's crew—two more heists, max, and she's out, she promises.

Episodes.Title: Bad Magic
Episodes.Description: When Parker suspects Riri of wrongdoing, she knows she has to figure out the source of his powers.

Episodes.Title: Karma's a Glitch
Episodes.Description: Riri sets out to create a suit unlike anything she has ever attempted—but at what cost?

Episodes.Title: The Past Is the Past
Episodes.Description: Riri builds her most powerful suit yet, but she's unsure if it's enough to beat Parker and The Hood.

Entries.Title: Smoke
Entries.Description: When an arson investigator begrudgingly teams up with a police detective, their race to stop two arsonists ignites a twisted game of secrets and suspicions.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise as the search for suspects begins. Michelle Calderone pumps the brakes on her personal life. Dave Gudsen gets creative.

Episodes.Title: Your Happy Makes Me Sad
Episodes.Description: Seemingly stalled, Gudsen and Calderone consider a new lead. Chaos ensues on a side mission. Freddy Fasano rethinks his future.

Episodes.Title: Weird Milk
Episodes.Description: Calderone charts her own course for answers. Gudsen pitches a new path for their partnership. Freddy heads to Coop's headquarters.

Episodes.Title: Strawberry
Episodes.Description: Gudsen sheds light on his dark past. Calderone digs even deeper. Freddy starts to spiral.

Episodes.Title: Size Matters
Episodes.Description: While Gudsen heads out of town for a conference, Calderone tries to track down his old partner. Freddy seeks revenge.

Episodes.Title: Manhood
Episodes.Description: Esposito and Calderone urge Harvey to take action. A fully rogue Freddy reaches out to an ally.

Episodes.Title: Whitewashed Tombs
Episodes.Description: On the heels of heartache, Calderone clocks in for a covert mission. Gudsen navigates newfound glory—and an unexpected confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Mercy
Episodes.Description: Gudsen flips the script. Harvey grapples with regret. Calderone is forced to confront her past.

Episodes.Title: Mirror Mirror
Episodes.Description: A desperate Calderone calls in a favor. Gudsen scrambles for control. A massive blaze stokes a make-or-break showdown.

Entries.Title: Adolescence
Entries.Description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking: what really happened?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Police break down the door of the Millers' family home. Teenage Jamie is arrested and taken in for questioning but insists he's done nothing wrong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The police look for answers — and the weapon — at Jamie's school. They can't get any leads from his friends, until DI Bascombe's son offers to help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jamie meets with a psychologist. He's reluctant to speak at first, but eventually he opens up about his complex feelings towards Katie.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: On Eddie's birthday, the Millers try to celebrate like everything is normal. But a series of upsetting events threatens to send the family over the edge.

Entries.Title: Ballard
Entries.Description: Detective Renée Ballard plunges into a web of murder and corruption as she hunts a ruthless serial killer and uncovers a sinister police conspiracy that threatens everything she stands for. With her own demons nipping at her heels, Ballard must outwit both criminals and colleagues to bring long-overdue justice to the victims and their families.

Episodes.Title: Library of Lost Souls
Episodes.Description: Ballard reopens a mysterious John Doe case while pursuing justice for a councilman's murdered sister. As she navigates reluctant witnesses, department politics, and her own demons, Ballard and her team uncover buried secrets that suggest corruption within the police force.

Episodes.Title: Haystacks
Episodes.Description: Ballard and Parker investigate housekeeper Yulia Kravetz's murder. Meanwhile, the hunt for the serial killer's latest victim reunites Ballard with retired Detective Harry Bosch.

Episodes.Title: BYOB
Episodes.Description: The 2006 death of fraternity member Nick Thatcher was initially ruled an accident. When a video goes viral accusing the fraternity of murder, Ballard and her team are forced to reopen the case.

Episodes.Title: Landmines
Episodes.Description: Ballard uncovers an LAPD conspiracy with connections to a Mexican cartel. The Pearlman case heats up when clues lead to a dangerous showdown with a potential suspect.

Episodes.Title: What's Done in the Dark
Episodes.Description: When the team uncovers disturbing new information in the Pearlman case, they focus in on a new suspect.

Episodes.Title: Beneath the Surface
Episodes.Description: Ballard's serial killer investigation takes a high-stakes turn. With 72 hours to secure the case before it's transferred to Homicide, the team races to find connections between the victims.

Episodes.Title: Fork in the Road
Episodes.Description: Bosch delivers a shocking lead in the LAPD corruption case. Ballard and team dive into the mysterious murder of a teenager with ties to a local gang.

Episodes.Title: Last Call
Episodes.Description: The Ibarra case turns personal as Martina discovers someone close to her is part of the corrupt LAPD ring. The team races to identify the remaining corrupt officers before time runs out.

Episodes.Title: Collateral
Episodes.Description: A fresh lead turns into a shocking revelation as the team learns their serial killer has been in their grasp the whole time.

Episodes.Title: End of the Line
Episodes.Description: A city-wide manhunt begins for Rawls's shooter. Ballard receives an unexpected update on the LAPD conspiracy case.

Entries.Title: Stick
Entries.Description: Pryce Cahill was headed for golf greatness when an on-course meltdown derailed his career. Now struggling to stay afloat, he goes all in to mentor Santi—a teenage phenom with immense potential—and maybe save himself.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Pryce is down on his luck when a chance encounter at the driving range sends him on a mission to secure the opportunity of a lifetime.

Episodes.Title: Grossweiner's Law
Episodes.Description: Mitts and Pryce evaluate Santi's game over 18 holes. While testing out new clubs, Pryce tries to impart some wisdom about staying in the moment.

Episodes.Title: Daddy Issues
Episodes.Description: The gang hits the road in Mitts' RV. Pryce's coaching methods get tested in their first tourney. Santi makes a friend who unlocks his game.

Episodes.Title: Zero Sum Game
Episodes.Description: Pryce does everything he can to break through to Santi and get back to training. Zero is presented with an unexpected offer.

Episodes.Title: The Birdie Machine
Episodes.Description: Santi tees off at the qualifier with a new caddy as Pryce deploys covert coaching tactics. Mitts delivers harsh truths—and gets some right back.

Episodes.Title: RV Shangri-La
Episodes.Description: Ahead of the U.S. Amateur Championship, Pryce gives everyone a rest day on the campgrounds. Mitts takes a risk. Santi makes a painful discovery.

Episodes.Title: Dreams Never Remembered
Episodes.Description: After a blowup with Santi, Pryce is lost in thought about his past and what could've been. The gang prepare to go their separate ways.

Episodes.Title: Clark the Mark
Episodes.Description: A brazen plan is hatched to hustle Clark Ross. Pryce gets a chance to prove he was always the better golfer.

Episodes.Title: Showtime
Episodes.Description: Pryce tries to help Santi deal with the pressure of his first PGA tournament. Romantic sparks fly as Santi starts climbing the leaderboard.

Episodes.Title: Déjà Vu All Over Again
Episodes.Description: On the last day of the tournament, an unexpected visitor shakes things up while Santi's golf dreams hang in the balance.

Entries.Title: The Bondsman
Entries.Description: Backwoods bounty hunter Hub Halloran comes back from the dead with an unexpected second chance at life, love, and a nearly-forgotten musical career — only to find that his old job now has a demonic new twist.

Episodes.Title: Pot O'Gold
Episodes.Description: Hub Halloran starts out on an earthbound revenge story, but quickly realizes he might be in a supernatural one.

Episodes.Title: Valacor
Episodes.Description: Hub learns more about his new job working for the devil and encounters his first demon.

Episodes.Title: Marphos
Episodes.Description: Hub tries to turn Cade against Lucky and winds up using him for cover as he hunts another demon.

Episodes.Title: Erdos
Episodes.Description: Maryanne, on a mission to reprimand Hub for hurting Cade, stumbles into the world of demons.

Episodes.Title: Slypharis
Episodes.Description: Midge's emotional reason for joining Pot O' Gold comes to light. Hub puts together the pieces of a bigger mystery and tries to recruit Midge's help.

Episodes.Title: Revelations
Episodes.Description: Lucky exacts his revenge on Hub only to be caught in a demon battle.

Episodes.Title: Pyralis
Episodes.Description: Hub and Midge try to prevent the end times.

Episodes.Title: Lilith
Episodes.Description: Losing the thing he loves the most, Hub is finally forced to confront his greatest sin. He sets out for a last shot at redemption by stopping a demonic force that's been unleashed from Hell.

Entries.Title: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
Entries.Description: Amanda Knox arrives in Italy for her study abroad only to be wrongfully imprisoned for murder weeks later. Follow Knox's relentless fight to prove her innocence and reclaim her freedom and examines why authorities and the world stood so firmly in judgment.

Episodes.Title: Amanda
Episodes.Description: American college student, Amanda Knox, embarks on her study abroad trip in Italy. The morning before Amanda is supposed to leave on a romantic excursion with her new Italian boyfriend, Raffaele Sollecito, things take a sinister turn.

Episodes.Title: Ci vediamo più tardi ("See you later")
Episodes.Description: Under mounting pressure, the police try to break Amanda and Raffaele while Edda races to reunite with her daughter.

Episodes.Title: The Guardian of Perugia
Episodes.Description: As Amanda, Raffaele, and Patrick Lumumba enter prison, Giuliano Mignini, their prosecutor, continues to build his case against them while the media's reporting turns Amanda into a monster.

Episodes.Title: All You Need Is Love
Episodes.Description: A wrench is thrown in Mignini's case and the search for a new suspect, Rudy Guede, begins. As the highly anticipated trial unfolds, Amanda's choices continue to be scrutinized by the press.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Nobody
Episodes.Description: As the trial continues and Raffaele's days in prison turn to months and years, his heartbreaking history unfolds. Raffaele is urged to separate his defense from Amanda's before the verdict comes in.

Episodes.Title: Colpevole
Episodes.Description: After the verdict, Amanda falls into a depression, resigning herself to making the best of life in prison. As her appeal approaches and new facts come to light, Amanda decides she will not make the same mistakes that she made in her first trial.

Episodes.Title: U were there
Episodes.Description: After four years in prison for a crime they didn't commit, Amanda and Raffaele are free. Amanda gets to go home, but everything is unfamiliar and unrecognizable, including herself, and the public is still hell bent on seeing her suffer.

Episodes.Title: Libertá
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Your Friends & Neighbors
Entries.Description: When a financial titan suddenly finds himself divorced and jobless, he starts robbing his wealthy neighbors to stay afloat. Stealing from his own social circle strangely exhilarates him—but he gradually gets tangled in a deadly web.

Episodes.Title: This Is What Happens
Episodes.Description: After losing his high-powered job, Coop attends a neighbor's barbecue, where he faces his ex-wife Mel and makes a surprising choice.

Episodes.Title: Deuce
Episodes.Description: After an unsuccessful job interview, Coop pawns a stolen watch.

Episodes.Title: Theoretical Herpes
Episodes.Description: Nick throws a party for the neighborhood men, leading to tension between Coop and Paul. The women take a self-defense class.

Episodes.Title: Literal Dragons
Episodes.Description: An unlikely alliance begins. Nick throws Mel a surprise birthday party, where she connects with Coop.

Episodes.Title: This Tourist Has Balls
Episodes.Description: Coop and Elena sell a stolen painting. Barney tries to hide his financial struggles from his in-laws. Coop makes a discovery at Sam's home.

Episodes.Title: The Things You Lost Along the Way
Episodes.Description: After being investigated, Coop sets off on a college tour with Mel and their kids while Elena attempts to get ahold of him.

Episodes.Title: The First Honest Thing
Episodes.Description: Detective Lin makes a discovery at the crime scene. Coop plays hardball with Kat. Chivo puts Elena in a tough spot.

Episodes.Title: When Did We Become These People?
Episodes.Description: Coop tries getting back what he's lost. Mel and Sam clash. Coop, Nick, and Barney have a boys' night.

Episodes.Title: Everything Becomes Symbol and Irony
Episodes.Description: Coop fights for his freedom.

Entries.Title: Daredevil: Born Again
Entries.Description: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

Episodes.Title: Heaven's Half Hour
Episodes.Description: Matt Murdock gives up the mask. Wilson Fisk has his sights set to new heights.

Episodes.Title: Optics
Episodes.Description: Matt Murdock gets a new client who's more than he claims to be. Fisk learns the power of optics.

Episodes.Title: The Hollow of His Hand
Episodes.Description: The trial of Hector Ayala begins. Fisk's old business associates seek to claim his vacant mantle.

Episodes.Title: Sic Semper Systema
Episodes.Description: Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk's darker halves fight to be unleashed.

Episodes.Title: With Interest
Episodes.Description: A day in the life of Matt Murdock gets intense, forcing him to team up with a familiar face.

Episodes.Title: Excessive Force
Episodes.Description: When a serial killer terrorizes the streets of New York, the city needs a savior.

Episodes.Title: Art for Art's Sake
Episodes.Description: Daredevil is back and races Fisk to stop Muse from killing again.

Episodes.Title: Isle of Joy
Episodes.Description: At his inaugural Black and White Ball, Mayor Fisk tightens his grip on New York City.

Episodes.Title: Straight to Hell
Episodes.Description: Mayor Fisk becomes Mayor Kingpin, and Daredevil is unleashed as chaos takes over the city.

Entries.Title: Overcompensating
Entries.Description: Closeted former football player and homecoming king Benny becomes fast friends with Carmen, a high school outsider on a mission to fit in at all costs. With guidance from Benny's older sister and her campus-legend boyfriend, Benny and Carmen juggle horrible hookups, flavored vodka, and fake IDs.

Episodes.Title: Lucky
Episodes.Description: Benny Scanlon arrives at Yates and makes fast friends with Carmen at Orientation. Will Benny and Carmen be more than friends? Or will the fact that he’s totally… you know… get in the way? His sister Grace hooks him up with unflavored vodka for his pregame, while her boyfriend, Peter, imparts sage senior bro wisdom: get laid day one or suffer the consequences. The stakes couldn't be higher tbh.

Episodes.Title: Who's That Girl
Episodes.Description: Benny and Carmen scour the campus for fake IDs so they can join the rest of the freshmen class–including certified HOTTIE Miles–at Rock Bar. Peter comes through for Benny but not even Carmen's party girl roommate, Hailee, can help her out. Peter flakes on date night at the local Italian restaurant and Grace befriends an elderly woman (for her volunteer hours, duh!). Hailee throws up.

Episodes.Title: Black and Yellow
Episodes.Description: Benny gets noticed by a secret society and will stop at nothing to get his bestie / security blanket, Carmen, the same attention. Lucky for them, it's alumni tailgate weekend so she gets to show off her legendary drinking prowess. Peter gets some sobering news from a coked out "brother" and Grace reconnects with Mimi, who is back from her semester abroad. What sport is this tailgate for again?

Episodes.Title: Boom Clap
Episodes.Description: Benny gets caught in a lie so our main besties are in a fight. That won't stop Carmen from basking in her new legend status from the tailgate. While Grace works the Charli xcx concert, Peter hazes the F&G male pledges. Meanwhile, Carmen is psychologically tortured alongside the female pledges. :/ Oh! And the episode ends with "party 4 u"!

Episodes.Title: Scary Monsters and Nice Sprites
Episodes.Description: It's Halloweekend and Benny is still on the outs with Carmen so he and Miles have been getting… closer. Carmen and Hailee reconcile just as the latter enters her bad girl era. Grace calls Peter out for treating her like an assistant. Tensions (sexual and otherwise) rise at the annual Chem Party. But who will go home with who (or is it whom)? This episode is so good.

Episodes.Title: The Edge of Glory
Episodes.Description: Carmen expertly avoids confronting her disastrous love life while trying to help Benny with his. Grace confides in Janet who pushes her to explore other romantic endeavors. Peter does something drastic that's gonna make you go "oh my god dude" at the end. Oh, and Hailee has mono!

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Black Parade
Episodes.Description: Carmen tags along with Benny and Grace for an Idaho Thanksgiving, complete with karaoke, a fist fight, and some ghosts from the past. We are nothing if not consistent! Benny regresses in front of his dad, while Carmen and Grace start to understand each other a bit more over some vodka crans and onion rings. But Carmen is still keeping her devastating secret...

Episodes.Title: Crown on the Ground
Episodes.Description: It's finals week and relationships are put to the test (get it?). Carmen forces Benny to explain his web of lies, Grace makes a discovery, Peter goes to get what's his, Hailee wants to know where her performance enhancing meds are, and Miles wonders what he did wrong. Answers lead to more questions at the final Bader House party of the semester... your jaw is gonna be on the floor, sweetheart!

Entries.Title: Long Story Short
Entries.Description: From the creator of "BoJack Horseman" comes this animated comedy about a family over time, following siblings from childhood to adulthood and back again.

Episodes.Title: Yoshi's Bar Mitzvah
Episodes.Description: It's a night to remember when Avi brings his girlfriend home to meet the family on the same weekend his kid brother is becoming a man.

Episodes.Title: Hannah's Dance Recital
Episodes.Description: Shira and Kendra head north to attend a winter-themed dance recital in Santa Rosa... and to ask Avi a very important question.

Episodes.Title: There's a Mattress in There
Episodes.Description: With Elliott's blessing, Yoshi goes all-in on an exciting new business opportunity, inspired by a salesman wearing flip-flops.

Episodes.Title: Shira Can't Cook
Episodes.Description: To crush the competition at a high-stakes school potluck, Shira tries making knishes — her mother's most difficult recipe.

Episodes.Title: Yoshi & Baby
Episodes.Description: Yoshi's determined to come through for his sister and be responsible. But a chance meeting while waiting in line for potato ice cream changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Wolves
Episodes.Description: While trying to address the "wolf situation" at Hannah's school, Avi teams up with a group of parents who take things a little too far.

Episodes.Title: Kendra's Job
Episodes.Description: Kendra weighs the pros and cons of putting work before personal relationships when she's accepted into a management training program.

Episodes.Title: The Intervention
Episodes.Description: The truth comes out when the kids come home for an awkward conversation under the guise of celebrating their parents' anniversary.

Episodes.Title: Honoring Naomi Schwartz
Episodes.Description: A special event at the Jewish Community Center puts Naomi in the spotlight — but it's the same night as Shira's prom.

Episodes.Title: Uncle Barry
Episodes.Description: A somber occasion brings everyone together in Las Vegas, leading to a surprise family gathering in the desert.

Entries.Title: The Institute
Entries.Description: When 14 year old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won’t last, as his story and Luke’s are destined to collide.

Episodes.Title: The Boy
Episodes.Description: Luke Ellis wakes up at The Institute, a facility that abducts teenagers with psychic powers. Ms. Sigsby, the place's charismatic director, claims they're saving the world. Meanwhile, Tim Jamieson hides from his haunted past as a small-town night knocker.

Episodes.Title: Shots for Dots
Episodes.Description: Luke bonds with the other Front Half residents, begins plotting his escape. Meanwhile, Ms. Sigsby manages the fallout from a security breach. In town, Tim begins to look into The Institute, only to find himself caught up in a high-stakes standoff.

Episodes.Title: Graduation
Episodes.Description: Luke begins to plan his escape while Sigsby is distracted trying to expose Stackhouse's disloyalty. Meanwhile, Tim loses a friend.

Episodes.Title: The Box
Episodes.Description: As Luke's tests intensify, a new arrival causes problems for Sigsby; Tim isn't buying the official story about what happened to Annie.

Episodes.Title: Back Half
Episodes.Description: Sigsby tricks Luke into confirming he's TP, forcing him to move up his escape attempt; Tim's suspicions put him on the Institute's radar.

Episodes.Title: Run
Episodes.Description: As Tim's investigation pays off in ways he never imagined and Sigsby scrambles to avert disaster, Luke must finally decide who he can trust.

Episodes.Title: Hide
Episodes.Description: Luke and Tim go on a desperate search for help as Sigsby uses all of her formidable assets in a last-ditch attempt to keep the Institute's secrets.

Entries.Title: The Better Sister
Entries.Description: Chloe moves in New York's most elite circles with her lawyer husband Adam and teenage son Ethan by her side while her estranged sister Nicky tries to make ends meet and stay clean. When Adam is brutally murdered, the investigation sends shockwaves through the family and exposes long-buried secrets.

Episodes.Title: She's My Sister
Episodes.Description: Chloe Taylor has the biggest night of her career, and not a day later her husband winds up dead. Now cops are asking a lot of questions she doesn't want to answer, and even worse, they called her sister.

Episodes.Title: Lotta Sky
Episodes.Description: Chloe and her sister Nicky are back together but things are bumpy, and not just because Detective Guidry seems too interested in Ethan.

Episodes.Title: Incoming Widow
Episodes.Description: A day in court doesn't go as planned, and Chloe goes somewhere surprising for emotional support.

Episodes.Title: Gazpacho
Episodes.Description: Catherine throws a memorial for Adam that no one wants to go to. Chloe and Nicky have very different memories of just about everything.

Episodes.Title: Just Ask
Episodes.Description: Nicky tries to shake off a bad night. Chloe tries to figure out what Adam was up to when he died. And the trial is starting.

Episodes.Title: Steadying Hand
Episodes.Description: The sisters take the stand, but what truth will they tell? Guidry's temper flares.

Episodes.Title: Back from Red
Episodes.Description: Adam's darkest secret finally comes out, and it changes everything for Chloe and Nicky. Guidry and Bowen go back to basics.

Episodes.Title: They're in Their World
Episodes.Description: Chloe enacts a plan, Guidry takes a trip, Nicky explains a few key details, and the sisters try to figure out if being in each other's lives is even possible.

Entries.Title: UNTAMED
Entries.Description: In the vast expanse of Yosemite National Park, a woman's death draws a federal agent into lawless terrain — where nature obeys no rules but its own.

Episodes.Title: A Celestial Event
Episodes.Description: When a woman fatally falls from El Capitan, special agent Kyle Turner suspects it wasn't an accident — and that the truth may lie deep within Yosemite.

Episodes.Title: Jane Doe
Episodes.Description: The mystery around Jane Doe deepens as Turner and Vasquez investigate a strange symbol and visit a remote encampment in the woods.

Episodes.Title: El-o'-win
Episodes.Description: Jane Doe's identity raises new questions about the life she left behind — and connects to an old case that has haunted Turner for years.

Episodes.Title: Gold Rush
Episodes.Description: A grim discovery in the mines makes Turner question the squatters' role in the case. Vasquez fights to protect her son when his father reappears.

Episodes.Title: Terces
Episodes.Description: Turner takes the investigation to new extremes — with serious repercussions. Jill gets caught up in Vasquez's conflict with her ex.

Episodes.Title: All Trails Lead Here
Episodes.Description: As the investigation comes to a close, Turner discovers the truth about Lucy's death — and the long-buried secrets that set it in motion.

Entries.Title: Motorheads
Entries.Description: After moving to Ironwood, siblings Caitlyn and Zac Torres are drawn into a thrilling car culture where street racing reigns and high school status is all about your ride. Haunted by their father's dark past, they join forces with loner Curtis and outcast Marcel to rebuild his legendary car.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: New kids Caitlyn and Zac Torres navigate the hierarchy of Ironwood High School, and try to avoid the dark cloud of their notorious father. Logan struggles to make ends meet. Caitlyn meets Curtis, a loner caught in a tug of war between his father, the Sheriff, and his brother, a local criminal. Zac befriends the "unpopular" Marcel, while making an enemy of street racing champ, Harris Bowers.

Episodes.Title: Glow
Episodes.Description: Sparks fly at the annual Ironwood Firefly Festival. Caitlyn decides to take a leap of faith. Zac jumps the gun on his mission to race Harris Bowers. Marcel unveils his signature logo. Curtis is pulled into the seedy world of his brother, Ray. And Uncle Logan is presented with an opportunity.

Episodes.Title: Assessment
Episodes.Description: Urged by Logan to repair his friendship with Marcel, Zac suggests they go to an unreasonably dangerous Go-Kart track. Curtis invites Caitlyn to a family BBQ, where a surprising guest joins them. Harris prepares for an upcoming street takeover. Sam discovers how much Ironwood has changed, while Logan reminds her that the best parts of Ironwood will always be there.

Episodes.Title: Disassemble
Episodes.Description: Zac and Curtis skip school together and watch some high octane drag racing at an abandoned air strip, run by Curtis' brother, Ray. Kiara invites Caitlyn to lunch, which turns into a group outing. A video of Harris Bowers' street takeover is mocked online, leading to an exhilarating street race. Zac asks Logan to train him, just like he taught his brother, Zac's dad, years ago.

Episodes.Title: Value
Episodes.Description: Car auction in Ironwood. A nostalgic Sam considers bidding on her old car. Marcel convinces his dad, Wade, to make his famous chili. Logan takes Caitlyn's advice and starts a car restoration side gig. Zac has a secret street race. And realizing everyone else has a spot, Caitlyn finds hers.

Episodes.Title: Reassemble
Episodes.Description: Marcel gets bad news about his dad, so the crew takes him to White Knuckle Run, an ATV dirt motocross event in nearby West Newton. Logan and Sam take a road trip to see Marcel's mom. Sheriff Hugo Young enlists Ray's help finding some local criminals. Harris challenges Zac.

Episodes.Title: Red, Green, Blue
Episodes.Description: With only three weeks until Zac's race with Harris, the crew works overtime to finish the UNB10 car. Zac's confidence grows with Ray's guidance. Caitlyn and Curtis discover a possible clue to Christian Maddox's whereabouts. Logan discovers who Zac's been training with. Harris faces a new challenge on his mom's birthday memorial. Curtis takes Brooke for a ride on his bike.

Episodes.Title: Wiring
Episodes.Description: Homecoming. Marcel and Brooke's post-apocalyptic themed dance is a big hit. Zac hopes to meet up with Alicia. Hitting an electrical snag with the car, Caitlyn and Curtis wonder if they should skip the dance. Sam and Darren Bowers co-chaperone, looking out for “commotion.” Kiara is fed up with Noah. And one of the bank robbers from 17 years ago gets out of prison.

Episodes.Title: Ignition
Episodes.Description: It's time to turn the key on the UNB10 car, but will it start? Zac gets a big race at the speedway, but with an unexpected opponent. Ryan asks Harris to meet someone. Brooke and Curtis grow closer. Logan and Hugo are out of options. Marcel and Brooke become “friendly” rivals.

Episodes.Title: Redbird
Episodes.Description: UNB10 is ready for the big race, but is Zac? Caitlyn visits Buzz at the junkyard, wondering what's next for her. Marcel takes a leap of faith. Brooke prepares for her winter break. Curtis confronts his father. Logan attempts to get out of Ezra's plan. Kiara stands up to her mom. And Harris, feeling lost and alone, reaches out to Alicia.

Entries.Title: Marvel Zombies
Entries.Description: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

Entries.Description: Go inside Canelo Álvarez and Terence Crawford's training camps and personal lives as they prepare for their once in a lifetime super middleweight matchup.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Canelo and Crawford spend time with their families, trainers and teams and reflect on their rise from promising beginners to boxing elites.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: In the thin air of the Sierra Nevada Mountains, Canelo begins camp. Crawford fine-tunes his mental fortitude and puts on pounds with precision.

Entries.Title: Dope Thief
Entries.Description: Two lifelong friends in Philadelphia pose as DEA agents to rob small-time drug dealers. It's a perfect grift—until they choose the wrong mark and become targets of a massive narcotics enterprise.

Episodes.Title: Jolly Ranchers
Episodes.Description: Ray and Manny decide their fake drug busts could be more lucrative, so they recruit a third partner and target an unassuming country house.

Episodes.Title: Bat Out of Hell
Episodes.Description: Dealing with the repercussions of their robbery gone wrong, Ray and Manny go into hiding while trying to keep their families safe.

Episodes.Title: Run, Die, or Relapse
Episodes.Description: Ray combs the streets looking for Manny as the biker gang closes in. DEA agents search for new leads in their hunt for Ray.

Episodes.Title: Philadelphia Lawyer
Episodes.Description: Ray enlists Son’s help with the biker gang. Manny descends deeper into despair. Agents pressure Michelle as a way to get to Ray.

Episodes.Title: Fear of God
Episodes.Description: Manny feels compelled to make amends. Mina digs into Jack's part in the operation. An unexpected person comes to Ray's rescue.

Episodes.Title: Love Songs from Mars
Episodes.Description: Ray refuses to go to the hospital as the situation at Theresa’s house unfolds into chaos.

Episodes.Title: Mussolini
Episodes.Description: Agents devise a plan to see if Ray knows more than he's letting on. Sherry gives Manny news.

Episodes.Title: Innocent People
Episodes.Description: Ray comes clean and finds an unlikely ally in his search for the truth.

Entries.Title: The Rainmaker
Entries.Description: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head to head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend, Sarah. Rudy, along with his boss, Bruiser, and her disheveled paralegal, Deck, uncovers two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor confronts Leo F. Drummond in a medical malpractice case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Rudy and Deck have a tense encounter with a witness and make a crucial discovery about their client.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: As Rudy and Deck search for a missing nurse, their investigation suggests a dark conspiracy at play.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: When Sarah reveals a detail about the case, Rudy must choose between his client and his girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Worried about Melvin's threat, Rudy defies Bruiser and risks his job and future as Dot's attorney.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Rudy continues to defend his client; Sarah faces new temptations in London with Leo and Brad.

Entries.Title: KPOPPED
Entries.Description: Global music icons team up with world-renowned K-pop idols for spectacular song battles. Performing their biggest hits with a K-pop twist, these artists show up, show out, and shut it down in a friendly competition for the ultimate bragging rights.

Episodes.Title: Megan Thee Stallion. Patti LaBelle. Billlie.
Episodes.Description: The H-Town Hottie, the Godmother of Soul, and Billlie bring the heat as “Savage” takes on “Lady Marmalade.”

Episodes.Title: Spice Girls (Emma & Mel B). ITZY.
Episodes.Description: A mini Spice Girls reunion combined with an ITZY collab lead to a showstopping showdown between “Wannabe” and “Say You'll Be There.”

Episodes.Title: Vanilla Ice. Taylor Dayne. Kep1er.
Episodes.Description: The ‘90s rapper and the powerhouse belter join forces with Kep1er for a fierce face-off between “Ice Ice Baby” and “Tell It to My Heart.”

Episodes.Title: Eve. Kesha. JO1.
Episodes.Description: K-pop meets J-pop as the 11-member Japanese boy band JO1 hits the stage for Eve's “Let Me Blow Ya Mind” versus Kesha's “JOYRIDE.”

Episodes.Title: Kylie Minogue. J Balvin. ATEEZ.
Episodes.Description: It's a global megahit mashup when ATEEZ performs the Aussie's “Can't Get You Out of My Head” and the Colombiano's “Mi Gente.”

Episodes.Title: Boy George. TLC. STAYC.
Episodes.Description: STAYC wows the crowd in an electrifying battle between Culture Club's “Karma Chameleon” and TLC's “Waterfalls.”

Episodes.Title: Ava Max. Jess Glynne. KISS OF LIFE.
Episodes.Description: The U.S. and U.K. pop divas came to slay as KISS OF LIFE serves a double dose of high-energy vibes with “Kings & Queens” and “Hold My Hand.”

Episodes.Title: Boyz II Men. BLACKSWAN.
Episodes.Description: The best-selling R&B group of all time teams up with BLACKSWAN to pit “Motownphilly” against “End of the Road.”

Entries.Title: Doc
Entries.Description: Dr. Amy Larsen must navigate an unfamiliar world after a brain injury erases the last eight years of her life. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience.

Episodes.Title: If at First You Don't Succeed…
Episodes.Description: When Chief of Internal Medicine Dr. Amy Larsen suffers a catastrophic brain injury, her life is turned upside down. Still determined to once again practice medicine, she charts a new path forward, ready to face whatever obstacles stand in her way.

Episodes.Title: ...Try Try Again
Episodes.Description: While at the hospital recovering, Amy can’t help but insert herself into her roommate’s case. Meanwhile, all the other doctors and nurses have to adjust to the once formidable Chief now being the patient.

Episodes.Title: Day One
Episodes.Description: Amy, allowed to return to work under strict guidelines, teams up with TJ to treat a patient suffering from mysterious liver problems. Sonya and Jake help an elderly couple navigate the final chapter of their love story.

Episodes.Title: One Small Step
Episodes.Description: Amy must confront who she has become after the tragedy that struck her family seven years ago. Sonya and TJ disagree on how to treat a sick Marine, and Amy and Jake make a life-changing discovery about an Alzheimer’s patient.

Episodes.Title: He Ain't Heavy
Episodes.Description: Amy and Sonya endeavor to help a teen in need of a bone marrow transplant and his younger brother whose own health issues jeopardize his disability to donate. Jake deals with a fainting bride and her worried groom. Michael struggles with a secret he’s been keeping.

Episodes.Title: Once More, with Feeling
Episodes.Description: It’s a race against time as Amy and Jake try to uncover the cause of a unique patient’s worsening condition. Gina treats a quirky hypochondriac, and Amy makes a shocking discovery about her pre-accident love life.

Episodes.Title: Secrets and Lies
Episodes.Description: Sonya wrestles with treating a guy from her past and must rely on Amy to help her. Richard deals with a family situation. Jake and TJ debate the moral implications of a diagnosis.

Episodes.Title: Man Plans
Episodes.Description: Amy and Richard reconnect while treating a patient whose diagnosis is not at all what it seems. A real life romcom comes to Westside Hospital, bringing love to the forefront of everyone's mind.

Episodes.Title: What Goes Up…
Episodes.Description: Amy, finally allowed to practice medicine again without supervision, struggles to diagnose her most complicated patient yet: TJ’s Dad. Sonya and Jake treat a single mom who’s reluctant to stay in the hospital. Richard tires to contain the truth about Dixon.

Episodes.Title: …Must Come Down
Episodes.Description: A mass casualty event requires all hands on deck at Westside Hospital. Amidst the chaos, Gina deals with a devastating revelation and Amy’s forced to confront her demons.

Episodes.Title: Her Heart
Episodes.Description: Amy's past comes back to haunt her when a desperate father sacrifices everything to secure his daughter's heart transplant.
