Entries.Title: Lazarus
Entries.Description: In 2052, a Nobel Prize-winning neuroscientist develops a drug called Hapna — a cure-all that has the unexpected side-effect of causing death three years later. In response to this threat, a special force of agents—nicknamed "Lazarus"— is assembled to take on the malevolent Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye Cruel World
Episodes.Description: The miracle drug, Hapna, now threatens to wipe out humanity. A chronic jail-breaker named Axel is asked to find the only man with a cure: Dr. Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Life in the Fast Lane
Episodes.Description: Genius hacker Eleina finds a potential lead to Skinner. The Lazarus team splits into two groups to investigate it, but both end up getting shot at.

Episodes.Title: Long Way from Home
Episodes.Description: Searching Skinner's house and interviewing his old colleague reveals a new lead. Axel and Leland go to Istanbul but have trouble with local thugs.

Episodes.Title: Don't Stop the Dance
Episodes.Description: The team investigates a club owned by a stockbroker who got rich off Hapna. One of his associates is the hacker Dr. 909, who may be helping Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Pretty Vacant
Episodes.Description: The team tries to lure Skinner out of hiding with a fake cure staged by the president of Delta Medicinal, but a hacker named Popcorn Wizard butts in.

Episodes.Title: Heaven Is a Place on Earth
Episodes.Description: A secluded commune where Eleina once lived is identified as a potential hiding spot for Skinner. She and Leland infiltrate it to find out for sure.

Episodes.Title: Almost Blue
Episodes.Description: Coordinates from an AI lead to islands that Skinner bought just before they sunk under rising sea levels. The team visit them hoping to learn more.

Episodes.Title: Unforgettable Fire
Episodes.Description: Chris is held captive on an arctic oil rig by Russian operatives. The team unites to save her, despite learning Chris was once a Russian spy herself.

Episodes.Title: Death on Two Legs
Episodes.Description: An inquiry is held at the Pentagon to determine the future of Lazarus where information emerges that prompts Schneider of INSCOM to hire an assassin.

Episodes.Title: I Can't Tell You Why
Episodes.Description: Skinner's medical history provides a lead but requires entry to a private clinic. Leland takes Axel and Doug to his home to secure them an invite.

Episodes.Title: Runnin' with the Devil
Episodes.Description: Doug and Eleina go to Islamabad seeking the elusive hacker but are pursued by INSCOM. Meanwhile, Axel gets into a chaotic fight with the assassin.

Episodes.Title: Close to the Edge
Episodes.Description: Eleina gets a lead to Skinner from Popcorn Wizard, but with Hersch, Axel, and Doug out of commission, it's up to Chris and Leland to crack the case.

Episodes.Title: The World Is Yours
Episodes.Description: Abel conducts a raid to free Hersch, while Axel sneaks off to face his nemesis. The rest of the team pursues Skinner in a final bid to save humanity.

Entries.Title: Sherlock & Daughter
Entries.Description: Sherlock Holmes faces a sinister case risking friends' lives. American Amelia joins, seeking her father after her mother's murder. Despite differences, they solve a conspiracy and her mother's case.

Episodes.Title: The Challenge
Episodes.Description: Blackmailed and sidelined from investigating, Sherlock Holmes finds hope when a young woman arrives on his doorstep, potentially holding the key to solving the kidnapping of an ambassador's daughter.

Episodes.Title: The Common Thread
Episodes.Description: While Sherlock chases a stolen carriage, he sends Amelia on a hunt across London; Amelia has her own ideas and follows her intuition closer to answers but even closer to danger.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Crime
Episodes.Description: Amelia goes under cover to search for clues at Clara's home; Sherlock goes to prison under pretense of meeting his forever foe, Moriarty.

Episodes.Title: For Kith & Kin
Episodes.Description: Amelia withholds details from Holmes after encountering a charming man with a pistol, but Sherlock must step in when her investigation turns fatal.

Episodes.Title: Doubting Thomas
Episodes.Description: Sherlock searches for the missing jewels and their connection to the kidnapping of his friends; he turns to the insurance investigator, Birtwistle, for his assistance.

Episodes.Title: Sound Connections
Episodes.Description: As Sherlock and Amelia identify the villains surrounding them on all sides, Holmes repays a favor to his oldest enemy, arranging a meeting between Professor Moriarty and the young Australian man who has suddenly become very close to Amelia.

Episodes.Title: The Golden Fleece
Episodes.Description: Having cracked the code of the Red Thread's communications network, Sherlock is hot on the path of the kidnap victims, chasing a trail of breadcrumbs that leads all the way to the vaults of the Bank of England.

Episodes.Title: The Last Dance
Episodes.Description: Having unmasked the Red Thread syndicate, Sherlock and Amelia must confront their enemies at the most anticipated debutante ball of the season.

Entries.Title: On Call
Entries.Description: Traci Harmon, a veteran female training officer, and her rookie male ride-along, Alex Diaz, navigate the loss of a fellow officer and politics of modern day policing  — in the department and on the streets of Long Beach.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: In the wake of tragedy, LBPD training officer Traci Harmon takes on new trainee, Alex Diaz who on day one is already learning the job is harder than he imagined.

Episodes.Title: Laws of the Universe
Episodes.Description: A chaotic street takeover finds our officers grossly outnumbered, revealing philosophical rifts inside West Division.

Episodes.Title: South of Heaven
Episodes.Description: Diaz learns that Harmon has enemies within West Division, and begins to fear she cannot be trusted.

Episodes.Title: Unsung
Episodes.Description: Desperate for a lead, Harmon goes off book resulting in a major breakthrough and a deadly showdown.

Episodes.Title: Not Your Savior
Episodes.Description: Back on patrol, the rift between Harmon and Diaz comes to a head.

Episodes.Title: L.A. Woman
Episodes.Description: When Diaz's family is threatened, Harmon realizes she must break her own rules to fix it.

Episodes.Title: War Machine
Episodes.Description: A shot caller's revenge mission results in West Division going head to head with an entire gang.

Episodes.Title: How the West Was Won
Episodes.Description: Harmon and Diaz join forces with an elite squad to intercept a major drug shipment.

Entries.Title: The Residence
Entries.Description: A brilliant, eccentric detective must solve a murder in the White House residence — where the staff and guests at a state dinner are all suspects.

Episodes.Title: The Fall of the House of Usher
Episodes.Description: At a Congressional hearing, the story of a mysterious death at the White House, and the brilliant detective hired to crack the case, begins to unfold.

Episodes.Title: Dial M for Murder
Episodes.Description: From celebrities and Cabinet members to plumbers and pastry chefs, everyone is in the hot seat as Cordelia conducts interviews.

Episodes.Title: Knives Out
Episodes.Description: Simmering conflicts in the White House kitchen offer Cordelia a delicious opportunity to uncover clues.

Episodes.Title: The Last of Sheila
Episodes.Description: Irrepressible butler Sheila has risen from Waffle House to the White House. But her misbehavior at the state dinner arouses Cordelia's suspicions.

Episodes.Title: The Trouble with Harry
Episodes.Description: A surprise tip points Cordelia to three of the President's lesser-known housemates: his brother Tripp, his mother-in-law Nan and his top advisor, Harry.

Episodes.Title: The Third Man
Episodes.Description: As dawn breaks, Cordelia faces pressure to end the residence's lockdown. Meanwhile, in the present day, a fresh testimony upends the Senate hearing.

Episodes.Title: The Adventure of the Engineer's Thumb
Episodes.Description: Elsyie, a housekeeper, is the most-liked employee in the residence. But Cordelia suspects there's more to her than meets the eye.

Episodes.Title: The Mystery of the Yellow Room
Episodes.Description: As the clock ticks down on her investigation, Cordelia is ready to reveal the murderer in the residence — even if she has to do it on the fly.

Entries.Title: Devil May Cry
Entries.Description: When a mysterious villain threatens to open the gates of Hell, a devilishly handsome demon hunter could be the world's best hope for salvation.

Episodes.Title: Inferno
Episodes.Description: A violent heist at a Vatican City museum sparks chaos, pulling unsuspecting demon hunter Dante into a sinister plot to forge a rift between worlds.

Episodes.Title: Our Lady of Sorrows
Episodes.Description: In Washington, DARKCOM gathers a group of mercenaries and offers a bounty to bring in Dante — and the family heirloom that hangs around his neck.

Episodes.Title: The Deep and Savage Way
Episodes.Description: A flashback sheds light on Mary's past. In the present, a convoy with precious cargo hits a roadblock as the White Rabbit creeps closer to his prey.

Episodes.Title: All Hope Abandon
Episodes.Description: The amulet's signal leads DARKCOM to a run-down apartment building. But is it really the Rabbit's lair... or a trap? Dante learns his true origins.

Episodes.Title: Descent
Episodes.Description: Grim discoveries complicate Mary's mission. An exhilarating free fall fuels an epic transformation, forcing Dante to confront his demon side.

Episodes.Title: The First Circle
Episodes.Description: A revealing trip down the rabbit hole yields a haunting tale of two childhoods — parallel stories with intertwining fates.

Episodes.Title: At the Gates of Paradise
Episodes.Description: The stage is set for the ultimate showdown as the Rabbit and his army lie in wait for Dante to arrive. But there's more than one hero ready to fight.

Episodes.Title: A River of Blood and Fire
Episodes.Description: Dante and Mary face impossible choices — and an enemy more powerful than the world has ever seen. In the aftermath, Baines puts a bold plan into motion.

Entries.Title: Eyes of Wakanda
Entries.Description: Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

Episodes.Title: Into the Lion's Den
Episodes.Description: A former member of the Dora Milaje is sent to take down a rogue Wakandan known as The Lion.

Episodes.Title: Legends and Lies
Episodes.Description: Amidst the Trojan War, a soldier attempts to breach the city's defenses to retrieve an artifact.

Episodes.Title: Lost and Found
Episodes.Description: A powerful stowaway infiltrates the Golden City and threatens the secrets kept within.

Episodes.Title: The Last Panther
Episodes.Description: Two Wakandans must choose to complete their mission or defy their homeland and save their world.

Entries.Title: American Primeval
Entries.Description: A mother and son fleeing from their past form a found family while confronting a harsh landscape of freedom and cruelty in the American West.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: At a desolate outpost, Sara and her son Devin forge new connections while searching for a guide to help them navigate treacherous trails further west.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: A frightening encounter takes Sara's party by surprise. A deeply wounded Jacob forms a posse to find Abish. Isaac reconnects with his past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Following a lead, Jacob joins a bounty hunter's search. Brigham Young rides into Fort Bridger. Sara, Devin and Isaac come face-to-face with evil.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Red Feather vows to fight, Jacob acts on his suspicions and Abish receives shocking news. En route to Crooks Springs, the elements intensify.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: As Devin's leg worsens, Sara faces a terrifying choice. Brigham Young makes Bridger an offer. Abish delivers a stark warning to the Shoshone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Ignoring the danger, Isaac sets out to rescue Sara. Jacob's search for Abish comes to an end. Bridger celebrates before saying good-bye.

Entries.Title: Paradise
Entries.Description: The tranquility in a serene, wealthy community inhabited by some of the world's most prominent individuals explodes when a shocking murder occurs and a high stakes investigation unfolds.

Episodes.Title: Wildcat Is Down
Episodes.Description: It's just another day in Paradise until Agent Xavier Collins discovers one of the world's most powerful individuals has been viciously murdered. Xavier analyzes the crime scene while recalling his complex relationship with the victim.

Episodes.Title: Sinatra
Episodes.Description: Agent Xavier Collins is interrogated. Samantha Redmond (codename Sinatra) begins to reassure the community as she reflects on how she got to Paradise.

Episodes.Title: The Architect of Social Well-Being
Episodes.Description: Isolated, Xavier seeks answers on his own and cautiously turns to Dr. Gabriela Torabi. Meanwhile, Billy and Jane feel the pressure from Robinson's investigation.

Episodes.Title: Agent Billy Pace
Episodes.Description: The citizens of Paradise celebrate at the annual carnival. Xavier and Billy delve deeper into their investigation.

Episodes.Title: In the Palaces of Crowned Kings
Episodes.Description: Xavier faces the consequences of his investigation, forcing him to consider how to proceed. Meanwhile Cal's family history and his last days are examined.

Episodes.Title: You Asked for Miracles
Episodes.Description: Xavier and Robinson set their plans in motion while Sinatra works to preserve the status quo in Paradise.

Episodes.Title: The Day
Episodes.Description: Sinatra and Xavier confront the past, returning to the harrowing day that brought them to Paradise.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Kept the Secrets
Episodes.Description: Xavier and Robinson race to find President Bradford’s murderer before it's too late.

Entries.Title: Monster: The Ed Gein Story
Entries.Description: The shocking true-life tale of Ed Gein, the infamous murderer and grave robber who inspired many of Hollywood's most iconic on-screen killers.

Entries.Title: Dept. Q
Entries.Description: A brash but brilliant cop becomes head of a new police department, where he leads an unlikely team of misfits in solving Edinburgh's cold cases.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: DCI Carl Morck returns to work after a near-fatal incident and finds himself head of a new department. A prosecutor faces a tough day in court.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As Carl and his new assistant start digging into their first cold case, he can't stop his personal demons encroaching on his professional life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Carl and Akram recreate the fateful ferry journey on their way to the Isle of Mhòr. A frustrated Rose makes her case for joining their Department.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Rose goes to the island to find out what Carl couldn't. Akram finds a note which sends the investigation in an entirely new direction.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The prosecutor's disappearance becomes connected with a death. A scuffle in a newspaper office sees Carl making headlines, and Moira sees a therapist.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The police detain a suspect for the Leith Park shooting. Carl returns to the scene of the crime, before losing his temper in public once again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Carl makes some dangerous allegations to some powerful men, while Rose takes a fresh angle to uncover more information about Sam Haig.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The kidnappers give their victim a clue as they press her for an answer to their question. Dept. Q gets closer to unravelling its own riddle.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: A decades-old recording helps all the clues to fall into place. But as the pressure rises — in and out of the chamber — can Carl get there in time?

Entries.Title: Zero Day
Entries.Description: A former U.S. President is called out of retirement to find the source of a deadly cyberattack, only to discover a vast web of lies and conspiracies.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Former President George Mullen's comfortable retirement is upended after he's asked to lead an investigation into a horrific cyberattack.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Mullen's commission investigates a hacking ring. President Mitchell weighs retaliation. A powerful figure has demands for Roger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Mullen's initial arrests draw blowback from the public — especially TV pundit Evan Green. Alex faces pressure to investigate her father.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: A shock to the financial system increases scrutiny on Mullen's commission. Valerie investigates Proteus. Roger must make a difficult choice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A personal tragedy reopens old wounds for the Mullen family. Speaker Dreyer pushes for a change in leadership. Sheila testifies before Congress.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A new threat creates further unrest across the nation. As he narrows in on the culprit, Mullen is faced with an agonizing decision.

Entries.Title: Revival
Entries.Description: On one miraculous day in rural Wisconsin, the recently deceased suddenly rise from their graves. But this is no zombie story, as the 'revived' appear and act just like they once were. When local officer and single mother Dana Cypress is unexpectedly thrown into the center of a brutal murder mystery of her own, she's left to make sense of the chaos amidst a town gripped by fear and confusion where everyone, alive or undead, is a suspect.

Episodes.Title: Don't Tell Dad
Episodes.Description: When the recently deceased return to life, appearing normal and unchanged, Officer Dana Cypress is thrust into a peculiar murder investigation-one where the murder victim is now alive, and everyone, whether living or revived, is a suspect.

Episodes.Title: Keeping Up Appearances
Episodes.Description: While a dangerous Reviver jeopardizes the peace in Wausau, Dana’s Reviver investigation becomes personal and threatens to unravel secrets she may not be ready to face.

Episodes.Title: Reality Check
Episodes.Description: As Wausau fractures, Dana's search brings her into conflict with a dangerous local family.

Episodes.Title: Run Along Little Lamb
Episodes.Description: A new mandate targets Revivers as Em's memories spark a violent reckoning with brutal costs.

Episodes.Title: Triage
Episodes.Description: With Dana's fate uncertain, Wayne searches for answers as Em races the clock to save her.

Episodes.Title: Bloodlines
Episodes.Description: As Wayne peels back the layers of a disturbing crime ring, Ibrahim makes a key discovery. But then a chilling abduction puts the Cypress family in danger and the clock is ticking.

Episodes.Title: Too Many Secrets
Episodes.Description: With Wausau under martial law, Wayne struggles to shield his daughters from the rising chaos, while a shocking ally emerges and changes the course of the investigation.

Episodes.Title: A Rose and a Thorn
Episodes.Description: The past collides with the present, as an old case and some old friends help Dana and Em piece together the chilling truth about Revival Day's origins.

Episodes.Title: Mother of Babylon
Episodes.Description: Dana and Wayne race to thwart Blaine Abel’s plans, as a captive Em desperately faces off with her inner demons and General Cale’s own intentions for the Revivers of Wausau.

Episodes.Title: Rend the Veil
Episodes.Description: In the shocking season finale, Dana and Em uncover the horrifying truth about Revival Day, but at an unimaginable cost that changes the Cypress family and Wausau forever.

Entries.Title: The Hunting Wives
Entries.Description: Sophie trades New England for East Texas and falls into a wealthy socialite's magnetic orbit — where a clique of housewives hide deadly secrets.

Episodes.Title: Strange and Unfamiliar Places
Episodes.Description: New to East Texas, Sophie O'Neil bonds with the alluring Margo Banks, who shows Sophie another side of life.

Episodes.Title: Knockin' Boots
Episodes.Description: Jed considers a run for governor. Margo aims to protect their privacy as the Hunting Wives navigate behind closed doors. The dead blond woman in the woods is found.

Episodes.Title: Sunrise Tells the Story
Episodes.Description: Margo has a surprise for Sophie and Callie's jealousy grows, as does Jill's concerns. A chilly discovery is made about the unidentified dead woman.

Episodes.Title: Cheat Day
Episodes.Description: After a body is discovered in the woods, tensions ignite as Margo and Brad rush to align their stories. Sophie searches for her missing handgun.

Episodes.Title: Not Her First Rodeo
Episodes.Description: Sophie desperately tries to manage her situation. Jill is determined to protect her son at all costs.

Episodes.Title: Deep in the Heart of Texas
Episodes.Description: Determined to prove her innocence, Sophie searches for answers. Margo hits the campaign trail. Nina's fondness for Pete grows.

Episodes.Title: Shooting Star
Episodes.Description: New information in Abby's murder investigation threatens to seal the fate of Sophie and the Hunting Wives. Starr discovers an unbearable truth.

Episodes.Title: Sophie's Choice
Episodes.Description: With Nina's safe return, Pete's suicide and Abby's killer shot dead, Sophie and Margo rest easy knowing the murder is solved, or so they think.

Entries.Title: Dying for Sex
Entries.Description: After Molly Kochan receives a diagnosis of Stage IV metastatic breast cancer, she leaves her husband and explores the full breadth and complexity of her sexual desires for the first time in her life.

Episodes.Title: Good Value Diet Soda
Episodes.Description: Molly leans on her best friend Nikki after receiving a distressing diagnosis.

Episodes.Title: Masturbation Is Important
Episodes.Description: Molly dodges her treatment plan and follows her own desires. Nikki struggles in her new role as Molly's caretaker.

Episodes.Title: Feelings Can Become Amplified
Episodes.Description: Molly tries to maintain a positive attitude despite disturbances from her new neighbor.

Episodes.Title: Topping Is a Sacred Skill
Episodes.Description: Molly and Nikki attend a sex party, and Molly's desires lead her to unexpected places.

Episodes.Title: My Pet
Episodes.Description: Molly's mother, Gail, comes for a visit.

Episodes.Title: Happy Holidays
Episodes.Description: Molly confronts her past, as Nikki struggles to find balance.

Episodes.Title: You’re Killing Me, Ernie
Episodes.Description: Molly has a visitor at the hospital.

Episodes.Title: It's Not That Serious
Episodes.Description: Molly reflects on her life.

Entries.Title: Good American Family
Entries.Description: A Midwestern couple adopts who they believe to be a little girl with dwarfism but gradually started to believe she may not be who she said she was.

Episodes.Title: Almost Like a Prayer
Episodes.Description: Reeling from the grief of a failed adoption, the Barnett family gets a second chance when they get a call about a little girl named Natalia.

Episodes.Title: Jump the Jitters Out
Episodes.Description: Natalia starts school, and Kristine's suspicions about the adoption deepen. Michael receives unexpected news at work.

Episodes.Title: Ghosts Everywhere
Episodes.Description: Kristine investigates Natalia's age. As she doubles down on her suspicions, Jacob's star rises and Michael's web of lies spins further.

Episodes.Title: Right There in Black and White
Episodes.Description: Michael and Kristine's marriage reaches a breaking point as their differing perspectives on Natalia threaten to tear them apart. When the stakes become dangerous, Kristine draws a line.

Episodes.Title: Too Hurty Without It
Episodes.Description: Left to her own devices, Natalia faces her new circumstances and how the world sees her.

Episodes.Title: Not Today Satan
Episodes.Description: Natalia questions whether she can trust an unexpected set of allies. As questions about her past arise, painful memories are unearthed.

Episodes.Title: If You Tell a Story Well Enough
Episodes.Description: Just as the Barnetts think they've distanced themselves from Natalia, Detective Drysdale takes up her case to challenge her re-aging.

Episodes.Title: Blood on Her Hands
Episodes.Description: With the world watching, Natalia and the Barnetts face off in the court of law and the court of public opinion.

Entries.Title: Duster
Entries.Description: In 1972, the first Black female FBI agent heads to the Southwest and recruits a gutsy getaway driver in a bold effort to take down a growing crime syndicate.

Episodes.Title: Baltimore Changes Everything
Episodes.Description: Assigned to take down a Phoenix crime lord, FBI Agent Nina Hayes targets reluctant getaway driver Jim Ellis – unaware that deeper corruption awaits.

Episodes.Title: Suspicious Minds
Episodes.Description: As Jim plots to take down a corrupt cop, Nina uncovers buried FBI secrets – while a shadowy figure in D.C. watches her every move.

Episodes.Title: You're No Good
Episodes.Description: As Nina and Awan seek out a troubled former agent at a sanitarium, Jim finds evidence that suggests Nina might be right about Saxton.

Episodes.Title: Criminalus Velocitus Super-Sonicus
Episodes.Description: Jim fights thieves and a deadly assassin while making a delivery for Saxton. Nina and Awan unearth key evidence for their case.

Episodes.Title: Ravishing Light and Glory
Episodes.Description: As they infiltrate Saxton's world, Jim and Nina uncover a conspiracy of murder, drugs, and cover-ups – while a shadowy enemy moves to silence them.

Episodes.Title: Встречают по одёжке (Meet by the Clothes)
Episodes.Description: After surviving a bloody ambush, Jim and Nina grow closer as their enemies multiply – and a high-stakes conspiracy spirals out of control.

Episodes.Title: K-129
Episodes.Description: In Vegas, Jim discovers shocking secrets about his brother's death, while Nina's cover is blown by an old enemy's shocking return.

Episodes.Title: 66 Reno Split
Episodes.Description: After discovering the truth about Jim and Nina, Saxton makes plans to destroy them – and his mob rivals – once and for all.

Entries.Title: The Hunting Party
Entries.Description: A small team of investigators are assembled to track down and capture the most dangerous killers our country has ever seen, all of whom have just escaped from a top-secret prison that's not supposed to exist.

Episodes.Title: Richard Harris (Pilot)
Episodes.Description: When a massive explosion at a top-secret prison known as the Pit allows notorious serial killer Richard Harris to escape, disgraced FBI agent Bex Henderson is called back into action to hunt him down before he kills again.

Episodes.Title: Clayton Jessup
Episodes.Description: Clayton Jessup, a deranged serial killer who targets happy families, is on the loose and looking to kill again. The team must race against time to stop him before it's too late. Bex learns who she can and can't trust.

Episodes.Title: Lowe
Episodes.Description: In rural Montana, the team hunts down Lowe, a brutal serial killer obsessed with wolves. Bex and the team must track Lowe through the wilderness while dealing with local Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Doctor Ezekiel Malak
Episodes.Description: Dr. Ezekiel Malak, a hospital psychiatrist turned serial killer, is prowling for new victims in Chicago. Bex and the team work to find a method to his madness in a desperate bid to get ahead of him until Malak makes a move no one saw coming.

Episodes.Title: Roy Barber
Episodes.Description: When Bex and the team race to stop Roy Barber, known as the Couples Killer, before he strikes again, they uncover a chilling scheme that puts Roy's crimes in an entirely new light.

Episodes.Title: Arlo Brandt
Episodes.Description: Arlo Brandt, a hoarder-turned-serial killer, emerges from the Pit with newly found purpose. As Arlo hunts for innocent victims, Bex and the team must get inside a deranged mind.

Episodes.Title: Mark Marsden
Episodes.Description: Bex and the team race to catch Mark Marsden, known as the Widower, a handsome and charming serial killer who murdered three of his wives in cold blood. Everything changes when Mark decides to take a new bride.

Episodes.Title: Denise Glenn
Episodes.Description: The student becomes the master when an escaped serial killer from the Pit decides to adopt another inmate's style of killing as a way of paying homage to them.

Episodes.Title: Tom Beecher
Episodes.Description: Bex and the team hunt their most depraved serial killer yet, Tom Beecher, who seeks pleasure in other people's pain.

Episodes.Title: Jenna Wells
Episodes.Description: Bex and the team track the brilliant and beguiling Jenna Wells, the notorious Killer Chemist whose therapy in the Pit has made her even more dangerous and deranged.

Entries.Title: Missing You
Entries.Description: When Detective Kat Donovan matches on a dating app with the fiancé who disappeared years before, she learns that some secrets are best left in the past.

Episodes.Title: Every Breath You Take
Episodes.Description: Detective Kat Donovan is confronted with her past when she encounters the man she once loved — and learns some news about one she loathes.

Episodes.Title: With or Without You
Episodes.Description: Kat begs Stagger to help her extract a confession from LeBurne, and Stacey offers to look for Josh. Someone needing help from Kat arrives at the station.

Episodes.Title: Never Too Much
Episodes.Description: Defying Stagger's direct orders, Kat continues to look into Dana's case — and learns that she might not have known Josh as well as she thought she did.

Episodes.Title: Don't You Forget About Me
Episodes.Description: After questioning Brendan's attacker, Kat tries again to track down Josh, but instead comes face-to-face with the last person she ever expected to see.

Episodes.Title: Chain Reaction
Episodes.Description: Kat finally gets the answers she's been searching for these last 11 years. Time is running out for Dana, and Titus goes searching for Brendan.

Entries.Title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
Entries.Description: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

Episodes.Title: Amazing Fantasy
Episodes.Description: During high school orientation Peter's life is forever changed. A new era of Spider-Man begins here!

Episodes.Title: The Parker Luck
Episodes.Description: Peter begins an exclusive internship, but his first day is way more complicated than he expected.

Episodes.Title: Secret Identity Crisis
Episodes.Description: Peter deals with the fallout of his secret revealed. Meanwhile, Lonnie's perfect life falls apart.

Episodes.Title: Hitting the Big Time
Episodes.Description: Peter and Norman work through creative differences, while Lonnie undergoes a loyalty test.

Episodes.Title: The Unicorn Unleashed
Episodes.Description: Peter makes a new friend. Meanwhile, Lonnie finds himself in the sights of a dangerous gang.

Episodes.Title: Duel with the Devil
Episodes.Description: Peter's night off is derailed when he must suit up to stop a mysterious intruder.

Episodes.Title: Scorpion Rising
Episodes.Description: Peter and Lonnie face the consequences of their secret lives. Spider-Man faces his biggest threat.

Episodes.Title: Tangled Web
Episodes.Description: Norman gives Spider-Man an ultimatum, causing Peter to do some soul-searching.

Episodes.Title: Hero or Menace
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man swings into action, as Lonnie looks to settle a score and Norman visits an old friend.

Episodes.Title: If This Be My Destiny...
Episodes.Description: Peter's internship takes a dark turn with the arrival of an unexpected visitor.

Entries.Title: The Waterfront
Entries.Description: A prominent North Carolina fishing family wades into treacherous waters to keep their crumbling business empire afloat.

Episodes.Title: Almost Okay
Episodes.Description: When a suspicious shipwreck draws the eyes of the law, the fractured Buckley family must put aside their grievances to cover their tracks.

Episodes.Title: Taking Control
Episodes.Description: Cane and Harlan take bigger risks to keep the business running. Bree seeks proof to confirm her suspicions about her family.

Episodes.Title: Playing with Fire
Episodes.Description: As Harlan re-enters a risky alliance tied to the family's past, Belle makes quiet moves to protect what's left of their legacy.

Episodes.Title: You Can't Trust a Buckley
Episodes.Description: Cane works to contain the growing fallout at home. Harlan connects with a new player — and learns the rules of the game have changed.

Episodes.Title: I'm a Hugger
Episodes.Description: As pressure mounts and operations get riskier, Belle and Harlan struggle to keep a low profile. Old wounds resurface between Cane and Bree.

Episodes.Title: Hunting Season
Episodes.Description: Belle receives upsetting news about the family's future. A hunting trip troubles the fragile alliance between Harlan and Grady. Bree makes a confession.

Episodes.Title: Nice Try
Episodes.Description: Hoping to regain control of his operation, Harlan tries to outmaneuver an imminent threat. A violent warning shakes the Buckley family to its core.

Episodes.Title: Lost at Sea
Episodes.Description: As tensions flare, a dangerous standoff at sea brings the Buckleys face-to-face with their enemies.

Entries.Title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
Entries.Description: A Librarian from the past time travels to the present and finds himself stuck here. When he returns to his castle, which is now a museum, he inadvertently releases magic across the continent. He is given a new team to help him clean up the mess he made, forming a new team of Librarians.

Episodes.Title: And the Deadly Drekavac
Episodes.Description: When a Librarian from 200 years ago reappears today, he brings back to life a long-closed magical Library and accidentally resurrects an evil Drekavac. The Librarian, along with a quickly assembled team, must stop the Drekavac before it can kill and multiply.

Episodes.Title: And the Dance of Doom
Episodes.Description: Our newly assembled Librarians crew investigates a mysterious "dancing sickness," leading them to a showdown with a powerful magical factioneer at a professional ballet company.

Episodes.Title: And the Ghost Train
Episodes.Description: Half of the team becomes trapped on a runaway ghost train, and the rest of the team must help solve the unresolved business of the ghosts on board.

Episodes.Title: And the Thief of Love
Episodes.Description: The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake.

Episodes.Title: And the Memory Crystal
Episodes.Description: The team goes to a college campus with a world-class observatory to discover who is using the Crystal of Dr. John Dee to steal people's memories, in order to own the future.

Episodes.Title: And the House of Cards
Episodes.Description: When the magic door reroutes Charlie, Lysa and Connor to a bizarre manor where a series of Agatha Christie-style murders take place, they must figure out whodunnit, while Vikram tries to track them down with the help of a mysterious tarot card reader.

Episodes.Title: And the Con-Con
Episodes.Description: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

Episodes.Title: And the Hangover from Hell
Episodes.Description: After a wild bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

Episodes.Title: And the Feast of the Vampir
Episodes.Description: While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

Episodes.Title: And Going Medieval
Episodes.Description: When Vikram attempts to return to 1847 (via a homemade time machine), he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and ... Elaine.

Episodes.Title: And the Graffiti of the Gods
Episodes.Description: When graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl, the team have to work out how these strange events are related to Gregor's Hammer -- and the imminent return of Gregor himself.

Episodes.Title: And the Unfinished Business
Episodes.Description: General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia (remember from the Train episode), gaining control of their nuclear arsenal. The team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

Entries.Title: Black Rabbit
Entries.Description: When the owner of a New York City hotspot allows his turbulent brother back in his life, he opens the door to escalating dangers that threaten to bring down everything he's built.

Entries.Title: Adults
Entries.Description: A group of twenty-somethings in New York trying to be good people, despite being neither "good" nor "people" yet.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: The friend group finds out that someone they know is making national headlines.

Episodes.Title: Spitroast
Episodes.Description: The group accompanies Billie to the hospital for a colonoscopy and must decide who should be her medical proxy.

Episodes.Title: Have You Seen This Man?
Episodes.Description: A stabber is on the loose in the neighborhood and the group realizes Anton may have accidentally befriended him.

Episodes.Title: House Rules
Episodes.Description: The group continues a house tradition.

Episodes.Title: Theracide
Episodes.Description: Issa and Anton look for meaning after an unexpected loss, while Samir and Paul Baker start underage drinking.

Episodes.Title: Roast Chicken
Episodes.Description: The group throws their first dinner party.

Episodes.Title: Annabelle
Episodes.Description: Anton and Paul Baker host a visitor from out of town, while Issa takes a stand at work.

Episodes.Title: The Mail
Episodes.Description: The group opens the mailbox for the first time in months.

Entries.Title: Common Side Effects
Entries.Description: Former high school lab partners Marshall and Frances begin to unravel a conspiracy involving big pharma and the federal government to suppress knowledge of a rare mushroom that may hold the key to curing all the world’s diseases.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Marshall meets his old high school classmate Frances and lets her in on a world-changing secret.

Episodes.Title: Lakeshore Limited
Episodes.Description: Marshall's forced on the run as the DEA pursues him.

Episodes.Title: Hildy
Episodes.Description: Marshall visits an old mentor as new pressures mount.

Episodes.Title: Dumpsite
Episodes.Description: Frances tracks down Marshall in an unlikely location.

Episodes.Title: Star-Tel-Lite
Episodes.Description: Marshall, Frances, and their crazy neighbors deal with the aftermath of a dangerous incident.

Episodes.Title: In the System
Episodes.Description: Stuck in jail, Marshall faces new threats.

Episodes.Title: Blowfish
Episodes.Description: A chance encounter offers a risky opportunity for escape.

Episodes.Title: Amelia & Wyatt
Episodes.Description: Marshall and his new ally make a bold move.

Episodes.Title: Cliff's Edge
Episodes.Description: Marshall's mushroom project grows out of hand.

Episodes.Title: Raid
Episodes.Description: Dangerous forces converge on Marshall's camp.

Entries.Title: The Thundermans: Undercover
Entries.Description: Twins Phoebe and Max Thunderman embark on a mission to alleviate the threat in the seaside town of Secret Shores, as well as helping Chloe develop her superhero abilities by bringing her along on their undercover mission. Chloe forms a bond with two classmates while they investigate suspicious activity coming from the local school, who don’t realize their new friend has secret powers. As the danger increases, the Thunderman trio must stay in town indefinitely, leaving the squabbling twins in charge of raising their younger sister.

Episodes.Title: Thundercover
Episodes.Description: Max and Phoebe bring Chloe on an undercover mission in a new town, so she can experience life as a normal kid.

Episodes.Title: Faulty Powers
Episodes.Description: A training accident makes Chloe's powers faulty; Max tries to cure her and gets a misleading positive result, so she goes to a party; but his treatment actually creates brand new powers Chloe can't control.

Episodes.Title: Bummer School
Episodes.Description: Chloe's mascot project fails due to Max and Phoebe's feud; twins learn how fighting affects Chloe.

Episodes.Title: The Parent Zap
Episodes.Description: After Phoebe and Max let Chloe's friends watch a horror movie and eat candy, Jinx and Booch's parents want to meet Chloe's; with Hank and Barb away, Max and Phoebe transform into them to help Chloe; it goes well until the real Hank and Barb show up.

Episodes.Title: Save the Date
Episodes.Description: Max bets Phoebe she can't turn off being a superhero and go on a normal date.

Episodes.Title: Cherry Bad Things
Episodes.Description: Cherry visits and Max discovers Phoebe never took her sparkle power away; Phoebe promises to do so and has a girls' night with Cherry while Max hosts Jinx; Colosso gets jealous; Cherry's powers malfunction, nearly blowing Phoebe's cover.

Episodes.Title: Not So Fast and Furious
Episodes.Description: A new super-fast villain is wreaking havoc in Secret Shores; after Billy's speed accidentally triggers an avalanche, he decides to hang up his cape and retire.

Episodes.Title: For Your Spies Only
Episodes.Description: Max and Phoebe attend a parent-teacher night, leaving Chloe to have friends over without adult supervision; Jinx finds the Air Lair and believes spies are targeting the school and his meddling puts Max and Phoebe's school jobs at risk.

Episodes.Title: No Friend in Sight
Episodes.Description: Chloe feels smothered and thinks it's because Phobe and Max need friends; Phoebe and Max accidentally make the same friend named Brenda and fight over her.

Episodes.Title: All About Steve
Episodes.Description: Billy brings a new sidekick, to join the T-Force; but when they reject him, he turns evil.

Episodes.Title: Tide and Prejudice
Episodes.Description: The former protector of Secret Shores arrives at the Thundermans' beach house.

Episodes.Title: Prank You Next
Episodes.Description: Max seeks help dealing with a mystery prankster at school from his old principal, who was always the target of his pranks.

Episodes.Title: From Dust Till Dawn
Episodes.Description: Chloe struggles with her leadership skills; when a villain attacks her school field trip, Max and Phoebe have to put Chloe in charge while they try to take down the villain and defuse his dangerous astronomical weapon.

Episodes.Title: Summer of Secrets
Episodes.Description: Chloe must attend summer school, and Max is assigned to be her teacher. While they will be busy all summer, Phoebe goes solo with a new superhero named Captain Perfect.

Episodes.Title: I Know What You Did This Summer
Episodes.Description: B.C. invites Chloe to a launch party at Splat By The Sea, at the same time Jinx and Booch invite Chloe to protest outside the party. Phoebe is keeping her work with Captain Perfect.

Episodes.Title: The Summer I Turned Giddy
Episodes.Description: Upset that Phoebe has a new partner, Max decides to partner with his friend Gideon. But things backfire when Max tries to turn Gideon into a supersized superhero.

Episodes.Title: A Midsummer Knight's Scheme
Episodes.Description: Max agrees to mentor Captain Perfect's younger sister, who is headed down the path of becoming a supervillain. She tries to become one of Mastermind's henchmen.

Episodes.Title: Cruel Summer
Episodes.Description: Max and Phoebe are working well as a team, until he is accused of committing crimes and Phoebe must apprehend him.

Episodes.Title: Endless Summer
Episodes.Description: Max pretends to turn evil to infiltrate Mastermind's henchmen and steal the Chip-Chucker, a device that previously turned him evil.

Episodes.Title: The Max of Life
Episodes.Description: Max, who misses fame and attention, wants to make a name for himself again by breaking Booch's sandwich stack record. But Chloe wants to prevent her friend from losing the record title and challenges Max.

Episodes.Title: Love Is in the Lair
Episodes.Description: Mrs. Wong visits Secret Shores and threatens to reveal the Thundermans' superhero identities to the town, but Max and Phoebe's plan backfires.

Episodes.Title: She's All Splat
Episodes.Description: With Cherry working at Splat by Sea, Max gets her into a fake dating scheme to obtain discounts at the restaurant; Chloe faces a tough choice.

Episodes.Title: Party All the Crime
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: The Mastermind Unmasked
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Necaxa
Entries.Description: Beloved Mexican soccer team Club Necaxa strives to reclaim their place as one of Mexico's top teams, while their Mexican-American owner Eva Longoria tries to breathe new life into the team by enlisting the help of her high-profile friends including new co-owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Necaxa
Episodes.Description: Club Necaxa fights to reclaim greatness and win the hearts of Aguascalientes. Investor Eva "La Patrona" Longoria calls in support of fellow owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds as "Los Rayos" future hangs in the balance.

Episodes.Title: Anxiety
Episodes.Description: When a major injury threatens the season, Eva Longoria struggles to rebuild Club Necaxa's fractured fanbase. Sports Director José "Pepe" Hanan and Coach Fentanes guide "Los Rayos" through the Leagues Cup.

Episodes.Title: The Fighter
Episodes.Description: As Eva Longoria and Club Necaxa reel from Alexis Peña's injury, the team makes a bold move by bringing on Emilio "Pelon" Lara; a devoted fan's story of sacrifice reveals the deeper meaning of loyalty; a fiery match turns explosive.

Episodes.Title: Death
Episodes.Description: The town honors its departed during Día de los Muertos, while "Los Rayos" struggle to keep their spirit alive after a string of painful defeats; Eva Longoria and the ownership group confront a gut-wrenching decision.

Episodes.Title: Matador
Episodes.Description: With Club Necaxa at its breaking point, new Head Coach Nicolas Larcamón arrives with a radical vision to reshape the team; "Los Rayos" must now come together like never before or risk falling apart for good.

Episodes.Title: Pain
Episodes.Description: A heart-stopping injury to Diber "Cambi" Cambindo halts Necaxa's momentum forcing Coach Larcamón to lead through chaos, doubt and the weight of expectation.

Episodes.Title: Second Chances
Episodes.Description: Rob Mac joins Eva Longoria in Aguascalientes, offering a rare glimpse into their personal stakes and shared vision for Necaxa's future, as the two double down on their ownership mission.

Episodes.Title: Back to the Future "Family"
Episodes.Description: With history and a championship on the line, veteran Diego de Buen channels the Club's golden era to rally after a crushing loss; Eva Longoria's competitive spirit blazes in a padel ball showdown against Coach Larcamón.

Episodes.Title: Growing Pains
Episodes.Description: Eva Longoria books a GQ Mexico cover with Club Necaxa's rising stars as the team secures its first La Liguilla berth since 2019. Diego "Sheldon" González's journey from career-ending injury to a vital role within the Club inspires the fight ahead.

Episodes.Title: Living the Dream
Episodes.Description: Club Necaxa and Eva Longoria have journeyed together to reignite their legacy and earn newfound respect, but just as momentum builds, Coach Larcamón rocks the squad with shocking news.

Entries.Title: Building the Band
Entries.Description: In the series we will meet a number of talented singers who aim to be part of a band. To form their bond, they'll have one-on-one conversations (and singing sessions) to figure out who they have the best chemistry with. Only when they decide who they want to form a band with do the different members get to see each other. From then on, they will have to work together to achieve the best performance.

Episodes.Title: The Pinky Promise
Episodes.Description: The singers settle into sound booths and hear their potential bandmates perform live. Will they make a musical match — or will their personalities clash?

Episodes.Title: Locked In
Episodes.Description: As more singers await their fate, one vocalist makes a career-defining decision. A new band is born, and AJ brings in Nicole Scherzinger as a mentor.

Episodes.Title: The Magic Number
Episodes.Description: Options dwindle for those who haven't found a band yet. As more musical alliances emerge, two groups take the stage for their formation performance.

Episodes.Title: I Always Get What I Want
Episodes.Description: A contestant goes home in tears when a new group locks in. Can a boy band find their fourth member? One singer without a band stirs up suspense.

Episodes.Title: The First Look
Episodes.Description: Six freshly formed bands move in together to test if they can cohabitate in harmony. At their first look performance, they finally see their competition.

Episodes.Title: Breaking the Band
Episodes.Description: What's in a name? The bands must decide before the showcase. A budding romance puts one group at risk; Kelly Rowland and Liam Payne join as guest judges.

Episodes.Title: The Showcase
Episodes.Description: The bands showcase their skills before a live studio audience for the first time. As elimination looms, one vocalist's power moves strike a sour note.

Episodes.Title: The Big Stage
Episodes.Description: Bigger stage, bigger crowd: As the stakes rise, pressure mounts. The bands lay it all on the line, leaving their future up to the audience to decide.

Episodes.Title: The Pressure Is On
Episodes.Description: One contestant faces a singer's worst nightmare: vocal issues. In a bold move, a group changes their song at the last minute. Will it pay off?

Episodes.Title: The Finals
Episodes.Description: Fueled by a surprise boost of support, the three final bands give powerhouse performances. Who will be crowned winner — and who will face the music?

Entries.Title: Washington Black
Entries.Description: 11-year-old George Washington "Wash" Black embarks on a globe-trotting journey of identity after fleeing a Barbados sugar plantation aboard a flying machine in the company of his master’s eccentric inventor brother.

Episodes.Title: The Flying Man & the Musician
Episodes.Description: In 1837 Halifax, inventor Washington Black chases flight while haunted by his past. He meets Tanna, a bold, independent woman. Together, they face trials and learn that daring to dream can defy the limits of their world.

Episodes.Title: Movements of Jah People
Episodes.Description: Young Wash and Titch flee a plantation in the Cloud Cutter but crash onto a pirate ship. In Halifax, Wash battles his past as his bond with Tanna deepens—a fight for survival and belonging amid growing tensions on land and sea.

Episodes.Title: Of Love & Caribbean Rum
Episodes.Description: As Wash confronts his past, his bond with Tanna grows—but is tested by her engagement to McGee. Betrayed and ambushed by bounty hunters, Medwin must act fast. As secrets surface, loyalty and survival hang in the balance.

Episodes.Title: The Souls & Science of Black Folk
Episodes.Description: Young Wash, Titch, and Theo head to Virginia to confront truths about Titch's father. In Halifax, Tanna's plan to sabotage her engagement backfires. Wash's daring dive to impress Goff brings both danger and a chance for something greater.

Episodes.Title: St. George and the Dragon
Episodes.Description: Young Wash and Titch dodge capture, uncovering allies, threats, and shocking truths about Titch's family. In Halifax, Tanna's plan backfires, straining ties with Wash and Goff. As Wash's aquarium impresses, danger tests loyalty and ambition.

Episodes.Title: Selamiut
Episodes.Description: Pursued by Willard, Wash faces a life-changing decision. As tensions rise between Tanna and McGee, Young Wash must carve his own path on a perilous Arctic journey.

Episodes.Title: J'ouvert Morning
Episodes.Description: Wash urges Medwin to fight for love, then joins Tanna and Goff in London. At the Royal Science League, betrayals surface, and a reunion at the Wilde estate unveils a powerful truth about Wash's past.

Episodes.Title: If You See My Mama, Whisper Her This...
Episodes.Description: In Morocco, Wash reunites with Titch and discovers his father's true legacy. He and Tanna journey home on the Wind Sailer. A dreamlike reunion brings answers from the past as Wash's family sets sail toward a new future.

Entries.Title: Étoile
Entries.Description: In an ambitious gambit to save their storied institutions, two world-renowned ballet companies in New York City and Paris swap their most talented stars.

Episodes.Title: The Swap
Episodes.Description: Ballet is in trouble. Jack’s company in New York and Genevieve’s in Paris are struggling. She pitches him a radical solution, but there’s a catch.

Episodes.Title: The Bull
Episodes.Description: Things get off to a rocky start as Jack and Genevieve announce the swap at a dual press conference. Cheyenne is on the hunt for the perfect dance partner in New York, while Mishi and Tobias struggle to find themselves in Paris.

Episodes.Title: The Fish
Episodes.Description: Jack has a terrible day. Tobias is casting his new piece, and Gabin is eager to be noticed. Mishi lands a big role, and confronts Genevieve about the past.

Episodes.Title: The Hiccup
Episodes.Description: It’s opening night! Jack deals with dancer dramas while Genevieve causes an international incident. Things between Cheyenne and Gael heat up, while Tobias and Gabin struggle to connect.

Episodes.Title: The Rat
Episodes.Description: It’s Nutcracker season, and the MBT team begs Cheyenne to dance the Sugar Plum Fairy. It’s also Jack’s birthday, and Genevieve’s in town. Mishi tries to connect with Bruna. Gabin returns from his suspension. There’s a rat in Tobias’ apartment.

Episodes.Title: The Disaster
Episodes.Description: Tobias’ new ballet is a disaster. Genevieve struggles to keep everyone happy and Jack won’t let Nicholas retire. Crispin and Cheyenne face off during company class, while Mishi goes on a date.

Episodes.Title: The Slip
Episodes.Description: Gabin gets in trouble and Mishi gets ghosted. Someone from Gael’s past resurfaces and Cheyenne slips up. Jack struggles to name a successor for Nicholas, but Crispin has an idea.

Episodes.Title: The Offer
Episodes.Description: Jack makes a bold decision about a new artistic director, putting him at odds with Genevieve. Tobias’ new piece premieres, and Cheyenne dances a heartfelt solo while questioning the choices she’s made.

Entries.Title: One Night in Idaho: The College Murders
Entries.Description: Told in captivating, tense, and emotionally wrenching detail by only those involved in and affected by the crime, this series intimately explores this American tragedy and its continued impact and fallout.

Episodes.Title: Part 1 One
Episodes.Description: The idyllic University of Idaho Campus in the small college town of Moscow, Idaho is shattered when four popular college students are founded murdered. Shock turns to fear when the police reveal there is no suspected killer in custody.

Episodes.Title: Part Two
Episodes.Description: The police department's refusal to give information isn't helping quell the rising tide of terror. Sleuths on social media fuel speculation and rumors. When the police finally speak, horrifying details are released.

Episodes.Title: Part Three
Episodes.Description: In a shocking turn of events, seven weeks after the murders, a suspected is arrested. A complete stranger to the victims' friends and families. The arrest sends shockwaves through the community, as more and more questions arise.

Episodes.Title: Part Four
Episodes.Description: A detailed account of what happened the night of the murders is revealed, including details from the eyewitness. The biggest remaining question is, who was the killer's target, and why? Potential motive emerges as the delayed trial looms.

Entries.Title: Side Quest
Entries.Description: Go deeper into the Mythic Quest universe in these four standalone stories. Follow the lives of players, comic book shop owners, touring orchestra musicians, and members of the art department as they search for community, success, and love.

Episodes.Title: Song and Dance
Episodes.Description: Phil, the art director of MQ, attempts to enjoy a Hawaiian vacation with his girlfriend while dealing with increasingly invasive calls from Ian Grimm.

Episodes.Title: Pull List
Episodes.Description: When a Black-owned comic book shop receives only one copy of the latest MQ comic, five superfans fight over who deserves it the most.

Episodes.Title: Fugue
Episodes.Description: A young cellist joins a touring video game orchestra, only to discover what happens when your dream job becomes a nightmare.

Episodes.Title: The Last Raid
Episodes.Description: Five high school friends in a long-running MQ guild discover a glitch that might break the game—or their friendship.

Entries.Title: Katrina: Come Hell and High Water
Entries.Description: Twenty years after Hurricane Katrina, survivors reflect on the disastrous storm that forever changed their lives and the systemic inequities it exposed.

Episodes.Title: WE GONNA RIDE IT OUT LIKE WE ALWAYS DO
Episodes.Description: As Katrina closes in, officials issue a voluntary evacuation order that turns mandatory hours before landfall. With no way out, thousands hunker down.

Episodes.Title: SHELTER OF LAST RESORT
Episodes.Description: Stranded in floodwater or held against their will at the Superdome, survivors face dire conditions — and no help from the federal government for days.

Episodes.Title: GOD TAKES CARE OF FOOLS AND BABIES
Episodes.Description: New Orleans residents past and present honor loved ones lost in the storm and reflect on the challenges facing the city's culture and communities today.

Entries.Title: IT: Welcome to Derry
Entries.Description: Prequel to IT beginning in 1960s also covering origins of Pennywise the Clown.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Watson
Entries.Description: A year after the death of his friend and partner Sherlock Holmes at the hands of Moriarty, Dr. John Watson resumes his medical career as the head of a clinic dedicated to treating rare disorders. However, he soon finds that his old life is not done with him yet.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Dr. John Watson resumes his medical career as the head of a clinic dedicated to treating rare disorders six months after the death of his friend and partner, Sherlock Holmes, at the hands of Moriarty.

Episodes.Title: Redcoat
Episodes.Description: Watson and the fellows investigate the perplexing case of a family man with a bullet lodged in his head who insists he is a Scottish soldier and seems to be hiding something nefarious.

Episodes.Title: Wait for the Punchline
Episodes.Description: Watson and the fellows treat a comedian who collapses at an open mic night, but throughout the case her past is revealed to be much more complex than initially believed.

Episodes.Title: Patient Question Mark
Episodes.Description: When Sasha discovers a link between her current patient, who has advanced cancers and distinctive lesions on his tongue indicative of Cowden syndrome, and a cadaver she dissected during medical school, the team traces the case to Amish country.

Episodes.Title: The Man with the Glowing Chest
Episodes.Description: Watson takes a major ethical risk when he decides to treat a sickle cell patient with an unorthodox surgery, and the team faces their own dilemma when they must decide whether to look the other way or help the young woman.

Episodes.Title: The Camgirl Inquiry
Episodes.Description: Stephens musters the courage to ask Watson to help him when his camgirl suddenly collapses during a video call. He does not know anything about her real life, so the team must act quickly to locate her before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: Teeth Marks
Episodes.Description: While Watson and the team help a woman whose memory resets every three minutes, Watson struggles with auditory hallucinations and questions whether someone is behind his current decline. Also, Moriarty plots his next move.

Episodes.Title: A Variant of Unknown Significance
Episodes.Description: Watson runs into brilliant con artist and an old friend of Sherlock Holmes, Irene Adler, when her son Angus is admitted to UHOP for temporary paralysis. The fellows help Watson after he grows fond of Angus and pursue various leads to find a cure to his illness.

Episodes.Title: Take a Family History
Episodes.Description: Ingrid's lies come back to haunt her when her sister Gigi needs to be treated by the team after she develops side effects to the secret treatments Ingrid put her through. Also, Watson and Mary bond over a tragedy.

Episodes.Title: The Man with the Alien Hand
Episodes.Description: Watson is thrown into a detective case when he is unsure whether the patient he is treating for one of the most rare ailments in the world, Alien Hand Syndrome, is guilty of pushing his brother in front of a bus to his death.

Episodes.Title: The Dark Day Deduction
Episodes.Description: Watson confronts a traumatic event from his Army days that still weighs heavily on him when his Army veteran friend’s wife reaches out begging for help when her husband is seemingly having a psychotic break. Meanwhile, Shinwell is asked for one last favor by Moriarty.

Episodes.Title: My Life's Work (1)
Episodes.Description: When part of the team falls ill after becoming targets of a sinister plot, it becomes an all-hands-on-deck situation to save them before it's too late. Meanwhile, Watson announces a new ambitious project that he has been working on.

Episodes.Title: My Life's Work (2)
Episodes.Description: Watson and the team are faced with an impossible choice when two lives hang in the balance, but they only have one vial of antidote available. Meanwhile, Shinwell races to help the team, and Watson goes head to head with Moriarty.

Episodes.Title: A Son in the Oven
Episodes.Description: Watson and the fellows spring back into action when Mary’s mother accidentally poisons herself while suffering from a rare form of dementia that is progressing with impossible speed. Meanwhile, Sherlock Holmes resurfaces after being presumed dead.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Moniker
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Green Thumb
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Young Lungs
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Back from the Dead
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Happy Face
Entries.Description: The story of Melissa Reed, daughter of Keith Jesperson, aka the Happy Face Killer. After decades of no contact, Keith forces his way back into his daughter’s life, and Melissa must find out if an innocent man is going to be put to death for a crime her father committed. In the process, she must face a reckoning of her own identity.

Episodes.Title: The Confession
Episodes.Description: After decades of no contact, the “Happy Face Killer” and his daughter are begrudgingly reunited, in order for her to find out if an innocent man is going to be put to death for a crime he committed.

Episodes.Title: Killing Shame
Episodes.Description: Melissa and Ivy travel to Texas to learn everything about Heather Richmond's murder.

Episodes.Title: Was It Worth It?
Episodes.Description: Melissa navigates the highs and lows of going public with her story.

Episodes.Title: Controlled Burn
Episodes.Description: Ben tries to keep his family safe as Hazel receives an unexpected invitation.

Episodes.Title: Don't Dream
Episodes.Description: When crucial evidence goes missing, Melissa creates an unlikely alliance to solve the problem.

Episodes.Title: Lorelai
Episodes.Description: Melissa and Ivy find unknown footage of Heather performing that changes everything.

Episodes.Title: My Jesperson Girls
Episodes.Description: Melissa faces a dark family secret that leads her back to Ash.

Episodes.Title: The Star
Episodes.Description: Melissa solves the case. Keith suffers an attack. Ben faces consequences for his actions.

Entries.Title: Suits LA
Entries.Description: Ted Black, a former federal prosecutor from New York, has reinvented himself representing the most powerful clients in Los Angeles. But his firm is at a crisis point, and in order to survive, he must embrace a role he held in contempt his entire career.

Episodes.Title: Seven Days a Week and Twice on Sunday
Episodes.Description: Attorney Ted Black and partner Stuart Lane are about to merge with a firm run by Ted's ex. Associates Rick and Erica vie for positions in the firm, but when the merger hits a snag, Ted, a former prosecutor, must step into a role he holds in contempt.

Episodes.Title: Old Man Hanrahan
Episodes.Description: Ted needs Amanda's help with a new prosecutor in Lester's murder trial. Erica squares off against Rick to stop him from poaching a client. Stuart and Samantha argue over Rick's position.

Episodes.Title: He Knew
Episodes.Description: Ted and Kevin deal with a bombshell about Lester's motive for killing his producing partner. Erica and Leah try to fulfill an unorthodox request for a celebrity client. In the past, Ted drags his old friend Stuart into his mob case.

Episodes.Title: Batman Returns
Episodes.Description: Ted and Erica take on Samantha to save Lester's movie, but the battle may hurt his murder trial. Rick enlists Stuart's help when a difficult actor is arrested. In the past, the danger of going against a mob boss sends Ted to an old friend.

Episodes.Title: You're on Your Own
Episodes.Description: Ted and Amanda attempt to thwart the prosecutor from having Lester's wife testify. Kevin, Rick and Erica discover a problem with Lester's story.

Episodes.Title: Dester
Episodes.Description: Erica and Kevin keep a secret from Ted that could hinder his murder trial. With the case slipping away, Ted turns to an unlikely source to save Lester.

Episodes.Title: Good Times
Episodes.Description: The death of a beloved client brings Ted and Rick back together. Kevin helps Erica with a family matter. Stuart and Samantha clash over a distasteful client. Leah considers leaving the law. In the past, Ted gets news that could derail his career as a prosecutor.

Episodes.Title: Acapulco
Episodes.Description: In the past, Ted's mob trial case takes a bad turn, forcing him to turn to old friend Harvey Specter. Erica and Leah's clash over personal time gets the attention of the firm's new head of HR. Stuart calls in a favor from Rick to discredit a witness.

Episodes.Title: Bat Signal
Episodes.Description: Ted and Harvey team up to right a wrong from their past and put a monster behind bars. Stuart confronts the possibility he may have unwittingly helped a client commit a crime.

Episodes.Title: Slugfest
Episodes.Description: Law students Ted and Stuart’s friendship is tested when they face off in a mock trial. In the present, Stuart faces a crisis as his doubts about his client mount.

Episodes.Title: Tearin' Up My Heart
Episodes.Description: Ted must deliver on a request from client Patton Oswalt. Amanda turns to Erica for help defending a teen star accused of attacking her dad. Stuart’s accident sends him into a spiral. In the past, Ted and Eddie come to L.A. for Stuart’s bachelor party.

Episodes.Title: Angry Sylvester
Episodes.Description: Erica and Ted disagree when she tries to sign a high-profile client against his wishes. Stuart meets an unexpected adversary at anger management. Rick works to secure Dylan Pryor’s dream role.

Episodes.Title: Freedom
Episodes.Description: The relationships at the two firms are complicated as Ted and Samantha join forces to take down Rosalyn's former boss. Erica and Rick work against each other as they finalize Dylan Pryor's deal. Stuart recruits Kevin for a special task in New York.

Entries.Title: Crossroad Springs
Entries.Description: The Hamilton family faces financial struggles and staffing shortages on Hamilton Ranch. Pastor James and Janet return to help the family, encountering a generational feud between the family owners. James starts a cowboy church on the farm, where faith, family, and ranch life are intertwined, despite the lack of worship spaces on the vast farmland.

Episodes.Title: Return to Crossroad Springs
Episodes.Description: When Willis falls off his horse, siblings James and Janet are forced to return home from their respective careers to help on the family ranch.

Episodes.Title: Wolf on the Range
Episodes.Description: A wolf sighting and rising tensions leave James torn between family, faith, and the growing pull of Crossroad Springs.

Episodes.Title: A Quarry Divided
Episodes.Description: A secret land deal threatens to divide the Hamiltons, forcing James to choose between his church and life at the ranch.

Episodes.Title: Storm on the Horizon
Episodes.Description: A summer storm tests the Hamiltons, as they unite to protect the ranch and find strength in faith, love, and each other.

Episodes.Title: A Turn in the Road
Episodes.Description: At a service honoring their mother, a long-lost heirloom resurfaces uncovering memories, grief, and unexpected grace.

Episodes.Title: Sunrise and Still Water
Episodes.Description: When a young couple seeks guidance, James must confront his own past and what it truly means to love and commit.

Entries.Title: Irish Blood
Entries.Description: Hot-shot Los Angeles divorce lawyer Fiona Fox receives a letter from her estranged father and sets out to uncover the mystery of his disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Briefcase
Episodes.Description: After receiving a mysterious package from her long-lost father, Fiona Sharpe travels to Ireland to investigate his cryptic message, becoming entangled in hidden truths about his past.

Episodes.Title: Horseshoe
Episodes.Description: Young cop Roisin secretly helps Fiona in uncovering clues that suggest foul play. As Fiona digs deeper, she discovers a web of criminal activity involving horse thefts and cons run by the shady Patsy Burgess.

Episodes.Title: Under Wraps
Episodes.Description: Fiona, Musa, and Róisín investigate the next clue in the briefcase-a pair of blood-stained Mixed Martial Arts gloves with a hidden metal gauze. Róisín suspects a link to a local criminal fighter.

Episodes.Title: Father Al
Episodes.Description: Fiona's mother, Mary, arrives to take her back to the U.S., but a visit to a grave and an unexpected encounter with an old flame force them to face old wounds and unexpected truths.

Episodes.Title: Adding Machine
Episodes.Description: After Fiona and Róisín uncover Declan's hard drive, Fiona questions his death. Johnny McIntyre is mysteriously broken out of prison.

Episodes.Title: Turboclash
Episodes.Description: Fiona races to expose the truth behind the sabotage of a car rally and its tragic consequences, only to discover an ultimate betrayal.

Entries.Title: Dr. Seuss's Red Fish, Blue Fish
Entries.Description: One fish, two fish, meet Red Fish and Blue Fish! From there to here — and from here to there — these friends find opposites everywhere!

Episodes.Title: Quiet/Loud + Clean/Dirty + Go/Stop + Lock/Unlock
Episodes.Description: Red and Blue take jobs as babysitters and pet groomers, team up to rescue Blue's teddy bear from a taxi, and help animals sleep tight at the farm.

Episodes.Title: Loose/Tight + Gather/Scatter + Catch/Let Go + Relax/Stressed
Episodes.Description: The friends try on Halloween costumes, work together to clean up leaves, and try to catch a colorful butterfly — then they find some time to unwind!

Episodes.Title: Dangerous/Safe + Inside/Outside + First/Last
Episodes.Description: A tea party attracts an uninvited guest, a sneaky mouse makes mischief on movie night, and Blue and Red buckle up to win a race.

Episodes.Title: Awake/Asleep + Hot/Cold + Clumsy/Graceful
Episodes.Description: On a snowy Christmas Eve, the friends try to stay up and see Santa Fish. Later on, they hit the pool to stay cool, then bundle up to go ice skating.

Episodes.Title: Near/Far + Heavy/Light + Open/Shut
Episodes.Description: A furry dog wants Red and Blue's frisbee, Little Fish needs help moving into a new house, and a snappy clam traps the friends' favorite ball.

Entries.Title: StuGo
Entries.Description: Six middle schoolers are tricked into attending a fake academic summer camp by a mad scientist. Now they’re stuck for three months on a wild tropical island with mind-reading manatees, giant fighting fungi and fashion-forward mutants.

Episodes.Title: Dog Eat Dog
Episodes.Description: MUTANT MISCHIEF! The kids must face the Mutant thieves who stole their food.

Episodes.Title: Legitimate Summer Camp
Episodes.Description: SWEET SUMMER SCIENCE! The kids arrive at Lullah's mysterious summer camp and attempt to fix her laser.

Episodes.Title: The Nannytee
Episodes.Description: OH THE HU-NANNYTEE! Lullah wants alone time and creates a Manatee-Nanny to watch the kids.

Episodes.Title: Noodle It (A Little Bit)
Episodes.Description: LIZARD LOVIN' LARRY! Pliny must choose - support Larry's noodling habit or keep him safe.

Episodes.Title: Diorama Drama
Episodes.Description: FIENDISH FIGURINES! Pliny tries to keep a promise when the kids play with a strange diorama.

Episodes.Title: Goat Racket
Episodes.Description: CRIME AND BEANS! Sara feels guilt after conning Larry out of his collectible beans.

Episodes.Title: Breakfast at Chippany's
Episodes.Description: CHIP BREAKFAST-HANDS! Chip wants to make a breakfast that will blow his friends' socks off.

Episodes.Title: Birdyguard
Episodes.Description: HERPETOLOGICAL HIJINKS! Larry saves a baby lizard and swears to protect it from harm.

Episodes.Title: No Manhands Is an Island
Episodes.Description: MARITIME MUTATION! Chip tries committing to the ways of survivalist Nils Vulfen.

Episodes.Title: Sister Swim
Episodes.Description: PERTURBING PORPOISE! When the kids encounter a dolphin, everyone is excited - except Merian.

Episodes.Title: Moon Moon
Episodes.Description: RESENTFUL ROBOTS! Lullah sends Sara to stop a rover from drawing a dirty rear on the moon.

Episodes.Title: Mailbog
Episodes.Description: DIRE DISPATCH! Francis goes on a quest to deliver a letter.

Episodes.Title: Finder's Kelpers

Entries.Title: Seen & Heard: The History of Black Television
Entries.Description: Journey through the history of Black representation on television, showcasing how Black artists and creators both shaped and revolutionized the medium while confronting the systemic challenges that have often undermined their contributions.

Episodes.Title: Part 1: Seen
Episodes.Description: From Amos 'n' Andy to The Jeffersons and Good Times, Black television was historically shaped by white writers and creators. But in the 1990s, a rise in shows by Black creators brought social issues to the forefront, allowing Black television to go beyond merely reflecting culture, but to create it with shows such as In Living Color and The Arsenio Hall Show.

Episodes.Title: Part 2: Heard
Episodes.Description: The responsibility and power of storytelling is demonstrated through the work of Shonda Rhimes, Oprah Winfrey, and other creators, as well as stories depicting the breadth of the Black experience. With ownership of news and entertainment properties, Black creators now shape perception and policy – while honoring the scope of their history in all its paradoxes and complexities.
