Episodes.Description: When an art historian is found murdered in his home, DI Mick Palmer and DC Shazia Malik are sent to investigate. As they dig into the case, they uncover a vandalized painting, sabotaged security footage, and a dark family secret.

Episodes.Title: Dead & Buried
Episodes.Description: The detectives look into the discovery of a gold Viking hoard stolen from a prehistoric burial chamber. After the site is reopened, they unearth a series of secrets and betrayals leading to a thousand-year-old cover-up.

Episodes.Title: Warped
Episodes.Description: A music producer is battered to death in his studio and his rare rock memorabilia stolen. But when the victim's collection is later found dumped in the river, Mick and Shazia question the killer's motive.

Episodes.Title: Noble Rot
Episodes.Description: At an exclusive wine tasting, host Raymond Bettane dies from a spiked drink. As the detectives question each of the guests, Mick makes a shocking discovery about Bettane's vintage wines.

Episodes.Title: Ice Cold
Episodes.Description: An American millionaire who planned to donate his collection of Titanic memorabilia is found dead in his hotel room in Belfast. Discovering that the man was poisoned, Mick and Shazia suspect someone wanted to stop the donation.

Episodes.Title: Final Bid
Episodes.Description: Mick's father, Ron, is taken hostage by a criminal gang for stealing a valuable painting from them-and Mick gets an ultimatum; he and Shazia must investigate the theft of a rare Chinese vase that has disappeared from a locked vault.

Entries.Title: Kevin Costner's The West
Entries.Description: This fresh look at the epic history of the American West delves into the desperate struggle for the land itself – and how it still shapes the America we know today.

Episodes.Title: Fallen Timbers
Episodes.Description: Following years of land encroachments by American settlers, Chief Little Turtle of the Miami leads the Indian Nations of the Northwest Confederacy to a major victory over the fledgling U.S. Army. But a new force under General "Mad" Anthony Wayne embarks on a counteroffensive, leading to a final battle that will see the Confederacy defeated - and open a new era of westward expansion.

Episodes.Title: Colter's Run
Episodes.Description: After building his reputation as a formidable hunter on Lewis and Clark's Expedition into the newly acquired Louisiana Territory, John Colter chooses to stay out in the wilderness and enter the booming fur trade. But when he repeatedly ignores warnings from the Blackfeet not to hunt their sacred beaver on their lands, he's taken captive and forced to make a run for his life.

Episodes.Title: Oregon Trails
Episodes.Description: Missionaries Marcus and Narcissa Whitman settle by the Columbia River to convert the Cayuse. Cultural clashes and a measles outbreak increase tensions, leading to a fateful confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Comancheria
Episodes.Description: The abduction of nine-year-old Cynthia Ann Parker kicks off a series of increasingly deadly confrontations between her Comanche captors and the newly independent Texas.

Episodes.Title: The Robin Hood of El Dorado
Episodes.Description: In Gold Rush California, Mexican immigrant Joaquin Murrieta forms a gang of outlaws that spreads terror across the newly formed state.

Episodes.Title: Bleeding Kansas
Episodes.Description: When Kansas becomes a battleground in the national debate over slavery, settlers on both sides of the issue pour into the territory to determine its future.

Episodes.Title: The Fetterman Fight
Episodes.Description: Civil War veteran Col. Henry Carrington takes command of Fort Phil Kearny in Northern Wyoming.

Episodes.Title: Johnson County Wars
Episodes.Description: A cabal of cattle barons smear small-time ranchers as common thieves and plot an invasion.

Entries.Title: Magic City: An American Fantasy
Entries.Description: Explore the most famous strip club in the world and the celebrities, dancers, and founder who propelled it to its iconic status.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Atlanta
Episodes.Description: "Magic City: An American Fantasy" begins by immersing viewers in the club's allure; before the club, there was the man - Michael Barney, a natural hustler, he was so gifted that people started calling him Mr. Magic.

Episodes.Title: Whoomp! There It Is
Episodes.Description: Magic City became the epicenter of entertainment, drawing legendary celebrities before and during their rise to superstardom; the secret sauce was Mr. Magic's vision; he demanded that his club have the best of everything.

Episodes.Title: Three, Six, Nine, Damn She Fine
Episodes.Description: With Mr. Magic in prison, the schemers played, Magic City spiraled into lawlessness as DJs, bartenders, and dancers ran their own side hustles, each believing they were bigger than the club.

Episodes.Title: Trap or Die
Episodes.Description: The notorious Black Mafia Family drug cartel sets up shop in Magic City; thus begins the "Make It Rain" era of the club, promising more money (and violence) than ever before.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5

Entries.Title: Providence Falls
Entries.Description: In 1844 Ireland, thief Liam falls for aristocrat Cora. When their love disrupts destiny, angels send him to present-day Oregon to ensure Cora marries another man. As her police partner, Liam struggles with his enduring feelings.

Episodes.Title: Chance of a Lifetime
Episodes.Description: In 1844 Ireland, a rogue falls for a squire's daughter, altering her destiny. Angels send them to present-day Providence Falls to correct it. He must make her fall for another man, though she's now a cop with no memory of their past lives.

Episodes.Title: An Impossible Promise
Episodes.Description: Detectives Cora and Liam must solve a murder. Meanwhile, despite Liam's hidden love for Cora, he pushes her toward DA Finn Walsh, her fated match, in order to change their destinies.

Episodes.Title: Thief of Fate
Episodes.Description: Detectives Cora and Liam close in on solving their murder case and rebel against the angels, choosing to take fate into their own hands.

Entries.Title: Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer
Entries.Description: This tense true-crime series examines the hunt for the Long Island serial killer through the perspective of his victims, their loved ones and the police.

Episodes.Title: Part One
Episodes.Description: Long Island, 2010. The search for a missing woman leads to the discovery of multiple unidentified bodies, all connected by a disturbing common thread.

Episodes.Title: Part Two
Episodes.Description: With a potential serial killer at large, the search for Shannan resumes — but the investigation stalls as a corruption scandal plagues local police.

Episodes.Title: Part Three
Episodes.Description: A pivotal tip that was overlooked for years leads to an arrest at last. Dark details emerge, linking the killer to more homicides spanning two decades.

Entries.Title: Coulda Been Love
Entries.Description: An internet celebrity hosts a dating competition where singles vie for his heart and a hefty cash reward, leading to unexpected twists and romantic drama.

Episodes.Title: Meet the Bachelor
Episodes.Description: One estate, seventeen girls, nine beds and one Druski.

Episodes.Title: A Woman's Touch
Episodes.Description: One estate, sixteen girls, nine beds and one Druski.

Entries.Title: Demascus
Entries.Description: A Black man on a know-thyself mission begins an experimental immersion therapy that sends him into alternate timelines of his own life.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: The road to self-discovery is long, rough, and dirty. Move like a chameleon.

Episodes.Title: Establishing Episode
Episodes.Description: The algorithm doesn’t lie, but Black art can alter timelines.

Episodes.Title: Anthology
Episodes.Description: A triptych: three mirrors, one truth.

Episodes.Title: The Thanksgiving Episode
Episodes.Description: The ghosts of alternate Thanksgivings loom heavy. Don't put the skillet in the dishwasher.

Episodes.Title: Penultimate
Episodes.Description: Isopods are detritivores. As is grief.

Episodes.Description: Red or Blue.

Entries.Title: Tyler Perry's Divorced Sistas
Entries.Description: Five friends - Rasheda, Geneva, Naomi, Tiffany, and Bridgette - support each other through divorce, marriage, dating, healing, and friendship struggles while their loyalty and sisterhood bonds are tested.

Episodes.Title: The Pretty Lady
Episodes.Description: Geneva, Tiffany and Rasheda confront personal betrayals as tensions rise while preparing for a church banquet, and Naomi seeks revenge on her ex-husband amid her tumultuous divorce.

Episodes.Title: Old Flames, New Scars
Episodes.Description: As Bridgette grapples with Vaughn's persistent immaturity and his inability to hold a job, she faces a crossroads between love and self-discovery.

Episodes.Title: Hushed Tones
Episodes.Description: Javon makes a wild declaration to Geneva, but when he doesn't get the response he's looking for, he attempts to make her jealous; Bridgette feels uncomfortable introducing Vaughn and causes a rift between them.

Episodes.Title: Line in the Sand
Episodes.Description: Naomi lashes out at her ex-husband's ultimate disrespect; Rasheda and Pastor Jefferson have a moment of hurtful truths.

Episodes.Title: Breath of Fresh Air
Episodes.Description: Naomi feels overwhelmed by the harassment from her ex-husband and flirts with the idea of a permanent solution.

Episodes.Title: Heavier Than Words
Episodes.Description: Geneva confronts Yara with false intentions of a playdate between their daughters and Pastor Jefferson learns disturbing news about his wife's past.

Episodes.Title: Brutal Honesty
Episodes.Description: Bridgette, Pastor Jefferson and Rasheda get to the bottom of Vaughn's actions, Geneva and Tiffany face the growing tension between them, and Naomi spills many painful truths.

Episodes.Title: Birds of a Feather
Episodes.Description: Rasheda and Pastor Jefferson navigate the tumultuous waters of their parental roles as Laz's explosive outburst fractures their family dynamic.

Entries.Title: The Kollective
Entries.Description: After a sudden tragedy,  a group of intrepid young citizen journalists find themselves sucked into a web of government lies and corruption.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: The Kollective meet in person for the first time to discuss a new project. Josh is driven to solve the mystery surrounding a plane crash in the Democratic Republic of the Congo that killed all passengers on board, including a prominent journalist.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: In Kinshasa, Delia, Aaron and Maya are devastated to see Joshua's tortured body; while officials feed them the implausible story that Josh's murder was the result of a robbery gone wrong, Delia's rage is barely contained.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The Kollective reunite at Joshua's funeral, determined to uncover the truth but lacking sufficient evidence to publish.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The Kollective plans Sugalov's escape from Russia with Maya and Sergey. Sugalov agrees to an interview in exchange for asylum but unexpectedly arrives with his teenage daughter, Anna. He refuses to talk until both are guaranteed safety.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After publishing Joshua's death footage, The Kollective exposes Russia's crimes in the DRC. As Mbemba leads the presidential race, the Russians threaten Etienne, using his daughter Arielle as leverage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Witnessing Drischev's shocking death, Aaron resolves to track Kuzmin's plane with Etienne, who has rejoined The Kollective. He identifies Kuzmin's companion as Rebin Tuerxun, a US-educated scientist.

Entries.Title: All the Sharks
Entries.Description: Four teams of shark experts and enthusiasts travel the globe trying to find the most elusive shark species in this fin-tastic reality competition.

Episodes.Title: Eye of the Tiger Shark
Episodes.Description: The teams grab their cameras and diving gear and hit the turquoise waters of the Maldives, where rare silvertips lurk and ferocious tiger sharks circle.

Episodes.Title: Sharks After Dark
Episodes.Description: Along Australia's Great Barrier Reef, the teams get the rare chance to dive at night. Between bamboo sharks and wobbegongs, the race is gill and gill.

Episodes.Title: Land of the Rising Sharks
Episodes.Description: Brutal currents and jellyfish stings make Japan the most challenging dive yet — but the prospect of seeing a sharknado keeps the group's spirits afloat.

Episodes.Title: Chum and Get It!
Episodes.Description: Low visibility and an imminent elimination create choppy competition in South Africa. Still, the teams are determined: Will they find a great white?

Episodes.Title: Its Hammer Time
Episodes.Description: With a game-changing bonus in play, the teams head to Bimini. Amid lemon sharks and an epic hammerhead sighting, one expert bravely faces their fears.

Episodes.Title: The Grand Fin-Ale
Episodes.Description: The finalists duke it out in the Galápagos, a shark-rich hotspot. Can they snap a photo of an ultra rare whale shark — or will a killer get in their way?

Entries.Title: The Mortician
Entries.Description: A trusted family-owned funeral home hides behind a façade of decency and propriety to take advantage of loved ones at their most vulnerable moments.

Episodes.Title: Episode One
Episodes.Description: After David Sconce takes over his family's mortuary business, a local funeral director makes shocking allegations about the crematorium.

Episodes.Title: Episode Two
Episodes.Description: David expands the business as allegations of abuse mount. Following his arrest, shocking evidence is discovered in the death of a rival.

Episodes.Title: Episode Three
Episodes.Description: After members of the Lamb family are convicted of fraud and various crimes, the case brings about new regulations to the mortuary business.

Entries.Title: F1: The Academy
Entries.Description: Fifteen young women break barriers in one of the world's most demanding sports as they race to get a female driver back on the Formula 1 grid.

Episodes.Title: No Friends on Track
Episodes.Description: The pressure is on for F1 Academy director Susie Wolff as her new teams and drivers give their all to prove themselves on the track in Miami.

Episodes.Title: The One to Beat
Episodes.Description: F1 Academy heads to Barcelona, where Abbi pulls ahead to defend her coveted pole position and Amna is left shaken by a collision.

Episodes.Title: No More Mrs. Nice Guy
Episodes.Description: Stormy weather complicates the next round of races in Zandvoort. Bianca's performance starts to worry her team while Hamda reflects on a past injury.

Episodes.Title: Target on My Back
Episodes.Description: Lia deals with the fallout of a bad start. Setting her sights on a podium win, Doriane begins to climb her way up the ranking.

Episodes.Title: Feel the Heat
Episodes.Description: Sweltering heat awaits the drivers in Singapore, where Lia gains confidence, Bianca continues to struggle and Abbi remains the one to beat.

Episodes.Title: The Hardest Race of My Life
Episodes.Description: The penultimate racing weekend in Qatar raises the stakes, with motor issues threatening Abbi's qualifying position and Chloe incurring a penalty.

Episodes.Title: End of the Road
Episodes.Description: Abu Dhabi sets the stage for the climactic final round of F1 Academy. Who will take the season win — and who will be left in the gravel?

Entries.Title: Clean Slate
Entries.Description: Harry is an old-school car wash owner in Alabama who has a lot of soul searching to do when the child he once called "son" returns after 17 years as a proud trans woman named Desiree. Her homecoming brings together a hilarious cast of friends, coworkers, and love interests as Desiree and Harry try to get it right the second time around.

Episodes.Title: Desiree. And Whatnot.
Episodes.Description: After 23 years away, Desiree returns home to Alabama to repair her estranged relationship with her old-school father, Harry. Together, they must process their new reality as father and daughter.

Episodes.Title: Spark Joy
Episodes.Description: Desiree throws a yard sale to purge her childhood home of unnecessary clutter, with unintended consequences. Meanwhile, Louis keeps Harry busy with a game-day feast.

Episodes.Title: Opal's Day Off
Episodes.Description: After Opal is suspended from school, Desiree drags the gang on a surprisingly cathartic outing to a theme park.

Episodes.Title: Chrome Jesus
Episodes.Description: Desiree's return to Sunday service has an unintended ripple effect on the church and their community. Meanwhile, Mack and Opal launch a unique Sunday car wash to increase business.

Episodes.Title: Closer Than They Appear
Episodes.Description: A father-daughter driving lesson takes a turn when Harry has a health emergency, leaving Desiree playing nurse while both of them ponder the future. Meanwhile, Mack tries to keep a secret from Harry.

Episodes.Title: Pillars
Episodes.Description: As Desiree and Mack keep an eye on the car wash, Harry and the others navigate an Election Day from hell.

Episodes.Title: Mess and Magic
Episodes.Description: Desiree and Louis let loose during a much-needed Mardi Gras adventure, until Harry and Ella crash the party.

Episodes.Title: Born Again... Again
Episodes.Description: Desiree seeks a second baptism while wondering if her stay in Alabama could be more than temporary.

Entries.Title: Court of Gold
Entries.Description: Go behind the scenes with the top medal contenders in men's basketball as they battle for gold and glory at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After failing to medal at the 2023 World Cup, Team USA rallies a star-studded roster for the 2024 Olympic Games — but their global competition is steep.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As Canada pressures Greece, France and rising rookie Victor Wembanyama take on Brazil. Kevin Durant cements his legacy on the court against Serbia.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Steve Kerr reflects on his Olympic journey and the challenges of coaching an MVP-stacked team. For Serbia, Yugoslavia's basketball legacy looms large.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Bam Adebayo finds inspiration in his mother. France and Canada meet in a quarterfinal match where Evan Fournier thrills the host country crowd.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: It's win or go home for the US and Serbia as they clash in the semifinals, where a stunning momentum shift turns the fourth quarter into a nail-biter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Bubbly flows as Serbia secures bronze. With gold on the line, the US sees double-digit leads come and go against France — until Steph Curry takes over.

Entries.Title: VE Day 80
Entries.Description: Eighty years on from the announcement that brought joy and relief to the nation, join in with moments of remembrance from across the UK to pay tribute to the heroes of the past.

Episodes.Title: The Nation Pays Tribute
Episodes.Description: The first day of the VE Day 80 celebrations begins with a military procession and a fly-past to honour the Second World War generation. Presented by Sophie Raworth. The first day of the VE Day 80 celebrations starts with live coverage of a special military procession taking place in London.

Episodes.Title: The Nation Remembers
Episodes.Description: The VE Day 80 celebrations continue with a service of thanksgiving from Westminster Abbey. Presented by Sophie Raworth, with commentary from Petroc Trelawny.

Episodes.Title: A Celebration to Remember
Episodes.Description: The finale of the VE Day 80 celebrations culminate in a spectacular concert from Horse Guards Parade in London, presented by Zoe Ball.

Entries.Title: A Body in the Snow - The Trial of Karen Read
Entries.Description: This exclusive behind-the-scenes docuseries tells the story of murder defendant Karen Read and the controversial trial that has divided a town.

Episodes.Title: What Happened at 34 Fairview?
Episodes.Description: When police officer John O'Keefe turns up dead, authorities arrest his girlfriend Karen for murder.

Episodes.Title: Did I Hit Him?
Episodes.Description: The murder trial of Karen Read begins and jurors hear testimony from witnesses at the scene where they found John O'Keefe's body; outside the courthouse, Turtleboy advocates for Karen's innocence.

Episodes.Title: How Long to Die in Cold
Episodes.Description: As the trial continues, more details emerge about allegedly sloppy evidence collection, conflicting testimonies, manipulated video footage and baffling DNA results; Karen's team suggests a conspiracy and cover-up are at play.

Episodes.Title: A Town Divided
Episodes.Description: The jury hears testimony about Karen's alleged affair, scandalous texts, mysterious butt dials and conflicting Google search timestamps; the conflict in Canton grows.

Episodes.Title: The Verdict
Episodes.Description: As the trial winds down, experts attempt to recreate John's death, the defense brings in one final witness and closing arguments grip the nation; Karen, emotional after a long haul, anxiously awaits her fate; the jury returns with an unexpected note.

Entries.Title: Thirst Trap: The Fame. The Fantasy. The Fallout.
Entries.Description: When 21-year-old William White posted a lip-synching video to TikTok, he hardly expected to become an internet sensation overnight. Sparking a "thirst trap" obsession with lovesick fans, the line between real connection and online fantasy was blurred as gained millions of fans. What first seemed like innocent interactions with self-formed fan-clubs for White, turned into jealousy, blackmail and betrayal by the fans who were determined to watch his every move online.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of a TikTok Heartthrob
Episodes.Description: A TikTok heartthrob. A fanbase of older women. And a movement no one saw coming.

Episodes.Title: Power, Control, and The Fandom of Will White
Episodes.Description: The fandom gets messy. The money gets real. Who's in control now?

Entries.Title: LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy - Pieces of the Past
Entries.Description: A new threat rises in the galaxy, and Sig Greebling and Darth Dev must combine their powers of Force Building and Sith Breaking to stop it. Alongside Jedi Bob, Yesi Scala and Servo, they will journey into the deepest corners of Lego Star Wars lore, uncovering pieces of all the galaxies that have come before.

Entries.Title: Let the Devil In
Entries.Description: A haunting and mysterious documentary series about a decades-old tragedy that destroyed one family and ignited the darkest fears of a small New Jersey town. For the first time, witnesses, friends, and community members try to make sense of the unthinkable events, some believing that Satan took hold of a vulnerable teen boy, while others believe that far more earthly demons were to blame.

Episodes.Title: Shock
Episodes.Description: In 1988, devout Catholic and loving mother was found murdered in her Jefferson, NJ home; investigators uncover satanic symbols and come to realize that her son is missing; was this crime the result of the occult...or something far more close to home.

Episodes.Title: Panic
Episodes.Description: A chilling discovery of another body thrusts the town of Jefferson, NJ into the national spotlight; whispers of devil worship fuel the fire of a nation engulfed by Satanic Panic; as fear mounts, rumors blur what's real...and the supernatural.

Episodes.Title: Evil
Episodes.Description: The town of Jefferson faces a mystery; how does a son murder his mother so brutally and die by suicide in such a seemingly impossible way?; as investigators uncover an obsession with Satan, whispers of demonic possession grow.

Episodes.Title: Trauma
Episodes.Description: Several decades later, the community of Jefferson has formed their own theories…and suspects…behind the crime; unsettling questions explore the intersection of obsession and psychosis, and the haunting events that left a traumatic mark in Jefferson.

Entries.Title: Ninjago Legends: Monstrosity
Entries.Description: After ‘the Merge,’ Kai finds himself in the dark and dangerous Land of Monsters. Surrounded by terrifying creatures, he’s not just looking for his friends—he’s fighting to survive! As his journey unfolds, Kai uncovers shocking secrets and realizes he’s not alone in this twisted world. What secrets lie hidden in the shadows?

Entries.Title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
Entries.Description: Offers the most intimate and profound exploration into the wide-ranging impacts of the Hurricane Katrina disaster to date. Weaving together critical moments of the crisis and the past events that precipitated it, the series delivers an unparalleled, emotionally raw examination of the storm’s personal, political and societal fallout.

Episodes.Title: The Coming Storm
Episodes.Description: Hurricane Katrina looms over New Orleans, while residents face a chaotic evacuation. As the city scrambles to prepare, 100,000 are left behind.

Episodes.Title: Worst Case Scenario
Episodes.Description: New Orleans floods after the levees breach. Residents try to evacuate, rescue efforts begin, and a chaotic atmosphere sets in.

Episodes.Title: A Desperate Place
Episodes.Description: Rescues persist as thousands are trapped at home, with others ushered to the Superdome. Stories of resilience emerge amid media focus on violence.

Episodes.Title: Shoot to Kill
Episodes.Description: Gen. Honoré leads rescue efforts post-Katrina amid pressure to use force. Evacuees face discrimination, and tensions rise as violence increases.

Episodes.Title: Wake Up Call
Episodes.Description: The future of a devastated New Orleans hangs in the balance as its residents struggle to return, rebuild and restore their lives even 20 years later.

Entries.Title: With Love, Meghan
Entries.Description: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex invites friends and famous guests to a beautiful California estate, where she shares cooking, gardening and hosting tips.

Episodes.Title: Hello, Honey!
Episodes.Description: When Meghan's friend Daniel Martin comes to visit, she prepares a thoughtful guest basket, then harvests honey for DIY beeswax candles and a sweet treat.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Party
Episodes.Description: Fellow toddler mom Mindy Kaling drops by Montecito to help Meghan plan a kid-friendly tea party in the garden. But first, frittatas and parfaits.

Episodes.Title: Two Kids from LA
Episodes.Description: Chef Roy Choi bonds with Meghan about growing up in Los Angeles, while teaching her a foolproof way to cook with spicy Korean flavors.

Episodes.Title: Love Is in the Details
Episodes.Description: Meghan and her polo pal Delfina Figueras enjoy a hike in the great outdoors, followed by an afternoon picnic featuring fresh, homemade focaccia.

Episodes.Title: Surprise and Delight
Episodes.Description: Meghan hosts her longtime friends Abigail Spencer and Kelly Zajfen for a breezy ladies' lunch, then shares an easy tip for everyday flower arrangements.

Episodes.Title: The Juice Is Worth the Squeeze
Episodes.Description: When Meghan's girlfriends come over for game night, a local chef pops into the kitchen to help her prepare a gourmet taco bar.

Episodes.Title: Elevating the Everyday
Episodes.Description: Meghan assembles a harvest basket for her dear friend and neighbor Vicky Tsai, then they make Vicky's potsticker recipe and enjoy home beauty treatments.

Episodes.Title: Feels Like Home
Episodes.Description: To celebrate her new business, Meghan and legendary chef Alice Waters whip up fresh California cuisine for a brunch party with family and friends.

Episodes.Title: MeGusta
Episodes.Description: A playful competition ensues when Meghan and Daniel Martin invite chefs David Chang and Christina Tosi over for flower arranging and an improvised feast.

Episodes.Title: It's Way Past Our Bread-time
Episodes.Description: Fellow mom Chrissy Teigen stops by for a hands-on craft day with pressed flowers and throwback snacks. But first, Meghan attempts sourdough starter.

Episodes.Title: Easy as Pie
Episodes.Description: Meghan and fashion expert Tan France exchange easy recipes and kid-friendly craft ideas, including coconut-crusted French toast and custom aprons.

Episodes.Title: How 'bout Them Apples
Episodes.Description: Over apple butter, roast chicken and bookbinding, author and chef Samin Nosrat joins Meghan in Montecito to share old family recipes and new traditions.

Episodes.Title: Spice Up Your Life
Episodes.Description: Rich South Asian flavors abound as Meghan makes vegan soap, naan and green bean curry with podcaster Jay Shetty and cookbook author Radhi Devlukia.

Episodes.Title: Just For The Halibut
Episodes.Description: From fresh green juice to local halibut, California cuisine takes the spotlight as Meghan hosts Clare Smyth, the celebrated chef behind her wedding menu.

Episodes.Title: A Weekend Away
Episodes.Description: Meghan shares tips for packing a capsule wardrobe and heads to Malibu for a girls' getaway filled with pottery, mixology and lots of laughter.

Episodes.Title: A High Tide Raises All Boats
Episodes.Description: Local lobster, uni and oysters shine as chef and humanitarian José Andrés helps Meghan prepare a sumptuous seafood feast to celebrate the show's crew.

Entries.Title: Fit for TV: The Reality of the Biggest Loser
Entries.Description: Takes an inside look at the making of the hit reality TV competition, exploring the good, the bad, and the complicated. Featuring interviews with former contestants, trainers, producers, and health professionals, the documentary examines the show's approach to transformation, the support systems in place, and the unique challenges of filming reality television.

Episodes.Title: Winning the Lottery
Episodes.Description: Eager to transform their lives and bodies, hopefuls audition for "The Biggest Loser." The show is a ratings behemoth — but is it all that it promises?

Entries.Title: A Week Away: The Series
Entries.Description: At Camp Aweegaway, a Christian summer camp filled with adventure and camaraderie, kids come together for experiences that challenge and inspire them. Between team-building competitions, campfires, and heartfelt conversations, they form deep friendships and uncover new layers of their faith and identity. Each day at camp offers opportunities for growth, connection, and unforgettable memories.

Episodes.Title: Welcome Orphans
Episodes.Description: Max, Charlie, and the Sunshine kids are uprooted from their foster home and sent to a Christian summer camp, where longtime campers Lennie and Jake try to help them adjust to the challenges of camp life. As the kids find their footing, Camp Director David faces mounting tension when Karla, the camp’s controlling benefactor, and her determined daughter Savannah arrive, intent on reshaping the camp to fit their vision.

Episodes.Title: Why Am I Here?
Episodes.Description: While Max slowly warms up to camper Lennie, he remains cautious of the camp’s spiritual atmosphere, unlike his brother Charlie, who eagerly embraces the experience and finds his place. As the first big event—the team chant competition—kicks off, Jake is determined to defend his reigning champion title, setting the stage for a summer filled with competition, personal growth, and unexpected friendships.

Episodes.Title: Charlie Turns Green
Episodes.Description: Camp is alive with rivalry and excitement as teams rehearse for the talent show. Charlie’s growing faith leads him to agree to a baptism during Savannah’s flashy ceremony, which is designed to showcase the camp’s spiritual success. But Max grows increasingly unsettled, worried the baptism will create distance between him and his brother. Quietly, he forms a plan that could derail the event, forcing both brothers to confront what faith, family, and belonging truly mean.

Episodes.Title: It Is Well
Episodes.Description: Day 4 at Camp Aweegaway kicks off with the 4:13 Challenge—a high-energy, scripture-based scavenger hunt that pushes each team to work together and dig deeper. Still reeling from the failed baptism spectacle, Karla and Savannah set their sights on Max, secretly plotting to turn his potential conversion into a redemption story. Unaware of their scheme, Max begins to soften—not because of pressure, but through his growing friendship with Lennie, who quietly guides him toward a more spiritual path.

Entries.Title: The Kingdom
Entries.Description: In 2024, the two-time defending champion Kansas City Chiefs aimed to make history by becoming the first NFL team to win three straight Super Bowls. "The Kingdom" – a new six-part ESPN Original Series – chronicles the Chiefs’ dramatic pursuit of a three-peat, the legacy of the franchise, and the unforgettable characters who built its modern-day football dynasty.

Episodes.Title: Family Business
Episodes.Description: Behind Patrick Mahomes, whose journey from son of a baseball player to superstar quarterback is already legendary, the Chiefs - one of the NFL's most storied franchises - kick off their bid for a third straight Super Bowl title. But a rash of injuries threaten their strong start to the 2024 season and raise serious concerns about the challenging road ahead.

Episodes.Title: Don't Judge
Episodes.Description: Guided by a resolve never to judge anyone else and a firm belief in second chances, legendary Chiefs coach Andy Reid has leaned on family bonds to sustain him through the highs of victory and the lows of unthinkable tragedy. As the 2024 season continues, injuries and new additions engender major question marks.

Episodes.Title: In Our Chiefs Era
Episodes.Description: In the most anticipated game of the regular season, the Chiefs square off against AFC rivals Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills. Meanwhile beyond the field, the team works to maintain focus, a difficult task considering their dominance and global popularity have earned them love and hate in equal measure.

Episodes.Title: The Formula
Episodes.Description: An ankle injury to Patrick Mahomes puts more pressure - and the team's Super Bowl hopes - on the shoulders of Chris Jones and the Chiefs' defense. A Christmas Day showdown against the Pittsburgh Steelers has major postseason implications.

Episodes.Title: Heartland
Episodes.Description: With Chiefs Kingdom in full-throated support, Kansas City earns a home playoff win against the Texans. Their reward: an AFC Championship Game rematch with the Buffalo Bills, with a third straight trip to the Super Bowl on the line.

Episodes.Title: The Pursuit
Episodes.Description: The Chiefs arrive in New Orleans on the verge of Super Bowl history. Standing in the way of their three-peat hopes are the Philadelphia Eagles, who have no intention of playing supporting characters in a storybook ending.

Entries.Title: Are You My First?
Entries.Description: In this groundbreaking new dating experiment, the largest, hottest group of virgins ever assembled search for intimacy, love - and maybe their first - in a tropical paradise designed just for them. For the first time, they're free to explore their connections without judgment, allowing these sexy young singles to embark on a heated yet heartfelt journey packed with romantic dates, revealing challenges, and new love interests eager to find "the one." Who will find that special someone? And who will go home hot, bothered and heartbroken?

Episodes.Description: Colton Underwood and Kaitlyn Bristowe host the virgins in paradise and kick off their first challenge. Crushes and love triangles quickly form, and when a sexy new arrival shows up,

Episodes.Description: Women swoon over the new arrival, threatening current connections. One virgin questions her crush after learning he’s been smooth-talking other girls. A spicy

Episodes.Title: The Virgin Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: A broken promise leads one woman to explore a previous relationship, meanwhile one guy is blindsided when a connection reveals feelings for someone else.

Episodes.Title: Double The Trouble
Episodes.Description: An agonizing tiebreaker forces one woman to leave her connection and the Island forever. The arrival of two new virgins threatens current couples, fueling jealousy and insecurities. One guy makes a grand romantic gesture in a bid to save his relationship.

Episodes.Title: F-Boys for Life
Episodes.Description: A high-flying date nosedives, leaving one virgin guarded. A shocking breakup exposes the f-boys on the island. One woman second-guesses the connection she left behind, while another confronts her partner when the truth about his feelings are revealed.

Episodes.Title: Never Have I Ever
Episodes.Description: The Virgin Sacrifice explodes with surprises. Two friends create a splash as they compete for a date with the same woman. One woman experiences a few firsts on her date. Two virgins realize their love interests may be more into each other than them.

Episodes.Title: The First Love Shack
Episodes.Description: Virgins lay their hearts on the line during the Virgin Sacrifice. Three new guys spice things up on the Island. A salsa class heats up with a steamy kiss while one couple bonds in the Love Shack.

Episodes.Title: A Tight Spot
Episodes.Description: Laughter quickly turns to tears when two couples have their relationships roasted in front of the group. One virgin fears her intimacy struggles could jeopardize her promising connection, while another is determined to find romance before time runs out.

Episodes.Title: The Virgin Betrayal
Episodes.Description: One virgin is furious when her crush is taken on a date by another girl, fueling conflict. A sexy paint session pushes one couple out of their comfort zone. The final Virgin Sacrifice delivers shocking choices and emotional goodbyes that shake the villa.

Episodes.Title: The Big Finish
Episodes.Description: In the season finale, one woman ends her love triangle. The final couples shack up and out of their comfort zones. Finally, the virgins decide if they will take their relationship off the island.

Entries.Title: Oh My God... Yes! A Series of Extremely Relatable Circumstances
Entries.Description: Follow three women – Sunny, Tulip, and Ladi – who live in the not-so-distant future of South Central LA as they navigate womanhood in an unpredictable, tech-driven world.

Episodes.Title: you fools!
Episodes.Description: Sunny and Tulip clash on how to parent a giant demon baby while Ladi is hell bent on destroying it.

Episodes.Title: fieh
Episodes.Description: After being dumped, Tulip rebounds with a rapping spider. Sunny and Ladi try to convince her that her new arachnid boyfriend is bad news.

Episodes.Title: like literally eat them?
Episodes.Description: Accompanied by a Man Tiger, the girls are chased through South Central by a cult of outdated bots who believe their destiny is to eat the rich.

Episodes.Title: steel ball sounds like a very dangerous game
Episodes.Description: SteelBall champ Jicheal Mordan wants to have a baby with Sunny and bankroll her life. Now if only she can remember where she put her uterus ...

Episodes.Description: Things go awry when Sunny attempts to produce a "better" Jamal over and over... and over again.

Episodes.Description: While Sunny spirals about getting older, Tulip seeks closure in all the wrong places until Ladi takes control.

Episodes.Description: The girls discover an ominous DO NOT TOUCH button in the Pixel Bar that, when pressed, ignites a series of very strange encounters.

Entries.Title: Love Thy Nader
Entries.Description: Four Louisiana sisters - led by model Brooks Nader - chase their dreams in NYC's Soho, balancing fashion careers and sisterhood far from their bayou roots.

Episodes.Title: Not in the Bayou Anymore
Episodes.Description: Supermodel Brooks Nader moves in with her three outspoken sisters just as their parents arrive to celebrate her new fashion line. But when questions swirl about Brooks' boyfriend, "Dancing with the Stars" partner Gleb, family pride gives way to scandal.

Episodes.Title: Threesomes in Joshua Tree
Episodes.Description: Brooks tries to keep it together as her relationship crumbles before her Hudson Jeans launch. Grace Ann faces fallout with her agents as she clashes with Sarah Jane's advice. A trip to Miami offers a new start until headlines blow it up.

Episodes.Title: Kegs and Legs
Episodes.Description: Breakup buzz follows the girls to Miami. Grace Ann makes a bold career move on her own. Brooks throws herself into work, but missing her sister's 25th birthday sets off a whole new mess. Sarah Jane confronts her attitude toward her sister.

Episodes.Title: Easter Slaps
Episodes.Description: Sarah Jane faces her conservative roots head-on when she brings a girl home to Baton Rouge for the Easter crawfish boil. Mary Holland questions whether Lord Jules can hang in the Bayou. New threats shatter Brooks' hometown peace.

Episodes.Title: Sextapes and Silence
Episodes.Description: Brooks wrestles with how to live with the threat of a sex tape hanging over her head. The family crosses paths with Gleb for the first time since the breakup. Sarah Jane is called out for being messy.

Episodes.Title: Sex, Swimwear and Salmon Sperm
Episodes.Description: Brooks rushes into her single era. Grace Ann books a major campaign. Mary Holland plots her next micro-retirement step. Sarah Jane's roster stirs the pot.

Episodes.Title: Panic in the Bathtub
Episodes.Description: Brooks' health takes a dive, worrying her sisters. Mary Holland's startup dreams face reality. Grace Ann begins thinking about marriage. Sarah Jane pushes back against slut-shaming.

Episodes.Title: Sisterhood Above All
Episodes.Description: When stakes hit an all-time high, the sisters face their toughest choices yet. How far will they go to succeed in the modeling world? Will it cost them their relationships and well-being?

Entries.Title: Cold Case: The Tylenol Murders
Entries.Description: Who really laced Tylenol with cyanide? This true-crime series examines alarming theories behind the unsolved killings — and tracks down a key suspect.

Episodes.Title: Pain Killer
Episodes.Description: After cyanide-laced Tylenol kills multiple people across Chicago, police and the media scramble to spread a nationwide warning.

Episodes.Title: The Bitter Pill
Episodes.Description: A key suspect maintains his innocence, even as authorities discover his suspicious past and possible motive. Tylenol unveils new triple-seal packaging.

Episodes.Title: Sealed for Your Protection
Episodes.Description: Decades after the murders, a victim's daughter searches for justice — and uncovers forgotten evidence that supports a controversial theory.

Entries.Title: The Black Dagger Brotherhood
Entries.Description: A brotherhood of vampire warriors protects their race from demonic lessers. United by tragedy, the few remaining fighters confront the lessers, striving to restore the vampire realm.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Darius makes an impossible request of his fellow Brother, Wrath. The Black Dagger Brotherhood suffers a direct attack from the Lessening society. Darius’s half breed daughter, Beth meets Wrath and their connection is immediate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The Brotherhood searches for the Lessening Society’s headquarters. Butch shows Beth how he feels about her. Wrath tells Beth who and what her father really was.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Wrath and Marissa’s past comes to light. Mr. X sets his sights on Billy Riddle. Butch grows more worried about Beth. Beth meets Tohrment. An intimate dinner brings Wrath and Beth closer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Rhage unleashes his beast. Wrath opens up to Beth. Mr. X punishes a lesser and invites Billy to join the Society. Beth’s transition begins and Butch rushes her to Wrath where he meets the Brotherhood.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Beth survives the transition with Wrath’s help. As their bond deepens, the house prepares for a major ceremony. Wrath seeks guidance from the Scribe Virgin. Butch learns the truth about the vampire world. Mr. X and the Omega target Billy Riddle. Havers begins plotting his revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Wrath learns of a murder plot against him. Mr. X kidnaps Beth. Wrath rallies the Brotherhood and Butch for a rescue mission. As night falls, the battle begins.

Entries.Title: WWE LFG
Entries.Description: Take an inside look at what it truly takes to make it in the WWE. Iconic WWE Legends such as Paul "Triple H" Levesque and Shawn Michaels and weekly regular coaches Undertaker, Booker T, Mickie James and Bubba Ray Dudley mentor a new generation in weekly matches on their quest to become the next WWE Superstars.

Episodes.Title: This is WWE LFG
Episodes.Description: The Future Greats meet their legendary mentors, and show their skills on the mic and in the ring. Four select superstars have a match to control their destiny, while one WWE-hopeful's attitude could kill his chances at LFG glory.

Episodes.Title: Legendary Teams
Episodes.Description: The top four superstars compete in a mixed tag match before a sold out LFG arena. The remaining members of the roster find out which WWE Legend will be leading them on their respective journey, and get some pointers in the ring before putting the advice to practice in a match with their peers and coaches as spectators.

Episodes.Title: Verbal Takedown
Episodes.Description: The Legends get a double-dose of help from former colleagues and champions Brian "Road Dogg" James and Michelle McCool. One Future Great adds a finishing move to her developing repertoire, another finds out that sometimes a match can be unforgiving, and four new superstars fight for one LFG roster spot.

Episodes.Title: Faction Frenzy
Episodes.Description: Former WCW President Eric Bischoff created the N.W.O., breaking new ground for sports entertainment. Bischoff and WWE Hall of Famer Sean Waltman challenge each LFG team to create a new faction to expand their individual and collective personas.

Episodes.Title: Speak Your Truth
Episodes.Description: LFG gets a visit from controversial and charismatic WWE superstar CM Punk. "The Best In The World" joins the Legends to try to push the Future Greats on the mic and in the ring, as tensions continue to rise

Episodes.Title: Stepping into the Spotlight
Episodes.Description: Several of the Future Greats prepare for a milestone event: their first ever match in front of a live audience! Who will shine under the bright lights? And who will crumble under the pressure?

Episodes.Title: Toughness & Grit
Episodes.Description: WWE World Heavyweight Champion Gunther challenges the Future Greats to show more toughness and urgency in their matches. One Future Great is tasked with finding her dark side, while another is pushed to the edge when Bubba Ray Dudley makes a comment that cuts her to the core.

Episodes.Title: Making Your Move
Episodes.Description: Tensions are at an all-time high as the competition reaches the halfway point. WWE Hall of Famer Diamond Dallas Page stops by to help the Future Greats develop new signature moves.

Episodes.Title: Tag Team Turmoil
Episodes.Description: Bubba Ray Dudley brings in his brother D-Von to teach the Future Greats the art of tag team wrestling; the unexpected return of BJ Ray throws everything into disarray and causes complete chaos in the ring.

Episodes.Title: Expect the Unexpected
Episodes.Description: The Future Greats are forced to navigate a difficult task and adjust on the fly to an unexpected malfunction. Meanwhile, tensions between BJ and Cutler reach a boiling point, and one of these competitors will be sent home for good.

Episodes.Title: The Name Says It All
Episodes.Description: As the threat of elimination hangs over their heads, "The Phenomenal" AJ Styles lays down a challenge to the Future Greats; who can create a compelling nickname and live up to it in the ring?

Episodes.Title: The Playoffs Begin!
Episodes.Description: The playoffs begin! Emotions run high, as the female future greats face off to see who will advance to the semi-finals, and who will be sent home.

Episodes.Title: Who Wants It More?
Episodes.Description: The male future greats compete in the semifinal matches of the LFG playoffs. Two will move onto the finals at Madison Square Garden, while the other two will be forced to say goodbye.

Episodes.Title: Win or Go Home
Episodes.Description: The Great Eight become the Final Four on the road to the Finals in New York City. But before battling it out in the ring, the Future Greats meet face-to-face in a series of epic promo battles where not even the Legends are safe.

Episodes.Title: The LFG Finals
Episodes.Description: It's the LFG Finals from New York City! Which coach will be awarded the LFG Championship belt? And which Future Greats will become the newest members of NXT?

Episodes.Description: It's high drama during the LFG Draft! Sparks fly and tensions are at an all-time high, as unresolved issues between Drake Morreaux and Bubba Ray Dudley come to light.

Episodes.Description: The Future Greats are switching it up, evolving their characters, and trying something new. Who will crumble under the added pressure?

Episodes.Title: Good Vs. Evil
Episodes.Description: WWE Superstar Charlotte Flair stops by LFG, where the Future Greats impress The Queen in the ring and on the mic! Two alphas face off as Shiloh and Harlem go to war, while Sirena and Haze shine in the main event spotlight, and a hard-hitting showdown.

Episodes.Description: Bayley and Summer headline this larger than life edition of LFG, as the Future Greats are tasked with using their size to their advantage. Dani, Elijah, and Chris are all underdogs hungry for a fight.

Entries.Title: American Manhunt: O.J. Simpson
Entries.Description: The white Bronco. The gloves. The trial of the century. This documentary series investigates the shocking murder case that became a cultural phenomenon.

Episodes.Title: The Blood
Episodes.Description: A dog with bloody paws leads neighbors to Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman's bodies. O.J. Simpson's DNA is found at the crime scene.

Episodes.Title: The Search
Episodes.Description: O.J. agrees to turn himself in, but he's a no-show. Following a tip, police pursue a white Bronco on the highway and a media frenzy erupts.

Episodes.Title: The Circus
Episodes.Description: O.J.'s defense targets the prosecution's witnesses, DNA evidence and a detective's racist history. Courtroom cameras lend a theatrical edge to the trial.

Entries.Title: Unconventional
Entries.Description: Unconventional is a bold, hilarious, and deeply authentic look at modern queer life. Created by six-time Emmy nominee Kit Williamson (EastSiders, Mad Men), this irreverent comedy follows Noah Guillory (Williamson), a queer millennial juggling a decade-long marriage, the uncertainty of fatherhood, and the chaos of academia—all while acting as a sperm donor for his sister’s wife.

Episodes.Description: Noah agrees to be the donor to his sister's girlfriend, but his husband wants a baby of their own.

Episodes.Description: Noah and Dan try to hide their boyfriend from their parents and Margot reveals she's off her meds.

Episodes.Title: Whiskey Bottle
Episodes.Description: Margot has a manic episode, and Eliza discovers a complication in her pregnancy.

Episodes.Title: Honeydew
Episodes.Description: With their lives falling apart, everyone is faced with difficult choices about the future.

Episodes.Title: A Fucking Baby
Episodes.Description: In the season finale, the gang must face what a fucking baby means for their future.

Episodes.Description: Ify, Zeke, Ronnie, and Alex play Betrayal at House on the Hill, the horror board game of deception.

Episodes.Description: Carolyn, Jimmy, Danielle, and Brian play Cosmic Encounter, the board game of intergalactic conquest.

Episodes.Description: The cast of Dimension 20: The Seven become pirates and play the dice games Liar’s Dice and Farkle.

Episodes.Description: Chris Grace and friends play Blood on the Clocktower and try to find the demon amongst themselves.

Entries.Title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
Entries.Description: To safeguard their streets, the New Orleans Police Department boasts a dedicated team of homicide detectives, many of whom are natives of the legendary city. “Homicide Squad New Orleans” chronicles the harrowing work of this committed group of men and women united against the odds to protect their city and home. In each episode, the team will be faced with a new case and tasked with putting together the evidence to catch the perpetrator, find answers for the victims loved ones, and keep their community safe.

Episodes.Title: My Sister's Keeper
Episodes.Description: Detective Maurice Stewart investigates the murder of Raynard Williams Jr, a 15-year-old boy, who was gunned down after walking his younger sister home.

Episodes.Title: In  Cold Blood
Episodes.Description: Det. Walter Edmond responds to a homicide where a woman is found dead from multiple gunshot wounds, and a couple at the scene leads him to a suspect. Surveillance footage and ballistics evidence link the suspect to two murders.

Episodes.Title: Mardi Gras Murder
Episodes.Description: Amid the vibrant chaos of New Orleans' Mardi Gras celebrations, gunshots shatter the festive atmosphere of the French Quarter, leaving a man dead. Detective James Fyfe takes on the investigation, determined to bring closure to the victim's grieving family despite the challenges of solving a murder in one of the city's busiest seasons.

Episodes.Title: Know Thy Neighbor
Episodes.Description: Lead Detective Tanisha Sykes Smith tackles the case of a lifetime resident of the Lower 9th Ward found murdered a block away from his mother’s home. Detective Smith works the case step-by-step to apprehend the alleged shooter.

Episodes.Title: A Mother's Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Detective Rayell Johnson investigates the murder of a 42-year-old New Orleans native, who was gunned down in his truck on a stormy night.

Episodes.Title: Afternoon Ambush
Episodes.Description: With the help of Det. Johnson and Det. Stewart, Det. Diesburg pieces together what happened one Saturday afternoon when two teens fired rifles on two other teens driving down the street in a residential neighborhood in the 6th district.

Episodes.Title: A Witness to Murder
Episodes.Description: Detective Arthur Hill is on the case to catch a suspected killer, but he's relying on a witness who is fearful because they survived a gunshot from the suspect. Meanwhile, Detective Stewart is called to a busy intersection where an elderly woman suffers a horrible attack from a homeless man armed with a knife.

Episodes.Title: Caught in 4K

Entries.Title: The Tech Bro Murders
Entries.Description: The Tech Bro Murders" is a six-episode true crime docuseries from Investigation Discovery (ID) that explores real-life homicide cases set against the backdrop of Silicon Valley. Guided by retired detective Sandra Brown, the series uncovers the dark side of the tech world, where ambition, wealth, and power can lead to shocking acts of violence. The show examines a variety of cases, including the murder of a Google X executive, a cold case connected to a politician, and a recent high-profile case involving Cash App founder Bob Lee. Each episode delves into a different story, providing a glimpse into the tragic outcomes that have occurred in this high-stakes digital frontier.

Episodes.Title: Killer Code
Episodes.Description: Police are baffled when they find a gifted programmer and a jilted lover at the scene of the murder of a beloved 62-year-old resident in Menlo Park, CA. The investigation takes an unexpected turn as they work to find the responsible party.

Episodes.Title: Black Widow, Dark Web

Episodes.Title: Rich and Reckless

Entries.Title: Earnhardt
Entries.Description: The untold story of Dale Earnhardt Sr.'s ascent as NASCAR's preeminent figure. His charm resonated beyond the sport, yielding fame and fortune. An intimate exploration of a working-class icon's impact on his family and the racing world.

Episodes.Title: Ironhead
Episodes.Description: Dale rockets to stardom on NASCAR's biggest stage with an unprecedented championship in just his second season, but a series of challenges on and off the track threatens his future. His upbringing inside North Carolina's racing culture sheds light on what drives him, while he and upstart team owner Richard Childress aggressively chart their path back to the top.

Episodes.Title: The Intimidator
Episodes.Description: Dale transforms into 'The Intimidator' as the bad boy of racing chases Richard Petty's record of seven Winston Cup championships. As his legend grows, the intensifying demands of Dale's career fuel tensions within the family—and the life and death stakes of racing soon hit close to home.

Episodes.Title: One Tough Customer
Episodes.Description: Dale's fame and fortune reach new heights as he pursues an eighth championship and an ever-elusive Daytona 500 win. But a younger crop of drivers challenge his reign, and family dynamics become more complicated when the Earnhardt kids set out to follow in their father's footsteps on the track.

Episodes.Title: Dale
Episodes.Description: Father and son unite on the track at the 2001 Daytona 500, leading the pack in a fateful race that becomes a turning point for the family and the entire sport of NASCAR.

Entries.Title: Amy's Dead-End Dreamhouse
Entries.Description: Welcome to Amy’s Dead-End Dreamhouse! Follow Amy and her apartment full of appliances as they encounter all kinds of adult problems, from mental illness, to job hunting, to impossible beauty standards, to your guy friends getting red-pilled. Turns out, life can’t really be solved in under 20 minutes, even with commercial breaks.

Episodes.Title: Total Career Collapse
Episodes.Description: Amy tries working two jobs at once to make double the money in half the time. But when she’s unceremoniously fired from both, she has to venture out into the big wild world of job hunting.

Episodes.Title: Ugly Panic
Episodes.Description: Amy wakes up with a new lease on life and a plan to become “hot” by any means necessary. As her scary unconscious desires come to life, her appliances have to figure out how to break the spell before her internal monsters destroy them all.

Episodes.Title: Ghosts of Friendship Past
Episodes.Description: Amy is sent a mysterious letter in the mail from an ex-best friend. Amy concocts an elaborate plan for revenge, but she’ll have to learn to face her own fears of abandonment.

Episodes.Title: Microwaved Misogyny
Episodes.Description: When Amy’s apartment gets hit by lightning, Mike the Microwave is reverted back to his misogynist factory settings. Can they pull their dear friend out of his new red-pill mode? Or will Amy have to explode him with a fork?

Episodes.Title: Personality Disorder
Episodes.Description: Amy can’t get out of bed. Amy needs a mental health professional. But don’t worry! Amy also has horrible insurance.

Entries.Title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
Entries.Description: Seeking out incredible people who perform real feats that look like magic, David Blaine takes viewers on a jaw-dropping journey through some of the world's most extraordinary cultures as he seeks out kindred spirits, finds inspiration, and learns some truly exceptional skills along the way.

Episodes.Title: Brazil
Episodes.Description: In Brazil, David Blaine seeks inspiration by immersing himself in his hosts' vibrant energy, passion and spontaneity. The exceptional daredevils, artists, explorers and athletes he encounters unite to help him bring an audacious feat to life that's lingered in his dreams for years.

Episodes.Title: Southeast Asia
Episodes.Description: In Southeast Asia, David Blaine explores fascinating relationships with wildlife and how pain endurance can transform fear into magic. He meets practitioners who appear impenetrable by sharp objects and performers who can endure the stings of venomous creatures. David unpacks how people exploit fear in order to create wonder.

Episodes.Title: India
Episodes.Description: Growing up, David Blaine was fascinated by images from India of extraordinary physical feats. This evolved into a life-long obsession with real acts that are so extreme they look like magic. Using secrets passed down over hundreds of years, people still perform these acts today. In India, David unearths these modern practitioners to explore how belief and performance intersect to make magic.

Episodes.Title: Arctic Circle
Episodes.Description: In the stunning frozen landscape of the Arctic Circle, David Blaine explores humanity's curiously extreme ability to endure freezing temperatures. He meets and learns from people who reach beyond their limits to transform barriers into new frontiers and embody a sense of resilience, perseverance and grit that is unique to the region.

Episodes.Title: South Africa
Episodes.Description: In a nation once defined by apartheid, David embarks on an epic adventure in South Africa, uncovering the magic of its diverse cultures and wildlife that is reshaping perceptions and dismantling barriers in this dynamic country.

Episodes.Title: Japan
Episodes.Description: From perfectly punctual bullet trains to meticulously assembled pieces of sushi, Japan is renowned for its craftsmanship, artistry and commitment to excellence in all endeavors. In Japan, David explores the concept of mastery by meeting with people who spend a lifetime refining a single skill.

Entries.Title: Extracted
Entries.Description: 12 untrained competitors attempt to survive extremely grueling conditions, perilous terrain, and the threat of fearsome predators in the unforgiving Canadian wilderness. Meanwhile, some miles away, their family members are locked down at a secluded headquarters watching them navigate their dangerous surroundings alone via a 24/7 live feed.

Episodes.Title: Survive the Night
Episodes.Description: The survivalists arrive in Canada and spend their first night alone in the wilderness; as they attempt to build a shelter, their families watch from afar.

Episodes.Title: Gimme Shelter
Episodes.Description: Tensions mount as families compete for the power to send in life-saving supplies to their loved ones; several families are on the verge of extraction as their survivalist must figure out how to get across the lake to get the next drop of supplies.

Episodes.Title: The Hunt
Episodes.Description: Emotions between family members in HQ erupt when faced with another challenge; the starving survivalists compete for food, while family members draw maps to get their family members to a food source in the forest.

Episodes.Title: Surviving the Storm
Episodes.Description: The alliances at HQ are tested as families must anonymously provide critical supplies to one of the remaining survivalists; the survivalists face a decision that could affect both their fellow competitors in the wild and their families back at HQ.

Episodes.Title: Burn Before Reading
Episodes.Description: The competition becomes more intense for both the survivalists and their family members. In the first challenge, the members in HQ must unanimously rank all the survivalists from strongest to weakest. The order of ranking will determine which family will be first to select a hunting weapon of their choice in the supply room which will then be dropped off to their loved one in the wilderness. Then, the family members get the chance to write a letter to their survivalist

Episodes.Title: The Game Has Changed
Episodes.Description: The survivalists attempt to hunt for food using the various weapons and tools their loved ones selected for them in the last supply drop; a family member at HQ must decide which of the remaining seven survivalists will receive critical supplies.

Episodes.Title: Family vs. Family
Episodes.Description: With limited energy left in them, the survivalists are put head-to-head in a swimming race to retrieve a bag of supplies located in the center of the lake; the battle continues in HQ as families are pitted against each other.

Episodes.Title: Mystery Box
Episodes.Description: With only five survivalists left, alliances are tested, and new strategies emerge in HQ as family members must choose which survivalist will forfeit a critical supply of their choosing. Then, a crucial supply box is stranded in the middle of a freezing 48-degree lake, but only one survivalist can claim it in time. In the final challenge, the families must guide their survivalists to crates filled with supplies using only a compass

Episodes.Title: Banished
Episodes.Description: With four competitors left in the competition, the families in HQ build alliances and focus on their strategies to keep their survivalist in the competition. A mystery crate creates tension amongst the families as they either keep or trade the items inside the box. A hidden advantage is placed in HQ which will be powerful for whoever finds it first and detrimental to another family. Then, two survival trials take place which include building a torch, racing with it and sacrificing some of their most coveted supplies when faced with possibly relocating their shelters

Episodes.Title: The Final Drop
Episodes.Description: The remaining survivalists and their families at HQ go head-to-head; the survivalists must correctly guess a five-letter word chosen by their family at HQ to open the final supply drop; the survivalists must decipher a Morse code puzzle.

Episodes.Description: When the Mermicornos find a community of fish being bullied, Gwen takes matters into her own hooves.

Episodes.Title: Memories of a Mermicorno
Episodes.Description: The Mermicornos finally make it to the Mermicorno Kingdom ... but new revelations threaten to change the Mermi-Crew forever.

Episodes.Title: No Place Like Home
Episodes.Description: The Mermi-Crew set out in search of Valentina ... but soon realize that while finding her is easy, getting her to leave is hard.

Episodes.Title: Kraken Down
Episodes.Description: Astra adopts a laid-back persona to impress Rip Tide and Sunsprite. Meanwhile, Squishella's jealousy leads to magical mayhem.

Episodes.Description: After discovering his creative side, Sawtooth must decide if he's a Hench-Shark or a Mermicorno.

Entries.Description: This thought-provoking documentary series examines the harrowing consequences of the Vietnam War, from the Gulf of Tonkin incident to the fall of Saigon.

Episodes.Title: America Goes to War
Episodes.Description: As Cold War tensions escalate, the US secretly enters the fight against North Vietnam, while widespread protests spark intense unrest in South Vietnam.

Episodes.Description: From undesirable to undeniable, The American Nightmare lives out his dream inside the squared circle, rising to the top of WWE.

Entries.Title: 1000-lb Roomies
Entries.Description: Self-proclaimed 'extra' in every way, Jaz and Nesha are each other's ride-or-die and co-conspirators in laughter, snacks and survival. But when Jaz' doctor gives her the shocking news that her life is at risk if she doesn't lose weight soon, the duo realizes that it's time to turn over a new leaf and kickstart their wellness journey. Jaz doesn't want to leave her daughter without a mother, so she commits to losing almost 200 lbs. Nesha, still not sold on surgery, isn't quite ready to jump on board. As roles shift and tensions rise, the pair must navigate new boundaries, old habits and the weight of what's at stake. The decision to change their lives and embark on this endeavor will test their commitment, willpower and unbreakable bond in unimaginable ways, but through it all, they will always have each other's backs.

Entries.Title: Octopus!
Entries.Description: This is a documentary about being murdered by your lover, getting lost in Mexico, finding a unicorn, a competitive quilter, Tracy Morgan, and exploring our connection with a possible alien. In other words, it's a documentary about the octopus. Narrated by Phoebe Waller-Bridge.

Episodes.Title: Part 1
Episodes.Description: Let's look at the octopus through the eyes of the people who love them, as well as those who think they're ugly. And along the way, we'll follow the life of a Giant Pacific Octopus we've named "Doris" as she survives in the dark, dangerous ocean.

Episodes.Description: Our journey with Doris and the humans who are obsessed with her continues, as we add more people to our story. Investigators question everyone in Trent's inner circle, but no one can think of a single person who would want to hurt the popular athlete. Entries.Title: Spy High
Entries.Description: When teenager Blake Robbins files a lawsuit claiming his school is spying on him, it sparks a wild scandal with alarming digital privacy implications.

Episodes.Title: Caught in the Act
Episodes.Description: High school sophomore Blake Robbins' entire life changes when he's called into the principal's office and accused of selling drugs. The evidence is a photo of Blake taken in his bedroom. Blake's family files a lawsuit against the school district, causing a media frenzy, triggering an FBI investigation, and exposing shocking new evidence that sends his small suburban township into a furor.

Episodes.Title: Project Green Light
Episodes.Description: The Lower Merion School District hires a prominent law firm to conduct an investigation into the spying allegations. The investigation reveals a startling discovery: over 56,000 images were captured from students' laptop webcams and dozens of students were recorded in their homes. The Robbins' attorney digs further, uncovering disturbing revelations from behind the scenes.

Episodes.Title: Not For Us
Episodes.Description: As the FBI investigate allegations that the Lower Merion School District spied on Blake Robbins, students Keron Williams and Jalil Hassan are notified that photos were taken of them with their laptop webcams. This discovery leads to an exploration of the complicated history of racial inequity in the school district. As the family and community prepare for trial, new obstacles arise.

Episodes.Title: Canary in the Coal Mine
Episodes.Description: When a settlement is reached, uncomfortable truths emerge about the winners and losers of the lawsuit. As the community moves on, the lasting impact on the victims and their families remains, while, today, student activity monitoring software is more prevalent than ever, leading to a host of troubling new consequences that raise the question: are we protecting children or harming them?

Special guest judges Revry CEO, Damian Pelliccione and the Director of Bridesmaids, Paul Feig, will be here to decide who has the right stuff!

The kings show off their improv skills in a group Weenie Challenge before transforming into legendary celebrities for "The Dong Show,": King of Drag's celebrity impersonation talent show!

Comedy pros Jeff Hiller and Bridget Everett join Murray Hill for a Somebody, Somewhere reunion and are guest judges on the Kings Court for this unforgettable episode.

Episodes.Title: Death of Your Fears
