Then, in a deeply personal Beefy Challenge, they'll confront their greatest fears through the transformative power of drag. With special guest judges Liv Hewson (Showtime’s Yellowjackets), Vico Ortiz (HBO Max’s Our Flag Means Death), and Landon Cider (winner of Dragula).

Episodes.Title: Prom Night
Episodes.Description: Relive the awkward glory of prom! First, for the Weenie Challenge, the kings test their knowledge in a Drag King History Quiz. Then, it's time for an “Under the Seaquins”-themed Beefy Challenge as they create dazzling aquatic-themed looks and campaign for the role of Prom King. Special guest judges Carmen Carrera, Brian Michael Smith, and Jackie Beat will crown the royalty of the night.

Episodes.Title: A Song for the King
Episodes.Description: Let's rock! The kings unleash their inner rock stars in a high-energy Weenie Challenge before battling it out in an epic Lip Sync Battle. Get ready for fierce competition and killer performances with special guest judges Kathleen Hanna (Le Tigre), comedian Cameron Esposito, and Aubrey Shea (Revry’s Unconventional).

Episodes.Title: Showbiz
Episodes.Description: The crown is within reach. In the grand finale, the remaining kings pull out all the stops in a final showdown to determine who will be named the FIRST EVER "King of Drag". Featuring guest judges on the Kings' Court: Tony-winning playwright and actor Cole Escola (Oh, Mary!), legendary actress and "Real Housewife" Lisa Rinna (Prime Video's Traitors), Damian Pelliccione (Revry CEO), and Kylie Sonique Love (MTV's RuPaul's Drag Race).

Entries.Title: Naming the Dead
Entries.Description: There are 50,000 bodies lying unnamed and unmourned across America with no way of identifying them, until now. This powerful new series follows the DNA Doe Project - a leading organization in genetic investigation and identification - as they partner with law enforcement agencies to solve the coldest of cases, name these unidentified bodies, and bring resolution to families across the country.

Episodes.Title: The Hitchhiker
Episodes.Description: After exhausting all leads, coroner Scott McCord turns to the DNA Doe Project to try to identify one of the victims of serial killer Larry Eyler.

Episodes.Title: A Box Of Bones
Episodes.Description: For 38 years, the identity of a Texas murder victim has been a mystery - now police are teaming up with the DNA Doe Project to find out who she was.

Episodes.Title: The Body in the Sand
Episodes.Description: Thirty-two years ago, a young, unidentified female was found dead in the desert. Now, local police are joining forces with the DNA Doe Project to bring her home.

Episodes.Title: The Body on the Train
Episodes.Description: Discovering the grave of a man crushed under ice in a railroad car, journalist Marresa Burke joins forces with the DNA Doe Project to find his family.

Episodes.Title: The Oil Well Murder
Episodes.Description: Detective Bryan Johnson’s first case is a homicide. To solve it, he first needs to identify the victim, so he enlists the help of the DNA Doe Project.

Episodes.Title: The Man on fire
Episodes.Description: In 1996, a young man was burned alive in Atlanta. Who was he? Investigators team up with the DNA Doe Project to identify him and find his family.

Entries.Title: Taurasi
Entries.Description: Basketball legend Diana Taurasi shares the inside story of her life and career - with no stone left unturned.

Episodes.Title: A Star in Storrs
Episodes.Description: Diana Taurasi's journey to basketball greatness begins in Chino, CA with her family. After a brief, difficult move to Argentina, her family returns home, reigniting her passion for basketball. A top high school recruit, she joins UConn under Geno Auriemma, thriving alongside Sue Bird. Drafted first in 2004, she faces the WNBA's financial limits, leading her to explore opportunities overseas.

Episodes.Title: Rolling in Rubles
Episodes.Description: After a tough WNBA rookie season, Diana seeks better competition and pay in Russia. Struggling to adjust, she stays after receiving a lucrative deal from Spartak Moscow. She dominates with Spartak and leads the Phoenix Mercury to WNBA titles in 2007 and 2009. Legal troubles and a doping accusation threaten her career, but with resilience, she overcomes setbacks, reinforcing her legendary status.

Episodes.Title: League of Her Own
Episodes.Description: Nearing retirement in 2025, Diana reflects on a two-decade career that made her the GOAT of women's basketball. At 42, she faces the challenge of life beyond the game. Known for fearless play, she pushes limits to become the first basketball player to win six Olympic gold medals in 2024. Though critics question her longevity, her relentless drive cements her legacy as a global icon in the sport.

Entries.Title: Battle Camp
Entries.Description: Netflix reality stars duke it out in hair-raising physical challenges and scheme to avoid elimination to win $250K in this adventurous competition show.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Battle Camp!
Episodes.Description: It's sink or swim as the players face their first challenge — and their old rivals. New alliances form, but are they strong enough to survive the wheel?

Episodes.Title: Frozen Out
Episodes.Description: Ego and strategy collide during a game that tests how well the players know their teammates. One contestant's misstep leads to a chilling betrayal.

Episodes.Title: Blindsided
Episodes.Description: Flirtation sizzles within the camp, but is it sincere or strategic? The players put their acting skills on full display before a torturous punishment.

Episodes.Title: BeTreyed
Episodes.Description: Emotions run high after a shocking wheel ceremony rattles the camp. Later, an effort to recruit allies leads to a stunning reversal of trust.

Episodes.Title: Draft Day
Episodes.Description: As one player's moves spark heightened scrutiny, another's strength puts them at risk. A gameplay twist radically alters power dynamics in the camp.

Episodes.Title: Battle of the Bears
Episodes.Description: Subtlety goes out the window as the players trade solidarity for sabotage. Teams and tables may have turned, but the wheel still gets the last word.

Episodes.Title: A Wolf in the Eagle's Nest
Episodes.Description: Unexpected contenders emerge during an electrifying challenge. One player's treacherous tendencies creates a potential opening for their opponents.

Episodes.Title: Loose Lips Sink Ships
Episodes.Description: Alliances splinter as numbers dwindle, prompting players to ask: Who can they really trust? Shady behavior is one thing, but strong bonds are another.

Episodes.Title: Fanning the Flames
Episodes.Description: It's every camper for themselves. The remaining players race through their first nighttime challenge and cast their last elimination votes.

Episodes.Title: The Final Spin
Episodes.Description: The finalists have proven they're unbeatable and unbreakable, but who's unhateable? After a grueling gauntlet of challenges, a lucky winner is crowned.

Entries.Title: Kill Lupercal
Entries.Description: Set in the siege of Terra itself, Kill Lupercal follows a Warlord Titan and its crew as they seek to end the war for the Throneworld in a single devastating blow.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: As the Siege of Terra rages, a group of Loyalist Titans attempt to hunt down and eliminate the Arch-Traitor, the Warmaster Horus, in the first episode of this new three-part original Warhammer animation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Princeps Gemnon and Aurora Ferrum take a gamble on glory – but will unforeseen resistance put an early end to their mission?

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Keeso and Gemnon lead the charge on the traitorous Warmaster's position. The risk is great, but the reward could mean salvation for the Emperor's forces – if all is as it seems.

Entries.Title: Gabriel and the Guardians
Entries.Description: It follows Gabriel, a Celestial Guardian in the mythical world of Ara who is tasked with protecting the Tree Eternal — even as his companions falter, Gabriel stays true to his mission and never loses hope through this story of identity, rebellion, faith and redemption.

Episodes.Title: Palizha'ah! (invasion!)
Episodes.Description: Gabriel, the celestial guardian of Parah’dem, confronts an unexpected invasion when a chaos giant threatens the sacred realm. Meanwhile, in the mortal world, Nok, a hunter, fights for survival, and Namay’ah, a determined princess, seeks divine intervention. As their destinies intertwine, the battle to protect light and order unfolds, testing their strength and purpose in ways they never imagined.

Entries.Title: Toxic
Entries.Description: Toxic follows Elizabeth Chambers as she draws from her experience and background as an investigative journalist to delve into the dark and twisted side of relationships. Through conversations with survivors from across the country, Chambers brings viewers into the raw and real stories of those affected by destructive relationship dynamics, showcasing the lasting trauma and tragedy that can result from unhealthy relationships.

Episodes.Title: Sleeping with a Stranger
Episodes.Description: Elizabeth Chambers unravels the manipulation that leads to the bloody ending of Kelly Sutliff’s marriage — but a vicious attack is only the beginning.

Episodes.Title: Three's a Crowd
Episodes.Description: Elizabeth untangles the web of lies that wrongfully imprisoned Michelle Hadley for 88 grueling days.

Episodes.Title: The Depraved Heart
Episodes.Description: Elizabeth joins the Harris family in their fight for justice against the doctor who uses power, privilege, and drugs to control their daughter, Sarah.

Episodes.Title: Don't Shoot Mommy
Episodes.Description: Elizabeth Chambers unravels the toxic marriage Kate Ranta finds herself stuck in and how her military husband uses his service for a free pass.

Episodes.Title: Surviving Strangis
Episodes.Description: Elizabeth Chambers lifts the veil on convicted conman Anthony Strangis. Elizabeth discovers new alleged victims that puts her hot on his trail.

Episodes.Title: Chasing A Ghost
Episodes.Description: After uncovering alleged new victims, Elizabeth Chambers is hot on the trail of convicted conman Anthony Strangis and ends up face-to-face with him.

Entries.Title: Fatal Destination
Entries.Description: Exploring the dark side of exotic tourist destinations through first-hand accounts of those involved in tragic incidents.

Episodes.Title: Baja Noir
Episodes.Description: A wealthy man's dream of seaside paradise in Mexico becomes a nightmare when police find him brutally murdered; a love triangle, deceit and betrayal unravel in a case where greed collides with deadly ambition.

Episodes.Title: Where's Emily?
Episodes.Description: A Vermont anniversary trip turns dark as a romantic getaway unravels into secrets, violence, and a camper crime scene, exposing the fragile line between love and control.

Episodes.Title: Missing Myrtle Beach
Episodes.Description: A teenager's spring break getaway to Myrtle Beach turns into a mystery that grips the nation; sneaking off without her parents' permission, she vanishes into the night, leaving behind a trail of cryptic clues.

Episodes.Title: Blood on Bourbon Street
Episodes.Description: A hotel room in New Orleans turns into a horrific scene with a man dead in a hot tub and book pages plastered on walls. Security footage reveals four strangers arriving with the victim hours earlier.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost Ship
Episodes.Description: A Miami couple sets sail with friends for a Bahamian getaway aboard a luxury charter boat. When the vessel is found drifting near Cuba with no sign of the crew, the Coast Guard uncovers bloodstains, shell casings, and a missing life raft.

Episodes.Title: Detour to Darkness
Episodes.Description: An 18-year-old sets out on a cross-country journey, drawn to a counterculture festival that promises freedom and belonging. Along the way, she finds community, music, and fleeting joy-until her path takes a dark and unexpected turn.

Entries.Title: Not a Box
Entries.Description: Get creative with bright-eyed bunny Riley! With just one cardboard box, Riley imagines magical worlds full of new friends and fantastic adventures.

Episodes.Title: It's a Boat / It's a Mountain
Episodes.Description: Powered by imagination, Riley sails away to help a pizza-loving sea creature make friends. Riley invents a mountain in the hopes of kissing a cloud.

Episodes.Title: It's an Egg / It's a Pumpkin
Episodes.Description: After a baby dinosaur hatches, Riley uses her imagination to teach it how to play games. Riley gets creative to grow the biggest pumpkin ever.

Episodes.Title: It's a Castle / It's a Plane
Episodes.Description: Adventurous Riley embarks on a magical quest to become a knight. Soaring above, Riley tries to keep up with a group of pinky-pink birds.

Episodes.Title: It's a Fly-in-the-Sky Balloon / It's a Piano
Episodes.Description: Riley takes flight and imagines surprising ways to cool off Sunny, the sun, on a very hot day. Riley searches for silly sounds to make music.

Episodes.Title: It's a Choo-Choo Train / It's a Treasure Chest
Episodes.Description: On a railway adventure, Riley gathers bananas for an unexpected baking project. Riley heads to the beach to collect beloved keepsakes.

Episodes.Title: It's a Comet / It's a Cowboy Hat
Episodes.Description: Riley blasts off on a mission to dunk a cookie in a moon river. Cowboy Riley saddles up to chase down a balloon bandit.

Episodes.Title: It's a Bed / It's a Submarine
Episodes.Description: A not-so-sleepy Riley tries to befriend an under-the-bed monster. Riley journeys down the drain to reunite with lost bath toys.

Episodes.Title: It's a Spaceship / It's a Present
Episodes.Description: Riley zooms away to a distant planet and meets a cute space alien. Riley's birthday inspires an amazing party full of surprises.

Entries.Title: Secrets Declassified with David Duchovny
Entries.Description: From black ops and bizarre experiments to deadly cover-ups and nefarious gadgets, David Duchovny pulls the curtain back on all the government secrets in modern history we always suspected, but were never given the answers to.

Episodes.Title: Secrets of the Skies
Episodes.Description: Forget the moon or the stars – every government has even bigger designs in the race to dominate the furthest corners of the sky. Uncover a plane crash in North Carolina that almost triggered nuclear Armageddon, the story of a UFO attack on a U.S. missile base that was suppressed for decades, and a daring Israeli heist to steal a cutting-edge fighter jet – right from under their enemies’ noses.

Episodes.Title: Black Sites
Episodes.Description: What lies beneath? David Duchovny takes us into the top-secret government bases and the clandestine operations they were built to conceal. Discover a deadly poison lab operated by the Soviet Union's infamous "Doctor Death," a vast nuclear missile site buried beneath the Greenland ice sheet, and the U.S. government's doomsday bunker concealed inside a hollowed-out mountain.

Episodes.Title: Extreme Missions
Episodes.Description: When is Mission: Impossible more than just a movie? From the gaspingly record-shattering depths submarine divers have plunged to tap a secret Soviet communication line to the Special Ops team of suicidal soldiers sent to hand-deploy A-bombs in enemy territory, newly uncensored evidence will reveal the lengths that the few and the elite have gone to within the most hostile lands, all in the name of completing the mission.

Episodes.Title: Strange Weapons
Episodes.Description: While wars may be won by men, they're fought with weapons and every country wanted to leave nothing to chance. Teetering between the apocalyptic and absurd, declassified records will unveil the top secret weapons programs that attempted to bring down the world. Uncovering the Soviet atomic test that shook the Earth with a force 1,500 times more powerful than the Hiroshima bomb, the CIA's creation of a gun that fired a shellfish harvested toxin  and the Allies' bizarre secret plan to end World War II by feminizing Hitler.

Episodes.Title: Mind Games
Episodes.Description: Imagine a world where you could be compelled to do anything and everything, your government orders. That's not just a post-apocalyptic worst-case scenario, but at one point in time, the reality of state-run programs designed to warp and control minds, both in the lab and on the battlefield. From the CIA's decades-long pursuit of the perfect truth serum to the U.S. Army's secret PsyOps in Vietnam, mind games have long been at play among countries, its enemies, and even its own citizens. Every one, a more alarming deception than the next.

Episodes.Title: Deep Cover
Episodes.Description: The dangerous, emotional and arduous toll of stealth ops has never been felt more deeply than by those who adopted completely separate personas to integrate themselves into a shadowy underworld. From "The Pond", an intelligence operation so secret the CIA was kept in the dark, to a luxury Red Sea diving resort covertly operated by Mossad agents, to the British security services' daring rescue of a double agent in Moscow. These undercover smokescreens were all driven by daring agents in service of executing a greater purpose.

Episodes.Title: Dark Science
Episodes.Description: Stalin's gruesome trials to create a hybrid human-ape super army and the eerie reason East Germany's Stasi collected the scents of dissidents in airtight jars.

Episodes.Title: Deep Space
Episodes.Description: Glimpses into NASA's covert plan to blow up the moon with a nuclear warhead and the Soviet Union's cover-up of history's deadliest space disaster.

Episodes.Title: Spy Tech
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Unholy Alliances
Episodes.Description: They say better the devil you know, but what happens when you have to hold hands with him? When governments strike dark deals with cults, mobs, and even sworn enemies, frosty relationships and mounting tensions are tested head on. From the CIA's attempt to enlist the Chicago Mob to assassinate Castro, to the only World War II battle where U.S. troops fought alongside the German Army, to Vladimir Putin's recruitment of a convicted murderer as his personal assassin, which sacrifices are worth the bigger picture?

Entries.Title: Eva Longoria: Searching for Spain
Entries.Description: Follow Eva Longoria on a gastronomic pilgrimage across the rich tapestry of Spanish cuisine.

Episodes.Title: Barcelona and the Catalonia Region
Episodes.Description: Eva Longoria explores Barcelona and the Catalonia region, a Mediterranean hub of creativity and cuisine, where world-class chefs push the boundaries of Spanish food.

Episodes.Title: Seville and the Andalusia Region
Episodes.Description: Eva Longoria visits Andalusia, the birthplace of flamenco and bullfighting. From jamón ibérico to tapas, she savors the iconic flavors of the region.

Episodes.Title: Madrid
Episodes.Description: In vibrant Madrid, Eva Longoria experiences a city that never stops moving. Its rich mix of cultures creates an exhilarating cuisine that excites the senses.

Episodes.Title: San Sebastian and the Basque Country
Episodes.Description: Eva Longoria travels to the Basque Country where San Sebastian's imaginative cuisine reflects a proud cultural heritage and culinary mastery.

Episodes.Title: Galicia
Episodes.Description: Eva Longoria journeys to Galicia, a land once thought to be the end of the world. Its wild landscapes produce exceptional ingredients and unforgettable flavors.

Episodes.Title: Asturias
Episodes.Description: Returning to her ancestral roots, Eva Longoria explores Asturias' majestic mountains, orchards, and seas, discovering the region's rich culinary traditions.

Episodes.Title: Marbella
Episodes.Description: After making Marbella her home, Eva Longoria celebrates with family and friends, enjoying the city's vibrant dishes and local flavors.

Episodes.Title: Spain's Big Bang
Episodes.Description: Eva Longoria uncovers how Spain's cuisine transformed from humble beginnings to become a global culinary sensation in just one generation.

Entries.Title: Justice on Trial
Entries.Description: Judge Judy Sheindlin puts the American justice system on trial in a true crime high-stakes courtroom drama, as she and her expert legal team recreate the trials from notorious cases where following the letter of the law did not necessarily feel "just."

Episodes.Title: What Happens in My House (The Matter of Terrence K.)
Episodes.Description: Judge Judy Sheindlin and her expert legal team revisit one of the most personal and complex cases of her career-a diplomatic immunity battle she encountered as a Family Court Judge. When a foreign diplomat invoked immunity to shield himself from child abuse charges after brutally beating his son, the case ultimately pitted the interests of the U.S. Government against the rights of an abused child.

Episodes.Title: Burying Rights (Ohio v. Dixon)
Episodes.Description: Judge Judy Sheindlin and her expert legal team recreate the chilling case of Archie Dixon, who confessed to brutally murdering his roommate and burying him alive to profit from selling his car. The case focuses on whether police tactics crossed the line between lawful interrogation and coercion. If the pursuit of truth becomes a violation of justice, will a confessed killer be set free?

Episodes.Title: Sixteen to Life (1) (People v. Deskovic)
Episodes.Description: As a teenager, Jeffrey Deskovic stood trial for the tragic assault and murder of his high school classmate. Judge Judy Sheindlin and her expert legal team recreate the courtroom battle, revealing questionable police interrogation tactics that led to Deskovic being coerced into a false confession. Will Deskovic's questionable confession be enough to convict him of murder?

Episodes.Title: Sixteen to Life (2) (Deskovic v. Putnam County)
Episodes.Description: After being exonerated of assault and murder following 16 years in prison, Jeffrey Deskovie fights back with a civil suit. Judge Judy Sheindlin and her expert legal team recreate this trial to examine the limits of police and prosecutor liability in wrongful conviction cases. Did law enforcement's tactics used to convict Deskovic make them liable for monetary damages, or criminal prosecution?

Episodes.Title: For the Defendant (Gideon v. Wainwright)
Episodes.Description: Judge Judy Sheindlin and her team recreate the trials of Clarence Gideon, a Florida man accused in 1963 of burglarizing a pool hall. Forced to defend himself in court due to Florida law, Gideon was found guilty. While in prison, his successful appeal to the Supreme Court effectively created the Public Defender system we have today. Now armed with a savvy attorney, would Gideon win his freedom?

Episodes.Title: Killer, but Not a Liar (People v. Turriago)
Episodes.Description: Troopers stopped Leonardo Turriago for a speeding violation on the New York State Thruway, which led police to a grim discovery in the back of his truck: a decomposing body locked in a steamer trunk. But was the search of the truck legal? Judge Judy Sheindlin and her team recreate the case, examining the delicate balance between police search powers and constitutional privacy protections.

Episodes.Title: Hell Goes On Forever (Snyder v. Phelps)
Episodes.Description: Is inflammatory speech protected under the 1st Amendment? A grieving father witnessed the Westboro Baptist Church's protest with hateful signs and slogans at his son's military funeral, forcing a legal showdown over free speech. Judge Judy Sheindlin and her team recreate this provocative case to highlight the legal boundaries of protected speech, when it conflicts with potential harm to others.

Episodes.Title: Scopes Monkey Trial (State of TN v. Scopes)
Episodes.Description: To mark the 100th Anniversary of the famous Scopes Monkey Trial, Judge Judy Sheindlin and her expert legal team recreate this landmark case. In 1925, John Scopes challenged a Tennessee law prohibiting the teaching of Darwin's theory of evolution. The iconic case tested the legal boundaries in teaching science versus religion, and, ultimately, the limits of government control over the classroom.

Entries.Title: Akogare no Onna Joushi
Entries.Description: By a strange coincidence, the protagonist is forced to move in with his boss. He's secretly in love with her, so he took the move as a divine blessing. However, he soon realized it was his punishment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: By a strange coincidence, the protagonist is forced to move in with his boss. He's secretly in love with her, so he took the move as a divine blessing. However, he soon realized it was his punishment.

Entries.Title: RoboForce: The Animated Series
Entries.Description: In 2089 Detroit, RoboForce is obsolete and has no hope of becoming heroes. That is until a mysterious code virus infects the UA101 bots, and no one besides RoboForce can stop them.

Episodes.Title: Rebooted, Rewired, and Ready to Go
Episodes.Description: Years after the elite and incorruptible RoboForce was made obsolete, the bots are called to back duty when their replacements turn on humanity.

Episodes.Title: Way Down Below
Episodes.Description: RoboForce finds a long-lost friend at the bottom of the ocean along with a clue that brings them closer to unmasking the leader of the Bot Uprising.

Episodes.Title: The Search for S.O.T.A
Episodes.Description: While looking for a friend from the past, the cracks in RoboForce become too big to ignore.

Episodes.Title: Journey to the Center of Maxx
Episodes.Description: With the help of S.O.T.A 64, RoboForce must save Maxx 89 from a rogue virus, while a twisted and powerful Bot from the past is resurrected.

Episodes.Title: To Break These Earthly Bounds
Episodes.Description: RoboForce clash with evil Bots and face Detonator, an army-killing machine, as they are forced to choose a side.

Episodes.Title: Today Detroit, Tomorrow the World
Episodes.Description: Taking their battle to space, RoboForce tries to end the Bot Uprising, while unlikely friendships begin to blossom.

Entries.Title: The Home Team: New York Jets
Entries.Description: In this intimate look at NFL family life, follow Tyler Conklin, C.J. Mosley, Quinnen Williams, Allen Lazard, Alijah Vera-Tucker, and Chuck Clark and their partners through a year of setbacks and breakthroughs . From fatherhood and injuries to contract pressure and uncertain futures, this series captures the heart, sacrifice, and humanity behind America's favorite game.

Episodes.Title: The Kick Off
Episodes.Description: The premiere offers an intimate look at the lives of New York Jets players and their families as they embrace the promise of a new season. As the team pushes forward with determination and heart, their partners provide strength and support, revealing the deep bonds that fuel life on and off the field.

Episodes.Title: Nest Man Up
Episodes.Description: Amid early-season hope and mounting pressure, Jets players juggle injuries, personal challenges, and shifting futures. As fatherhood nears, careers hang in the balance, and a coach is suddenly fired, they confront the brutal demands of football and life beyond it-fighting to hold on, stay present, and keep going.

Episodes.Title: All the Way Through
Episodes.Description: Amid injuries, pressure, and a midseason slide, the Jets find new energy with Davante Adams' arrival. AVT and Tyler Conklin prepare for first-time fatherhood, Chuck Clark and C.J. Mosley manage recovery, and Mosley embraces new fatherhood. A win over Houston ends the skid, and with belief intact, the climb continues.

Episodes.Title: Back in the Fight
Episodes.Description: After a hard-fought win, the Jets regroup as injuries, births, and doubts shape their season. Tyler Conklin continues to prepare for fatherhood, the Vera-Tuckers welcome a newborn son, and C.J. Mosley weighs the future after a neck injury. As Chuck Clark returns and Allen Lazard reflects from the sidelines, hope flickers as another late loss reminds them: the fight isn't over yet.

Episodes.Title: The Stretch
Episodes.Description: The Jets enter their bye at 3-8, wrestling with injuries, doubt, and fading playoff hopes. Allen Lazard reflects in recovery, C.J. Mosley faces his uncertain future, and Tyler Conklin prepares for fatherhood. AVT bonds with his newborn, and Quinnen gives back to the community. Losses mount, but heart remains. Even eliminated, they fight on with family, pride, and purpose.

Episodes.Title: Finish Strong
Episodes.Description: The Jets close the season with a final win, but big changes loom. Tyler Conklin hits his bonus and becomes a dad. CJ Mosley is released, Chuck Clark welcomes twins, and Alijah Vera-Tucker enters the offseason healthy. Quinnen Williams begins his recovery with next season in mind, and Allen Lazard quietly prepares for fatherhood. Reflection and fresh starts define what's next.

Entries.Title: House of Knives
Entries.Description: Chefs battle with cooking, strategy, and survival skills for the throne. Weekly rulers emerge through cultural challenges, while eliminations and new entries keep six players in play. The winner takes home $100K.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the House of Knives
Episodes.Description: Host Scott Conant welcomes six of the world's most prestigious and talented chefs to the House of Knives arena. The chefs create dishes using a signature ingredient in hopes of impressing Culinary Council judges Marcus Samuelsson and Judy Joo to become the very first ruler of the game and avoid banishment.  One contender's shocking strategy proves that culinary expertise alone won't keep you safe in the House of Knives.

Episodes.Title: He's Making What?
Episodes.Description: With a new ruler sitting on the throne, the contenders realize the importance of having a solid strategy. The chefs are challenged with creating layered dishes in hopes of earning control of the game. In an effort to stand out, one contender takes a sweet risk but runs into a slew of problems. The winning chef makes a strategic decision while Ruler Burrell and her challenger fight for the throne over shrimp. Her challenger makes a very bold move in hopes of becoming the ruler, shocking the entire arena. But will it pay off?

Episodes.Title: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
Episodes.Description: In the first battle, the chefs are tasked with creating cold dishes, and one contender is confident about getting on the throne but nearly burns down the House of Knives instead. The Culinary Council is wowed by the level of cooking but gives control of the game to a chef who successfully elevates a humble classic into something new and exciting. However, that chef makes a shocking decision that proves how important strategy is in this game. The battle for the throne is fought over chicken and gives one contender a chance for revenge.

Episodes.Title: Surprise Banishment
Episodes.Description: In a surprise twist, one chef will be banished at the end of the contender battle, setting up a potential double elimination. The intensity is sky high as the chefs create handheld dishes for their survival in the game. One contender confidently makes a signature dish while another races against the clock and risks serving the Culinary Council undercooked meat. The banished chef exits the arena and makes a stunning career announcement, and one contender becomes the first to willingly challenge the ruler for the throne.

Episodes.Title: A Southern Belle Arrives
Episodes.Description: A new culinary powerhouse enters the House of Knives arena hoping her Southern flair gets her onto the throne. The chefs create noodle dishes in the contender battle, and one competitor takes a risk and ventures outside her comfort zone. Two chefs hope unexpected dishes will get them a shot at the throne while another makes a critical mistake. In a highly anticipated matchup between two of the strongest chefs, the battle for the throne is fought over mushrooms.

Episodes.Title: Battle Brunch
Episodes.Description: The chefs are ordered to create brunch dishes and wow the judges with their innovative plates. The fierce battle for the throne is fought over clams.

Episodes.Title: Last Chance to Control the Game
Episodes.Description: A formidable new contender enters the game, and the chefs face their most difficult contender challenge yet: surf and turf.

Episodes.Title: The Culinary Crown Goes to...
Episodes.Description: The final contenders compete, and one chef is selected to challenge the ruler head-to-head for the culinary crown and the $100,000 prize.

Entries.Title: Family Recipe Showdown
Entries.Description: Academy Award-winning actress Octavia Spencer returns to her Southern roots this summer in the new home cooking competition Family Recipe Showdown. Set in New Orleans, the series features Octavia as the host, alongside Southern cooking royalty Edgar “Dook” Chase as the resident expert.

Episodes.Title: Southern Brunch
Episodes.Description: Octavia and Dook open the kitchen to three teams of Southern families for a down-home showdown. In the first round, an aunt and niece, mother-in-law and son-in-law and wife duo serve up their best Southern brunch. In the second round, the final two teams put their own spin on one of guest judge Reese Witherspoon's childhood favorites to win $10,000.

Episodes.Title: Biscuit Bliss
Episodes.Description: Octavia Spencer and expert judge Edgar Dook Chase invite the home cooks to make their family's version of a Southern staple, biscuits; the two final teams take on guest judges Al and Leila Roker's family favorite desserts for a chance at $10,000.

Episodes.Title: Southern Cocktail Hour
Episodes.Description: Octavia Spencer and expert judge Edgar "Dook" Chase challenge the home cooks to make three cocktail bites alongside a signature cocktail. Then, the remaining teams put their spin on either guest Eric Stonestreet or Octavia's childhood comfort meal.

Episodes.Title: Team Tailgate
Episodes.Description: Octavia Spencer and judge Edgar "Dook" Chase challenge the home cooks to present their best handheld tailgate specialties; the two remaining teams prepare one of guest judge Danielle Brooks' family favorite dishes to win the $10,000 prize.

Episodes.Title: Catch of the South
Episodes.Description: Octavia Spencer and expert judge Edgar "Dook" Chase welcome three teams of family home cooks to create Southern seafood specialties; two teams move on to round two, where they create their version of guest judge Kandi Burrus' family favorite.

Episodes.Title: Cast-Iron Secrets
Episodes.Description: Host Octavia Spencer and Edgar "Dook" Chase ask the teams to make their best cast-iron dishes; in round two, the competitors take on guest judge Tina Knowles' family favorite recipes to win the $10,000 prize.

Episodes.Title: Peas, Greens and Superstitions
Episodes.Description: Octavia Spencer and Edgar Dook Chase ask three teams of home cooks to create a dish based on family superstitions; in the second round, the remaining teams create a Southern vegan dish for guest judge Jessica Chastain.

Episodes.Title: Southern Fried and Some Sides
Episodes.Description: Octavia Spencer and Edgar "Dook" Chase meet three family teams who are ready to take on southern-fried food; the two remaining teams bring their family's twist to one of the guest judge Tim Gunn's favorite dishes.

Entries.Title: Murder Before Evensong
Entries.Description: In 1980s England, Canon Daniel Clement, the Rector of Champton, finds himself unexpectedly entangled in a murder case when a dead body turns up in the church. When Daniel announces a plan to modernize the church, the parish is suddenly divided. And then a body is found dead at the back of the church. As the police move in and the bodies start piling up, Daniel is the only one who can try and keep his fractured community together... and catch a killer.

Entries.Title: Tucci in Italy
Entries.Description: Follow Stanley Tucci as he returns to Italy for more food-based adventures, seeking out the essence of each region and its people through the food they eat.

Episodes.Title: Tuscany
Episodes.Description: In Tuscany, where Tucci once lived as a teenager, he samples an unexpected local breakfast, rides out with traditional cowboys, and joins a grand Sienese feast that captures the spirit of the region.

Episodes.Title: Lombardy
Episodes.Description: In Lombardy, he explores Italy’s industrial engine through a culinary lens—tasting futuristic farm-to-table menus, investigating one of the world’s most expensive ingredients, and dining at a rest stop that’s anything but average.

Episodes.Title: Trentino-Alto Adige
Episodes.Description: Trentino-Alto Adige takes Tucci into new territory: skiing down Alpine slopes, fly fishing glacial rivers, and eating slope-side polenta in a region where Italian and German identities blend in the kitchen.

Episodes.Title: Abruzzo
Episodes.Description: Abruzzo is rugged and surprising. It’s Tucci’s first time there, and he leans into the wildness—grilling mutton in sheep country, sharing Sunday lunch with a French twist, and tracing the sugary roots of Italy’s iconic confetti almonds.

Episodes.Title: Lazio
Episodes.Description: In Lazio, Tucci steps outside of Rome to explore the region’s rural soul. He tries porchetta from Ariccia, rustic fish soup, and a springtime lamb dish that speaks to a deeper connection between simplicity and seasonality.

Entries.Title: Stephanie's Places
Entries.Description: Stephanie McMahon teams up with the iconic Places series to explore WWE’s legacy through stories and experiences with wrestling legends.

Episodes.Title: CM Punk: The Return
Episodes.Description: Stephanie McMahon visits her husband and WWE chief content officer, Paul "Triple H" Levesque, at the new WWE headquarters before she heads to Cleveland for SummerSlam and meets up with CM Punk, who reflects on his shocking return to the WWE after nearly a decade away from the ring.

Episodes.Title: Cody Rhodes Takes Center Stage
Episodes.Description: Stephanie meets with "The American Nightmare" Cody Rhodes at the historic Center Stage Theater in Atlanta, the former home of the WCW. Cody shares his unique path to WWE stardom and what he envisions as his legacy.

Episodes.Title: Rhea Ripley's Rise
Episodes.Description: Stephanie visits the WWE Performance Center in Orlando where she meets up with Rhea Ripley and the WWE Hall of Famer Shawn Michaels to discuss how the next generation of stars are trained. Later, Rhea surprises Stephanie with a dramatic makeover to prepare for a wild entrance.

Episodes.Title: Stone Cold Rides Again
Episodes.Description: Stephanie spends a day with Steve Austin at Broken Skull Ranch to learn about how he became 'Stone Cold' and life after the WWE. The two end their day with Stephanie experiencing Steve's newest adventure: off-road racing.

Episodes.Title: The Evolution of Charlotte Flair
Episodes.Description: Stephanie meets up with the "Queen", Charlotte Flair at Nassau Coliseum to discuss the origins and evolution of women in the WWE, before they take a helicopter to MetLife to relive her epic WrestleMania 35 arrival.

Episodes.Title: Roman Reigns and The Bloodline
Episodes.Description: Stephanie hits the open waters of Miami on a yacht with Roman Reigns and "The Bloodline" to discuss the Anoa'i family's wrestling legacy. Stephanie then enjoys some traditional Samoan cuisine alongside the family, including a unique delicacy.

Episodes.Title: Pat McAfee Can't Be Stopped
Episodes.Description: Stephanie sits down with Pat McAfee to find out how the art of a WWE "promo" helped him become one of the biggest names in sports and entertainment. A visit to Indianapolis allows Stephanie to pick Pat's brain and hear his unlikely journey from NFL punter to podcaster and his dream job at WWE.

Episodes.Title: Digging Deep with Undertaker
Episodes.Description: Stephanie heads to Madison Square Garden, the location of the first WrestleMania, and meets up with The Undertaker. They discuss his career and his own iconic moments at the Garden.

Episodes.Title: Triple H's Perfect Entrance
Episodes.Description: Stephanie and Triple H examine the power of an iconic WWE entrance. Later, they head to Las Vegas to get a first-hand look at the pageantry and spectacle that can only be found at WrestleMania.

Episodes.Title: John Cena's Final Round
Episodes.Description: Stephanie meets up with John Cena as he reflects on his incredible 20-plus-year sports entertainment journey. She gets a tour of his personal gym and sees how one of the most decorated WWE superstars of all time stays at the top of his game as he winds down his incredible career.

Entries.Title: Chef's Table: Legends
Entries.Description: The Emmy-nominated series celebrates four culinary giants — Jamie Oliver, José Andrés, Alice Waters and Thomas Keller — who changed how the world eats.

Episodes.Title: Jamie Oliver
Episodes.Description: Jamie Oliver was a TV chef who didn't look like a typical chef. He found his true passion by inspiring younger generations with healthy, joyful cooking.

Episodes.Title: José Andrés
Episodes.Description: A maximalist chef who revolutionized Spanish cuisine in the United States, José Andrés elevated his love of cooking into his life's greatest work.

Episodes.Title: Thomas Keller
Episodes.Description: As the first American chef to win three Michelin stars, and the only one to do it twice, Thomas Keller reflects on his legacy and undeniable influence.

Episodes.Title: Alice Waters
Episodes.Description: When Alice Waters built the farm-to-table movement from scratch at Chez Panisse, she inspired generations to embrace the flavor of local, organic food.

Entries.Title: The Baldwins
Entries.Description: An intimate, behind-the-scenes look into the lives of Alec and Hilaria Baldwin and their seven children, blending the highs and lows of family life, with the challenges and humor that come while raising a large family in the public eye.

Episodes.Title: Along Came Hilaria
Episodes.Description: Actor Alec Baldwin and wife Hilaria celebrate oldest son Rafael's birthday. They pack up their seven kids and pets and leave for East Hampton for the summer, but with Alec's trial coming up, they face difficult decisions as a family.

Episodes.Title: It's Really Complicated
Episodes.Description: Alec and Hilaria do their best to put on a brave face for their kids with Alec's trial just a week away. Hilaria prepares an unusual gift for Alec for their Wedding Anniversary, as the couple faces a tough choice and an unknown future.

Episodes.Title: Coming Home
Episodes.Description: Alec and Hilaria Baldwin return home after the trial to their kids and try to discover a new normal. Alec agrees to go to therapy to process what has happened.

Episodes.Title: Always Be Cleaning
Episodes.Description: Alec and Hilaria try to move forward and focus on the kids; they attend a therapy session to try to heal, but have different opinions about the next steps in their life.

Episodes.Title: Glengarry Glen Floss
Episodes.Description: Hilaria plans a trip to the city to take all seven kids to the dentist.

Episodes.Title: Mission Impossible: Rug Nation
Episodes.Description: Alec and Hilaria attempt to potty-train their dogs, who have ruined their rugs; after years of fight or flight, it's time for some fun as the couple takes up salsa dancing.

Episodes.Title: Working Guy
Episodes.Description: The family soaks up the last days of summer before heading back to the city. Alec faces a tough decision: return to acting or continue as a stay-at-home dad? Hilaria addresses changes in her post-partum body.

Episodes.Title: You're My 30 Rock
Episodes.Description: The family celebrates Carmen's birthday, and Alec gets an offer for a movie that could take him away from the family. When they head back to Manhattan, they face new opportunities and a new reality as they get 6 kids off to school.

Entries.Title: Murder 360
Entries.Description: Through intimate interviews, expert analysis, and rare footage, the series paints a vivid portrait of the motive, method, and aftermath of each crime - from thrill killings to deadly vows.

Episodes.Title: Elizabeth Is Missing
Episodes.Description: When a nine-year-old girl vanishes, suspicion falls on her troubled teenage neighbor.

Episodes.Title: Murder in Moab
Episodes.Description: A young couple vanishes days after telling friends about a disturbing man at their campsite.

Episodes.Title: Soldier Down
Episodes.Description: A decorated Marine is ambushed and killed at her kids' school, triggering a frantic police pursuit.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Vows
Episodes.Description: When a woman's husband and lover are found dead, police uncover a deadly marriage pact.

Episodes.Title: Losing Streak Lois
Episodes.Description: Police investigating a brutal double-homicide learn the prime suspect appears to be a grandmother.

Episodes.Title: Where's Micah?
Episodes.Description: When a religious woman goes missing, her Christian family begins to question her husband's devotion.

Episodes.Title: Killer in the Forest
Episodes.Description: Detectives race to find a serial killer lurking in the forest before he selects another victim.

Episodes.Title: The Gardener
Episodes.Description: A conversation over a card game in prison sparks an investigation into a notorious serial killer.

Episodes.Title: First Response
Episodes.Description: Detectives uncover a shocking murder-for-hire plot targeting a beloved firefighter.

Episodes.Title: The Bayou Strangler
Episodes.Description: A near-decade-long manhunt ends when one victim escapes, leading police to a serial killer.

Entries.Title: Love Island: Beyond the Villa
Entries.Description: Follow the season 6 Islanders as they navigate new careers, evolving friendships, newfound fame, and the complexities of life and love outside the villa.

Episodes.Title: You're So Last Summer
Episodes.Description: One year after their time in Fiji, ten Islanders reunite in Los Angeles to explore life beyond the villa; new opportunities put Kaylor and Liv's friendship to the test; JaNa has unresolved issues with Connor; Aaron tries to make peace with his past.

Episodes.Title: Porta-Potty Hottie
Episodes.Description: JaNa attempts to mend the fractured friendship between Kaylor and Liv; influencerlife is taking off for Kordell and Serena, but a big opportunity could take him away from LA; Miguel and Leah do some horsing around; Connor celebrates his birthday.

Episodes.Title: Under the Influence(r)
Episodes.Description: JaNa gets Liv and Kaylor to mend their friendship; Serena is scared when meeting Kordell's cat; Miguel supports Leah through a health scare; Aaron and Kaylor reconnect at Liv's housewarming party.

Episodes.Title: My Man, My Man, My Man -- Is Leaving!
Episodes.Description: Serena struggles when Kordell leaves LA for an acting job; Leah shares a health concern with her friends; JaNa and Kenny take in a foster dog as a practice run for parenthood; Kaylor gets involved with a new man.

Episodes.Title: Back in the Saddle, Baby!
Episodes.Description: Kaylor introduces her new boyfriend, which proves difficult for Aaron; JaNa and Kenny have different opinions about living together; Leah and Miguel take "fostering" a step further; Kendall tries to unite the group around a mechanical bull.

Episodes.Title: A Bombshell Has Entered Los Angeles
Episodes.Description: Leah and Serena help JaNa through the fallout of her anniversary dinner with Kenny; Kendall's dating life is turned upside down when his ex, Nicole, makes an unexpected visit; the group gets a very hot girl invite.

Entries.Title: The Z-Suite
Entries.Description: Set at a boutique New York ad agency where generational divides see the established C-Suite and rising Gen Z employees collide. After a company decision spirals out of control, the agency's reigning executives are pushed out and the Z-Suite employees are suddenly put in charge, ultimately testing both generations' skills and patience.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Monica and Doug take on a high-profile campaign, but a controversial ad threatens their power and gives Gen Z an opening at Atelier Ad Agency.

Episodes.Title: In with the New
Episodes.Description: While Monica and Doug scheme to get their jobs back, Kriska gives Elliot and Clem the corporate card to make the "office vibes" work for them.

Episodes.Title: Expectation vs. Reality
Episodes.Description: Kriska, Elliot, and Clem try not to blow their first big pitch, while Monica desperately seeks to rehabilitate her image in the advertising community.

Episodes.Title: Fake It Till You Make It
Episodes.Description: Kriska and Elliot battle to star in a mock commercial for Boppin' Burger, while Monica and Doug take bold steps to get back in the advertising game.

Episodes.Title: Work Hard, War Hard
Episodes.Description: Elliot and Clem attempt to make Monica and Doug's new office space a nightmare, while Kriska tries to secure an elusive, hard-partying client.

Episodes.Title: Second Shift
Episodes.Description: Kriska seeks out a new direction on her Boppin' Burger campaign after a major screw up while Monica and Doug's research on Gen Z devolves into chaos.

Episodes.Title: How to Get Away With Burger
Episodes.Description: George throws a murder mystery birthday party at his mansion in Connecticut as Kriska and Monica battle each other for valuable face time with him.

Episodes.Title: Pitch, Please
Episodes.Description: With everything on the line, Kriska and Monica make their final pitches to secure the Boppin' Burger campaign.

Entries.Title: Wear Whatever the F You Want
Entries.Description: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London return to television in this new style transformation show, giving people the confidence and style savvy to wear whatever they want. Over the course of a couple of days, they empower each client to live out their fashion fantasy and find their style truth in the journey of a lifetime.

Episodes.Title: Grown-Up Girly Girl
Episodes.Description: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London return to make fashion fantasies come true! They begin with Jessica, a petite young mom who has neglected self-care and still dresses like a teenager. With her kids growing up, Jessica seeks guidance to uncover her own style, aiming to embrace a sophisticated look that will reflect her confidence as a grown woman. It’s time for her to feel great in her own skin!

Episodes.Title: Punk Rock God
Episodes.Description: Stacy and Clinton meet Patrick, a charming “brewery dad” eager to swap his t-shirts and clogs for the edgy punk rock style he idolized as a kid. Struggling with confidence, Patrick has hesitated to embrace his true self. As Clinton and Stacy guide him through this transformation, he rediscovers his identity and finally steps into the spotlight, fulfilling his teenage dream of ultimate cool.

Episodes.Title: Powerhouse Diva
Episodes.Description: Clinton and Stacy’s new client, Freedom, is a two-time breast cancer survivor eager to reclaim her confidence. Seeking to embrace her inner diva, she needs help creating a style that reflects the resilient spirit she has lost. Clinton and Stacy help Freedom discover the power clothes can have on your life, giving the jumpstart she needs to enter a new chapter as a strong, empowered woman.

Episodes.Title: Eclectic Bohemian
Episodes.Description: Aspiring artist Akemi has left a corporate job to pursue her dream as a visionary artist, but she struggles with personal style and craves her parents' approval. Enter Stacy and Clinton, ready to create a bold, artsy look that truly reflects her creative spirit. Together, they empower Akemi to embrace her vibrant identity, boosting her confidence to thrive as the artist she was meant to be.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Gender Norms
Episodes.Description: Clinton and Stacy take on their most exciting challenge yet with Alan, a recently transitioned trans man seeking a bold, androgynous style. After years of prioritizing comfort over self-expression, Alan is ready to embrace a look that defies traditional norms. Together, they craft a style that brings Alan a true joy that is uniquely his own, breaking the rules of fashion along the way.

Episodes.Title: Country Glitz and Glam
Episodes.Description: Clinton and Stacy meet Naomi, former Amish and ex-stripper, who is seeking help after reverting to traditional Amish dress to hide her post-pregnancy body. Now back on the farm and raising a toddler, she yearns for the confidence she felt during her stripper days. Clinton and Stacy help Naomi find a style that both reclaims her femininity and balances her life as a new mom with a country heart.

Episodes.Title: Masculine Avant-Garde
Episodes.Description: Clinton and Stacy meet Maurice, a larger-than-life baker and devoted single dad ready to elevate his style to prepare for the opening of his new storefront. Needing a look to represent his brand, Maurice turns to Clinton and Stacy for help in creating a “masculine avant-garde” look that embodies his vibrant personality and commands respect as a successful business owner.

Episodes.Title: '90s Preppy
Episodes.Description: Clinton and Stacy welcome Selena, a goth content creator seeking a dramatic style transformation. Having worn an all-black aesthetic since middle school, Selena realizes that it hinders her ability to connect with others and looks for guidance to uncover a more approachable style that reflects her evolving identity.

Entries.Title: My Happy Place
Entries.Description: My Happy Place invites viewers on an immersive excursion across the world anchored by an all-star cast of hosts including Alan Cumming, Taraji P. Henson, Simu Liu, Billy Porter, Octavia Spencer and Questlove. Across six visually stunning episodes, each host reflects on why these meaningful sites have become their escape, revealing a never-before-seen side of the person and the destination.

Episodes.Title: Scottish Highlands with Alan Cumming
Episodes.Description: As a child growing up in Scotland, the Highlands were a place where Alan Cumming went to escape. Now, as an adult, they are a window into his history that provide him with a new sense of belonging, connection and joy.

Episodes.Title: Bali, Indonesia with Taraji P. Henson
Episodes.Description: Two years ago, when Taraji P. Henson was feeling burnt out and disillusioned with Hollywood, she fled to Bali where she was able to recharge, refocus, and find her spiritual side. Bali is still a lifeline, and Henson returns to enjoy the rich culture and peace of her happy place.

Episodes.Title: Austin, Texas with Questlove
Episodes.Description: Questlove comes to Austin for creative inspiration, but it’s also home to good friends, favorite stores, and is a place where his band The Roots first found success. He returns to recharge his artistic batteries and enjoy all that the city has to offer.

Episodes.Title: Mykonos, Greece with Billy Porter
Episodes.Description: Billy Porter was working on a cruise sailing around the islands of Greece when he discovered his happy place: Mykonos. He felt a sense of freedom and belonging he had never experienced before, and has found much to celebrate on the island, both then and now.

Episodes.Title: New Orleans, Louisiana with Octavia Spencer
Episodes.Description: Octavia Spencer first came to New Orleans for Mardi Gras as a broke college student and has been hooked ever since. Now as an adult, it’s the city’s unique international flair and the familiarity of the American South that makes this her happy place.

Episodes.Title: Bangkok, Thailand with Simu Liu
Episodes.Description: Bangkok was always Simu Liu’s dream destination to visit, and two years ago his dream became a reality. The city was everything he dreamed of, and on this trip he’s revisiting some of his favorite places and finding new things to love about Bangkok.

Entries.Title: Yellowstone to Yosemite with Kevin Costner
Entries.Description: Follow Kevin Costner as he traces the footsteps of the pivotal 1903 Yosemite expedition of 26th President Teddy Roosevelt and environmental advocate John Muir. Through spectacular visuals of the geology, flora, and fauna of Glacier Point to El Capitan, Yosemite Falls and more, Costner brings the fascinating journey and long battles to preserve the American frontier to life.

Episodes.Title: The President
Episodes.Description: Kevin Costner explores the vast wilderness of Yosemite National Park while diving into the incredible story of Teddy Roosevelt's 3 day camping trip in a blinding snowstorm that changed America forever.

Episodes.Title: The Naturalist
Episodes.Description: Kevin Costner retraces the journey of Teddy Roosevelt and John Muir in Yosemite as he explores the tragic and triumphant life of the man behind the American conservation movement.

Episodes.Title: The War
Episodes.Description: The rivers of Yosemite once ran red with blood as the sound of gunfire echoed from the canyon walls. In the final episode, Costner immerses himself in the legendary story of the battle for Yosemite.

Entries.Title: Mr. & Mrs. Murder
Entries.Description: Four close friends' seemingly perfect lives unravel after one vanishes on a hunting trip. Nearly 20 years later, the truth emerges with devastating consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vanished
Episodes.Description: When Mike Williams vanishes on a Florida duck hunt, suspicions grow on his widow Denise.

Episodes.Title: Locked In
Episodes.Description: A divorce and a new marriage raise suspicions.

Episodes.Title: He Got Her
Episodes.Description: Kathy rekindles an old friendship.

Episodes.Title: Cold-Blooded Justice?
Episodes.Description: Kathy has a startling revelation. A shocking arrest leads to a horrifying confession.

Entries.Title: Trainwreck: Storm Area 51
Entries.Description: A viral joke about storming a secretive US Air Force base sparks a meme-fueled media frenzy and puts the military on alert in this bizarre true story.

Episodes.Title: The S**tpost
Episodes.Description: A late-night social media prank goes viral, kickstarting an extraordinary chain reaction that leads to a highly classified Air Force base in Nevada.

Episodes.Title: They Can't Stop All of Us
Episodes.Description: As the "Storm Area 51" event takes off, Matty finds the FBI on his doorstep. Unequipped to deal with the onslaught, desert locals brace for disaster.

Entries.Title: Stalking Samantha: 13 Years of Terror
Entries.Description: The docuseries tells the harrowing story of Samantha Stites, a bright college freshman who, in 2011, met Christopher Thomas. This encounter marked the beginning of an 11-year period of unsettling obsession and constant stalking by Christopher. He would stealthily and openly show up wherever Samantha went, from restaurants to grocery stores and sporting events.

Episodes.Title: Hunted
Episodes.Description: Stalked for over a decade, Samantha faces the unthinkable.

Episodes.Title: Trapped
Episodes.Description: Kidnapped and chained in a soundproof box, Samantha must outwit her stalker to survive.

Episodes.Title: The Reckoning
Episodes.Description: Christopher denies the rape. Now, Samantha faces a devastating choice for justice.

Entries.Title: Secrets of the Penguins
Entries.Description: Over two extraordinary years, National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovered never-before-filmed secret traditions, surprising intelligence and close-knit societies of penguins. This astonishing series reveals they are more like us than we ever dreamed, from their powerful friendships to the courageous risk-takers using ingenuity and innovation in some of the world's most extreme places.

Episodes.Title: Heart of the Emperors
Episodes.Description: In Antarctica, emperor penguin societies reveal mysterious bonds forged from birth. These bonds are the secret to surviving their extreme world.

Episodes.Title: Survival of the Smartest
Episodes.Description: The banded penguins venture far beyond their icy homes, mastering deserts, tropical islands—and even city life—to become perhaps the smartest of all.

Episodes.Title: Rebels with a Cause
Episodes.Description: In the Southern Ocean, courageous penguins break the rules to find their edge. Taking risks helps make them the most successful of all.

Episodes.Description: Whether driving a Zamboni, destroying an expensive car or delivering a Stunner, The Texas Rattlesnake doles out one great Raw moment after another.

Episodes.Description: The American Nightmare's story plays out on Monday nights as he turns his dream into reality against Raw's top Superstars.

Episodes.Description: You want some? Come get some of The Cenation Leader's most memorable matches and moments as part of WWE's flagship show.

Episodes.Description: The Man Becomes Big Time Becks in this collection of her best matches and moments as the face of Raw.

Episodes.Description: She's the EST of WWE, and these are the best and most unforgettable moments from her illustrious Raw career.

Episodes.Title: Bret Hart
Episodes.Description: He is "the best there is, the best there was and the best there ever will be" to step between the ropes on Raw.

Episodes.Title: Charlotte Flair
Episodes.Description: Whether squaring off on Raw, Smackdown or NXT, The Queen leaves the WWE Universe in awe of superior athleticism.

Episodes.Title: CM Punk
Episodes.Description: He claims to be The Best in the World and you can see why in these classic matches and jaw-dropping moments on the mic.

Episodes.Title: Kurt Angle
Episodes.Description: Your American Hero shows everyone why he won an Olympic gold medal as he competes against Raw's toughest Superstars in these instant classics.

Episodes.Title: The New Day
Episodes.Description: No one puts on a show in the ring or on the mic quite like the entertaining trio of Big E, Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods.

Episodes.Title: Randy Orton
Episodes.Description: The Viper's strike has been felt on Raw from his days as The Legend Killer to epic clashes with John Cena, Triple H and AJ Styles.

Episodes.Title: Rey Mysterio
Episodes.Description: The Master of the 619 has been mystifying Monday Night Raw crowds for more than 20 years with high-flying matches and memorable moments.

Episodes.Title: Roman Reigns
Episodes.Description: Acknowledge The Head of The Table from his time as The Big Dog to his record-breaking reign as the box office draw of Monday Night Raw.

Episodes.Title: Seth "Freakin" Rollins
Episodes.Description: The Visionary has been burning it down on Raw for more than a decade, from betraying The Shield to becoming World Heavyweight Champion.

Episodes.Title: Shawn Michaels
Episodes.Description: HBK battles everyone from Marty Jennetty to Kurt Angle in this collection of his best matches on Raw.

Episodes.Title: Triple H
Episodes.Description: The Game battles fellow greats like Ric Flair, Shawn Michaels and John Cena in these must-see Raw showdowns.

Episodes.Title: Trish Stratus
Episodes.Description: Her legendary Raw rivalries with Lita and Becy Lynch, plus history-making matches, have always had fans saying, "Thank you, Trish."

Episodes.Title: The Undertaker
Episodes.Description: The Phenom's Monday night resume includes the most-watched match in Raw history and competing in the main event of the first-ever episode.

Entries.Title: Dia Imamku
Entries.Description:
A story of a love story of two levels, a rich and arrogant girl is willing to marry a poor man she hates in order to defend her ego. Can a husband's sincerity be able to destroy his wife's ego and become the best imam for her.

Cempaka Humairah, a proud and arrogant girl. She feels neglected by her parents, Dato' Malik and Datin Orkid who love her sister Lily Hamra more. Humairah hates her grandmother's adopted grandson, Amiruddin (Budin), a village man who is looked down upon, considered meaningless.

However, an unexpected incident forces Humairah to face the sincerity of Amir's feelings. When she begins to realize the truth and begs for forgiveness, Amir's heart has turned cold. Will Humairah find a way to mend the rift, or has she lost Amir forever?

Episodes.Description: This is Episode 01

Entries.Title: Got to Get Out
Entries.Description: Participants living in a mansion for 10 days vie for a cash prize that increases by $1 each second they’re in the game. As contestants compete in physical and mental challenges, more money will be added to “the pot,” with up to $1 million at stake.

Episodes.Title: Million Dollar Lies
Episodes.Description: Simu Liu introduces 20 reality contestants, all thieves scheming to escape his locked mansion for a million-dollar prize. Mixing reality tv celebs with everyday people, it’s mayhem for money!

Episodes.Title: Trash Talkers
Episodes.Description: The escape attempts ratchet up when a new game twist is introduced. Is anyone smart enough to make it out under the radar? Or will they be too busy cooking chicken piccata?

Episodes.Title: It's A Plant Guy!
Episodes.Description: The wannabe escape-artists are forced to work in teams, creating unlikely alliances and unbe-leaf-able action. When one of them comes up with an absurd plan to escape, it may just work.

Episodes.Title: Mimi’s Meatballs
Episodes.Description: People are losing their minds, as a strange romance sweeps the house, and everyone needs to JUST GET OUT. In the end, success or failure all comes down to one serving of meatballs.

Episodes.Title: Not So Fast!
Episodes.Description: Nearly halfway through the ten-day lockdown, and the gloves are off. New strategies abound, as the game keeps delivering surprises. Gifts that keep on giving.

Episodes.Title: Wheeling and Stealing
Episodes.Description: A power outage freezes the money clock, revealing a secret way to get out.  Alliances solidify, the defense gets harder, and a villain makes their move.

Episodes.Title: Breaking News
Episodes.Description: Cabin fever reaches an all-time high as the plotting takes a ridiculous turn. And one rat tries to steal the game!

Episodes.Title: Endgame
Episodes.Description: It’s the last day! With the windows boarded up, and the moving trucks outside, last-minute alliances shift the balance of power and threaten to empty the pot. Can the defenders save themselves from going home with nothing?

Entries.Title: Chasing the West
Entries.Description: Ranch-raised brothers Drew and Jonathan Scott are helping homeowners realize their dreams to live on a ranch, teaching livestock care, farming and adjusting to rural rhythms across Arizona, California and Texas landscapes.

Episodes.Title: #Ranchlife
Episodes.Description: Texas business owners turn to the brothers to find a home that embodies their years of hard work; a couple leaving the Hollywood film industry look for their first home and quickly realize country living is not for the faint of heart.

Episodes.Title: All Boots No Cowboy
Episodes.Description: City slickers want Jonathan and Drew to help them find life beyond their laptops in an old California mining town; the Brothers teach a Canadian horse trainer how to start a new life in Scottsdale, Ariz.

Episodes.Title: The City Slickers
Episodes.Description: Phoenix-based TV reporters head off to cowboy college with the brothers as they learn the ropes of buying and running a ranch; after 17 years in Dallas, a chef and so-called city girl set their sights on chickens, pecans and lots of land.

Episodes.Title: Let's Raise the Bar
Episodes.Description: Jonathan and Drew take on a couple with two daughters and more than ten pets, but with ranches near Los Angeles scarce and expensive, finding the right one isn't easy; a couple and their three kids look for a smart investment with cowboy charm.

Episodes.Title: Head in the Clouds
Episodes.Description: Married for 35 years, longtime California State Rangers turn to the Brothers for a property that reminds them of state park life, but with land they own; and animal chiropractor and horse shoer are ready to flee their 400 square-foot rental.

Episodes.Title: Far, Far Away
Episodes.Description: An overworked air traffic controller needs the Brothers to help him find a peaceful retreat for himself and family; an Olympic hopeful and her close friend risk everything to buy property and launch an equestrian business together.

Episodes.Title: Size Matters
Episodes.Description: A Hollywood makeup artist wants to escape to the desert town of Agua Dulce, but putting her horses first doesn't bode well for her family; a family of four looks to live on their own terms and trust the Brothers to stretch their dollar.

Episodes.Title: No Point in Dreaming Small
Episodes.Description: Jonathan and Drew help two friends achieve their dreams of buying property together and growing their off-roading business; after living abroad and in Hawaii, a single woman has her sights set on the western town of Cave Creek.

Entries.Title: A Sorority Mom's Guide to Rush!
Entries.Description: Follows mother-daughter pairs during sorority Rush, from applications through Bid Day. Shows prep work, consultants, style choices, and legacy pressure as girls seek spots in coveted houses.

Episodes.Title: Legacy or Letdown
Episodes.Description: Carol Anne obsessively pushes her daughter to do everything perfectly in pursuit of abid.

Episodes.Title: Mute My Mom
Episodes.Description: As sorority rush looms, Paula struggles to loosen her grip on pampered legacy daughter Alexis.

Episodes.Title: She's Not Rushing Ma'am
Episodes.Description: Both headed to Ole Miss, Brehana and Kinsley face Rush with very different energies behind them.

Episodes.Title: There's No "We" in Rush
Episodes.Description: Mom Lori anxiously questions whether trying again is worth the risk.

Entries.Title: Top Gun: The Next Generation
Entries.Description: Follow a class of Navy and Marine Corps student pilots as they enter the final and most unforgiving phase of elite strike fighter training. It's six months of high-stakes aerial training, brutal physical demands, and emotional reckoning - where only the top performers earn the chance to fly the most coveted aircrafts.

Episodes.Title: Strike
Episodes.Description: One student's dreams of becoming a fighter pilot are put in jeopardy as the class starts advanced phase training with a set of breathtaking bombing tests. Diving at speeds they've never faced before, students struggle with the dynamic moves and start to make high-risk mistakes. Instructors deliver tough assessments in the debriefs to keep the students safe.

Episodes.Title: Catching the Wire
Episodes.Description: Landing on an aircraft carrier demands precision flying and is a skill vital for all U.S. Navy fighter pilots. As the students tackle the longest and most technical section of the Advanced Phase, they know it's a test they must pass to keep their dreams alive. The pressure mounts on some struggling students, and the commanding officer issues a timely warning to one.

Episodes.Title: Attack Attack!
Episodes.Description: As the students reach the midpoint of their training, they start the iconic dogfighting phase. Against them are seasoned instructors with hundreds of hours of real-world experience. To pass, they must outmaneuver the enemy to take a "kill shot." One student has the added pressure of flying with his Top Gun-trained commodore, while another struggles to control his aggressive instincts.

Episodes.Title: Fight's On!
Episodes.Description: As they enter the second and most challenging phase of dog fighting, everything is on the line for our students. Defensive dogfighting involves dynamic maneuvers to evade battle-hardened instructors. The physical strain proves too much for one student, while another has a crisis of confidence when past failures come back to haunt him.

Episodes.Title: Head-to-Head
Episodes.Description: The students face their final test in an iconic head-to-head dogfight against an instructor. To pass, they must bring all the skills they've learned during their Advanced Phase training. With graduation just days away, students start to worry about their final grades and whether they will get the posting they - and in many cases, their families - want.

Episodes.Title: Last Chance
Episodes.Description: It's graduation week. For the remaining students, it means they have one last chance to prove they deserve their prestigious fighter pilot wings. Standing in their way is a tense head-to-head dogfight against an instructor. Past failures come back to haunt one student, and another's whole fighter pilot future comes down to a single flight with their commanding officer.

Entries.Title: Secrets of Celebrity Sex Tapes
Entries.Description: The show offers an in-depth exploration of some of the most infamous celebrity sex tapes, examining the story behind each one, how they ignited public obsession, and how they impacted the lives of those involved. The series will feature exclusive interviews and details.

Episodes.Title: Birth of the Sex Tape
Episodes.Description: The underground sex tape market goes mainstream as the first two celebrity sex tape scandals, featuring Rob Lowe and Jayne Kennedy, cause public shock and private embarrassment.

Episodes.Title: Pam & Tommy
Episodes.Description: Pamela Anderson and Tommy Lee were the celebrity "it" couple of the 1990s, but when their private recording was stolen and leaked, it became the most famous sex tape in the world.

Episodes.Title: Kim Kardashian
Episodes.Description: A young Kim Kardashian lives in the shadow of her friend Paris Hilton, until her sex tape is leaked.

Episodes.Title: Colin Farrell
Episodes.Description: A sex tape of Colin Farrell with a Playboy Playmate has been leaked; Dustin Diamond wants his video.
