Entries.Title: No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski
Entries.Description: From Italy, Germany and the UK to Senegal, South Korea and Borneo, Antoni takes celebs on epic journeys to explore their ancestral and culinary roots.

Episodes.Title: Florence Pugh's English Odyssey
Episodes.Description: Antoni helps Florence explore the origins of her family's passion for food as they travel through Oxford, the Yorkshire coast and London; together, they encounter delicious dishes and discover stories of ancestors.

Episodes.Title: Awkwafina's Korean Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Awkwafina lost her mother at a young age; eager to help her reconnect with her South Korean culinary and ancestral heritage, Antoni curates a voyage of discovery filled with new experiences, family revelations, and evocative flavors.

Episodes.Title: Justin Theroux's Italian Quest
Episodes.Description: Seeking the origins of a family pasta dish, Antoni takes Justin on an Italian road trip; from chasing chickens to harvesting clams, they sample the region's finest food and uncover how Justin's Italian ancestry relates to a family dish.

Episodes.Title: James Marsden's German Dish Up
Episodes.Description: On the hunt for the origins of the Marsden family's beloved chicken fried steak, Antoni takes James from the Texas plains to Germany; they discover just how much the experiences of his German forebears have shaped James' family history.

Episodes.Title: Issa Rae's Senegalese Royal Roots
Episodes.Description: Antoni takes Issa to her father's homeland of Senegal, where they uncover ancestral stories of powerful women and royal connections; through this journey, Issa learns more about her family's epic history and how it all relates to her own identity.

Episodes.Title: Henry Golding's Malaysian Adventure
Episodes.Description: Antoni takes Henry to Borneo, where they unearth family stories and taste their way to a deeper connection with Henry's mother's Iban heritage; Henry learns that genealogy in this oral tradition is about far more than storytelling.

Entries.Title: Power Moves with Shaquille O'Neal
Entries.Description: NBA legends Shaquille O'Neal and Allen Iverson work to revive Reebok's legacy and find a rising star to rep the brand.

Episodes.Title: Unfinished Business
Episodes.Description: Shaq and Allen Iverson reveal their game plan to rebuild Reebok's basketball reputation, from launching a new sneaker to recruiting young stars.

Episodes.Title: The Pivot
Episodes.Description: A talented youngster emerges as a recruitment target for Shaq's team, while designs for the new shoe take shape ahead of the first prototypes.

Episodes.Title: The Future is Female
Episodes.Description: With help from pro superstar Angel Reese, the team builds out its WNBA strategy. A heartfelt talk with Allen sets DiJonai Carrington up to grow her game.

Episodes.Title: Forge Your Own Path
Episodes.Description: Shaq and the team miss out on signing a prime target. Embarking on his first recruiting trip, Shareef hopes to fill the gap with another player.

Episodes.Title: The Iverson Effect
Episodes.Description: Shareef faces a tough choice about chasing his NBA dreams. With four weeks to go before the sneaker's debut, Allen reviews the latest prototypes.

Episodes.Title: Back in the Game
Episodes.Description: The moment of truth arrives for Shaq and the team. With the entire basketball world watching, Angel Reese debuts Reebok's comeback sneaker.

Entries.Title: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America
Entries.Description: On April 19, 1995, the deadliest act of domestic terrorism in U.S. history devastated the nation, claiming 168 lives - including 19 children - and injuring hundreds more. The bombing of the Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building shattered families and changed America forever.

Episodes.Title: Explosion
Episodes.Description: April 19, 1995, begins like any other day in Oklahoma City until a bomb explodes outside a federal building. Oklahomans are plunged into chaos, and first responders race against the clock to save those trapped inside. Meanwhile, the media searches for answers, and the FBI begins what will become one of their biggest investigations.

Episodes.Title: Manhunt
Episodes.Description: Reports of a second explosive cause mass panic and an evacuation is ordered. Fighting their instincts, first responders must leave survivors trapped and fearing for their lives. The country questions who would strike a federal building in the heartland as the FBI launches a nationwide search to find those responsible for the worst domestic terrorist attack in American history.

Episodes.Title: Justice
Episodes.Description: President Clinton arrives in Oklahoma as grieving families come together to remember those they have lost.  The nation grapples with the reality that the bomber is an American veteran who shows no remorse. As the trial begins, the government seeks the death penalty for the worst domestic terrorist attack in US history.

Entries.Title: Memphis to the Mountain
Entries.Description: From the grit of South Memphis, a group of young climbers set out to scale a 16,000-ft rock tower on Mt. Kenya - defying the limits of their world and themselves, and confronting thin air, raw fear, and the climb toward self-discovery.

Episodes.Title: Acclimatization
Episodes.Description: Nine young climbers from South Memphis embark on a journey that may reshape their lives. Their first training mission on a Colorado mountain pushes them beyond the breaking point, and in the struggle, one climber faces a revelation.

Episodes.Title: Exposure
Episodes.Description: High above Nevada’s desert floor with Alex Honnold, the team faces fear and failure — while back in South Memphis, tragedy forces a critical choice.

Episodes.Title: Elevation
Episodes.Description: As the team heads to Mt. Kenya, multiple crises strike at home and on the mountain—pushing one climber off the team, another to the brink, and testing everyone’s limits.

Entries.Title: Weather Hunters
Entries.Description: Weather Hunters entertains and educates kids about the impact weather has on our daily lives, and inspires young kids to pursue a future in STEM. Understanding that representation in the media matters, the series includes diverse cast, helping to make science accessible to all viewers.

Entries.Title: Sevier Heights
Entries.Description:
Step into the heart of Knoxville, Tennessee, and experience powerful worship, authentic community, and life-changing messages with Sevier Heights. This weekly broadcast brings the vibrant spirit of Sevier Heights into your home—featuring dynamic preaching from a Bible-centered perspective, passionate music led by the church's gifted worship team, and real stories of transformation that inspire hope and purpose. Whether you're searching for truth, longing for connection, or simply looking to grow deeper in your walk with Christ, this is more than a show—it's a movement of faith, love, and grace.

Join us and discover how Sevier Heights is living out the Gospel and impacting lives across East Tennessee and beyond.

Entries.Title: Murder Has Two Faces
Entries.Description: In the shadow of a highly publicized tragedy, an eerily similar crime is overlooked. GMA's Robin Roberts shines new light on the victims largely ignored.

Episodes.Title: Motherhood Interrupted
Episodes.Description: Two pregnant women, Laci Peterson and Evelyn Hernandez, are found dead in the SF Bay. Is there a connection? Rumors of a satanic cult swirl.

Episodes.Title: Capitol Killings
Episodes.Description: Chandra Levy and Joyce Chiang, two young women tied to DC power circles, vanish and are found murdered. Is there a serial killer at work?

Episodes.Title: Good Guys Gone Bad
Episodes.Description: Predators known as the Craigslist Killer and the Tagged Killer, use social media to hunt. One survivor shares her story.

Entries.Title: Thresher
Entries.Description: Deep in the abyss, a motley crew boards the S.S. Thresher submarine to explore the abandoned Rán Boer station. Fighting claustrophobia, paranoia, oceanic behemoths, and hidden horrors, one thing is certain: from the deep, power rises.

Episodes.Title: From the Deep
Episodes.Description: A mystery long forgotten stirs in the abyss, as the Thresher crew makes a treacherous descent into the lost station of Rán-Beor.

Episodes.Title: Power Rises
Episodes.Description: After Rán-Beor's power is switched back on, the crew confront one another as tensions and unexpected truths bubble up to the surface.

Entries.Title: The Gilgo Beach Killer: House of Secrets
Entries.Description: Inside the home of the alleged Gilgo Beach killer, featuring exclusive family testimony revealing a double life and dark secrets hidden beneath their roof after his arrest.

Episodes.Title: Monster Among Us
Episodes.Description: When searching for a missing woman, law enforcement on Long Island stumble upon the remains of other victims; as the killer of the so-called "Gilgo Four" remains elusive, police come to believe that the monster himself may live among them.

Episodes.Title: House of Secrets
Episodes.Description: After Rex Heuermann is arrested and charged as the Gilgo Beach killer, a feverish hunt for information is undertaken -- but his family isn't talking; now, for the first time, the loved ones of the alleged killer speak publicly.

Episodes.Title: The Good Wife
Episodes.Description: With a mountain of seemingly damning evidence stacking up against him, Rex Heuermann's family struggles to understand how their beloved patriarch could be the monstrous serial killer law enforcement claims he is.

Entries.Title: Call Her Alex
Entries.Description: "Call Her Daddy" creator, host and executive producer Alex Cooper is at the top of her game, signing one of the biggest deals in podcast history. This revealing two-part series gives audiences a behind-the-scenes, intimate look at her journey and the defining moments that shaped her influential voice.

Episodes.Title: Part One
Episodes.Description: As Alex prepares for her first live tour, we uncover how her childhood and college soccer career shaped the voice that now defines her.

Episodes.Title: Part Two
Episodes.Description: After moving to NYC, Alex launches Call Her Daddy. What starts as a sex podcast evolves into the foundation of a media empire—uncovering the resilience and vulnerability it takes to become one of the most influential voices of a generation.

Entries.Title: Meet Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
Entries.Description: Join young genius inventor Tony Stark (Iron Man) and his team of heroic friends as they embark on thrilling adventures, using their tech, teamwork, and quick thinking to save the day!

Episodes.Title: Meet the IQ
Episodes.Description: Eight-year-old genius inventor Tony Stark (aka Iron Man) gives a tour of the IQ.

Episodes.Title: Meet Iron Man
Episodes.Description: Iron Man must rescue people from a Ferris wheel when it stops working.

Episodes.Title: Meet Ironheart
Episodes.Description: Ironheart, Iron Man, and Iron Hulk race to rescue a giant runaway donut in their Iron Racers.

Episodes.Title: Meet Iron Hulk
Episodes.Description: Iron Hulk helps rescue a kitten that's trapped in a tree.

Episodes.Title: Meet Iron Pup
Episodes.Description: The Iron Friends must get Iron Pup's flying disc back after Absorbing Man steals it.

Episodes.Title: Meet Captain America
Episodes.Description: Iron Man and Captain America work together when Swarm attacks the IQ with her robotic lightning bug.

Episodes.Title: Meet Iron Spider
Episodes.Description: Iron Man and Iron Spider must save the pier when Swarm makes a mess of it with her robotic bugs.

Episodes.Title: Meet Black Panther
Episodes.Description: When Swarm uses her robotic slime bug to make a mess of Stark Expo, it's up to Iron Man and Black Panther to rescue the visitors and save the day.

Episodes.Title: Meet Ultron
Episodes.Description: Iron Man must stop Ultron when he uses his robotic racer to steal things from people all over town.

Episodes.Title: Meet Vision
Episodes.Description: When the training bots go out of control in the Smashcade, Iron Man needs Vision's help to get everything back in working order.

Entries.Title: The Twelve Dates of Christmas
Entries.Description: Follows Saville Row textile pattern designer Kate, who lives in the quaint village of Blexford, England next door to her father Mac, who is long-divorced from Kate’s mother Delilah, a globe-trotting American always on an adventure.  When not at work, Kate looks after Mac, who’s recovering from a motorbike accident and is inclined to spend his days sitting in his recliner.  Her best friend Laura signs her up for The 12 Dates of Christmas – a holiday-themed matchmaking program in the days leading up to the holiday featuring carefully curated, yuletide dating experiences, in an attempt to get Kate out of her rut.

Episodes.Title: Shocking Behavior
Episodes.Description: Unprecedented pain awaits as the contestants must zap their fellow snakes with a shock collar. Then, a double-headed snake mutates and two players must decide their next move on the snake chain.

Episodes.Title: The Final Bite
Episodes.Description: In the season finale, the remaining contestants compete in two challenges for a coveted spot in the final saving ceremony. Decisions made throughout the game come back to bite the final two competitors, whose fate lies in the hands of their fellow snakes

Entries.Title: The Death Coast
Entries.Description: The Death Coast is an area of rough sea in the North Atlantic that's claimed more than six thousand vessels across centuries. Many sailors braved these waters – some for trade, some for war, and some for plunder. Gold and priceless objects from their wrecked ships now lie scattered across the ocean floor but salvaging has been banned here for the last decade. Now, after a long battle, shipwreck hunter Jeff Mackinnon has won exclusive rights to dive. He and his team have just 12 weeks to search the wrecks before the turbulent waters of the Death Coast make diving impossible.

Episodes.Title: The Hunt Begins
Episodes.Description: Jeff MacKinnon searches the Death Coast for Le Chameau, an 18th-century shipwreck carrying a fortune in rare coins; with a 300-year-old map and top divers, he must recover the treasure before the relentless storms of the "Death Coast" shut him down.

Episodes.Title: Phantom Wreck
Episodes.Description: After finding an American coin at Le Chameau's wreck site, Jeff MacKinnon must choose to either stay the course or chase a new mystery; sonar reveals a potential wreck, but a cryptic clue suggests an even greater discovery hidden beneath the waves.

Episodes.Title: Graveyard of Scatarie
Episodes.Description: Jeff MacKinnon's team searches Scatarie Island for The Feversham's lost fortune; battling currents, they uncover artifacts that may lead to treasure.

Episodes.Title: Into the Eye of the Storm
Episodes.Description: Jeff MacKinnon's team battles thick kelp, brutal currents and a looming storm while searching Scatarie Island's coast; just as the storm hits, they make a crucial discovery.

Episodes.Title: The Treasure Within
Episodes.Description: Jeff and his team's search for the wrecks of Mary, Joseph, and Neptune takes them further into uncharted territory. When an unusual artifact suggests a nefarious past for one of the ships, Jeff begins to suspect he may be on the verge of uncovering a field of stolen treasure.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Breakers
Episodes.Description: Following the trail of a cache of precious gemstones, Jeff and the team move further beyond the breakers, in search of The Neptune; with stormy weather closing in, a puzzling find may lead them one step closer to a privateer's long-lost treasure.

Episodes.Title: The Sunken Legend
Episodes.Description: A powerful hurricane forces Jeff's team into a secluded cove, where they investigate The Lombrac, an 18th-century ghost ship; as the divers recover clues from the depths, Jeff zeroes in on the site of a 300-year-old mystery that may be solved.

Entries.Description: The series follows the Chrisley family as Todd and Julie Chrisley are released from prison after being pardoned. It chronicles their emotional reunion, the challenges the family faced during their incarceration, and their journey to move on and "set the record straight." The show also addresses ongoing family drama, including the rift between Savannah and her sister Lindsie.

Episodes.Description: With former reality TV stars Todd and Julie Chrisley in prison, daughter Savannah fights to secure a pardon for them while balancing work, guardianship of her younger brother and sister, and navigating fractured relationships with family.

Episodes.Title: Freedom Frenzy

Episodes.Description: Minnie and Daisy want to throw a birthday party for puppy Cream Puff, but their doggie treat decorating machine goes bananas.

Episodes.Title: 2. Puppy Pool Party
Episodes.Description: When a new hotel guest is too scared of water to join in on the Pet Hotel puppy pool party, Minnie and Daisy pull out all the stops to help her take part in the fun.

Episodes.Description: Minnie and Daisy scramble to keep a bouncing baby goat from destroying the hotel.

Entries.Title: How I Escaped My Cult
Entries.Description: Go inside insidious modern-day cults through the unique lens of members who endured unspeakable trauma and the shocking investigations into these oppressive groups. With detailed, firsthand accounts from former cult members, their loved ones, and the investigators who helped bring these tormentors to justice.

Episodes.Title: Tony Alamo Christian Academy
Episodes.Description: As a teen in the Tony Alamo cult, Desiree becomes one of Alamo’s sex slaves. With investigators desperate for proof of his horrific crimes, Desiree holds the key to bringing him down. But first, she must survive a dangerous escape.

Episodes.Title: Angel's Landing
Episodes.Description: For Sara, Lou Castro is an angel with heavenly powers over life and death. But when a string of his devoted followers dies under mysterious circumstances, detectives must uncover Castro's shocking true identity while Sara plots her escape.

Episodes.Title: Word of Life
Episodes.Description: For Kristel Leonard, the Word of Life dictates every aspect of her life. But when ruthless new pastor Tiffanie Irwin takes over, Kristel tries to leave her iron grip, leading to deadly and horrifying consequences for those closest to her.

Episodes.Title: Nuwaubian Nation
Episodes.Description: Looking for a better life, Habiybah's family joins a new Black-led cult, the Nuwaubian Nation. But when their narcissistic leader, Dwight York uses his powers to commit horrific crimes, she knows the only way out is to go deeper in.

Episodes.Title: The Pilgrims
Episodes.Description: As the oldest daughter of family-cult leader Papa Pilgrim, Elishaba is the primary target of his rage and lust. His torment escalates when the entire group moves to Alaska, where she must survive a bold escape through the frigid wilderness.

Episodes.Title: La Luz Del Mundo
Episodes.Description: As a devoted member of La Luz Del Mundo, Alethea obeys her apostle Samuel Flores, becoming his sex slave. But when other brave women reveal their own horrific abuses, it leads to a dramatic arrest, an intense trial, and a harrowing escape.

Episodes.Title: Yearning for Zion / FLDS
Episodes.Description: When Warren Jeffs is arrested for unspeakable crimes his son Wendell and 8th wife Vicky are caught between their sadistic cult and the investigators trying to bring it down. Escaping Warren's physical and mental hold is their only way out.

Episodes.Title: NXIVM / The Vow
Episodes.Description: A look into insidious modern-day cults through the lens of members who endured trauma and investigations into the oppressive groups.

Entries.Title: Celtics City
Entries.Description: Containing extensive, never-before-seen archives and more than 80 interviews of past and present Boston Celtics legends, this series chronicles the history, cultural impact, and extraordinary tale of the NBA's winningest and most storied franchise, the Boston Celtics,

Episodes.Title: Chapter I: Founding Fathers
Episodes.Description: Led by Bob Cousy and Bill Russell, the Celtics become an NBA dynasty, but racial tensions in Boston and beyond augur a turbulent era ahead.

Episodes.Title: Chapter II: No Final Victories
Episodes.Description: Amid backlash for his commitment to civil rights, Bill Russell makes history as the first Black head coach in professional sports.

Episodes.Title: Chapter III: All Swept Up
Episodes.Description: The Celtics win a pair of titles in the '70s amid racial unrest, and near the end of the decade, they draft Indiana State star Larry Bird.

Episodes.Title: Chapter IV: Great Hope. Period.
Episodes.Description: Larry Bird elevates the Celtics and struggling NBA to new heights, but internal discord threatens to derail another potential dynasty.

Episodes.Title: Chapter V: F**k the Celtics
Episodes.Description: Larry Bird's epic rivalry with Magic Johnson captivates the sports world. Then, in 1986, an unthinkable tragedy changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Chapter VI: Untenable Toll
Episodes.Description: The tragic death of Len Bias casts a shadow over the Celtics. In 1992, Larry Bird's retirement closes a chapter for the team and the NBA.

Episodes.Title: Chapter VII: Not Again
Episodes.Description: After Reggie Lewis' sudden death leaves the city heartbroken, the Celtics spiral into steep decline following the arrival of Rick Pitino.

Episodes.Title: Chapter VIII: Ubuntu
Episodes.Description: After another downturn, new GM and former Celtic Danny Ainge acquires Kevin Garnett and Ray Allen to form a "Big Three" with Paul Pierce.

Episodes.Title: Chapter IX: We're the Celtics
Episodes.Description: After the 2008 title, injuries, and internal conflict take a toll. Led by a new crop of stars, the team wins an 18th championship in 2024.​

Entries.Title: Baylen Out Loud
Entries.Description: Follow the journey of Baylen Dupree, a young woman living with Tourette Syndrome. Despite her daily challenges, Baylen, her family, and long-term boyfriend aren't afraid to laugh and embrace the chaos that makes their everyday lives unique.

Episodes.Title: I Have Tourette's Stupid!
Episodes.Description: Baylen Dupree is a young adult living with Tourette Syndrome and it impacts every aspect of her life and the lives of her parents and five siblings. Ready to be an independent adult, Baylen tries to navigate a world full of triggers and danger, but a phone call from her boyfriend during her brother’s birthday might turn her whole world upside down.

Episodes.Title: The Airport is a Tic Disaster
Episodes.Description: Baylen learns what Colin's work relocation could mean for their relationship. Baylen is invited to be a guest panelist at a Tourette's Convention in Dallas but airports and flying can be a recipe for disaster.

Episodes.Title: We All Have Tourette's
Episodes.Description: Baylen travels to Texas for a Tourette convention, but her tics threaten to overpower her big moment. After connecting with new friends and a doctor who suggests a radical treatment, it all proves too much for Baylen when she suffers a severe tic attack.

Episodes.Title: Going For Narnia!
Episodes.Description: After suffering a terrifying tic attack, questions are raised about Baylen's ability to live on her own. Baylen and Colin decide to take a big step in their relationship, but the excitement is short-lived as they begin sharing the news with their families.

Episodes.Title: It Was Him, Chainsaws, Me
Episodes.Description: Baylen and Colin are excited to live together but they need an approval from Colin's very conservative parents first. Allen, still uneasy about their decision, talks man to man with Colin. Baylen tries Botox to help with her tics. Colin drops a life changing bomb.

Episodes.Title: I Have News
Episodes.Description: After an eventful apartment hunting adventure, Baylen and Colin move in together, but outside forces bring everything to a halt. At Baylen's birthday party, tension is in the air as Colin's birthday surprise royally backfires, leaving Baylen wondering if they're on the same page.

Episodes.Title: What If My Dad Says No?
Episodes.Description: After a huge fight at Baylen's birthday party, Colin works on rebuilding trust with her family. Allen and Julie worry Baylen's tics are getting worse and wonder if Deep Brain Stimulation could be an option. Colin breaks the news to Julie and Allen about his true intentions with Baylen.

Episodes.Title: You Don't Have To Stare Into My Soul
Episodes.Description: Colin seeks Baylen's parents' blessing to propose to her during their family vacation. Baylen and her parents meet with a neurologist to discuss Deep Brain Stimulation. Colin realizes its going to be an uphill battle after a secret meeting with Allen.

Episodes.Title: This Is a Big Plot Twist
Episodes.Description: The Duprees head to the beach for their annual family vacation where Colin secretly plans to propose, but a brewing thunderstorm threatens to ruin his proposal plans. Sammi takes the opportunity to share some long-harbored concerns with Baylen. Baylen and Colin drop one last bombshell on the entire family.

Entries.Description: The Autobots and Decepticons find themselves pulled by an unknown mastermind into the virtual realm of Cyberworld. Forced to compete in challenges to earn energon and gain strength, the trapped Transformers must battle the elements and each other to try and survive long enough to figure out who's behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Commence Program
Episodes.Description: Optimus Prime finds himself tumbling headfirst onto a strange and hostile alien planet. His attempts to discover more about his surroundings are met with violent onslaughts from the monstrous Scorponok and the fearsome Grimlock, who chases Optimus through the Jungle.

Episodes.Title: Prime Target
Episodes.Description: Bumblebee battles Megatron in a target shooting challenge while Optimus Prime races through the jungle, away from Grimlock, to reach his old friend.

Episodes.Title: Crate Point, Well Fought

Episodes.Title: River Race Ruckus
Episodes.Description: Optimus Prime and Bumblebee are travelling the banks of the river, in the Jungle region, when they are surprised by the arrival of Elita-1 - in the midst of a dangerous high speed race against her rival Sky-Byte. Misunderstanding the stakes, Optimus and Bumblebee force their way onto the track, disrupting the game and kicking off a fight between the hapless trio and an emboldened Sky-Byte.

Episodes.Title: Smoke & Mirrors
Episodes.Description: Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, and Elita-1 sneak into Cyber City on a covert mission for crucial intel - but the shadows hide surprises and secrets alike. Bumbebee receives a rare item drop, but things are not what they seem and not before long, the heroes are thrown into a dizzying maze of illusions.

Episodes.Title: Screamer City Arena

Episodes.Title: Hunter vs Hunted

Episodes.Title: What Goes Up

However, Optimus comes face to face with his enemy, Megatron for the first time on Cyberworld. With both teams racing for the Energon, who will make it to the top first?

Entries.Title: Next Gen NYC
Entries.Description: “Next Gen NYC” follows a tangled web of friends raised in the spotlight — or at least close enough for good lighting — as they stumble into adulthood one brunch, breakup and spontaneous decision at a time.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to New York
Episodes.Description: Hudson needs to find an apartment first; Brooks juggles a fashion shoot alongside her mom, Meredith, while quietly side-eyeing Charlie's flirtation with sister Chloe; Georgia's confession about her sanitary habits sends Gia and Riley reeling.

Episodes.Title: What Happens in Brooklyn
Episodes.Description: Ariana and Riley reconnect after a decade apart; Charlie struggles to hide his irritation as a Brooklyn night out shifts from cocktails to chaos; Brooks and Gia update their moms, Meredith and Teresa, on brewing drama.

Episodes.Title: Daddy Issues and Poolside Tissues
Episodes.Description: Brooks attempts father-son bonding with Seth, but their heart-to-heart turns into a grilling session.

Episodes.Title: Apology Not Included
Episodes.Description: Charlie's apology tour goes sideways when he casually hints he's into someone in the friend group; Ariana and Hudson land their dream apartment; on a museum outing with his parents, Brooks' dad diagnoses him as mom-dependent.

Episodes.Title: Zero Bucks Given
Episodes.Description: Brooks reaches a breaking point while styling Meredith for her caviar event. Ava's arrival to the party ignites drama. Charlie ducks out on a hefty bar tab, leaving Hudson and Riley stuck footing the bill. Riley stuns his mom, Kandi, by revealing her true career passion. Georgia and Charlie's mutual frustration leads to an explosive showdown.

Episodes.Title: Boardwalk of Shame
Episodes.Description: Ariana's excitement for her mother Kim's NYC visit fades when Hudson pushes her to set financial boundaries.

Episodes.Title: Shore Losers
Episodes.Description: The morning after Brooks' birthday blowout, the crew wakes up determined to have a fun day on the water.

Episodes.Title: Gutter Balls & Breakup Calls
Episodes.Description: Tensions linger as the group heads back from Jersey with Riley calling out double standards and Emira dropping a bombshell; Brooks finally steps out of Meredith's shadow; at Georgia's bowling event, Ava's loyalty sparks confrontation.

Entries.Title: Trophy Wife: Murder on Safari
Entries.Description: Explores the mysterious death of Bianca Rudolph on an African hunting trip.

Episodes.Title: Jekyll & Hyde
Episodes.Description: Dr. Larry Rudolph, a pioneering dentist and big game hunter, gets caught in a love triangle with deadly consequences.

Episodes.Title: Something Fishy
Episodes.Description: Larry is forced to choose between his wife, Bianca, and his longtime mistress, Lori. The love triangle comes to a deadly end on a safari adventure.

Episodes.Title: Crocodile Tears
Episodes.Description: Hot on Larry’s trail, an epic international cat-and-mouse investigation ensues. But he’s not the only one caught in the FBI’s crosshairs.

Entries.Title: Accused: Did I Do It?
Entries.Description: Follow the stories of individuals who are facing charges for serious offenses such as first-degree murder, manslaughter, domestic terrorism, and aggravated assault. Every piece of evidence may lead to an answer, but the truth is never quite clear until the final moment of reveal.

Episodes.Title: Pocketknife Killer or Vulnerable Vacationer?
Episodes.Description: A day out on the river with friends ends in a deadly encounter, when a man stabs five people with a pocket knife, following a terrifying confrontation. The Defense argues the man believed his life was in danger and he acted in self-defense. With the entire incident recorded on cellphone, the Prosecution believes the man was the aggressor and this was intentional homicide. Is he a pocket knife killer or a vulnerable vacationer?

Episodes.Title: Deadly Driver or Car Crash Survivor?
Episodes.Description: A man is killed instantly after a head on collision with a young mother driving home from a late-night shift at a Florida hotel. The Prosecution allege she was under the influence and caused the crash. However, the Defense are desperate for the jury to hear evidence that might prove otherwise. Is she a DUI driver or innocent survivor?

Episodes.Title: One Punch Killer or Protective Brother?
Episodes.Description: A frightening assault ends in tragedy when teenagers shoot splat ball guns at two brothers playing a nighttime basketball game; a fight ensues between the youths, leaving a 17-year-old dead at the scene.

Episodes.Title: Killer Knifeman or Innocent Defender?
Episodes.Description: A 52 year old VP of a Medical Center faces 95 years in prison for fatally stabbing a doctor's husband. He insists he was trapped, by a man intent on harming him, and forced to defend himself. But the Prosecution argues CCTV proves he's the aggressor and should be found guilty of manslaughter. Is he a killer knifeman or is he an innocent defender?

Episodes.Title: Negligent Midwife or Responsible Caregiver?
Episodes.Description: In Nebraska, an unlicensed midwife assists a home birth that ends in tragedy. The Defense believes the midwife took the correct decisions during the birth but the Prosecution allege she was inadequately qualified and charge her with Negligent Child Abuse resulting in Death. Is she a negligent midwife or a responsible caregiver?

Episodes.Title: Cold Blooded Killer or Terrified Shooter
Episodes.Description: A peaceful Sunday morning ends in tragedy when a car accident ends in a deadly altercation. A 25-year old man is charged with Second Degree Murder after he shoots a teenage driver dead. Facing up to 40 years in prison, the Defense claims he was ambushed and acted in self-defense. But the Prosecution believe he could have left the scene. Is he a cold-blooded killer or a terrified shooter?

Episodes.Title: Staircase Shooter or Defensive Dad?
Episodes.Description: An angry confrontation leads to a 31-year-old father facing life behind bars, after shooting his ex-girlfriend's boyfriend in the leg. He insists he was defending his ex and their child from an intruder, after the ex-boyfriend broke into her home. But the incident was captured on video and the Prosecution believe it shows a violent attack. Is he an angry ex or a defensive dad?

Episodes.Title: Murderous Cop Or Innocent Gunman?
Episodes.Description: An off-duty police officer shoots a man in the chest after a social event explodes into a deadly argument, between the two men. The Defense believes this is a clear case of self-defense. But when an eyewitness changes their statement, the Prosecution charges him with murder. Is he a murderous off-duty cop or an innocent gunman?

Episodes.Title: Freeway Shooter Or Innocent Father?
Episodes.Description: A 21-year old man is charged with domestic terrorism after a spree of shootings, on the freeway, sends the public into panic. Facing over 100 years in prison, the young father claims he has an alibi. But the Prosecution insists they have proof the gun used in the shootings belongs to him. Is he a domestic terrorist or innocent father?

Episodes.Title: Murderous Wife Or Battered Spouse?
Episodes.Description: A husband stumbles from a car and dies in the street after an altercation with his wife spirals out of control. The wife claims she has no memory of wounding him but, when the police investigate, she is charged with Second Degree Murder. Is she a murderous wife or a battered spouse?

Entries.Title: Baddies Africa Auditions
Entries.Description: Executive Producer Natalie Nunn arrives in ATL to cast a group of Baddies to take on a trip to Africa.

Episodes.Title: Parts 1
Episodes.Description: Atlanta is swarmed with ladies who show off their inner Baddie in the pre-screen and main stage.

Episodes.Title: Parts 2
Episodes.Description: Atlanta is swarmed with ladies who show off their inner Baddie in the pre-screen and main stage.

Episodes.Title: Parts 3
Episodes.Description: Natalie, Caresha, and Saucy Santana have their hands full on the main stage.

Entries.Title: The Killer Clown: Murder on the Doorstep
Entries.Description: With rumors of infidelity and an unhappy marriage, Marlene's husband Michael Warren emerges as the prime suspect, but with a solid alibi detectives can’t prove his involvement, and the case goes cold. Three decades later there's a shocking twist – Michael's alleged mistress Sheila Keen is arrested for Marlene’s murder accused of donning the clown disguise. In May 2023 Sheila pleaded guilty just before trial. Case closed? Or does this guilty plea raise as many questions as it answers?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: In 1990, Marlene is shot by a clown, and detectives try to find a motive for her murder. Her husband Michael becomes the prime suspect after detectives learn their marriage was on the rocks, but an anonymous tip leads investigators to another suspect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Michael’s affair leads detectives to investigate his alleged mistress, Sheila. A lead on the costume from a store puts Sheila firmly in the frame but without evidence the case goes cold, until in 2017 new DNA evidence leads detectives to an arrest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After Sheila’s arrest, the prosecution prepares for trial, the stakes are high. The prosecution’s case centers on new DNA and fiber evidence. Sheila’s defense attorney attempts to get the evidence thrown out and offers up a shocking alternative…

Entries.Title: Temptation Island
Entries.Description: In this spicy update to the hit reality series, four couples test their relationships by shacking up with eligible singles on a tropical island.

Episodes.Title: Bring on the Temptation
Episodes.Description: The couples meet the swimsuit-clad singles they'll be living with for three weeks. When each partner chooses one to date first, paradise turns tense.

Episodes.Title: Testing the Waters
Episodes.Description: As the tempters get to know their new housemates, a boozy lingerie party for the men and poolside lap-dancing for the women help break the ice.

Episodes.Title: Playing with Fire
Episodes.Description: Emotions boil over when the women see their significant others getting affectionate with the tempters and the men learn what's said behind their backs.

Episodes.Title: Getting Steamy
Episodes.Description: Mark gives the group a tough assignment. As new couples connect, boundaries are crossed and bonfire night delivers some harsh realities.

Episodes.Title: Temptation Haven
Episodes.Description: The Temptation Haven tents open — and they're a popular destination because no cameras are allowed. One of the women makes a major announcement.

Episodes.Title: Guessing Games
Episodes.Description: The mood shifts in the women's villa and a familiar face helps lift spirits. Bonfire night turns out to be a humbling experience for several men.

Episodes.Title: Mixed Messages
Episodes.Description: A video sends shock waves across the island. The men and women must decide if they'll take Mark's offer. Some of the tempters are sent home.

Episodes.Title: Trust the Process
Episodes.Description: Mark meets with the participants to look at candid footage and review lessons learned before their final overnight dates.

Episodes.Title: Beginning of the End
Episodes.Description: Tears, hugs and goodbyes fill the villas as the remaining tempters are sent home. The new and old couples prepare for the final bonfire.

Episodes.Title: The Final Bonfire
Episodes.Description: Mark moderates a tense and emotional reunion between the men and women. Will they decide to go home together, separate or leave with their new love?

Entries.Title: 911: Did The Killer Call?
Entries.Description: Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they’re innocent — but for the police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case. Find out which of them is the real killer in disguise.

Episodes.Title: Suspect #1
Episodes.Description: After a woman's murder, her ex calls 911, but police mark him a suspect.

Episodes.Title: Clues to Murder
Episodes.Description: A woman falls to her death in the Rockies, her husband calls 911. The police must find out whether her death was really an accident or was she pushed. And a three-year-old is found dead in a river. Her father calls 911, he becomes the prime suspect.

Episodes.Title: Reactions to Murder
Episodes.Description: A mother brutally murdered in her home, the husband and his bizarre alter ego are in the frame after calling 911; a woman is found dead in a creek after a road accident, her husband calls 911 in a panic.

Episodes.Title: Fooled by Murder
Episodes.Description: A wife wakes to find her husband dead outside in the snow, she calls 911; when the police discover a volatile history, suspicions are aroused; a man calls police after both his parents are shot dead in their home.

Episodes.Title: Suspect on the Line
Episodes.Description: After a man's savage murder at home, his wife is in the frame after calling 911, but the truth is more macabre than anyone dared believe. Also, a husband finds his wife with shots to the head. He claims it was suicide-the police have their doubts.

Episodes.Title: Lover Or Liar
Episodes.Description: A wife is killed while calling 911 and her husband is shot in the leg; he claims it was an intruder, but the police have their doubts.

Entries.Title: Sweethearts
Entries.Description: Follow the lives of six teenage couples in Charleston, South Carolina, as they navigate the end of high school and their final summer together as a couple, before heading off to college.

Episodes.Title: The Countdown Begins
Episodes.Description: During the final semester of their senior year, five high school couples grapple with the realities of becoming adults and how it impacts their relationships. Carissa plans a surprise 18th birthday party for her work-a-holic boyfriend, Brian, while Allison struggles to integrate into her boyfriend Will's social circle. Meanwhile, the rest of the Sweethearts plan for their upcoming Senior Prom.

Episodes.Title: Senior Prom
Episodes.Description: It's almost time for senior prom, a night that each of our couples has been dreaming of. Brian faces the scrutiny of Carissa's watchful father. Meanwhile as one couple is nominated for Prom King & Queen, another is uncertain whether or not they'll be able to attend the dance at all. Also, a potential new romance begins to brew between two longtime friends.

Episodes.Title: Spring Break
Episodes.Description: Reeling from their prom night disappointment, Allison and Will R spend Spring Break apart. Meanwhile, tempers flare between Jenica and Will T on vacation in Florida. Meanwhile back in Charleston, Makhi tip-toes around his romantic feelings for his longtime friend, Kat.

Episodes.Title: College Admission
Episodes.Description: College Decision Day has arrived, and while one couple dreads a 7 hour separation, another faces long distance with seeming confidence. Meanwhile, as one boyfriend wrestles with the decision to attend the same college as his demanding girlfriend, frustrations brew amongst other pairs when their partners procrastinate.

Episodes.Title: State Championship
Episodes.Description: In the lead up to a State Championship and final exams, senioritis takes its toll on the Sweethearts. As some couples are brought closer together by change, conflicting dreams threaten to push others apart. Meanwhile, it's almost time for Kat and Makhi's long awaited first date!

Episodes.Title: Graduation
Episodes.Description: The time has come for the Sweethearts to turn their tassels, but can relationships survive if one partner doesn't actually graduate? Meanwhile, Quinn and Miranda examine the unexpected consequences of attending the same college, and Kat is unsure where things stand in her budding romance with Makhi.

Episodes.Title: First Anniversaries
Episodes.Description: Reeling from unfortunate news, can an anniversary celebration bring one couple solace? Meanwhile, resentment rises in two relationships as girlfriends hold their partners to higher expectations. Later, when Quinn and Miranda embark on a summer bucket list, his dad throws a wrench into their plans.

Episodes.Title: Independence Day
Episodes.Description: As the Sweethearts celebrate Independence Day, Elle and Justin struggle to free themselves from her overbearing, parents' demands. Meanwhile Will T makes a gesture towards reconciling with Jenica, as their romantic evening under a fireworks turns into another fight.

Episodes.Title: Senior Trip
Episodes.Description: Ready for one last hurrah, the Sweethearts plan a Senior Trip! While fun in the sun finds some couples relishing their final moments as Sweethearts, others are overwhelmed by the togetherness. Communication issues abound as the reality of imminent separation sets in.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Beginning
Episodes.Description: As summer comes to a close, the Sweethearts say goodbye to their lives they knew. Despite degree of distance between schools, past assumptions, or even promises, each pair now recons with the pros and cons of staying together in a whole new light, knowing this decision will change everything.

Entries.Title: Capturing Their Killer: The Girls on the High Bridge
Entries.Description: In the bucolic town of Delphi, Indiana, 13-year-old Abigail Williams and 14-year-old Liberty German set out for a walk on a warm February afternoon in 2017 - and never came home. Their bodies were discovered the next day in a wooded area not far from the trail, setting off a five-year-long search that gripped the nation and haunted this close-knit community.

Episodes.Title: Missing in Delphi
Episodes.Description: Two teenagers disappear in small town Delphi, Indiana, and the hunt for a killer begins.

Episodes.Title: Evil Among Us
Episodes.Description: One of Delphi’s own is accused of the horrific murder of two young girls and the search for truth begins.

Episodes.Title: A Killer in Focus
Episodes.Description: As Richard Allen’s trial draws near, his attorneys launch a shocking defense.

Entries.Title: Visionaries
Entries.Description: Keanu Reeves and Gard Hollinger are kindred souls with a bond built on a love of motorcycles and an insatiable curiosity about the world around them. In 2011, they founded ARCH Motorcycle to reimagine what a motorcycle could be. To them, ARCH is a mindset, a lens through which to see the world. This is a journey of curiosity, to understand where human creativity comes from and to shine a light on the visionaries who are pushing the bounds of innovation and changing our world.

Episodes.Title: The Mind of Tim Ellis, Inspiration on Mars
Episodes.Description: On their journey to understand where human creativity comes from, Keanu and Gard meet aerospace pioneer Tim Ellis. The founder of Relativity Space, Tim's innovative thinking just might help humans to colonize Mars. He reveals the revolutionary technology he has developed to print 3D rockets, and brings Keanu and Gard inside the control room to witness a launch.

Episodes.Title: The Mind of James Turrell, Inspiration in Light
Episodes.Description: Keanu and Gard get the adventure they're seeking on a trip into the Arizona desert to visit famed artist James Turrell's magnum opus: the Roden Crater. They are offered unprecedented access to this mysterious work, exploring the tunnels and chambers that Turrell has spent more than 40 years creating. The experience offers deep insight into the use of light and space, and how we as humans perceive the world all around us.

Episodes.Title: The Mind of Omar Bailey, Inspiration from The Game
Episodes.Description: Keau and Gard visit Omar Bailey in his FCTRY LAb studio to understand how he innovates footwear design. Omar has designed and created sneakers for everyone from NLE Choppa to Miami Dolphin Jalen Ramsey. Today, Omar and the guys are dreaming up an ARCH motorcycle boot.

Episodes.Title: The Mind of Igor Akrapovic, Inspiration from Sound
Episodes.Description: As Keanu and Gard continue the search for the answer to where human creativity comes from, they travel to Ljubljana, Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Akrapovič is an elite exhaust manufacturer who is the stuff of MotoGP legend. Now, he is also the man responsible for working on the exhaust system for ARCH's new motorcycle project.

Episodes.Title: The Mind of Paige Bradley, Inspiration through Fire
Episodes.Description: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art in order to create something new. Paige reveals her centuries-old process working with bronze and fire to craft her work at the foundry. She visits ARCH to showcase her process, sculpting a piece inspired by the feeling of riding a motorcycle.

Episodes.Title: The Mind of Mattie Rodrigue, Oceanic Inspiration
Episodes.Description: In their pursuit of discovering the origins of human creativity, Keanu and Gard meet with Mattie Rodrigue. Mattie is the lead of scientific research on a vessel called the OceanXplorer, a ship funded by director James Cameron and billionaire Ray Dalio that contains the world's most high-tech oceanic research equipment. Mattie's work reveals how the natural world can inspire everything we do.

Episodes.Title: The Mind of Kjetil Thorsen, Inspiration in Nature
Episodes.Description: In Keanu and Gard's search for inspiration they discover one of the most creative and prolific architects on Earth: Kjetil Thorsen. As the founder of Snohetta, Kjetil pushes the limits of art and architecture with projects like the world's largest underwater restaurant and an opera house that plunges into the sea. Both are just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to Snohetta's design and imagination.

Episodes.Title: The Arch Journey, When Inspiration Strikes, Lessons Learned, Curiously Curious
Episodes.Description:
« Previous Ep.

The ARCH journey is all about curiosity - attempting to understand how inspiration strikes. On a journey around the world, Keanu and Gard met with visionaries who offered insight into that question, revealing lessons about human creativity. Along the way, they collected innovative tools created by mavericks that will now be revealed at ARCH HQ.

Entries.Title: Chao Tales
Entries.Description: Sonic, alongside an arrogant Shadow Chao, experiences all sorts of antics in Chao Tales: a new short series about a year in the life of the Chao Garden and all its residents!

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: While on a springtime run, Sonic stumbles upon a Chao Garden with a problem: they've got a Chao Egg that won't hatch, and a bossy Shadow Chao intends to get the new baby Chao out, one way or another!

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: It's chow time in the Chao Garden! Sonic is helping the Chao get a bite to eat until the resident trickster, a Shadow Chao, decides to make trouble...

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: It's a special day for the Chao; a whole bunch of little animals have come to visit! It's time for the Chao to pick our their favorite traits and transform. But when the Shadow Chao gets a bit too greedy, they run the risk of becoming something terrifying...

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: To beat the heat, the Chao are dancing and making music with Sonic in the shade. The Shadow Chao wants to crash the party, but even their shenanigans can't stop this jam session!

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: When all the Chao in the garden decide to run a race, the Shadow Chao confidently blazes in. Will pride be enough to fuel their path to victory? Can Sonic help them learn a little humility?

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: As the leaves start to change, the Shadow Chao is busy training, and they've gained a fan. Will the Shadow Chao push them away, or finally begin to soften up?

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: As winter closes in on the garden, the evil Dr. Eggman attacks, determined to level the Chao's precious forest for lumber. But Sonic is ready for him... or at least he thinks he is.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The battle against Dr. Eggman isn't going well. Will Sonic and his Chao friends be able to turn the tables on the doctor and save the forest?

Entries.Title: Dayan
Entries.Description: Dayan is a gripping story of a girl fighting for justice after enduring a series of injustices. It follows Nihaal, a young woman whose life is shattered by a tragic turn of events. The events that follow shake Nihaal to her core, drastically altering her personality. This leads Nihaal to embark on a journey to bring those responsible for ruining her life to justice.

Entries.Title: Esports World Cup: Level Up
Entries.Description: Esports World Cup: Level Up follows the most ambitious Esports tournament ever staged—1,500 players, 22 titles, $60 million on the line. From rising prodigies to battle-tested legends, the race for the first-ever Club Championship unfolds in Riyadh. Just because something doesn’t have a history… doesn’t mean it can’t be historic.

Episodes.Title: Level Up 101
Episodes.Description: The $60m tournament kicks off in Riyadh with Team Falcons' new Warzone trio ready to dominate. Leading the charge is Soka, a fierce competitor from the streets of San Mateo, CA, facing off against old rivals and former teammates at Fnatic.

Episodes.Title: Level Up 102
Episodes.Description: Team Liquid's League of Legend team must face the Esports GOAT, Faker. Then, Liquid must trust in a 17-year-old prodigy named Sanford, who isn't just fighting for a title in Mobile Legends Bang Bang, he's fighting for his family's future.

Episodes.Title: It Means More
Episodes.Description: NAVI and Vitality face defining moments in their Club Championship quests. For NAVI, CS2 is a mission of national pride, with a grand final against G2 and ex-prodigy M0nesy symbolizing hope. Vitality falters in CS2 but finds purpose through its dominant MLBB women’s team, as sisters Cinny and Chel fight through grief and pressure, turning their run into a powerful statement for women in esports.

Episodes.Title: From Out of Nowhere
Episodes.Description: The tournament heats up as the finale nears. In Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, FaZe battles archrival OpTic Gaming, with Alaskan newcomer Drazah paving the way. In EA FC, Team Liquid pushes to catch Team Falcons while a total unknown arrives in Riyadh from a remote island to make a stunning run and shake up the race for the Esports World Cup.

Episodes.Title: Finish Line
Episodes.Description: In the EWC finale, 22 games lead to a $7M prize. Vitality and Team Liquid battle across two titles: R1 Sim Racing and StarCraft II. Vitality fights to stay ahead in R1 against Max Verstappen’s Team Redline. The final showdown is in StarCraft, where Liquid’s rising star Clem takes on Vitality’s veteran Maru. With $4 million for second, every match is high-stakes in this epic esports showdown.

Entries.Title: Love Hotel
Entries.Description: Real Housewives stars Shannon Beador, Gizelle Bryant, Ashley Darby, and Luann de Lesseps visit Los Cabos' Grand Velas Hotel to find love among eligible bachelors.

Episodes.Title: Putting the Wives Back in Housewives
Episodes.Description: The ladies mix and mingle with a dating pool of successful suitors and must pick only one for their first date.

Episodes.Title: Three's a Crowd
Episodes.Description: As the Housewives get to know their new partners, things get tense when suitors Mark and Gerry both pursue Luann.

Episodes.Title: Romance In Retrograde
Episodes.Description: A new group of suitors pine for the Housewives' attention; triggers and tensions shine a light on old wounds for Shannon and Earl; Gizelle continues to vet her suitors. Ashley tries to break old patterns.

Episodes.Title: Wreck It, Ralph?
Episodes.Description: A series of adventurous dates get everyone's blood flowing; Ashley takes a plunge with Wale, but can't get her mind off of another man; after Shannon argues with Earl, she pivots to take a ride with Adam; James and Luann's connection deepens.

Episodes.Title: Guess Who's Back
Episodes.Description: Ashley makes an unexpected choice during elimination that changes her dynamic with Ralph and Wale; Shannon surprises Earl with a meaningful gift that brings him to tears; Luann gets her heart stolen; Gizelle pays the price for keeping her guard up.

Episodes.Title: The Love Boat
Episodes.Description: Shannon's patience with Earl's behavior runs thin; Luann isn't quite ready to go all in with James; the ladies are overjoyed when their BFF's all arrive at the hotel; the suitors are then put through the ultimate BFF test.

Episodes.Title: The Spa Before the Storm
Episodes.Description: With only a few days left before checkout time, the Housewives' romantic connections are put to the test; Gizelle is surprised by new discoveries about Phil but is undeniably intrigued by Theo; Wale puts the pressure on Ashley.

Episodes.Title: Check Out Time
Episodes.Description: The Housewives prepare to make a final decision; Shannon and Earl's issues boil over in front of the entire hotel; Luann contemplates a long-distance relationship with James; Ashley is forced to choose between Wale and Ralph once and for all.

Entries.Title: Chef Grudge Match
Entries.Description: Host Laila Ali challenges chefs to settle their disputes in a single round, head-to-head culinary battle. The food world is filled with bold chefs with egos as big as their resumes, employees who have been wronged by their boss, restaurateurs defending their livelihoods from copycats, and owners whose staff walked out during busy dinner shifts. They all come here to call each other out, put their favorite knives on the line, and bury the hatchet. The winners walk out with $10,000 cash, a prized knife from the losing chef's knife roll and bragging rights for life!

Episodes.Title: Crosstown Double Cross
Episodes.Description: Laila Ali hosts as four former colleagues battle it out. Gabe Bertaccini settles a 15-year grudge against Tyler Romine, who left his restaurant with only three days' notice. Then, Taylor Frankel battles Maria Busato for opening a rival catering company.

Episodes.Title: Friendly Fire
Episodes.Description: Laila Ali invites four friends to settle their grievances; Joe Sasto calls out his friend Richie Farina for continually one-upping him in the romance department; Damaris Phillips battles her business partner Coby Ming over a fried chicken recipe

Episodes.Title: So Sous Me
Episodes.Description: Laila Ali hosts as two sous chefs look to settle grudges that have been festering for years. Round one sees one of the most physical battles in Grudge Match history as Chef Brian Goodman claims that Chef Jonathon Sawyer's James Beard Award actually belongs to him. Then, in round two, Chef De’Unaka Haley is out to show Chef Niema DiGrazia that she needs to trust her and modernize or lose her customers. When the final bell rings, judges Jet Tila and Eric Adjepong decide who walks out of the arena with $10,000 in cash, their opponents most cherished knife, and the last word in the age-old battle of student versus master

Episodes.Title: Battle of the Bros
Episodes.Description: Laila Ali welcomes four culinary bros to duke it out in the kitchen. In the first match, reality star Johnny Bananas won't shut up about lasting longer than fellow TV competitor Mark Long on Worst Cooks in America, and with the help of legendary chefs Maneet Chauhan and Stephanie Izard, the two go head-to-head making a fine dining dish. In the second match, classically trained chef Michael Hung calls out self-taught chef and restaurateur Chris Oh for bad-mouthing him around LA. Judges Jet Tila and Tiffani Faison make the call on which bro is the better chef

Episodes.Title: Tame the Troublemaker
Episodes.Description: Laila Ali invites four chefs to resolve fiery recipe rivalries in explosive back-to-back battles. First, longtime Cuban chef Mika Leon squares off against competing Miami influencer chef Brad Delgado, accusing him of stealing her recipes and copying her content to surpass her online superiority. Then, witness an epic showdown between baller burger chefs Tommy Jobst and area newcomer Chris Lombardi to decide, once and for all, who builds the absolute best burgers in the college town of Davis, California. With $10,000 on the line and customer counts at stake, judges Jet Tila and Claudette Zepeda decide which chefs will walk away victorious

Episodes.Title: Clash of Culinary Couples
Episodes.Description: Laila Ali invites married couples to her arena, where some are battling together, and others are battling it out. In the first match, Los Angeles restaurant owners Michael and Kwini Reed challenge their friends and rivals, Lucy and Bret Thompson, after they showed them up at a prestigious event. Then, Executive Chef Tia Raiford challenges her husband, cookbook author and "CheFarmer" Matthew Raiford, to see who gets top billing in their home kitchen. In the end, judges Jet Tila and Stephanie Izard decide who walks out with a $10,000 cash prize, a special knife from the losing chef's knife roll, and bragging rights for life!

Episodes.Title: Honest Mistake or Foul Play?
Episodes.Description: Laila Ali welcomes four feuding chefs who had their well laid plans ruined by their careless partners. In the first round, accomplished New York restaurateur Adam Sobel seeks to publicly humiliate Boston-based chef Matt Jennings for "accidentally" ruining Adam's dish at a contentious football tailgate event. In the second round, Chef Marjorie Meek-Bradley calls out elite competitor Chef Mei Lin for allowing Mei's pet pooch to befoul her chef coat before an event and sets out to prove that Mei Lin isn't above the law in a coastal seafood battle. Judges Jet Tila and Maneet Chauhan decide which chef achieves redemption, not to mention $10,000 and their opponent's favorite chef knife

Entries.Title: American Prince: JFK Jr.
Entries.Description: Traces John F. Kennedy Jr.’s early years marked by his father’s assassination, through his decision to create George, a new kind of political magazine, and the love story he shared with Carolyn Bessette.

Episodes.Title: The Boy Who Would Be King
Episodes.Description: John F. Kennedy Jr.'s plans for his future begin to take shape as he launches a political magazine.

Episodes.Title: Ladies & Gentlemen, Meet George
Episodes.Description: George magazine is launched as his romantic life becomes the target of relentless media attention.

Episodes.Title: The Final Summer
Episodes.Description: As tensions rise at the magazine, the world is suddenly stunned as JFK Jr.’s life is cut tragically short.

Entries.Title: Stadium Lockup
Entries.Description: Follows the security team at the Cleveland Browns' stadium during game day, with more than 500 CCTV cameras monitored in real time, capturing large-scale brawls, lifesaving resuscitations, and heartfelt reunions with missing children.

Episodes.Title: Code of Conduct
Episodes.Description: The security team breaks up several brawls over unruly behavior and seat disputes.

Episodes.Title: Only in Cleveland
Episodes.Description: The security team stays on high alert over a potential influencer interference.

Episodes.Title: Bitter Rivals
Episodes.Description: Tensions are at an all-time high between these rivaling fans when a fight quickly erupts requiring multiple personnel to break it up.

Episodes.Title: Boiling Points
Episodes.Description: The security team is on high alert during scorching temperatures in Cleveland and fans tailgating in the heat hours before kickoff.

Episodes.Title: Frost and Furious
Episodes.Description: In this episode, a winter storm descends upon the stadium covering everything in snow, which intensifies the night by pushing the security teams to their limits.

Episodes.Title: Battle of Ohio
Episodes.Description: In this episode, tensions rise as officers respond to urgent calls including preventing intoxicated individuals from entering the stadium, tracking down a man in the stadium wanted on a warrant, enforcing their zero tolerance smoking policy, and reviewing CCTV footage of a woman claiming that a man behind her was touching her without her consent.

Episodes.Title: Zero Tolerance
Episodes.Description: In this episode, the security team escorts defiant smokers from the stadium while on high alert to ensure that the Kelce and Mahomes families go unbothered in their suites. The team also reviews CCTV footage of two incidents to see whether or not a woman flashed some patrons in one of the stadium's clubs and to determine who actually threw the first punch in a dispute between a loyal fan in his forties and a teenage boy.

Episodes.Title: Lost and Loaded
Episodes.Description: In this episode, the security team handles a range of incidents--from ejecting fans for vaping and breaking up a large scuffle in the stands, to investigating the concerning disappearance of a young man whose worried parents and girlfriend report him missing.

Episodes.Title: Out with a Bang!
Episodes.Description: In this episode, the security team helps a family deal with a loved one who is in a precarious emotional state, ejects some very hostile fans, and reunites a lost little boy with his parents after his mom suffers a sudden seizure in the concourse. And just as the game ends, an unexpected threat emerges when a suspicious package near the suites prompts a call to the bomb squad.

Episodes.Title: Preseason Problems
Episodes.Description: Protecting the stadium are highly trained men and women from law enforcement, private security teams and medics; new members of the team blend with seasoned veterans as the staff faces multiple challenges

Entries.Title: Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out
Entries.Description: In Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out, hosted by Brian Malarkey, four chefs each start with $25,000 and face off in a high-stakes cooking competition where strategy is just as important as skill. Along the way, they can spend their cash to gain advantages—or sabotage their rivals. From stolen ingredients to destroyed utensils and wasted time, no tactic is too ruthless. In the end, only one chef will outcook and outsmart the rest to keep whatever money they have left.

Episodes.Title: Carry-On Sabotage
Episodes.Description: The chefs have 30 minutes to make in-flight dinners using plastic utensils. Their only heat sources are coffee pots and two shared convection ovens.

Episodes.Title: Freezer Burned
Episodes.Description: Brian Malarkey challenges the chefs to create a hearty French entrée and side in 45 minutes, but the pantry is frozen.  With access to only one oven, the competitors must defrost their creativity to serve up something spectacular for judge Aarti Sequeira.

Episodes.Title: Gas Station Romance
Episodes.Description: Host Brian Malarkey asks the chefs to make fancy romantic dinners in 30 minutes with only convenience store ingredients and no ovens, fryers, or stoves. Judge Scott Conant picks the chef who manages to create the most deliciously romantic meal.

Episodes.Title: Unhappy Campers
Episodes.Description: Brian Malarkey's annual camping trip is underway, and he gives the chefs 30 minutes to whip up a duo of juicy and stacked sliders fit for a campsite feast. Unfortunately, Brian packed the car with everything but slider ingredients! Plus, it's raining, so there's no campfire to cook on, just single-burner camp stoves and minimalist camp cooking tools. Judge Maneet Chauhan selects the tastiest pair of sliders.

Episodes.Title: "I've Never Cooked Cow Tongue"
Episodes.Description: Brian Malarkey is hosting his monthly meeting of the Meat Lovers' League, and the chefs have 30 minutes to create a protein-forward masterpiece. The competitors first face "The Board of Impossible Ingredients," a carnival-style game that determines their exotic and challenging protein choice. Then, once shopping starts, they find no salt in the pantry, only snacks and other foods that must be harvested for their flavor. Judge Scott Conant decides which chef made the best meat-loving meal.

Episodes.Title: A Spoonful of Sabotage
Episodes.Description: Brian Malarkey challenges the chefs to craft the perfect sweet and savory entrée in 30 minutes, but the pantry holds only savory ingredients—not a sweet ingredient in sight. After the shop, Brian unveils a conveyor belt that will spit out four baskets of devilishly sweet ingredients. Judge Aarti Sequeira decides who makes the most balanced dish.

Episodes.Title: Science of Sabotage
Episodes.Description: The chefs make a hearty, high-end dinner in 45 minutes for a construction crew using only the crew's lunches, bent pans, and construction tools.

Episodes.Title: Doomsday Kitchen
Episodes.Description: The chefs have 30 minutes to create their dream last meal using only ingredients like frozen or dried meats, dehydrated veggies, and canned food.

Episodes.Title: Sabotage at Sea
Episodes.Description: The chefs attempt to make a refined Italian dish with limited ingredients before creating an elevated dish fit for the captain's table on a yacht.

Entries.Title: The Dark Money Game
Entries.Description: Discover the shadowy world of political donations and fundraising 15 years after the Supreme Court's decision in the Citizen’s United case, which enabled unlimited spending by hidden sources on many political campaigns.

Episodes.Title: Ohio Confidential
Episodes.Description: When a powerful political lobbyist is found shot to death, his apparent suicide highlights a bizarre turn in Ohio's largest public corruption case accidentally uncovered by federal investigators that was nearly concealed by loose super PAC campaign financing rules.

Episodes.Title: Wealth of the Wicked
Episodes.Description: Trace the tangled history of campaign finance back to the creation of the Federal Election Commission (FEC) in 1975, the 2002 McCain-Feingold Campaign Finance Reform Bill, and the Citizens United decision of 2010 that has molded the shape and opacity of present-day super PACs which now flood the system with money.

Entries.Title: Thrust: Surviving Acting School
Entries.Description: Thrust is a web series that gives the world a behind-the-scenes into college BFA programs and everything zany, absurd, and straight-up wild about it. Through the eyes and experiences of the new freshman class, learn what it's like to major in acting at a university, and follow our eight lovable thespians-to-be as they navigate the assignments, acting techniques, relationships, and of course, the school play.

Episodes.Title: A Stage That Extends
Episodes.Description: The students face the beginning of the school year while simultaneously experiencing their first college party.

Episodes.Title: To Push Forward
Episodes.Description: The students must face their school auditions while some of the group gets kidnapped.

Episodes.Title: To Introduce
Episodes.Description: The weekly assignment for the students is to find a random stranger on the street to impersonate.

Episodes.Title: A Principal Concern
Episodes.Description: After discovering the local blood drive improves the students' acting abilities, they become ravenous to discover the formula to success.

Episodes.Title: A Verbal Attack
Episodes.Description: When their adjunct director mentions a legendary acting professor that will help with their play's mishaps, finding the ancient teacher becomes the only option.

Episodes.Title: To Push Suddenly
Episodes.Description: Opening night is upon the students and tensions are high for Clark.

Entries.Title: Cringy Romance
Entries.Description: Clumsy when it comes to romance, four friends are ready to make fools of themselves to protect their love.
