Entries.Title: Relative Secrets
Entries.Description: From serial-killer parents to long-buried family secrets, award-winning actress Jane Seymour and archaeologist Natasha Billson explore the remarkable mysteries and dark legacies that haunt ordinary families.

Episodes.Title: Car Family
Episodes.Description: The daughter of a serial killer desperately hopes her family's lineage offers redemption from her father's horrifying crimes. But when Jane and Natasha search for an ancestor, they discover a secret far worse than they could ever imagine.

Episodes.Title: A Century of Guilt
Episodes.Description: A 99-year-old World War II veteran believes his neglect led to his grandmother's disappearance--or worse, her murder. Hoping to allay his fears, Jane and Natasha dig into the past.

Episodes.Title: An Outlaw by Any Name
Episodes.Description: A Texas family confronts their scandalous past while seeking the truth about their father, rumored to have been born to a brothel worker. As Jane and Natasha investigate his paternity, they discover the truth might be far closer than it seems.

Episodes.Title: The Mother Who Vanished
Episodes.Description: Seventy years ago, a Philadelphia mother vanished, leaving three young children behind. With Jane and Natasha's help, they go in search of answers: Did their mother fake her death, or has she been living under a false identity all along?

Entries.Title: Botched Presents: Plastic Surgery Rewind
Entries.Description: The reality TV series follows nine celebrities and social media influencers through a journey at the “Rewind Retreat” as they decide whether to reverse previous plastic surgeries and return to a more natural look.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Rewind Retreat
Episodes.Description: Brielle is shocked at the side effects of getting filler dissolved in her face and her mother, Kim, throws caution to the wind when it comes to fixing her arms.

Episodes.Title: Know Thy-Selfie
Episodes.Description: The retreat guests are tested to see how willing they are to strip down in front of the cameras and Alan wrestles with the differing opinions on their butt.

Episodes.Title: Deflated Egos?
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Baby Got Back Problems?
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Parting Ways
Episodes.Description: Aubrey reacts to shocking news and Sophia examines the reasons she's holding on to her toxic ex.

Episodes.Title: Every Scar Tells a Story New
Episodes.Description: Dr. Spirit, PhD challenges the remaining Rewind Retreat guests to take the next steps in healing.

Episodes.Title: Suns Out Buns Out
Episodes.Description: The doctors question if Aubrey is mentally prepared for her rewind surgery.

Episodes.Title: Time to Heal
Episodes.Description: Michelle joins the group to take a deep dive on how this rewind experience has changed their lives.

Entries.Title: Not Her First Rodeo
Entries.Description: This six-part series takes viewers inside the fast-paced world of professional bull riding., following five remarkable women called the Elite Lady Bull Riders.

Episodes.Title: The Most Dangerous Sport on Dirt
Episodes.Description: Champion bull rider Jorden Halvorsen - joined by rookies and returning pros - begins a new season of her women's bull-riding league, with each cowgirl hoping this will be their year to win the championship buckle.

Episodes.Title: Seven Seconds Don't Pay the Bills
Episodes.Description: A new contender arrives for the Mabank, Texas, rodeo as Catalina struggles to rebound from injury, Renata faces a life-changing decision, and Jordan fights for the women to be taken seriously in the sport.

Episodes.Title: Legacy
Episodes.Description: Jordan's off to a hot start of the season while Cat confronts childhood ghosts, Renata decides if she's staying with the league, and a female bull-riding legend shows up to watch the Elite Lady Bull Riders compete in Colorado.

Episodes.Title: The Name of the Game Is Pain
Episodes.Description: Jordan recruits young riders in Florida, giving their all to the dangerous sport, and with an eye on Rookie of the Year, Alexia hopes to stay uninjured as she practices at home in North Carolina.

Episodes.Title: Broken Dreams and Bodies
Episodes.Description: With the Championship days away, a rider suffers a devastating season-ending injury, while another deals with tragedy outside the arena.

Episodes.Title: Eight Seconds of Championship Buckle
Episodes.Description: After a thrilling season, who will hang on long enough to win the coveted championship buckle for the Elite Lady Bull Riders?

Entries.Title: WWE Raw Top 10
Entries.Description: Monday Night Raw hosts some of the biggest and best matches in WWE history, featuring Superstars John Cena, Triple H, Becky Lynch and more

Episodes.Title: Raw's Top 10 World Championship Matches
Episodes.Description: WWE's top Superstars, including Seth Rollins, Triple H and The Undertaker, compete in classic showdowns for the World Heavyweight Championship.

Episodes.Title: Raw's Top 10 Women's Championship Matches
Episodes.Description: Iconic Superstars square off inside the Raw ring to earn the right to call themselves the WWE Women's Champion.

Episodes.Title: Raw's Top 10 Intercontinental Championship Matches 4
Episodes.Description: The Intercontinental Championship is on the line in these iconic showdowns featuring CM Punk, Gunther and Roman Reigns

Episodes.Title: Raw's Top 10 Cage Matches
Episodes.Description: WWE Superstars like John Cena, The Rock and Cody Rhodes step inside a steel cage to settle their rivalries once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Raw's Top 10 Tag Team Matches
Episodes.Description: Tag teams like DX, The New Day and The Judgment Day go all out on Monday nights in these classic tag team showdowns on Raw.

Entries.Title: Castle Impossible
Entries.Description: With passion, determination and grit, Daphne and Ian will confront budget constraints, battle bug infestations, hunt for rumored hidden treasure and tackle a seemingly endless list of projects head-on to breathe new life into the historic estate and preserve her grandfather's legacy.

Episodes.Title: Sleeping Beauties: The Tower Bedroom
Episodes.Description: Daphne and Ian take on their first renovation in the chateau: transforming the bell tower into a luxury bedroom suite. With the tower in a dilapidated state, rotten roof beams and a windstorm could turn the project into a catastrophe.

Episodes.Title: Beauty and the Feast: The Fairytale Kitchen
Episodes.Description: Daphne and Ian aim to transform a 300-year-old outbuilding into a luxury home, and the kitchen needs a major overhaul. Daphne looks to create an open plan space, but when the kitchen cabinets are canceled, the project may be doomed before it even begins.

Episodes.Title: Prints Charming: The Enchanted Bathroom
Episodes.Description: After completing their new bedroom in the Bell Tower, Daphne and Ian look to create a much needed bathroom. Now, the couple decides to take on a water-damaged room, with no existing plumbing, and turn it into a bathing chamber worthy of royalty.

Episodes.Title: Happy Ever Afters: The Secret Wedding Salon
Episodes.Description: Daphne and Ian plan to build on the existing wedding business her grandfather started, and the restoration of the castle depends on their bookings. Now, they hope to gain an edge by creating an impressive office and cozy sitting room to host clients.

Episodes.Title: Princess and the Zzzzs: The Hunters Lodge Bedroom
Episodes.Description: Daphne and Ian take on the Hunters Lodge, a cottage that her grandfather used as his home. Their plan is to create a bright and luxurious bedroom suite not just for themselves, but an enticing space for brides and grooms to occupy on their wedding night.

Episodes.Title: A Fairytale Mending: The Enchanted Castle Workshop
Episodes.Description: To continue their builds for ongoing chateau renovations, Daphne and Ian realize they need a dedicated workspace; they aim to transform one of the 28 horse stables into a workshop, but piled high with rubbish, it can be a big and costly renovation.

Episodes.Title: Rafunzel: The Castle Playroom
Episodes.Description: The chateau is the ultimate playground on 150 acres with a moat, dungeons and endless rooms, but it's not exactly kid friendly; Daphne and Ian set out to make over the existing playroom fit for the little princes and princesses who visit the castle.

Episodes.Title: Dreamland: The Bedroom Fit for a King
Episodes.Description: Daphne and Ian look to reinstate one of the original chateau bedrooms that once hosted real Kings and Queens of France.

Entries.Description: Sobha’s friend Meena visits her home, but things take a turn when Sobha’s son Vidhaan falls for her. Will love bloom or will relationships get in the way?

Entries.Title: Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit
Entries.Description: In 1995, rising TV news anchor Jodi Huisentruit disappeared from her Iowa apartment just before dawn, leaving behind signs of a violent abduction. Her case quickly became one of the nation’s most haunting unsolved mysteries. Now, 30 years later, “Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit” follows a major break that reenergized the case.

Episodes.Title: Stolen from the Spotlight
Episodes.Description: A beloved TV news anchor vanishes, and suspicion turns to a brand-new person of interest.

Episodes.Title: Lurking in the Shadows
Episodes.Description: A sketch and a new tip in Jodi's abduction lead police in a new direction in the case.

Episodes.Title: Bodies in the Woods
Episodes.Description: A cadaver dog search for Jodi unfolds as a serial killer becomes a new person of interest.

Entries.Title: Guys Next Door
Entries.Description: It’s mind-bending meta-metaphysical mayhem meets a soulful comedic meditation on the zeitgeist —where secret agents, techno-future-post-pre-humanistic science, and modern-day existential angst collide and create a new future for us -- and you!

Episodes.Title: Pilot

Entries.Title: Happy Endings with Bruno
Entries.Description: RuPaul’s Drag Race Pit Crew member and long-time masseur Bruno Alcantara lays down special guests on his table for a full body massage interwoven with intimate and emotional conversations which answer the question: "What does my Happy Ending look like?" Combining the soothing elements of massage ASMR with thoughtful and often vulnerable interviews, and a rare glimpse into the personal journeys of its guests.

Episodes.Title: Kyle Krieger
Episodes.Description: Kylie is a creator who stars, directs and produces high end adult films but is struggling with the stigma around promoting his work. Bruno helps Kyle navigate the internalized shame around his profession and guides him to practice self compassion. Because how you speak to yourself, shapes your reality.

Episodes.Title: Nick Lemmer
Episodes.Description: Nick (aka Lazy Suzan) is best known for being a Pit Crew dancer on RuPaul's Drag Race Live in Las Vegas. After a traumatizing experience, Nick shares about his new outlook on life. Bruno discovers how Nick cultivates joy and why he is proud of his queerness.

Episodes.Title: Sebastian 'Dino' Gonzalez
Episodes.Description: Sebastian is a fellow Pit Crew dancer who is used to a strict schedule. Therefore he experiences anxiety when his schedule is not busy and forgets to set aside time for his personal life. Bruno guides Sebastian through the struggle of not allowing himself to feel he has earned time to relax. A process that begins with celebrating each small victory.

Episodes.Title: Brandon Kyle Goodman
Episodes.Description: Brandon is an actor, writer and host of the podcast, Tell Me Something Messy. They are 15 years estranged from their mother who took issue with their sexual orientation. Bruno explores the journey that Brandon took through therapy and self reflection to finally believe they are a good person. That perfection is a social construct, and how they embraced their 'messy.'

Episodes.Title: Siam PhuSri
Episodes.Description: Hi Siam! Sawasdee Kha! Before making it onto Drag Race Thailand, Siam was a buddhist monk. Bruno learns how this experience helped to shape the slaysian diva we know today. Beauty is not forever, but being your most authentic self will last you a lifetime.

Episodes.Title: Kameron Michaels
Episodes.Description: Kameron lived much of his life saying, 'fake it until you make it.' But what do you do after you actually make it? Bruno learns how Kameron navigated their inner saboteur on RuPaul's Drag Race season 10.

Entries.Title: LEGO Masters Jr.
Entries.Description: Kids team up with stars like Ravi Patel and Jordin Sparks to create amazing Lego builds. Expert judges evaluate their work as they compete for $50,000, a trophy, and the Lego Masters Jr. crown.

Episodes.Title: Disney Train Ride
Episodes.Description: Young LEGO enthusiasts team up with celebrity guest starts like Andy Richter, Ravi V. Patel, Porsha Williams, Jordin Sparks and Alison Sweeney to make Disney-themed Lego creations.

Episodes.Title: Celebrity Stunt Doubles
Episodes.Description: Teams build Lego stunt doubles of their celebrity teammates and a vehicle for them to ride in a major action movie stunt.

Episodes.Title: Harry Potter
Episodes.Description: Teams are challenged with making LEGO reproductions of magical buildings from the "Harry Potter" franchise of books and movies.

Episodes.Title: Ninjago
Episodes.Description: Each team is tasked with building an incredible dragon; the winning team is revealed.

Entries.Title: Sherri Papini: Caught in the Lie
Entries.Description: Sherri Papini, who faked her own kidnapping, breaks her silence, revisiting the lies, secrets, and shocking fallout of a hoax that captivated the nation.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 1: Exodus
Episodes.Description: Sherri Papini, who faked her own kidnapping, breaks her silence, revisiting the lies, secrets, and shocking fallout of a hoax that captivated the nation.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 2: I'm a Liar
Episodes.Description: The wife and mother at the center of one of the most sensational kidnapping cases ever speaks for the first time about the circumstances that led to her mysterious disappearance, why she lied to the FBI, and what the media got wrong about her story.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 3: Multiple Truths
Episodes.Description: A convicted liar, Sherri enters prison with a target on her back. After release, troubling details of her childhood and, later, her marriage to Keith are revealed, and her inability to recall details of her story leads to an on-camera break.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 4: It's Complicated
Episodes.Description: Sherri Papini gains infamy for lying to the FBI, but the public perceives her based on a one-sided narrative. Papini pleads guilty and goes to prison for lying about her abduction, but her side of the story has never been told - until now.

Entries.Title: Spice Frontier
Entries.Description: Centuries after the destruction of Earth, Kentucky Williams and his cyborg companion, C-LA, lead the crew of the Serrano on an intergalactic, flavor-driven adventure to hunt down the last remaining Earth spices. But they too are being hunted by a ghost from C-LA's past.

Episodes.Title: Escape from Veltegar
Episodes.Description: The Serrano crew’s excursion to Veltegar goes awry when they’re chased by a giant space lobster and crash land on the desert planet. While Eloy repairs the ship, Kent, Ada, and Nexus seek the lost Human settlement they came to find. Trouble arises when they’re attacked by a tidal wave of carnivorous scarabs. These are smart bugs, and even C-LA will need a hand if they’re to survive. Meanwhile, Ada continues her search alone. What she discovers would put a smile on the face of any flavor aficionado. But something unexpected finds her—something that will mark the beginning of a whole new adventure.

Entries.Title: The Trouble With Tessa
Entries.Description: When disgraced documentarian Tessa Fowler rents a rural house to escape the big city, they unearth a box of old tapes - one seemingly capturing a murder. They set out to unravel the dark secrets buried in this perfect town's past.

Episodes.Title: Part One: Tessa
Episodes.Description: After relocating to a picture-perfect rural town, disgraced documentarian Tessa Fowler unearths a box of old tapes—one seemingly capturing a murder—and sets out to unravel the dark secrets buried in the town’s past.

Episodes.Title: Part Two: Lowery
Episodes.Description: Tessa learns about a former tenant of their rental home who went missing and then finds an unlikely ally.

Episodes.Title: Part Three: The Bone King
Episodes.Description: Tessa comes clean about why they ran to away to Lowery, agrees to meet Freddy before curfew, and faces new threats as the strange walls of Lowery begin to close in.

Episodes.Title: Part Four: Heir
Episodes.Description: Tessa returns to find that someone has taken the tapes. As strange noises rise from the basement, a surprise visit from Betsy changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Part Five: Alone
Episodes.Description: Tessa’s risky decision to recover stolen property leads to them getting trapped in a place not meant to be found—or escaped.

Episodes.Title: Part Six: Troubles
Episodes.Description: Tessa finally learns the truth they’ve been chasing all along—one that changes everything they thought they knew about Amelia’s fate.

Entries.Title: Survival Mode
Entries.Description: Across nine episodes, the series chronicles some of the most recent devastating disasters - including the Maui wildfires, the Amtrak 501 derailment, Superstorm Sandy, and the sinking of the Costa Concordia - through firsthand accounts from survivors and rare archival footage.

Episodes.Title: Joplin Tornado
Episodes.Description: When a monstrous tornado strikes Joplin, Missouri, families and strangers alike are thrown into a desperate fight for survival in the deadliest U.S. twister in over 60 years.

Episodes.Title: Maui Wildfires
Episodes.Description: As flames overtake Lahaina, terrified residents and tourists flee to the ocean in a desperate attempt to survive Hawaii's deadliest wildfire.

Episodes.Title: Hurricane Ian
Episodes.Description: As Hurricane Ian devastates Fort Myers Beach, three groups of residents who chose to stay face the deadliest storm to hit Florida in generations and endure harrowing consequences.

Episodes.Title: The Derailment of Amtrak 501
Episodes.Description: When a speeding train derails on its inaugural run, passengers are thrust into chaos and forced to find the will to survive amid one of the most shocking rail disasters in recent memory.

Episodes.Title: Montecito Mudslide
Episodes.Description: In the dark of night, Montecito, California, residents must outrun a deadly wall of mud triggered by torrential rains after a major wildfire, as homes vanish and lives hang in the balance.

Episodes.Title: Fort Worth Pileup
Episodes.Description: A brutal winter freeze turns a Texas highway into a deadly trap, where drivers and first responders fight to survive a massive, fast-moving pileup.

Episodes.Title: Kentucky Floods
Episodes.Description: When unprecedented floods rip through eastern Kentucky, families are forced to cling to rooftops and trees in a frantic effort to escape the raging waters.

Episodes.Title: Superstorm Sandy
Episodes.Description: As Superstorm Sandy crashes into the East Coast, a city braces for chaos and ordinary people find extraordinary courage as they face unprecedented threats from wind, fire and flood.

Episodes.Title: The Sinking of Costa Concordia
Episodes.Description: A luxury cruise turns into a nightmare as passengers scramble to escape a sinking ship in one of the most shocking maritime disasters of the 21st century.

Entries.Title: Running with the Wolves
Entries.Description: Follows daytime television icons Mark Consuelos and Kelly Ripa as they dive headfirst into the high-stakes world of Italian football—not as spectators, but as team owners. Set in the heart of southern Italy, Running with the Wolves chronicles the couple’s bold journey as owners of Campobasso FC, a gritty Serie C soccer club known as the “Lupi” (Italian for “Wolves”). Since taking the reins in 2022, Consuelos and Ripa have helped breathe new life into the once-struggling team and reignited passion among the club’s loyal fanbase.

Episodes.Title: Leading the Pack
Episodes.Description: Mark and Kelly prepare for their third season as Italian soccer club owners. Mark faces crucial roster decisions as Campobasso must sign and cut players before their first game of the season.

Episodes.Title: Home Games
Episodes.Description: Kelly travels to Campobasso for the first time as she and Mark explore buying a home in Italy. Mark begins to have doubts about the team’s head coach as they prepare for an epic rivalry match.

Episodes.Title: The Time Is Now
Episodes.Description: Mark must make a tough decision after a prolonged losing streak finds Campobasso’s head coach on the hot seat.

Episodes.Title: The Wolves Den
Episodes.Description: Campobasso fans protest the team as the Wolves battle to avoid relegation. Mark and Kelly travel to Italy for the final game of the season.

Entries.Title: The Kouncil
Entries.Description: Katie Florence is picking up the pieces after a crushing breakup. Living alone for the first time, she relies on her personified inner council to guide her through the chaos of adulthood. Logic pushes for rational decisions, Heart longs for love, Anxiety anticipates every possible disaster and Lady Parts has her own agenda. As Katie navigates friendships, romance, career setbacks and self-worth, she constantly battles between doing what she wants and what she needs. With humor, vulnerability and occasional self-sabotage, Katie learns that growing up means accepting every part of herself -- even the messy ones.

Episodes.Title: Big Girls…Consult Their Council
Episodes.Description: Katie, newly single, relies on her inner voices to steer her through a fresh start.

Episodes.Title: Why Do Fools Fall in Limerence
Episodes.Description: Encouraged by her inner voices, Katie jumps back into dating — with mixed results.

Episodes.Title: The Nice Guy, the A**hole, the Anxiously Attached
Episodes.Description: Katie meets Seth, a charming bartender, and the council debates whether he’s trouble or not.

Episodes.Title: The Death of a Hopeless Romantic
Episodes.Description: After another disappointment, Katie takes a no-strings-attached approach to dating.

Episodes.Title: Unwell, Unemployed, Unworthy?
Episodes.Description: Feeling stuck at work and in love, Katie reaches a boiling point and lashes out at Alanna.

Episodes.Title: Confidence Becomes Her
Episodes.Description: After Heart’s return, Katie reevaluates her choices and moves towards a long overdue reunion.

Entries.Title: The Flip Off
Entries.Description: America's most famous flipping exes Tarek El Moussa and Christina Haack reunite in a head-to-head competition to determine who's the ultimate flipper!

Episodes.Title: The Breakup
Episodes.Description: To kick off the competition, Tarek, Heather and Christina have one week to find a flip and battle it out over the kitchen. With their personal and professional pride on the line, they're taking big risks in hopes of being crowned the number one flipper.

Episodes.Title: Bending the Rules
Episodes.Description: Tarek and Heather compete against his ex Christina to find out who can out-flip the other in a main suite battle! As Tarek's plan to outspend and design Christina ramps up, Christina decides that it's time to play dirty.

Episodes.Title: Making a Deal With the Ex
Episodes.Description: Tarek and Heather compete against his ex Christina to find out who can out-flip the other in the living room! Unexpected issues force Tarek and Heather to try and strike a deal with Christina, but she always has a trick up her sleeve.

Episodes.Title: The Ex Factor
Episodes.Description: Tarek and Heather compete against his ex Christina to find out who can design the best guest bedroom and bathroom! An unexpected discovery shocks both teams, and Christina shocks everyone by inviting her second ex-husband Ant Anstead as a judge.

Episodes.Title: Old Friends, New Enemies
Episodes.Description: Tarek and Heather compete against his ex Christina to find out who has the best remaining miscellaneous spaces! With their exteriors remaining, both teams try to pull back the spending and make smarter design choices on this final interior challenge.

Episodes.Title: The Final Flip Off
Episodes.Description: It's time for the final tally as both teams race to finish their exteriors! Flipping star Jeff Lewis judges the final battle before the houses hit the market. And as the offers pour in, the team with the highest return will be crowned The Flip Off winner!

Entries.Title: Dictator - The Hitler Interviews
Entries.Description: What made him possible? His friends, his classmates, his co-workers, his admirers, his enablers. Many Nazis, several war criminals, few to trust. A series of unique and deeply disturbing interviews with some of Hitler's closest associates.

Episodes.Title: Populist
Episodes.Description: Today we know Adolf Hitler as the epitome of evil. But it wasn't always like that. There was a time when people worshipped him, went to war for him, and were willing to die for him. For the first time, we see Hitler from a different perspective. Through his friends, admirers, and supporters, new light is shed on who he was and how he wielded his power.

Entries.Title: The Serial Killer's Apprentice
Entries.Description: The documentary explores the story of Elmer Wayne Henley Jr., an accomplice to the infamous Houston serial killer, Dean Corll, also known as "The Candyman Killer." The program features an in-depth, never-before-seen interview with Henley, who speaks for the first time in over 50 years about his involvement in the murders. It examines the psychological dynamic between a predator and a vulnerable teenager and how Henley was groomed to become an accomplice in one of the worst serial murder cases in U.S. history.

Episodes.Title: Premier
Episodes.Description: The program features an in-depth, never-before-seen interview with Elmer Wayne Henley Jr., who, for the first time in over 50 years, speaks about his role as an accomplice to Dean Corll, the infamous "Candyman Killer." The documentary explores how Henley, as a teenager, was groomed and manipulated by Corll and delves into the events that ultimately led Henley to end Corll's killing spree.

Entries.Title: Hunting History with Steven Rinella
Entries.Description: Join world-renowned outdoorsman and author Steven Rinella as he dives into history’s greatest and most perplexing wilderness mysteries. With his deep knowledge of the wild, survival expertise, and unyielding curiosity and grit, Steve is uniquely positioned to look at these mysteries through a totally new lens, examining how people’s interactions with their environment may rewrite the narrative on some of our most iconic legends.

Episodes.Title: The Final Hunt for D.B. Cooper
Episodes.Description: In this thrilling exploration of the D.B. Cooper mystery, Steve takes to the skies and ventures into the heart of the Cascade Mountain range. Using his unique skill set to investigate one of the most audacious heists in US history, Steve explores D.B. Cooper through a new lens, asking not who D.B Cooper was, but how he could have survived and escaped his perilous jump into a dark and stormy November night. Testing his survival strategies and wilderness knowledge against the same rugged terrain that Cooper faced, Steve challenges everything we thought we knew about the infamous 1971 skyjacking.

Episodes.Title: The Alaska Triangle
Episodes.Description: Steve investigates the 1972 disappearance of the Begich/Boggs flight, a case that sparked the largest search in Alaska's history.

Episodes.Title: Unexplained Cattle Mutilations
Episodes.Description: Steve journeys to Oregon's remote ranches to investigate the mystery of cattle mutilations; drawing on his understanding of the natural...

Episodes.Title: The Lost Colony of Roanoke
Episodes.Description: Steve delves into the mystery of the Lost Colony of Roanoke, navigating North Carolina's dense wilderness and swampy waterways. Combining historical research with his wilderness expertise, he investigates the colonists' possible fate and survival strategies, uncovering the challenges they faced in their search for a safe haven.

Episodes.Title: The Holy Grail of Shipwrecks
Episodes.Description: Returning to his Michigan roots, Steve investigates the mystery of Le Griffon, the legendary lost ship of the Great Lakes that has fascinated him since childhood. Using his local knowledge and maritime expertise, he navigates shipwrecks, historical clues, and intriguing claims to piece together this 17th-century puzzle.

Episodes.Title: First Humans of North America
Episodes.Description: Near Steve’s cabin on Prince of Wales Island lies evidence of one of humanity’s greatest milestones–our arrival in the Americas. Drawing on his deep expertise in this rugged environment, Steve investigates when the first Americans arrived and how they might have navigated and survived in this harsh, untamed landscape long before modern tools.

Episodes.Title: The Donner Party
Episodes.Description: Steve retraces the perilous journey of the Donner Party through the unforgiving Sierra Nevada Mountains, where 19th-century pioneers were trapped by brutal winter storms. Rather than focusing solely on the tragedy, Steve faces the snow-covered terrain to explore the survival tactics, difficult choices, and sheer human endurance required to navigate one of America’s most infamous ordeals.

Episodes.Title: Lost American Civilization
Episodes.Description: Steve explores the arid deserts of the Four Corners region, investigating monumental ancestral Puebloan sites like Chaco Canyon and Mesa Verde. Shifting the focus from why these societies were abandoned to how they thrived, Steve examines the innovative survival strategies that sustained North America’s most complex indigenous culture for thousands of years in one of the continent’s harshest environments.

Episodes.Title: Black Out

Episodes.Title: Hacked

Episodes.Title: Firewall

Episodes.Title: Code of Deceit
Episodes.Description: Tootie is being hunted by The Betters; Kevin uncovers the sinister truth behind Pastor Murdock, a seemingly benevolent figure whose dark side threatens the very fabric of their community; as tensions rise, Pastor Murdock commits an unspeakable act.

Episodes.Title: Hidden in Plain Sight
Episodes.Description: In a thrilling confrontation between good and evil, The Gang rallies together to expose the nefarious Betters; torn between family and integrity, Hudson threatens to bring Murdock down with him to protect the community from the Betters' plans.

Episodes.Title: Conspiracy Nexus
Episodes.Description: The truth behind the Betters Organization is finally laid bare; as tensions rise, The Gang finds themselves in grave danger; as they delve deeper into conspiracy, the lines between ally and enemy blur, leaving everyone questioning their reality.

Entries.Title: Duck Dynasty: The Revival

With their dynasty expanding into more than just ducks, Willie and Korie will bring their signature humor and family fun as they grapple with mapping out the future of Duck Commander, watching the kids navigate marriage, children and businesses of their own, and passing down the family legacy.

Episodes.Title: The Robertsons Are Back
Episodes.Description: In this new series eight years after Duck Dynasty, the world has changed on Willie Robertson. His kids are grown, he’s a grandpa, and the Duck Commander warehouse has become the hub for multiple family businesses. Even so, Willie announces his retirement from Duck Commander, launching a quest to pass his legacy to the next generation. Also, the family welcomes the newest Robertson.

Episodes.Title: Granddaddy Day Care
Episodes.Description: Newly fully semi-retired, Willie turns his attention to bolstering the Robertson legacy amongst his grandkids, attempting to babysit all seven of them at once. Uncle Si tries to pitch Korie his eccentric ideas. Willie's sons-in-law enter into a battle on the pickleball court.

Episodes.Title: Si-Squatch
Episodes.Description: Si convinces Korie to make a movie about his Bigfoot sighting, but Willie wants more proof; once Willie discovers there could be some money in finding a Bigfoot, he takes matters into his own hands; Sadie finds out life-changing news.

Episodes.Title: Vintage Willie
Episodes.Description: Willie is on a mission to pass down his hard-earned wisdom, starting with helping his son-in-law Jacob grow his vintage clothing business. As Uncle Si’s iced-tea cups overrun Duck Commander, John Luke works at creative ways to get rid of them.

Episodes.Title: Chicken Chaos
Episodes.Description: When Korie and the kids convince Willie to build a chicken coop on their property, he leaves Uncle Si to supervise. Christian puts his foot in his mouth to his pregnant wife Sadie and pays a price for it. Willie takes Zane on a hunt for his first deer.

Episodes.Title: Country Stars and Squirrels
Episodes.Description: Willie tries to convince his son Will to move back home to Louisiana and he enlists the help of a Country Music celebrity friend. Bella entrusts John Luke to fill in as a museum birthday tour guide, and chaos quickly ensues when Uncle Si shows up.

Episodes.Title: Alone in the Woods
Episodes.Description: Always on the hunt to make his kids "more Robertson," Willie concocts a wild idea to put his daughters' outdoor skills to the ultimate test, in the woods by themselves.

Episodes.Title: Ducks Got Talent?

Episodes.Title: Si’s Unfortunate Advice
Episodes.Description: Looking to bolster his presence in the museum, Uncle Si tries to get the company to craft a talking fortune telling machine with his likeness. Sadie and Christian try their hand at matchmaking.

Episodes.Title: Shoot My Shot, Or Not
Episodes.Description: On a speaking trip to Puerto Rico, Willie scrambles to plan a last-minute anniversary surprise for Korie, settling on an unusual hunt. Meanwhile, the kids raid Willie and Korie’s house while they’re out of town. Then, Sadie’s gender reveal goes haywire.

Entries.Title: Hazardous History with Henry Winkler
Entries.Description: Hosted by the iconic Henry Winkler, each 60-minute episode of this nostalgia-drenched series tells the stories of the things we did—for fun, for money, or out of plain boredom—that you can’t do anymore. Pastimes, practices, and products that were once allowed—even encouraged—which you will never see again in modern America.

Episodes.Title: Perilous Play
Episodes.Description: Remember when childhood came with a side of danger? Think back to the outrageous toys and daredevil playground antics that once defined growing up; we uncover explosive science kits, high-flying kite tubes and more.

Episodes.Title: Spectacular Stunts
Episodes.Description: Buckle up as we take you on a wild journey into the world of vintage daredevils who risked it all for a rush. From the enigmatic Human Fly to skateboard speed demons and diving horses, these stunts were as reckless as they were unforgettable.

Episodes.Title: Mad Medicine
Episodes.Description: Ever taken medical advice from a cigarette commercial? There was a time when any and all "cures" could be sold to the public indiscriminately.

Episodes.Title: Very Extreme Sports
Episodes.Description: The modern concept of "extreme sports" is a product of marketing, but back in the old days, the rules (or lack thereof) of our nation's sports made them truly extreme.

Episodes.Title: Treacherous Travel
Episodes.Description: Exploding cars and blimp disasters to kids sent through the mail and doomed personal helicopters, the past is packed with jaw-dropping travel tales and the remarkable misfires that paved the road to modern transportation.

Episodes.Title: Food Fiascos
Episodes.Description: We uncover the incredible things people once ate without a second thought that can only mean one thing: you'll never look at your next bite the same way again.

Entries.Title: Settle Down
Entries.Description: Mason is an expert on queer relationships and a matchmaker with a booming success rate. When it comes to love, he knows all...except why his own relationship is on the rocks.

Episodes.Title: Putting in the Work
Episodes.Description: Mason sets a plan in motion to safeguard his marriage after Georgia gives him panic-inducing intel about Jarod. Mason is tasked with finding a suitable match for Patrick, an older gentleman interested in younger men.

Episodes.Title: Anxious-Avoidant
Episodes.Description: Ben isn't exactly thriving in his open relationship with his boyfriend Angelo. Mason's client Sandra tries to recover from a serious case of the "ick" after a not-so-steamy encounter with her new date.

Episodes.Title: First-Date Jitters
Episodes.Description: Mason plans a staycation with Jarod in a bid for some quality-time. At the office, Devon and Georgia struggle to get a closeted rap star to play nice with his celebrity match.

Episodes.Title: Love Bomb
Episodes.Description: New client Eddie tests Mason's personal boundaries. Ben tries to get over Angelo by fast-tracking a new relationship with Claude. Georgia and Devon tiptoe around a real awkward conversation about business and pleasure.

Episodes.Title: Dissonance
Episodes.Description: Mason and Jarod unleash years worth of pent-up resentment with the help of their new couple's therapist, Dr. Jolanta Zemaitis.

Episodes.Title: I've Got Butterflies!
Episodes.Description: Mason tries to keep himself together while he prepares for his big feature article with Plugged-In Magazine. Ben tries to kick his Angelo addiction once and for all. Georgia works up the courage to confront Devon about her feelings.

Entries.Title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
Entries.Description: From police officers to pastors, doctors to business leaders, they are the pillars of our communities. However, when power seduces and corrupts, it opens the door to evil, and some will stop at nothing, even murder, to protect themselves.

Episodes.Title: Bodies of Evidence
Episodes.Description: The vile truth behind an Olympic gymnastic doctor’s methods comes to light.

Episodes.Title: I Deserve to Live, They Don't
Episodes.Description: When a wealthy CEO’s colleague vanishes, the FBI uncovers a deadly plot.

Episodes.Title: Blood Badge
Episodes.Description: The real reason cops fail to solve a woman’s murder becomes brutally clear.

Episodes.Title: The Pain-Killer
Episodes.Description: When the medical board strikes off popular Arkansas pain doctor Randeep Mann amid allegations about his practice, they also uncover a monster; he stops at nothing to regain his practice, unleashing an explosive plot to regain power.

Episodes.Title: Without a Prayer
Episodes.Description: Pastor Schirmer wields power over his congregants, and when one takes their own life, investigators question the accidents that killed this minister's two wives, revealing a wolf in sheep's clothing.

Episodes.Title: I Am the Law
Episodes.Description: Sidney Dorsey is the first African American sheriff in DeKalb County, Ga.; after he wins on an anti-corruption ticket, revelations of him abusing the power of the office for money, sexual favors and deadly vengeance shock voters.

Entries.Title: Wildemount Wildlings
Entries.Description: Game Master Sam Riegel leads an unlikely band of angsty teen adventurers on a singular summer camp experience in Wildemount Wildlings, a three-part series set in Exandria’s premiere sleepaway camp for aspiring adventurers. Wilde Out!

Episodes.Title: Welcome, Campers!
Episodes.Description: It's the last day at Veth Brenatto's adventure camp, but with four campers lacking merit badges, Veth calls in a couple friends to teach some camp spirit...

Episodes.Title: Into the Wilde
Episodes.Description: Gub Gub the Flying Pig has kidnapped Beau and Yasha and it's up to the feckless OLGA cabin to rescue their counselors... all before curfew!

Episodes.Title: Wilde Out
Episodes.Description: Chaos reigns at camp! The OLGAs must summon their bravery as the danger heats up in their search for counselors Beau and Yasha!

Entries.Title: Scam Goddess
Entries.Description: As a hit podcaster, comedian Laci Mosley knows her way around a scam. Now, she's taking her expertise on the road, uncovering small-town swindles and big-city cons across the U.S.

Episodes.Title: The Horseplay Heist
Episodes.Description: Scam Goddess Laci Mosley digs into the story of Rita Crundwell, who stole $53 million from her town. Learning Rita used the money to fund her lavish equestrian lifestyle, Laci meets the whistleblower who finally reined in Rita's wild ride.

Episodes.Title: The Sideline Scammer
Episodes.Description: Scam Goddess Laci Mosley journeys to Miami to unravel a con targeting big names in sports. Financial advisor Peggy Fulford promised athletes like Dennis Rodman generational wealth but drained their accounts to fund her lavish lifestyle.

Episodes.Title: The Gig City Grift
Episodes.Description: Scam Goddess Laci Mosley is in Opelika, Alabama, to confront scammer Kyle Sandler, who portrayed himself as a tech guru who could make Silicon Valley dreams come true but left his clients with nothing but error 404s. Will Kyle admit the truth?

Episodes.Title: The Holy Hustle
Episodes.Description: Laci Mosley takes on New York City to expose Bishop Lamor Whitehead. Whitehead built a flashy Brooklyn congregation, streaming his sermons to the world. But as his faith grew, so did his taste for the finer things.

Episodes.Title: The Coin Conspiracy
Episodes.Description: Laci Mosley lands in Washington to uncover a years-long con at a private mint. Ross Hansen and Diane Erdmann promised golden returns, but greed tarnished their empire, leaving loyal investors shortchanged.

Episodes.Title: The Royal Racket
Episodes.Description: Laci Mosley arrives in Ohio to expose a royal con. Daryl Harrison convinced locals he was the prince of Ghana, with promises of riches. Laci dives into this princely deception and speaks with those who know him best.

Entries.Title: What Drives You with John Cena
Entries.Description: John Cena fuels his two biggest passions, cars and connecting with people, by spending time with today's most successful celebrities and talking about what drives them - on the road and in their hearts.

Episodes.Title: Logan Paul in Paradise
Episodes.Description: In Puerto Rico, John meets Logan Paul. They go for a drive in Logan's Ford Bronco, talk about career highs and lows, and end up at Logan's gym, where his brother, Jake Paul, is training for a fight.

Episodes.Title: Jelly Roll, Southern Gentleman
Episodes.Description: John visits country singer Jelly Roll in Nashville. They go for a drive in Jelly's RAM 1500 Laramie, and John learns about Jelly's life, from being a convict to his meteoric rise to stardom.

Episodes.Title: Travis Barker Drops a Beat
Episodes.Description: John meets up with drummer Travis Barker, who shows John his 1987 Buick GNX. After a drive in Travis' Mercedes Benz G-Wagon 4X42, the duo return to Travis' studio to collaborate on an original song.

Episodes.Title: The Miz and Mr. Cena
Episodes.Description: In Los Angeles, John visits his former WWE rival, The Miz. They hit the road in The Miz's Tesla Model X Plaid and talk about how The Miz went from cast member on The Real World to WWE superstar.

Entries.Title: Millionaire Murders
Entries.Description: True crime documentary series. In each episode, a UK or US murder case that collides the wealthiest people with the most fatal of crimes is examined, with either the killer or the victim living a life of luxury and wealth.

Episodes.Title: The Earl and the Playboy Model
Episodes.Description: When Anthony Ashley-Cooper disappeared in 2005, family feared that he had been kidnapped, but evidence confirmed that he had been murdered.

Episodes.Title: Death of a Dynasty
Episodes.Description: Alex and Maggie Murdaugh lived a lavish lifestyle, at their sprawling country estate in Moselle. In 2011, that dynasty would begin to crumble.

Episodes.Title: Money Means Motive
Episodes.Description: David Tronnes meets Shanti Cooper online and moves to Orlando, purchasing a house in cash. In 2018, David finds Shanti unresponsive. It is clear this is not an accidental death.

Episodes.Title: Rags to Riches: The Missing Millionaire
Episodes.Description: Abraham Shakespeare won $30M in 2006 but faced leeches exploiting his generosity. Dee Dee Moore befriended him, gained control of his assets, and murdered him in 2009. A tragic tale of greed and betrayal.

Episodes.Title: The Reclusive Millionaire
Episodes.Description: When William Saunderson-Smith was found bludgeoned to death in 2011, police discovered cash stuffed in bags and sixty-seven different mobile phones.

Episodes.Title: Ninja Murders
Episodes.Description: The Billings were a wealthy couple - Byrd was an entrepreneur and Melanie was a stay-at-home mum, raising sixteen children. In 2009, intruders entered the home and shot both at close range.

Episodes.Title: Love, Lust and Loathing
Episodes.Description: Tallahassee, FLA-Mike Williams is working hard and making a lot of money, but was very happy. Then he goes missing after going duck hunting with his friend Brian, ahead of his wedding annive...

Episodes.Title: A Violent Night
Episodes.Description: Pensacola, FLA-2015. In a quiet neighborhood, a violent triple homicide happens. 2 brothers in their 40s and their mom are all found dead and covered with clothing. Collectively, they were w...

Episodes.Title: Supermodel in the Pool
Episodes.Description: Madagascar born Samira was a fashion model in Paris when she met American podiatrist Adam Frasch. In 2014, a handyman arriving at Samira's home in Tallahassee, Florida is horrified to find her dead in the home's swimming pool.

Episodes.Title: Self-Made and Murdered
Episodes.Description: In December 2000, Mike went out onto the lake and never returned. It was thought he drowned and was eaten by alligators. His wife and her new husband lived lavishly off his hefty insurance payout. Mike's mother knew something wasn't right.

Entries.Title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids
Entries.Description: In a television first, Chief Eric Winstrom allows a film crew to capture the entire operation of the Grand Rapids Police Department. From twisted high-stakes homicide investigations to adrenaline-fueled patrol stories, nothing is off limits.

Episodes.Title: Fight Club
Episodes.Description: After the murder of 15-year-old Milli Penn, Grand Rapids detectives investigate the masked shooter, rumored to be another teenager linked to a fight club. Then, another shooting strikes and detectives must solve the case before more lives are lost.

Episodes.Title: Party Bus
Episodes.Description: After a gunfight on a party bus, Detective Katie Roszkowski — leading her first homicide case — must figure out how a brawl escalated to homicide.

Episodes.Title: No Excuse
Episodes.Description: Grand Rapids detectives investigate a victim with a history of domestic complaints. The shooter claims self-defense, but her actions raise doubts.

Episodes.Title: Cemetery
Episodes.Description: A jail informant tips off Grand Rapids detectives to an accidental overdose that looks suspiciously like murder.

Episodes.Title: The Twins
Episodes.Description: Twin brothers claim a deadly gunfight outside a bar is self-defense, but for one victim, detectives believe otherwise. Can they prove it was murder?

Episodes.Title: The Girl on the Scooter
Episodes.Description: A stray bullet kills 15-year-old La’kijah Williams

Episodes.Title: Patrol
Episodes.Description: Cameras follow the Grand Rapids police on patrol

Episodes.Title: Tethered
Episodes.Description: Aspiring rapper, Michael Munson is found shot

Entries.Title: Solo Traveling with Tracee Ellis Ross
Entries.Description: Tracee Ellis Ross is packing her bags and inviting audiences to join her solo trips to Morocco, Mexico, and Spain to experience the joy of solo travel.

Episodes.Title: Morocco
Episodes.Description: Tracee Ellis Ross is excited to go somewhere she's never been before: Marrakech, Morocco. Tracee falls in love with the colors of the "Red City" which includes her hotel, the iconic Royal Mansour. During her time shopping in the Medina, Tracee makes new friends and learns about the Berber tribe and their crafts. Later, she goes to Sahbi Sahbi to eat "Moroccan cuisine by empowered women." Finally, Tracee spends her last dinner under the stars in the Agafay Desert.

Episodes.Title: Mexico
Episodes.Description: Tracee Ellis Ross is heading to the Rosewood Mayakoba in Mexico to unwind, unplug, and recharge—with her big hat and a bag full of bikinis! After Tracee orders the interactive "Colibri" cocktail at Zapote Bar, she is inspired to take a cocktail making class. A "former amateur tennis player," Tracee comes out of "retirement" to train with a local tennis pro. But it's not all fun in the sun when it's pouring rain… So, Tracee checks out the wellness offerings and gets a "massage for the brain."

Episodes.Title: Spain
Episodes.Description: Tracee Ellis Ross has always wanted to go to Spain, a culture known for its food, taking it slow, and a flair for the dramatic. She has "meticulously and ridiculously" packed for the perfect solo trip—including some truly epic outfits! Unfortunately, things don't go to plan… After days of being sick, Tracee is finally unleashed on the streets of Marbella, where she takes in the natural beauty of Andalusia, becomes a connoisseur of specialty Spanish olive oils, and indulges in one memorable meal.

Entries.Title: Rishton Ka Chakravyuh
Entries.Description: In a city where power and deceit rule, one woman’s quiet life takes a drastic turn. Drawn into a dangerous game for survival, she reinvents herself in ways no one could imagine. What begins as desperation soon transforms into a battle for control, where every move could be her last.

Episodes.Title: The Call
Episodes.Description: A mysterious seductress sets fire to a fortune, igniting a story rooted in deception and sacrifice. Months earlier, Malti, a sheltered housewife, arrives in Mumbai to free her husband from prison.As she faces corruption and betrayal at every turn, her resolve sets her on a path she never imagined.

Episodes.Title: Menaka
Episodes.Description: Malti begins her transformation under the mentorship of a sharp and calculating woman from Mumbai’s underbelly.Thrown into unfamiliar territory, she faces uncomfortable tests and moral dilemmas that push her to the edge.Determined to save her husband, she slowly learns how power and seduction can become weapons.

Episodes.Title: Aakhri Daav
Episodes.Description: Malti's double life intensifies as she risks everything to infiltrate the world of ruthless tycoons, but one wrong move could cost her everything.

Episodes.Title: Aar Ya Paar
Episodes.Description: Balancing lies and survival, Mallika maneuvers deeper into the underworld’s power play, where trust is lethal and betrayal inevitable.

Episodes.Title: Chakravyuh
Episodes.Description: With evidence in hand, Mallika brings down empires, only to face the cruelest betrayal from the one she trusted most.

Episodes.Title: Ek Hasina Thi
Episodes.Description: Reborn through vengeance, Mallika turns predator in a final, audacious act that seals her triumph and her enemies’ destruction.

Entries.Title: Secrets of the Bunny Ranch
Entries.Description: Reveals how women drawn in by the promise of a better life through the glamourous world portrayed on Cathouse instead faced a hidden reality marked by bullying, humiliation, manipulation, sexual assault, and even murder.

Episodes.Title: Smoke & Mirrors
Episodes.Description: While life on the HBO series "Cathouse" was portrayed as one giant party, former sex workers say that behind the scenes, brothel life was anything but glamorous.

Episodes.Title: Here, Pretty Kitty
Episodes.Description: Millions of young girls watched "Cathouse" on TV, thinking that legal prostitution could be a shortcut to money and fame; new recruits quickly discovered that the reality is a world of manipulation, intimidation, abuse and debt bondage.

Episodes.Title: The Predator
Episodes.Description: In order to escape her abusive husband, a woman flees to the Bunny Ranch, thinking that legal brothels are safe; to her horror, her journey becomes even darker and more twisted than she could have imagined.

Episodes.Title: The Cathouse Murders
Episodes.Description: The world is shocked when a young Bunny Ranch brothel worker is brutally murdered in Oklahoma City; as police search for answers, brothel owner Dennis Hof sees a media opportunity.

Episodes.Title: The Lamar Odom Party
Episodes.Description: When a former LA Lakers star arrives at a Nevada brothel to get away from it all, what should have been a fun party turns into a drug-fueled nightmare for everyone involved.

Episodes.Title: Too Close to the Sun
Episodes.Description: Trying to stay in the spotlight, brothel owner Dennis Hof runs for political office; dark secrets threaten to destroy him and his legacy.

Entries.Title: The Warehouse Phase
Entries.Description: Malachi Moore, or Chi for short, is an overlooked musician who begrudgingly dives into the world of content creation and influencers after Nic P, an infamous rapper and influencer, dies unexpectedly. After being propelled into stardom Chi navigates his newfound audience, authentic self, friendships, and a rocky love life. Chi must learn to balance his love for music, his addiction to stardom, and his desperate search for a mysterious record executive all in the unapologetic pursuit of his ultimate goal; fame.

Episodes.Title: The Pilot Phase
Episodes.Description: After Nic P's death, Chi attends a memorial to seek out an elusive music exec for a record deal.

Episodes.Title: The Influencer Phase
Episodes.Description: Chi is invited to a content creator mansion and clashes with influencers while making a viral track.

Episodes.Title: The Dating Phase
Episodes.Description: Chi is invited to a content creator mansion and clashes with influencers while making a viral track.

Episodes.Title: The Yacht Phase
Episodes.Description: Chi takes Amelia as his date to an industry yacht party, where they learn about fame, love and life.

Episodes.Title: The Honeymoon Phase
Episodes.Description: Chi and Amelia go viral in a dance video together; Adi and Jordan's relationship is tested.

Episodes.Title: The Warehouse Phase
Episodes.Description: After going viral for "Teddy Bear," Chi and Pat secure a meeting with Jamie at Aisle Records.

Entries.Title: Kobe: The Making of a Legend
Entries.Description: Kobe: The Making of a Legend traces the story of Kobe Bryant from his childhood in Italy to his athletic superstardom and provides an intimate look at his post-NBA aspirations as a storyteller and as a father. Featuring personal interviews with Kobe's former coaches, teammates and family friends, this illuminating series reveals the conflicts and the complications behind the man with the Black Mamba mentality.

Episodes.Title: Part 1
Episodes.Description: Growing up in Italy, Kobe Bryant develops a passion for basketball under his father's influence; at 18, he moves to Los Angeles to join the Lakers, where he marries Vanessa Laine, straining family relationships.

Episodes.Title: Part 2
Episodes.Description: In 2003, Kobe's world is rocked by an allegation of sexual assault against a 19-year old hotel employee, drawing intense media scrutiny; in the aftermath, he channels his emotions into the Black Mamba alter ego.

Episodes.Title: Part 3
Episodes.Description: As the end of his basketball career looms, Kobe shifts focus to storytelling, mentoring and fatherhood; in 2020, the world is stunned by a tragic helicopter crash, which claims the lives of Kobe and his daughter, Gianna.

Entries.Title: Two Ways With Erica Mena
Entries.Description: The ladies and gents are in competition to win over the heart of Erica Mena!

Episodes.Title: Let the Love Games Begin!
Episodes.Description: A group of potential suitors arrive to meet Erica, in hope of becoming her one true love.

Episodes.Title: What’s Your Name?
Episodes.Description: Erica enlists her friend Bambi to help give her love prospects new names.

Episodes.Title: Mixer Mayhem
Episodes.Description: The men and women gather for a mixer where conflict and fights erupt immediately.

Episodes.Title: Pop That…
Episodes.Description: Erica holds a sex toy challenge which leads to a “love tap” gone crazy.

Episodes.Title: Date & Dates
Episodes.Description: Erica gets to know her potential mates during dates.

Episodes.Title: Gang Bang Bang
Episodes.Description: Bambi and Erica's best friend Cassie hold a “Kissing Gang Bang” challenge.

Episodes.Title: Ride the bull
Episodes.Description: Erica's love hopefuls participate in a bull riding challenge.

Episodes.Title: Hola Papi!
Episodes.Description: Erica's friend Prince comes to help her choose a potential mate.

Episodes.Title: Liar Liar
Episodes.Description: Erica's potential lovers are given the opportunity to tell the truth during a lie detector test.

Episodes.Title: Dance (My Clothes) Off
Episodes.Description: The Puerto Rican Princess Joseline Hernandez, is the special guest as Erica's remaining love hopefuls perform a sensual dance.

Episodes.Title: Final Four
Episodes.Description: Erica goes on individual dates with her Final Four contestants.

Episodes.Title: And Then There Were
Episodes.Description: Erica is down to her last two potential lovers and goes on a final date with each.

Entries.Title: Beer Budget Reno
Entries.Description: Kristen Coutts knows a thing or two about stretching a dollar, and she is using this valuable skill set on Beer Budget Reno. The new home renovation series premiering April 5 sees the self-taught DIYer pull from her own experiences to help others transform spaces. And doing it for those who may not be able to afford it otherwise. She’ll realize these visions through clever and cost-saving hacks.

Episodes.Title: No Booty in this Kitchen
Episodes.Description: Kristen meets Kira and Lev, whose kitchen in their recently purchased home is in dire straits. Its chaotic layout and dysfunctional storage would be a frustration for any family, but Lev is a chef! The couple has invested the bulk of their budget into becoming homeowners, so Kristen has a big challenge to bring this chef's family a five-star kitchen on a two-star budget. Kristen also helps couple Marcella and Ramiro reclaim their open concept living and dining rooms from being overrun by their toddlers' toys.

Episodes.Title: Plywood Palace
Episodes.Description: Long distance sweethearts, Meaghen and Jake, are about to start a new chapter together under one roof. Meaghen has done her best to DIY a temporary glow-up, but it's time to dig deeper to undo and re-do a decade's worth of baggage. They enlist Kristen to work some money-saving magic to make over their whole main floor, including the plywood-clad front facade that makes the house look like it's been condemned. Kristen needs to make sure that the couple's wish list isn't too big for the budget in an old house with scary surprises lurking behind its walls.

Episodes.Title: Nothing Ever Dries
Episodes.Description: Leanne and Dan have spent their lives caring for others, from their two daughters to their own aging parents. Now they're ready to invest in themselves by having Kristen renovate their two outdated and clunky bathrooms. But with no ventilation in either room, decades of moisture issues could eat up the budget. Kristen also helps an engaged couple give their dysfunctional kitchen a fast and frugal facelift in time to host guests for their wedding.

Episodes.Title: Multipurpose Mayhem
Episodes.Description: Megan, Joel and their two kids love the charm of their 120-year-old house. But the quirks of their family room have them at a loss for its layout. They need Kristen to get creative to make this workhorse space function for the family, and fix its fire hazards. Although they have a seemingly healthy budget for a single room reno, it could be eaten up fast by preserving the century home's features, and delivering a high-end wish list. Kristen also helps a single mom and her college-aged daughter overhaul their bedrooms to serve double duty for working and resting.

Episodes.Title: Project Sister Sister
Episodes.Description: Sisters Jaime and Alex live parallel lives, from back-to-back weddings, babies, and now home ownership just a few blocks apart. Their houses match in layout, but Jaime's is a fixer upper that's stuck in the 70s. She needs Kristen to bring her main floor into this century with some serious savings. Not to be left out, Jaime's sister, Alex's house is updated in style but lacking in function. She enlists Kristen to do a budget-friendly upgrade at her place, but each sister needs to roll up their sleeves to help the other's bottom line.

Episodes.Title: Labor of Love
Episodes.Description: Kristen is enlisted by her childhood friend, Melissa, to give her living space an overhaul. Melissa and her husband Steve are saving up for a home of their own by living with her parents--in the same basement digs where Melissa and Kristen had playdates. The primary bedroom, nursery, and living room need to feel like home in the meantime, and allow them some privacy from mum and dad. But with a shoestring budget and a baby on the way in just three weeks, this could be Kristen's biggest challenge yet. Kristen also helps desperate couple Tina and PJ take back their living room from their rambunctious son/doggie duo.

Episodes.Title: Bargain Basement
Episodes.Description: Katie and Andy have had their house turned upside down by parenthood. "Handy Andy" renovated nearly everything in time for their baby's arrival, but the basement has been left in limbo. They need Kristen to take over to stretch their limited budget to the max, and finish out the expansive basement in time for Katie to head back to work. Kristen's got her work cut out for her to give this family an entertainment space, a home office, and an in-law suite. Kristen is also inspired to take on a project at home to give her son's bedroom a mini makeover.

Episodes.Title: Grand Central Bathroom
Episodes.Description: Kristen works on a reno for Stefanie; a mom of four kids aged 9 to 20. After losing her husband to cancer, Stefanie hit a standstill with their home renovations. Their family bathroom is an absolute zoo!

Episodes.Title: A Water Closet Is Not for Clothes
Episodes.Description: Katherine and Justin love their new house, except for some disruptive quirks. Their big, awkward primary bath serves triple duty right off the kitchen as it houses the noisy laundry machines and makes it difficult to get down to business.

Episodes.Title: Ghosts of Renos Past
Episodes.Description: Vanathy and Joe's home is bursting at the seams. They're battling against an inefficient use of space on their second floor, with outdated organization.

Entries.Title: Bitchin' Rides: Road to the Ridler
Entries.Description: The pinnacle of the custom car world is the Don Ridler Award, given out every year at the Detroit Autorama. Dave Kindig has always had a Ridler-sized itch he needed to scratch, and has finally found the right client and idea to make it a reality.

Episodes.Title: Riddle Me This
Episodes.Description: Dave and the crew start the Ridler build by creating a fiberglass buck, which will then be transferred to aluminum, one of the most difficult metals to use in fabrication. But once they finish the buck, Dave realizes there may be a problem with the roof.

Episodes.Title: Aluminum, Aluminum and More Aluminum
Episodes.Description: The fabrication process begins, and the team begins to see how difficult building a car out of aluminum by hand will be. Each panel needs to be hand crafted to perfection, and some of the lines in Dave's drawings look virtually impossible to replicate.

Episodes.Title: Too Late to Turn Back Now
Episodes.Description: After almost a year of fabrication, the team starts assembling panels into the shape of a car. The chassis is also made of aluminum, and after a painstaking frame-design process, the two wild shapes are melded together for the first and last time.

Episodes.Title: Come Together, Right Now...
Episodes.Description: The team passes a huge milestone in the Ridler build, as the body and chassis are merged with mock-ups of the other major elements of the car. For the next major step, the body shop matches every panel, gaps the car seamlessly, and fixes any flaws.

Episodes.Title: One Chane for a First Impresson
Episodes.Description: Fabrication is done for the Ridler build, and the client is amazed by their progress. Dave agonizes over the color, since that's the first thing most people notice. The previous five winners were all yellow, but Dave decides to go in another direction.

Episodes.Title: Ready to Run
Episodes.Description: The Ridler car's engine and transmission are married for the last time and installed, and the team moves on to the wiring and other systems. As the car is prepped to fire up for the first time, a dent threatens to stop the whole build in its tracks.

Episodes.Title: Everything But
Episodes.Description: The team fires up the Ridler build for the first time, and surprisingly all goes according to plan. After they finish a seemingly endless list of details and appointments, the car is loaded and sent off to Detroit, where the Autorama's tech test awaits

Episodes.Title: Road to the Ridler
Episodes.Description: The Ridler build arrives at the Autorama, and at the initial drive test, Dave and Kev scramble to fix a transmission problem. The next day, the show opens to the public and the judging begins. It's also their first chance to size up the competition.

Entries.Title: Middlehood
Entries.Description: For Lisa Giordano Navarro, midlife is messy. At 50, she crashes head-on into a moment when the years she's lived meet the years she has left - and it scares her. So she blows up her life for a chance at a do-over.

Episodes.Title: The Drive
Episodes.Description: Lisa's maddening struggle to get Aldo and Ella into the car for the 5-hour drive to Marco's home in LA evokes old memories of a fraught family car trip. Back then it was her dad who kept secrets. Now? It's the whole Giordano clan.

Episodes.Title: The Confession
Episodes.Description: Trapped in the back seat of her parents' car, Lisa's mind replays the moments that shattered her marriage. Tano's encounter at the airport has him wondering if he could be a father. Marco bonds with one of his employees.

Episodes.Title: The Suitcase
Episodes.Description: Lisa makes a friend during a roadside coffee stop. Aldo's bigotry rears its racist head, while his memory visits a time when he was the hated "other." Marco and Tano prepare for what will inevitably be a fraught Giordano family Christmas.

Episodes.Title: The Fugue
Episodes.Description: Ella enters a German-speaking fugue state that has her in mid-1940s Germany, amidst a family dynamic even more tense than that of the Giordano's. Aldo is pulled over on the 210 freeway and comes dangerously close to being arrested.

Episodes.Title: The Date
Episodes.Description: Lisa ditches the family for a date with a guy she met at the airport. But she can't stop thinking about the first time she met Bill. It's almost as if he were there. Which, by the way, he IS when she comes home. The next morning.

Episodes.Title: The Surprise
Episodes.Description: Christmas morning at the Giordano house is rife with memories of - Christmas morning at the Giordano house. The other one. When they were kids.

Episodes.Title: The Secret
Episodes.Description: Tano flashes back to his breakup from Sarah and wonders if his life could have been different had he not had such a toxically masculine father. Christmas dinner blows up when Tano learns that Lisa's been keeping a secret.

Episodes.Title: The Decision
Episodes.Description: Another dysfunctional holiday behind her, Lisa struggles to figure out why she keeps sabotaging her life. Could it be tied to a misadventure she and her best friends had in high school? Something they never spoke of?

Entries.Title: Home is Where the Heart Is
Entries.Description: Luke Macfarlane follows families who invite him inside a once-glorious house that has either been inherited or holds special meaning to them but is long overdue for some TLC.

Episodes.Title: Empty Nesting
Episodes.Description: An empty nester asks Macfarlane and Westbrooks to update her childhood home, built by her late father, blending new life with family history.

Episodes.Title: Sister Act
Episodes.Description: Two sisters return to their childhood home to renovate it; they aim to transform the space into a new setting for memories, rooted in nostalgia.

Episodes.Title: Victorian Valentine
Episodes.Description: A young family purchases grandma's Victorian home; they face the challenge of updating the space for their growing family, without losing the sentimental treasures that make it unique.

Episodes.Title: Pop's Blessing
Episodes.Description: A couple inherits the wife's late father's home; Macfarlane and Westbrooks help create a space honoring his memory while adding a fresh perspective.

Episodes.Title: Lakehouse Love Letter
Episodes.Description: Macfarlane and Westbrooks renovate a lakeside home for three generations, aiming to please Grandma Honey and improve communication for deaf family members.

Episodes.Title: Porch Swing Living
Episodes.Description: A family seeks Luke Macfarlane and Olivia Westbrooks to create a multigenerational home on a budget, starting with the front porch.

Entries.Title: Star Trek: Khan
Entries.Description: The exciting expansion of the Star Trek universe will explore the dramatic untold events that unfolded in the desolate world of Ceti Alpha V after Captain Kirk left Khan and his followers stranded there, paving the way for the iconic clash in Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan.

Episodes.Description: Marooned by Captain James T. Kirk on Ceti Alpha V, Khan Noonien Singh and his followers begin building a new civilization, but this strange new world harbors a number of secrets.

Entries.Title: Bugs That Rule the World
Entries.Description: A four-part global investigation into insect declines, exploring their diversity and their critical roles on the planet. Scientists reveal the beauty of bugs, from pollinators to insect assassins to the tiny clean-up crews that purify the planet.

Episodes.Title: Insect Apocalypse?
Episodes.Description: Could a world without insects survive? Scientists investigate the global insect “apocalypse.”

Episodes.Title: The Lifegivers
Episodes.Description: Pollinators – bees, moths and butterflies – bring color to the world and put food on our plates.

Episodes.Title: Eat or be Eaten
Episodes.Description: The ruthless realm of some of the stealthiest and cleverest insects in the animal kingdom -- from praying mantises and aquatic insects to dragonflies.

Episodes.Title: Beetle Mania
Episodes.Description: As the world's most diverse and abundant species, the tiny yet mighty beetle plays crucial ecological roles in nearly every environment. Why are these colorful and ingenious creatures often regarded as "the most important species on the planet"?

Entries.Title: Onside: Major League Soccer
Entries.Description: Go beyond the pitch with unparalleled access to the players and personalities who power MLS. Electrifying moments and captivating stories made 2024 an unforgettable season—and gave us a glimpse of the future.

Episodes.Title: Back to Glory
Episodes.Description: Amid Messi Mania, Miami and the LA Galaxy gear up for a huge early-season test. Riqui Puig opens up about the pressure of superstar expectations.

Episodes.Title: Hell Is Real
Episodes.Description: Ohio's heated rivalry reignites. As kickoff nears, stars and managers discuss what's at stake, the will to compete, and leaving it all on the pitch.

Episodes.Title: Young Blood
Episodes.Description: Cavan Sullivan signs with Philly at age 14. The countdown is on for the homegrown phenom to make his debut as the youngest MLS player ever.

Episodes.Title: City Blues
Episodes.Description: Second-year club St. Louis CITY are under pressure to build a winning culture. A rematch against archrivals Sporting KC raises the stakes.

Episodes.Title: Kings of New York
Episodes.Description: Who runs NYC? A case is made in the Hudson River Derby's playoff debut. RBNY's rising star John Tolkin feels the heat of the spotlight.

Episodes.Title: The Window
Episodes.Description: Clubs go hunting for new talent in the summer transfer window, where deals get done—or fall apart—and stars arrive in the month-long frenzy.

Episodes.Title: The Big Decision
Episodes.Description: Atlanta United's long road back to title contention hits a tipping point. A Decision Day miracle sets up a Round One duel against Inter Miami and Messi.

Episodes.Title: Legacy
Episodes.Description: With Messi eliminated, it's anyone's MLS Cup. Riqui Puig's injury stuns the LA Galaxy as they get set to battle the New York Red Bulls for the title.

Entries.Title: Breaking4: Faith Kipyegon vs. the 4-Minute Mile
Entries.Description: What does it take to become the first woman to run a mile in under four minutes? Follow Faith Kipyegon, Olympic gold medalist and world record holder, as she prepares to push the limits of human potential and break a barrier previously thought impossible on June 26th in Paris.

Episodes.Title: Breaking4: Faith Kipyegon vs. the 4-Minute Mile (1)
Episodes.Description: What does it take to become the first woman to run a mile in under four minutes? Follow Faith Kipyegon, Olympic gold medalist and world record holder, as she prepares to push the limits of human potential and break a barrier previously thought impossible on June 26th in Paris.

Episodes.Title: Breaking4: Faith Kipyegon vs. the 4-Minute Mile-The Live Attempt
Episodes.Description: Live from Paris, watch Faith Kipyegon’s historic attempt to become the first woman to run a mile in under four minutes. Nearly 2,000 men have done it. No woman ever has. Follow the next chapter of the Breaking4 series with full live coverage of this monumental moment in sporting history.

Entries.Title: Caught in the Act: Double Life
Entries.Description: Armed with cutting-edge technology and covert surveillance, host Tamar Braxton and her elite team of specialists hack through deception, unearth hidden secrets, and unleash every tactic in their arsenal to catch double-lifers red-handed.

Episodes.Title: He's Selling Something And It Ain't Brownies
Episodes.Description: Tina's relationship is unraveling! Joque is distant, their spark is fading, and his behavior in bed has become intense. Desperate for answers, she turns to Tamar Braxton—only to uncover a shocking truth—Joque has been living a double life all along!

Episodes.Title: We Are Going to Bust That Buster
Episodes.Description: Taylor gave up everything for love to take care of Markie after his injury. But with bills piling up, zero intimacy, and his recovery at a standstill, something feels off. Is he hiding a double life?

Episodes.Title: Something in the Milk Ain't Clean!
Episodes.Description: After losing their parents, Sha became the guardian to her younger sisters, Tokyo and Ashayla. Now, Sha's recent unexplained distance has left her sisters feeling abandoned. What secrets is she hiding and could they tear the family apart forever?

Episodes.Title: Something Nefarious is Going On!
Episodes.Description: Quinton met his half-brother Teran as adults, forming an instant bond. However, Teran's behavior soon took a disturbing turn. Now, Quinton is left questioning: Is their brotherhood genuine, or is Teran hiding something sinister?

Episodes.Title: What Does She Do With The Marshmallows?
Episodes.Description: Tasha's wedding is at risk! Her maid of honor, Jess, has vanished from wedding plans, ignoring calls and skipping key events. Desperate for answers, Tasha turns to Tamar Braxton—only to uncover a shocking truth that could keep her from saying "I do!".

Episodes.Title: What I'm Not Going to Allow Is You Playing With Me!
Episodes.Description: Cindy took in her homeless friend, helped him rebuild his life, and fell in love. But now, Esteban is acting strange. Cindy's best friend Monique is convinced something's off—so they turn to Tamar to uncover the truth. Is he living a double life?

Episodes.Title: I Think We Need a Medic!
Episodes.Description: Charlotte knows something is off with her daughter, Chatarri—she's vanishing for hours, selling off her valuables, and growing more hostile by the day. Will Chatarri's secret double life tear their family apart forever?

Episodes.Title: I Gotta Go Palo Santos Myself
Episodes.Description: Brian's once warm and loving brother, Kimana, has suddenly turned cold, distant, and disturbingly submissive to his fiancée, Mila. With Tamar's help, a chilling secret about Mila's double life emerges from the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Everybody Calm the Eff Down!
Episodes.Description: Melo, Jamaal's personal trainer, has a shady past, but when he started dating Jamaal's close friend Allison, red flags started to fly. Fearing the worst, Jamaal turns to Tamar's team to find out if Melo's really changed—or just hiding a new hustle.

Episodes.Title: I Thought It Was My Wig Giving Me a Headache!
Episodes.Description: Naomi has it all—except a baby. Desperate for motherhood, she hired her friend Ash as a surrogate. But now, Ash is dodging her calls and only reaching out for money. Has Naomi's dream of motherhood become a nightmare?

Episodes.Title: Your Man Is Not Just A Man
Episodes.Description: After years of heartbreak, Gabe thinks he's found the one in Almond, his ex-con boyfriend. But when red flags—like Almond's lavish spending—arise, he can't shake the feeling something fishy is going on.

Episodes.Title: It's Giving Daddy Issues
Episodes.Description: Taliah's sister, Jameelah, has suddenly gone silent. Suspecting a secret that could disgrace their family, Taliah turns to Tamar. Nothing could prepare Taliah for what's coming—her sister's secret life is more disturbing than she ever imagined.

Episodes.Title: 187 Means Murder
Episodes.Description: Adela thinks Richie is the perfect man, but her best friend Jake isn't convinced. Before she falls too deep, she turns to Tamar's team for help. What they uncover could break Adela's heart—and reveal that Richie's been living a shocking double life.

Episodes.Title: What is She Cooking, Gold Lobster?
Episodes.Description: Jamal's world is crumbling! His wife, Ayisha, is spending big, dressing provocatively, and staying out late—all while claiming to run her catering business. Is Ayisha's work truly funding her lavish lifestyle, or is she cooking up a double life?

Entries.Description: Pamela’s Cooking With Love follows Pamela Anderson as she invites some of today’s most sought-after and buzz-worthy chefs to join her on a stunning rural property on Vancouver Island, where together they’ll prepare delicious plant-based meals to share with family and friends at dinner parties beautifully styled by Pamela.
