Episodes.Description: Chef Gregory Gourdet brings Haitian flair to Pamela's kitchen to teach her the art of spice blends, the knack for balancing sweet and savoury flavours and how to master the perfect pineapple upside down cake.

Entries.Title: Family Lockup
Entries.Description: In a bold bid to break the cycle of recidivism, Sheriff Nick Cocchi of the Hampden County Sheriff's Office in Massachusetts, is allowing estranged family members to spend two nights in jail to restore broken family bonds but when the cell doors close, will healing begin or will some inmates find themselves facing reintegration alone?

Episodes.Title: The Sins Between Us
Episodes.Description: Daryn has been trapped in a relentless cycle of loss, addiction, and incarceration after feeling abandoned by his family. His stepfather, Rick, will enter the jail for 48 hours, desperate to reconnect with the son he once knew.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Brother
Episodes.Description: Robert's history of incarceration due to drug addiction has fractured his family. With only 48 hours before Robert's release, his brother Brandon is determined to confront him about his addiction.

Episodes.Title: My Sister's Keeper
Episodes.Description: Jessica’s drug addiction has led to a series of crimes that landed her in jail more than once, and pushed her away from her sister, Erika, for over five years.

Episodes.Title: Last Son Standing
Episodes.Description: Scott, a father of four, has spent much of his kids’ lives in and out of jail. Ashton is Scott’s only remaining child willing to have a relationship with his father.

Episodes.Title: The Final Straw
Episodes.Description: Eddy has been in and out of jail for most of his daughter Jules’s life. Now, Jules is a mother of twin girls, and she must decide whether to give her father one last chance to mend their relationship or turn her back on him to protect her family.

Entries.Title: Killer Kings
Entries.Description: Killer Kings is a ground-breaking blend of true crime and historical documentary, which will vigorously present the case against six formidable Kings who have left an indelible mark on the world. The series will reveal the haunting mitigating factors and introduce conflicting and fresh evidence, ultimately leading to potentially new verdicts concerning these enigmatic men.

Episodes.Title: HENRY VIII
Episodes.Description: The case against six formidable kings who have left an indelible mark on the world. This episode conders Henry VIII, who reigned from 1509 until his death in 1547. Henry is remembered for his six marriages, the brutal treatment of his spouses and separating the Church of England from papal authority.

Episodes.Title: CALIGULA
Episodes.Description: The Roman Emperor Caligula, also known as Gaius, exploring his brief but brutal reign from AD 37 to 41, highlighting his initial popular policies - cutting taxes and pardoning exiles - which were followed by a descent into madness and tyrannical behaviour. This documentary delves into the historical context of his rule and the events surrounding his assassination.

Episodes.Title: KING JOHN
Episodes.Description: Bad King John I - the Medieval Monster - was far worse in real life that the fictitious villain of the Robin Hood legend. Even before he was crowned King in 1199, he had a dreadful reputation. This was the Prince who, when he learned that his brother ‘Good King Richard’ the “Lionheart” had been imprisoned on return from crusade, decided to tell people he was dead so that he could rule instead.

Episodes.Title: IVAN THE TERRIBLE
Episodes.Description: Tsar Ivan IV Vasilyevich - Ivan the Terrible - was the first grand prince of Moscow from 1533 to 1547 and later ruled as the “Tsar of all Russia” until his death in 1584. Back in the 16th Century when the suffix Terrible was first bestowed on Ivan, it meant ‘awe-inspiring’, ‘powerful’ and ‘formidable’. By the end of his reign, most of his subjects probably felt the word as we understand it today was more apt.

Episodes.Title: Nero
Episodes.Description: On the night of 18 July 64 AD, a fire broke out and swept across Rome, ravaging the city for over six days. It would become known as the Great Fire of Rome and legend states the decadent and unpopular emperor Nero ‘fiddled’ whilst his city burned before him.

Episodes.Title: King Herod
Episodes.Description: Despite being accused of murdering his own wife, children and countless other innocents, King Herod is still known as 'the Great'. Why?

Entries.Title: Baddies Gone Wild Reunion
Entries.Description: The Baddies Gone Wild girls reunite in front of a live audience. Hosted by Janeisha John and Zoe Spencer.

Episodes.Title: Part 1
Episodes.Description: The Baddies Gone Wild girls reunite in front of a live audience. Hosted by Janeisha John and Zoe Spencer.

Entries.Title: Unknown Serial Killers of America
Entries.Description: Explores the chilling cases of lesser-known serial killers whose crimes went unnoticed for years, leaving a trail of fear and unsolved murders before they were finally caught.

Episodes.Title: Carl Watts
Episodes.Description: Chilling confessions from a vicious slasher detail only some of his 100+ victims. When he's set to be the first serial killer ever released from prison, an eyewitness from decades prior could force justice on the man who vows to kill again.

Episodes.Title: William Suff
Episodes.Description: In the '90s, a deranged killer stalks sex workers in Riverside, Calif., claiming the lives of 13 women. When a would-be victim describes the perp to police, the race is on to catch the murderous john before he strikes again.

Episodes.Title: Daniel Conahan
Episodes.Description: Five corpses are found on the Florida hog trails. The investigation stalls until two men narrowly escape the perp's clutches. Years later, eight more bodies are found in nearby woods, leaving police to wonder if it's the same evil killer.

Episodes.Title: Terry Rasmussen
Episodes.Description: Multiple unidentified bodies are found inside barrels in a New Hampshire forest. Decades later, a murder 3,000 miles away reveals their connection to a serial predator who changes his identity after every violent kill.

Episodes.Title: Maury Travis
Episodes.Description: From 2001 the bodies of 12 black women start to surface in Missouri and Illinois. As the investigation intensifies the killer start to taunts authorities.

Episodes.Title: Herb Baumeister
Episodes.Description: A group of young gay men disappear in Indiana during the 1990s. An amateur detective uncovers clues that leads to identify a merciless offender.

Entries.Title: The Motherhood
Entries.Description: Connie Britton, herself a single mother, helps another mom balance work, parenting, and self-care. With expert coaches, they transform the mom's living space, parenting approach, and wardrobe over a week, fostering a supportive community.

Episodes.Title: Finding Her Pink
Episodes.Description: Tasha poured everything into being a mom, but lost herself; with support from The Motherhood, Tasha learns to set boundaries, reclaim her space and rediscover her confidence, proving that she's not just a mom, she's Tasha too.

Episodes.Title: Team Mom
Episodes.Description: Rochelle is a superhero single mom, always putting her boys first, but now it's her turn; with support from Connie Britton and The Neighbor Ladies, she realizes that even the strongest moms deserve to prioritize themselves.

Episodes.Title: Unpacking Possibility
Episodes.Description: Single mom Kathleen is ready to let go of the past and rediscover herself as her son Zane enters his pre-teen years. With a little help The Motherhood, she unpacks more than just boxes and finds support through community.

Episodes.Title: Reaching for the Stars
Episodes.Description: Space enthusiast Danielle has created a joyful life for her daughter Lucy, but lost sight of her own dreams along the way; with support from Connie Britton and the experts, she learns to accept help and reignite her passions.

Episodes.Title: A Bed of Her Own
Episodes.Description: Susan and daughter have been co-sleeping since birth, but it's time for change.

Episodes.Title: Room to Breathe
Episodes.Description: Rachel has dedicated everything to raising her neurodivergent son while juggling three jobs; Connie Britton and The Motherhood community are stepping in to provide parenting help, a home workspace and a confidence boost.

Entries.Title: Reetan Naal Preetan
Entries.Description: Reetan Naal Preetan is a heartwarming journey through the vibrant wedding traditions of Punjab. From pre-wedding rituals to grand celebrations, it beautifully showcases the emotional bonds, cultural richness, and timeless customs that make Punjabi weddings truly special. A perfect blend of love, laughter, and heartfelt moments rooted in tradition.

Episodes.Title: Din Shagna De Aaye
Episodes.Description: The search for Gudo’s groom begins! From family discussions to suggestions from neighbors, everyone has a say. As traditions guide their way, the excitement builds. What steps will the family follow in this age-old journey of finding the perfect match? With customs shaping every decision, where will this search lead? The journey of a Punjabi wedding begins—stay tuned!

Entries.Title: The Last Wright: Building the Final Home Design of America's Greatest Architect
Entries.Description: Modern-day building codes and materials challenge mother and daughter team, Sarah and Debbie Dykstra, as they take on the challenge of constructing a house from the last set of drawings completed by Frank Lloyd Wright before his death in 1959.

Episodes.Title: Build of a Lifetime
Episodes.Description: Sarah and Debbie are ready to build a home from plans that were on Frank Lloyd Wright's drawing table when he died. But the town must approve, first.

Episodes.Title: Who's in Charge Here?
Episodes.Description: Sarah and Debbie visit Wright's last living client for guidance on making adjustments to the plans.

Episodes.Title: It Has to Be Wright
Episodes.Description: Modern building codes and materials force Sarah and Debbie to make updates to Wright's plans.

Entries.Title: Golden Gai
Entries.Description: A Mexican-American mixologist searching for inspiration in Tokyo falls for a sharp-witted local, and together they open a Golden Gai-style bar in Los Angeles where each night brings a new story and the looming pressure of her father’s watchful eye.

Episodes.Title: “Hugo”
Episodes.Description: In search of inspiration, Hugo travels to Tokyo and meets Yuki, a local bar manager in Shinjuku’s Golden Gai district. As sparks fly, the two dream of opening their own izakaya in Los Angeles.

Episodes.Title: "Akira"
Episodes.Description: With their Golden Gai LA finally open, Hugo discovers his quirky, anime-obsessed staff may be hiding untapped creative talent.

Entries.Title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out
Entries.Description: Dr. Sandra Lee, also known as Dr. Pimple Popper, is the most famous dermatological surgeon in the world and an internationally beloved personality. She has dedicated her life to sharing her incredible skills with her huge audience, as she helps hundreds of suffering patients who are unable or unwilling to find treatment for their painful, oozing cysts, fatty tumors, and infinitely complex, life-affecting dermatological issues. Now, Dr. Lee is ready to take her practice to the next level. The doctor has made modern additions to her main office which include an entire new wing of patient rooms, and many new staff and doctors. For the first time, Dr. Lee will also be providing intimate self-shot footage of her life outside the office.

Episodes.Title: Lessons in Pimple Popping
Episodes.Description: "Dottie the Body" lost her confidence when a large bump started growing between her thighs; Dr. Lee brings in a new, young doctor to help Tim with his big, bumpy nose; Karime is insecure about her birthmark that looks like a black eye.

Episodes.Title: A Juicy Secret
Episodes.Description: Katrina has oozing, smelly boils that have taken over her life. Kim's head-to-toe tumors interfere with her sleep apnea mask, resulting in constant exhaustion. Dr. Lee and a medical student trainee help Emil and his wife, who are afraid the bump and lesion on his back might be cancerous.

Episodes.Title: Superglue to the Rescue
Episodes.Description: Tierra is a musician with massive bumps on her ears that hold her back from performing. Dr. Zoe assists Dr. Lee helping Ryan, whose numerous head bumps undermine his life journey. Ann keeps a great attitude even as she lives with everyday pain caused by her genetic skin condition.

Episodes.Title: Call Me Big Popper
Episodes.Description: Dr. Lyndsey assists Dr. Lee with Lance's notoriously big bump that halted his rap dreams. Shelby has lost control of her sweet tooth, her health, and the mystery bumps she has developed. Dr. Lee proposes a long-shot cure for Jante, who has been losing pigment in her skin as well as her confidence.

Episodes.Title: Senior Cyst-izen
Episodes.Description: Anthony is trying to move on from his troubled past, but his huge thigh lump is holding him back. Mary has a mysterious 70-year-old bump that amazes Drs. Lee and Tomassian. Sultana has a shocking red rash on her face that affects her social media success.

Episodes.Title: Jaw Dropper
Episodes.Description: Dr. Lyndsey joins Dr. Lee to help David, who is fearful that the lump on his jaw might be cancer. Carla has a large, mysterious bulge on her thigh that concerns Dr. Lee. James has over 70 skin tags that he wants removed so he can get his beach body back.

Episodes.Title: Holey Moley
Episodes.Description: Bill's swinging arm growth prevents him from living his retirement dreams. Regina distracts from the many moles on her face with a vibrant style. Budding med student Gili helps Dr. Lee solve the mystery of Cowboy Carter's extensive rash.

Episodes.Title: Tag Team My Bumps
Episodes.Description: Dr. Lee asks Dr. Zoe to help double-team needle-shy Mary Ann's crusty skin. Isaiah's mom is concerned he is ignoring the large, growing lump over his lower spine. Maressa worries about the dangers of treating the oozing skin covering her ankles and body.

Episodes.Title: Triangle of Death
Episodes.Description: Jason has become a recluse because of a giant growth on the back of his neck.

Episodes.Title: Nurse Bumpy Head
Episodes.Description: Bryan has a genetic condition that may be causing the huge mystery bumps on his head.

Episodes.Title: Psoria-Sisters
Episodes.Description: Dave is a firefighter and avid cyclist whose bump gets in the way of wearing various helmets. Bree empowers others on social media by accepting her own psoriasis, but it has recently become too painful to endure.

Episodes.Title: Buffalo Hump Bump
Episodes.Description: Dee has the voice of an angel, but her huge neck hump has stolen her passion to sing. Young Eli wants to be a chef, but feels ashamed of his cheek bump and worries removing it could paralyze his face.

Episodes.Title: My Head Laid An Egg
Episodes.Description: Stephanie has dreams of being a caterer, but is humiliated by her giant baseball-sized scalp bump. Deb is afraid that the growth on the side of her knee may eventually paralyze her.

Episodes.Title: Needle Little Help
Episodes.Description: Jimmy is a Charleston firefighter whose myriad of torso bumps make it painful to play with his young son.

Episodes.Title: Bye Bye Booty Bump
Episodes.Description: Denise has a growth on her booty, but scarring from a previous trauma has kept her from getting it removed. Zachary is a drag artist whose touring career is dragged down by his painful, debilitating psoriasis.

Episodes.Title: Hex Marks the Spot
Episodes.Description: Rachael is a caretaker whose arm bump interferes with helping her disabled bestie. Medical student Gili assists Dr. Lee with Christian's painful back bump as his stuffed animal companion watches.

Episodes.Title: Third Eye Blinded
Episodes.Description: Allie is a free spirit whose polyamorous lifestyle is ruined by the gumball-sized bump above her eye. Film buff Andrew's psoriasis and multiple body bumps have held him back from starting a family with his wife, Gift.

Episodes.Title: Beach Bump
Episodes.Description: Jon's huge, 25-year-old shoulder blade bump is ruining his family beach days and risking his health. April wants the wedding of her dreams but feels hideous in gowns due to her bumpy underarm "threast."

Episodes.Title: My Unlovely Lady Lumps
Episodes.Description: Tobi is having trouble re-entering the dating pool because of symmetrical, tush-shaped bumps around her spine. Tia is a beautiful young woman whose huge, shiny scalp growth has sent her into self-imposed exile.

Episodes.Title: Lump In My Throat
Episodes.Description: Jack searches for the confidence to try surgery on his throat bump, after fainting during a previous attempt. Kristan is a young, bubbly gym teacher who has given up on love after discovering a growth on her back.

Entries.Title: Animals on Drugs
Entries.Description: Around the world, wild animals are hooked on human vices -- bears drunk on alcohol, gators high on meth; even "cocaine hippos". Wildlife expert Forrest Galante tracks these animals, investigating their strange behaviors to find ways to rehab them safely.

Episodes.Title: Cocaine Hippos
Episodes.Description: Aggressive hippos raised by the infamous cocaine kingpin Pablo Escobar have escaped his abandoned compound in Colombia, becoming a dangerous and deadly invasive species. Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante embarks upon a risky plan to stop them.

Episodes.Title: Meth Gators
Episodes.Description: In a methamphetamine hotspot, drugs seep into local waterways, creating aggressive alligators.

Episodes.Title: Drunk Bears
Episodes.Description: A late-night encounter with a beer-hunting bear sparks a cross-country investigation.

Entries.Title: Phooli Ka Matka Raw Tape
Entries.Description: Phooli Ka Matka – A MoodX RAW TAPES Original Series Dive into the unfiltered world of Phooli, where rural innocence meets unapologetic passion. With 1+ hour of fully unedited, premium uncut content, this story captures the raw chemistry between a fiery village belle and a smitten laborer—recorded like never before. Set against a scenic backdrop and laced with desi drama, Phooli Ka Matka will stir your desires and break every boundary.

Episodes.Description: Phooli Ka Matka – A MoodX RAW TAPES Original Series Dive into the unfiltered world of Phooli, where rural innocence meets unapologetic passion. Entries.Title: Adaptive
Entries.Description: A profile of the personal and professional lives of world-class Paralympic athletes, highlighting the power of sport through community and advocacy.

Episodes.Title: The Quad
Episodes.Description: With the results of the 2020 Tokyo Games in the rearview mirror, Team USA Paralympians look ahead.

Episodes.Title: Sports Saved My Life
Episodes.Description: The personal journeys of our athletes come alive as they explore the impact of sports.

Episodes.Title: Spirit In Motion
Episodes.Description: After years of relentless training and a lifetime filled with dreams, the moment has arrived.

Entries.Title: Abolish Everything!
Entries.Description: On Abolish Everything!, comedian-abolitionists roast a pet peeve they want banned from society, while a panel of improvisers dubbed “The Political Establishment” argue on behalf of the status quo. The audience chooses their champion each episode, each of whom will come back to compete in the season finale.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Our Radical Movement
Episodes.Description: Alise Morales, Liz Hynes, Ben Doyle, and Ike Ufomadu set forth to abolish the more intolerable aspects of phones, door-holding, animals, and greetings. Rebutting them this week as part of The Political Establishment are Rachel Coster, Ben Marshall, Meredith Dietz, and Andy Vega.

Episodes.Title: Abolish Agreeing to Disagree
Episodes.Description: Annie Rauwerda, Kyle Gordon, Rima Parikh, and Adam Chase aim to remove certain annoying sounds, flexibility, a lack of birthday greetings, and a doctor with a drill from our daily lives. Rebutting them this week as part of The Political Establishment are Josh Nasser, Jamie Linn Watson, Brielle DeMirjian, and Andy Vega.

Episodes.Title: Abolish Cybertrucks
Episodes.Description: Amy Muller, Randall Otis, Michelle Chan Bennett, and Dan Toomey abolish singing the national anthem at sporting events, Cybertrucks, the name Jazz, and porn…that’s bad for you. Rebutting them this week as part of The Political Establishment are Rachel Coster, Ibhan Kulkarni, Josh Nasser, and Andy Vega.

Episodes.Title: Abolish Airplanes
Episodes.Description: Josh Gondelman, Ena Da, Jeremy Kaplowitz, and Augusta Chapman abolish confidence, planes, Liquid Death, and “Getting Involved in Some Hoopla.” Rebutting them this week as part of The Political Establishment are Jamie Linn Watson, Charlie Bardey, Nicole Conlan, and Andy Vega.

Episodes.Title: Abolish the English Language
Episodes.Description: Lukas Arnold, Maggie Mae Fish, Vannessa Jackson, and Jonathan van Halem abolish the English language, slow walkers, TikTok couples, being asked to turn off the big light. Rebutting them this week as part of The Political Establishment are Glo Tavarez, Alex Song-Xia, Josh Nasser, and Andy Vega.

Episodes.Title: Abolish Hot Doctors
Episodes.Description: Sila Puhl, Dorian Debose, Matt Krol, and Maeve Dunigan abolish hot medical professionals, sunscreen, lecterns, and mascots that are people. Rebutting them this week as part of The Political Establishment are Jamie Linn Watson, Alex Song-Xia, Brielle DeMirjian, and Andy Vega.

Episodes.Title: Abolish Meryl Streep
Episodes.Description: Kenice Mobley, Foreign Man in a Foreign Land, Henry Block, and Ryan Ciecwisz abolish twins having strokes, reaction creators, Meryl Streep and Uber drivers slamming Ryan’s penis in car doors because he won’t stop playing harmonica. Rebutting them this week as part of The Political Establishment are Glo Tavarez, Josh Sharp, Kylie Brakeman, and Andy Vega.

Episodes.Title: Abolish Grad School Graduation
Episodes.Description: Michael Kandel, Carson Olshansky, Graham Techler, and Charu Sinha abolish sports betting, guys who aren’t looking for anything serious kissing Carson on the forehead, telling Graham he can’t have extremely inexpensive back-to-school supplies from Staples, and corporeal forms. Rebutting them this week as part of The Political Establishment are Rachel Coster, Brielle DeMirjian, Kylie Brakeman, and Andy Vega.

Episodes.Title: World Championship
Episodes.Description: In this double-length season finale, eight of our most triumphant abolitionists return to abolish one last thing—and be crowned this season’s Abolish Everyking (Gender Neutral). Augusta Chapman, Vannessa Jackson, Amy Muller, Ikechukwu Ufomadu, Henry Block, Annie Rauwerda, Charu Sinha, and Maeve Dunigan abolish being too cool, the young adult section in bookshops, just taking a little piece of cake, the moon, songs with instructions, acronyms and initialisms, cars, and winging it. Rebutting one last time this season as part of The Political Establishment are Jamie Linn Watson, Josh Nasser, Brielle DeMirjian, and Andy Vega.

Entries.Title: Lil Kev
Entries.Description: Set in 1993 North Philadelphia, follow 12-year-old Kevin Hart, whose wild imagination and unshakable optimism constantly collide with his neighborhood's harsh realities. At the same time, his no-nonsense mother Nancy juggles night shifts as an E.R. nurse while waging a one-woman war to keep Kev on track – no easy feat with his mischievous older brother Robert blazing all the wrong trails, his trainwreck father Henry's outrageous attempts to win Nancy back, and his ex-con uncle Richard Jr.'s questionable life advice.

Episodes.Title: Take Your Kev to Work
Episodes.Description: Kev uses Uncle Richard's jail ball antics at basketball tryouts and accidentally starts a riot, so Nancy decides to scare him straight with a visit to her job at the ER.

Episodes.Title: Kev the Babysitter
Episodes.Description: Kev's plan to go to his crush Rhe Rhe's party is thwarted when he gets stuck babysitting Uncle Richard's two rowdy kids; Nancy goes to a spoken word poetry night with Marisol.

Episodes.Title: Laugh at My 'Paign
Episodes.Description: When the community pool closes, smooth-talking city council candidate Coleman Bridges proves unhelpful, so Kev schemes for Henry to run against Coleman.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Uncle Mom Jr.
Episodes.Description: Uncle Richard is put in charge of the boys while Nancy takes a risk visiting a new hair salon; when Kev and Robert's troublemaking plans go awry, Richard and Henry clean up the mess.

Episodes.Title: Driving Miss Nancy Crazy
Episodes.Description: Inspired by Rev. Mooney's sermon, Kev and Nancy try to prove each other wrong as they help their racist elderly neighbor; Richard thinks Miss Green is avoiding him.

Episodes.Title: Trial and Terror
Episodes.Description: Kev's class completes a read-a-thon challenge, but with a logbook tracking their progress stolen and their pizza party at risk, the class holds a mock trial to catch the thief; Nancy and Marisol devise a plan to save their endangered hospital.

Episodes.Title: The King and Queen of Harts Play Spades
Episodes.Description: Nancy and Henry head to Baltimore to reclaim their Spades glory from years past, and find their relationship spark reignited; nervous Kev gets the attention of a girl, and Richard's plans to spend a quiet weekend with Miss Green are crashed.

Episodes.Title: This Isn't 39
Episodes.Description: Nancy freaks on her birthday when she learns she's not turning 39, but 40; her friend Loretta arrives to take her out for one last crazy night; Kev and Henry trail them to keep Nancy away from other men; Richard helps Robert make a prison cake.

Episodes.Title: Bittersweet Charity
Episodes.Description: Nancy offers to watch Dirty Dante, and finds she enjoys mothering the grateful kid; Kev takes advantage of Nancy being distracted and gets into trouble staying out late; Richard suspects Miss Green is losing interest in him since he's gone straight.

Episodes.Title: Sink or Swim
Episodes.Description: Kev starts a swim team with new kid Brian; Nancy hosts a dinner for Coleman to discuss the growing crime problems; surprising Nancy, Henry also arrives for dinner to win her back; more folks crash the dinner, leaving Nancy frantic as chaos ensues.

Entries.Title: Spud Hut
Entries.Description: An improvised sitcom about the lives of the people and goings-ons at The Spud Hut.

Episodes.Title: A Smosh Sitcom
Episodes.Description: The business is failing... the mall is empty... what in the spud are they gonna do?

Episodes.Title: Our Marketing Sucks
Episodes.Description: Spud Hut GOES HOLLYWOOD!

Episodes.Title: Undercover Spud
Episodes.Description: WHY are the potatoes SO BIG?

Episodes.Title: What If We Kissed?
Episodes.Description: Will the spud-crossed lovers make it through this?

Episodes.Title: Spuds Against Sex
Episodes.Description: The companies get some much needed training.

Episodes.Title: The Finale
Episodes.Description: It all comes back to the spud.

Entries.Title: The Carters: Hurts to Love You
Entries.Description: Unravel a deeply disturbing path told by Angel Conrad, the Nick and Aaron Carter's sister, along with first-time interviews with friends Melissa Joan Hart and Scout Willis. Never-before-seen home movies that detail the brothers' rise to fame and the devastating toll it took on their family also help tell the Carters’ story.

Episodes.Title: Part 1
Episodes.Description: The extreme highs and tragic lows of a family propelled into the spotlight by two brothers.

Episodes.Title: Part 2
Episodes.Description: Nick and Angel Carter explore the painful dynamics that led to the death of three of their siblings.

Entries.Title: The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer
Entries.Description: Hamilton County coroner Jeff Jellison launches a new investigation into Herb Baumeister decades after thousands of bones were found in the woods behind Fox Hollow Farms, Baumeister's stately home. Using new DNA technology, Jellison and his team work to identify the human remains, bringing long-deferred closure to victims' families and unearthing unsettling questions about potential accomplices, missing evidence, and a key witness whose story keeps changing.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Boys
Episodes.Description: When human remains are found at Fox Hollow Farm, investigators uncover how a wealthy businessman preyed on vulnerable gay men.

Episodes.Title: A House with Good Bones
Episodes.Description: Fox Hollow Farm's new owner makes an introduction that raises questions about what really happened, and if a serial killer acted alone.

Episodes.Title: Answer the Riddle
Episodes.Description: Cold case investigator Steve Ainsworth reexamines evidence, uncovering new clues about a potential accomplice in the Fox Hollow Farm murders.

Episodes.Title: No Longer Forgotten
Episodes.Description: As new evidence emerges, a survivor recounts his experience with killer Herb Baumeister.

Entries.Title: TerrorBytes: The Evolution of Horror Gaming
Entries.Description: TerrorBytes explores the rich history of horror in the video game world, unravelling the stories behind everything from its pixelated past to its newest nightmares.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Survival Horror
Episodes.Description: We explore the survival horror genre, examining the early titles like 3D Monster Maze and Project Firestart, its explosive popularity in the 90s – where titles like Alone in the Dark, Resident Evil, and Silent Hill captured the imagination of the masses – and its legacy and enduring popularity today.

Episodes.Title: Lethal Licenses
Episodes.Description: We explore the good, the bad, and the ugly, including early Halloween and Texas Chainsaw Massacre games, bizarre obscurities like Ringu: Infinity, and successes like the brilliant Alien: Isolation, as well as the growing popularity of licensed characters in games like Dead by Daylight.

Episodes.Title: Narrative Nightmares
Episodes.Description: From the surreal and unique to the kitsch and campy, we celebrate and explore cinematic horror games and the now-obscure world of full motion video horror games, exploring "so-bad-it's-good" games like Night Trap, Sierra Online classics like Phantasmagoria, and the unusual use of CG tech in titles like D, among many others.

Episodes.Title: The Indie Revolution
Episodes.Description: We shine a light on indie development in horror gaming, from breakout hits like Five Nights at Freddy’s and Amnesia to the many unique and one-of-a-kind experiences like Yume Nikki, Papa Sangre, and FAITH: The Unholy Trinity.

Episodes.Title: Cursed and Controversial
Episodes.Description: We dive down the rabbit hole of controversy and explore the games - like Doom, Manhunt, and Saw - that people wanted banned. Along the way, we'll also take a look at the unusual world of "cursed" games, including urban legends like Polybius, Petscop, and Crow 64.

Entries.Title: Christmas at Sea
Entries.Description: Hallmark superfans celebrate the holidays aboard a Christmas cruise to the tropics, filled with festive fun and celebrity surprises.

Episodes.Title: Merry Cruise-mas!
Episodes.Description: The Hallmark Christmas Cruise kicks off with festive fun, as the passengers meet their favorite stars and begin their journey with a Christmas tree lighting at sea. Adventure and surprises await on this unforgettable voyage!

Episodes.Title: Docking Around the Christmas Tree
Episodes.Description: The Hallmark Christmas cruise approaches The Bahamas, where challenges, surprises, and life changing moments await the passengers.

Episodes.Title: Slay Ride
Episodes.Description: The holiday cruise is packed with excitement! Rob has an unforgettable surprise for Donna, Gail and Alicia enjoy an off-road adventure with a very special guest, and the Mr. Shipmas Contest sparks some friendly competition.

Episodes.Title: All I Want for Christmas Is You
Episodes.Description: On the last day of the cruise, a romantic celebration unfolds at sea with help from Hallmark Stars. Laura lands a life-changing opportunity, and passengers enjoy a final day of fun, laughter, and unforgettable holiday memories.

Entries.Title: Haha, You Clowns
Entries.Description: Three jacked, surprisingly kindhearted brothers are accompanied by their loving and similarly swole father as they engage in a series of adventures to bond after their mother's passing.

Entries.Title: Khadaan
Entries.Description: In a mining village shrouded in a dark and sinister past, an entire family is found brutally murdered. Has an angry spirit returned to seek revenge? Has the long-dormant curse been reawakened? Who—or what—is responsible for the hundreds of bodies unearthed during the investigation? Inspector Veer Pratap Singh, who has just arrived in the village to take charge, is thrust into a chilling investigation that will test his resolve and alter the course of his life forever.

Episodes.Title: Bhadra
Episodes.Description: Inspector Veer Pratap Singh's arrival in the village coincides with the discovery of the dead bodies of an entire family. While he takes charge of the investigation, fear and murmurs of an old curse spread through the village.

Episodes.Title: Tairti Laashein
Episodes.Description: The investigation gets more complicated with the villagers and also the local police unwilling to consider anything other than the curse. But Veer isn’t convinced.

Episodes.Title: Gade Murde
Episodes.Description: Veer realises what he is up against when he discovers a secret grave with hundreds of dead bodies. Veer realises that he has to turn to his old friends to help solve the case.

Episodes.Title: Shraap
Episodes.Description: Darkness envelopes the village as the old curse makes its strong presence felt. Veer encounters a suspect and a deeper twist around every corner.

Episodes.Title: Kalaa Kothi Ki Kahani
Episodes.Description: The truth threatens to be darker than anything that the police have imagined. This case becomes both professional and personal.

Episodes.Title: Khulaasa
Episodes.Description: The real curse is finally revealed.

Entries.Description: Guts & Glory flips the script on the traditional competition show – thrusting players into an immersive horror experience full of unexpected challenges. Entries.Title: Crime Patrol: 26 Jurm, 26 Cases
Entries.Description: From disturbing murder cases to gripping investigations, follow police officers as they delve into the most violent crimes that plague society.

Episodes.Title: Aakhri Call
Episodes.Description: Months after a young woman's death, five students receive calls from her number. But the case turns murky when a decapitated body is found on campus.

Episodes.Title: Hotel Blood Stone
Episodes.Description: After being missing for 10 days, a woman appears in a disturbing viral video taken at Hotel Blood Stone. Will the police be able to track her down in time?

Episodes.Title: Ek Kaatil, 15000 DNA
Episodes.Description: When a woman named Naina is found dead, police question people living in the housing complex. Soon a criminal web begins to unravel.

Episodes.Title: 48 Ghante, Tukdo Mein Sach
Episodes.Description: The founder of Pro Life Insurance, Subodh Khanna, goes missing under mysterious circumstances. When his wife presents a suicide video to the police, questions arise.

Episodes.Title: Garba Mein Maut
Episodes.Description: Amid the vibrant celebrations of Navratri in a small Gujarat town, a devoted mother sets out to prove her son's innocence when he is accused of murdering a young girl.

Episodes.Title: Sard Murder
Episodes.Description: When Harshdeep Kochchar's (Harry) body is found in a freezer at his brother's restaurant, the investigation spirals into a web of lies, love, and betrayal.

Episodes.Title: Mitti Mein Dafan Sach
Episodes.Description: When the wife and daughters of a distinguished judge vanish overnight, the evidence emerges in layers-one burial at a time-the case turns into a nightmarish puzzle full of deception, misdirection, and unsettling truths.

Episodes.Title: Slimming Pill, Bloody Kills
Episodes.Description: Superstar Randhir Raii is kidnapped, and ACP has 24 hours to save him. As the investigation unfolds, it exposes a deadly pharma scandal and a grieving father's fight for justice.

Episodes.Title: Ratna
Episodes.Description: Sanju arrives at his home to attend his sister Ratna's wedding ; only to see a sight that will shock him forever and suffer an attack that will handicap him forever. Sanju's whole family has been killed.

Episodes.Title: Charu
Episodes.Description: A maid is dead. But her secrets lived on in the lives of those who thought they never knew her. Her shocking ties to multiple elite residents come to light.

Episodes.Title: Shruti
Episodes.Description: When a young woman vanishes while delivering food, her search leads the cops into the hidden mysteries of the city's largest slum. Can the cops find out the terrible truth about the young girl?

Episodes.Title: Salma
Episodes.Description: Salma , a cook at a street-food cart is found beaten and unconscious in an auto; on regaining consciousness , she says that she got into a fight with her ex-boyfriend who has fled.

Episodes.Title: Roshni Behnaaz, Part 1
Episodes.Description: Set in the Parsi community, Roshni, a new mother is killed and the suspects are many - her husband, her maid, her neighbor amongst many others. Cops are not able to find the killer and now an expert is empanelled to investigate further.

Episodes.Title: Roshni Behnaaz, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Behnaaz is Roshni's best friend. Her quest for finding Roshni's murder intensified. What complicated the case further is that she herself was a victim of domestic violence.

Episodes.Title: Shagun
Episodes.Description: Shagun Sandhu disappears the morning after celebrating her 20th birthday, just hours after her father receives a threatening call. The next day, her body is discovered in a park. Who made the call, and why was Shagun targeted?

Episodes.Title: Sujata
Episodes.Description: Newlyweds Ramesh and Sujata arrive in Mumbai to start a new life. But joy turns into dread when Ramesh vanishes without a trace. Sujata seeks help, but the case takes a darker twist after a woman's body is found. What mystery lies ahead?

Episodes.Title: Kundan Mayuri, Part 1
Episodes.Description: Terror grips the village when a headless body is discovered, leaving the locals stunned and fearful. As the police launch their investigation, unsettling questions begin to surface - who was the victim, and what dark secret lies behind this gruesome act?

Episodes.Title: Kundan Mayuri, Part 2
Episodes.Description: When Naveen's severed head is discovered in his home freezer, the police launch an investigation and question his wife about Mayuri's whereabouts. As they track Dipika in hopes of reaching the culprit, the clock is ticking. Will they find her before it's too late?

Episodes.Title: Sarthak
Episodes.Description: Aspiring dancer Sarthak is found dead under a bus stop bench. As the mystery unfolds, his sister-in-law reveals a police constable had visited him a month ago. What led to his tragic end?

Episodes.Title: Farheen Naseem
Episodes.Description: A routine fishing trip takes a dark turn when a corpse is found floating in the water. Shock and confusion follow as the police arrive to investigate. Who was this person, and how did they end up here?

Episodes.Title: Preeti Sunil
Episodes.Description: In Nashik, Maharashtra, Preeti Deshmukh is found murdered in her home. The prime suspect, a firecracker seller, goes on the run and takes children in a chawl hostage. Can the police crack the case?

Episodes.Title: Shourya Dhiraj
Episodes.Description: In Nashik, Maharashtra, wheelchair-bound Dheeraj is found dead in a swimming pool. While it appears to be a suicide, the police suspect foul play. Can they uncover the truth with barely any clues?

Entries.Title: The Judd Family: Truth Be Told
Entries.Description: The Judd Family: Truth Be Told reveals the complex story of the Judds’ including their triumphs and tragedies across several decades. From Naomi’s beginnings in Kentucky as a young teen mom, then known as Dianna, struggling to survive with her young daughters, the doc illustrates how the famous country music mother-daughter duo of Naomi and Wynonna Judd came to be and where Ashley stood at the height of Naomi and Wynonna’s fame. Untold truths emerge, illustrating what tied them together, and what also drove them a part.

Episodes.Title: A Mother's Smile
Episodes.Description: To unlock the mysteries surrounding Naomi Judd’s 2022 suicide, the episode examines her past. Naomi struggles to make ends meet as a single mother in seedy 1970s Hollywood. Naomi discovers Wynonna’s musical gift.

Episodes.Title: Why Not Me?
Episodes.Description: Focuses on Naomi's efforts to launch Wynonna's career in Nashville, eventually leading to her joining the act.

Episodes.Title: Love Can Build a Bridge
Episodes.Description: Details The Judds' rise to fame, the growing tension between Naomi and Wynonna, and the impact on Ashley.

Episodes.Title: Child of the Light
Episodes.Description: Covers Naomi's Hepatitis diagnosis and forced retirement, while Wynonna and Ashley's careers flourish, and Naomi confronts painful childhood memories.

Episodes.Description: David, Joel's former doorman, and Shana, who can impersonate a weed whacker compete.

Episodes.Title: Shout out to Maddie
Episodes.Description: Brothers, Ethan and Paul, and an aspiring loan shark, Ericka, compete.

Episodes.Title: Let's Goooooo!
Episodes.Description: A reality show regular, a wig enthusiast, and a hype man compete for a chance at the prize.

Episodes.Title: Farmer Wants a Wife...and $100,000
Episodes.Description: The farmers of the first season of "Farmer Wants a Wife" are among contestants.

Episodes.Description: Mike, a professional mascot, Debra, a psychic, and Joshua, a rabbi, are among the 100 contestants.

Episodes.Title: Joel-O Shots
Episodes.Description: A realtor, a rare chicken farmer and a high school math teacher are among 100 contestants competing.

Episodes.Title: What's Up, Buttercup?
Episodes.Description: A former reality TV star, a fraternity brother and a neurosurgeon are among the contestants.

Episodes.Title: You're My Favorite Kicker!
Episodes.Description: A real estate agent, a woman who raises rare chickens and a mother-son duo compete.

Episodes.Title: 100% That Bish
Episodes.Description: Software engineers, an eccentric marketer and a sommelier are among 100 contestants competing.

Episodes.Title: Friendship Bracelets for Joel
Episodes.Description: A professional poker player, Joel McHale's biggest fan and auctioneer business partners.

Episodes.Title: Singles Night: She Might Be Out of Your League
Episodes.Description: A litigation attorney, a science teacher and a Whitney Houston superfan compete.

Episodes.Title: Singles Night: Don't Wanna be a Nurse or a Purse
Episodes.Description: It is singles night on The 1% Club! A litigation attorney and private money broker, Stephanie, a science teacher, Brittany and Whitney Houston superfan, Shaed are among 100 contestants competing for the chance to win up to $100,000 and possibly find love!

Episodes.Title: Second Chance: I Put on My Redemption Wig
Episodes.Description: Contestants who were eliminated on a past episode get another shot at a massive cash prize.

Episodes.Title: Second Chance: You Gotta Risk It for the Biscuit
Episodes.Description: Contestants who were eliminated on a past episode get another shot at a massive cash prize.

Entries.Title: Ted Bundy: Dialogue with the Devil
Entries.Description: In 1984, Ted Bundy offers to help catch the Green River Killer--launching a chilling game of cat and mouse with detective Robert Keppel. Featuring never-before-heard tapes, this is a gripping descent into one of history's darkest minds.

Episodes.Title: The Face Off Begins
Episodes.Description: Serial killer Ted Bundy offers to help Det. Robert Keppel catch the Green River Killer, giving Keppel a chance to find GRK and get Bundy to confess to eight unsolved murders. Keppel must match wits with the world's most notorious murderer.

Episodes.Title: Cat and Mouse
Episodes.Description: As Detective Bob Keppel listens to Ted Bundy's advice on catching the Green River Killer, clues into Ted's murderous mind emerge. Keppel steers the conversation into what both killers have in common: returning to where they disposed

Episodes.Title: Dark Secrets
Episodes.Description: As Ted Bundy profiles the Green River killer to Detective Bob Keppel, he reveals dark secrets about his own murders. But to get Ted to confess Keppel must keep his ruse going and play Ted's game to avoid the electric chair

Episodes.Title: Manhunt for a Madman
Episodes.Description: Ted Bundy escapes from jail twice - but is caught after committing three more murders in Florida. Bundy is sentenced to death - Det. Robert Keppel must get Bundy to reveal more about the Riverman and confess to his own murders in Washington State.

Episodes.Title: Date with Death
Episodes.Description: As his date with the executioner draws near, Ted Bundy offers to confess to 8 Washington State murders - if he's allowed to live long enough to tell the tale. Det. Robert Keppel has a last showdown with the killer, hoping Bundy will finally come clean.

Episodes.Title: In the Devil's Wake
Episodes.Description: Ted Bundy is finally executed in 1989. Six years later Gary Ridgway is caught and charged with 40 Green River murders. When Ridgway confesses, Det. Robert Keppel realizes how eerily accurate Bundy's taped predictions about GRK really were.

Entries.Description: K-Town Girls tells the story of four spunky girls in New York City.

Entries.Title: Downie Express
Entries.Description: Mike and his friend, Jeff, take on the challenge of travelling from the Arctic to Africa by train in this adventure series.

Episodes.Title: I Took the Train from the Arctic to Africa
Episodes.Description: Downie Express begins at the world's northernmost passenger rail station, deep within the Arctic Circle. From there, Mike and Jeff board the once-a-day southbound train, kicking off an epic trek toward Africa, however, they have one rule for this trip: they cannot leave a country until they've eaten the national dish.

Episodes.Title: Riding the Struggle Bus
Episodes.Description: Downie Express takes an unexpected turn when Mike and Jeff encounter a series of train cancellations, delays and curveballs. The guys decide to make the most of the situation by visiting the world’s largest miniature railway and then come up with a new strategy to circumvent the railway chaos.

Episodes.Title: Back on Track
Episodes.Description: Mike and Jeff eat waffles in Belgium and find themselves in a classic film in Paris, but Jeff has a big surprise up his sleeve.

Episodes.Title: We Trained for This
Episodes.Description: Mike and Jeff board a train to the southernmost station in Europe, chasing the last stretch of rails toward Africa.

Episodes.Title: We took the TRAIN from Europe to Asia
Episodes.Description: Starting at the western most train station in continental Europe, Mike and Jeff follow their phone’s directions to Asia.

Episodes.Title: A Train in Spain Is Never Plain…
Episodes.Description: Spain shows Mike and Jeff that a model train can deliver cocktails and the biggest tourist attraction is a construction site.

Episodes.Title: Navigating the Mediterranean
Episodes.Description: Following the Mediterranean coastline, Mike and Jeff get a glimpse at the life of the rich and famous.

Episodes.Title: Italy Is Another World
Episodes.Description: Mike discovers life in a city with no roads while Jeff struggles to stay awake.

Episodes.Title: Eating Schnitzel but Hungary Is Next…
Episodes.Description: Mike and Jeff discover the importance of Schnitzel, then cross from Pest into Buda before discussing about Jeff's health.

Episodes.Title: No Time for a BuchaREST This Close to the End…
Episodes.Description: After a long journey across Europe, Mike and Jeff part ways, leaving Mike to get to Asia by himself in this final episode.

Entries.Title: The Fixer
Entries.Description: In this new FOX reality series, The Fixer, successful business investor and entrepreneur Marcus Lemonis puts his money to work and uses his signature 3 P’s philosophy – People, Process, and Product – to empower businesses to thrive.  In each episode, Lemonis meets with business owners from across the country whose companies are at a crossroad and need to make impactful changes. Struggling with tough decisions and looking for direction, he’ll assess their prospects and pick one business in the hope that they will all make a profit. As they address extraordinary challenges together in a revealing behind-the-scenes journey to success, they will benefit from Marcus’s candid instruction and business know-how in an effort to seek an investment.

Episodes.Title: Perspirology
Episodes.Description: Marcus helps a dance and trampoline-based fitness studio.

Episodes.Title: Jazz Audio
Episodes.Description: Marcus helps a car audio and accessories store.

Episodes.Title: Fluffology
Episodes.Description: Marcus helps a pet grooming and wellness salon elevating the standard in grooming and nutrition.

Episodes.Title: Popinsanity
Episodes.Description: Marcus helps an artisanal gourmet popcorn manufacturer and distributor.

Episodes.Title: Tipsy Tie Dye
Episodes.Description: Marcus helps a company which offers DIY tie dye experiences and parties for people of all ages.

Episodes.Title: Kreme & Krumb
Episodes.Description: Marcus helps a boutique ice cream shop known for its handcrafted, seasonal flavors.

Episodes.Title: Good Quality Human
Episodes.Description: Marcus helps a clothing retailer and lifestyle brand inspiring kindness through hats and garments.

Episodes.Title: Healthy Italia
Episodes.Description: Marcus helps a multi-faceted culinary space offering cooking classes, prepared foods, catering, private events and retail products from Italy.

Entries.Title: Harlem Ice
Entries.Description: Follow the girls of Figure Skating in Harlem as they prepare for competitions, performances and a life changing global experience. Through their eyes, experience the highs and lows of the FSH Season, and the unique experiences they have as girls of color breaking the ice ceiling and gaining access to a global stage.

Episodes.Title: Harlem Ice
Episodes.Description: Pressure mounts as the last competition approaches. Can the girls medal, despite a major setback?

Episodes.Title: Olympic Dreams
Episodes.Description: After a disappointing end to the competition season, Adrianna wants to prove herself on Olympic ice.

Episodes.Title: Big News
Episodes.Description: Nerves are high as the girls compete for coveted Ice Show solos and spots on the international trip.

Episodes.Title: Show Stoppers
Episodes.Description: The girls spread their wings at the Ice Show and anticipate the big international trip.

Episodes.Title: My Power
Episodes.Description: The girls embark on a life-changing trip. Back in Harlem, they look toward their futures.

Episodes.Description: Desi Nuskhe (2025)

Entries.Title: An Update on Our Family
Entries.Description: Myka and James Stauffer were the picture of the 21st century American Dream: happy marriage, beautiful kids, and a self-built YouTube vlogging empire. At the center of it all was Huxley, an adorable young boy they adopted from China. Huxley was more than just their star — he was their son. Until one day, he wasn’t.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Our Family
Episodes.Description: After growing their YouTube channel, popular vloggers Myka and James Stauffer announce their plan to adopt a child from China.

Episodes.Title: Damn Good Mom
Episodes.Description: Though the adoption helps grow the Stauffers’ channel, after two years, Huxley suddenly disappears and all videos of him go private.

Episodes.Title: Where's Huxley?
Episodes.Description: With fans and the press concerned about Huxley’s welfare, the Stauffers finally update their followers.

Entries.Title: The Curious Case of...
Entries.Description: Take a deep dive into real-life scandals, exposing bizarre secrets, shattered lives, and twisted motives. Led by Beth Karas, each gripping story uncovers deceit, greed, and manipulation, proving truth is far more chilling than fiction.

Episodes.Title: Bam Margera
Episodes.Description: As Bam grapples with addiction, BJ attacks the motives of his conservator.

Episodes.Title: The Girl Who Died Twice
Episodes.Description: In 1981, 13-year-old Mary Day vanishes, and investigators suspect her stepfather may have killed her, but they never recover her body. Decades later, a woman claiming to be Mary appears, stirring suspicion and debate. Is this Mary Day or an imposter?

Episodes.Title: The Orphan Impostor
Episodes.Description: Master conman Nicholas Rossi fakes his death to evade justice, adopts new identities and leaves a trail of alleged crimes across continents. Now resurfaced as "Arthur Knight," he spins his most audacious con in court.

Episodes.Title: The Funeral Home of Horrors
Episodes.Description: Jon and Carie Hallford's "Return to Nature" promises eco-friendly care but instead leaves bodies decomposing in filth and provides families with concrete instead of ashes. When investigators arrive, the Hallfords flee, leaving families demanding justice and answers.

Episodes.Title: Jodi Hildebrandt
Episodes.Description: Therapist Jodi Hildebrandt's crusade against masturbation drives a wedge between couples in crisis. She forms a dark alliance with Mormon mommy vlogger Ruby Franke, but a horrifying 911 call exposes the depths of their bizarre beliefs.

Episodes.Title: The Doomsday Cat Cult
Episodes.Description: Preacher Sheryl Ruthven, a self-proclaimed prophet, beguiles her followers into subservience and uses them to settle personal scores. As her beliefs grow increasingly bizarre, she demands her congregation adopt cats, believing the animals' souls will save them in the impending apocalypse. Her manipulation drives followers into intense isolation, financial ruin, and bizarre rituals, tearing families apart and exploiting loyalty - all under the promise of salvation

Entries.Title: Scamanda
Entries.Description: Docuseries based on the podcast of the same name. The story of Amanda Riley — a wife, mother, blogger and Christian — whose tragic cancer tale captivates thousands. But Amanda has a secret that she's dying to keep, and after an anonymous tip to an investigative reporter, her own words may prove to be her downfall.

Episodes.Title: Stage 1: Perfect Wife, Perfect Life
Episodes.Description: A beautiful young mother is given a devastating cancer diagnosis; her community and church rally around her as she inspires thousands more with a blog, bravely chronicling her journey.

Episodes.Title: Stage 2: All About Amanda
Episodes.Description: Amanda Riley's cancer tale captivates thousands, but a tip to a reporter may be her downfall.

Episodes.Title: Stage 3: The Wheels of Justice
Episodes.Description: The IRS takes an interest in Amanda's blog, tracing the money that came through Amanda's website and subpoenaing years and years of Amanda's medical files.

Episodes.Title: Stage 4: Catch Me If You Cancer
Episodes.Description: The walls close in around Amanda. As friends and supporters get letters from the Department of Justice, Amanda continues to insist that she has cancer. When charges are filed, Amanda has her day in court.

Entries.Title: Weird Kids
Entries.Description: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe deep dive into their lives as the Weird Kids! This is a formal invitation to all the misfits, outcasts, and weirdos to take a seat at our table and join these former child actors as they embrace their unique upbringings and celebrate all things weird and wonderful.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Weird Kids
Episodes.Description: Welcome to the world of Weird Kids! Join Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe as they discuss growing up as child actors in Hollywood, and how they learned to re-discover a passion for storytelling as adults. They'll also take a walk down memory lane and show you all some of the comical commercials they starred in as children!

Episodes.Title: Toys and Tiny Things
Episodes.Description: From Care Bears to Polly Pocket; Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe talk toys that hit every Millennial’s nostalgia nerve. Of course this is through the lens of Hollywood Christmas parties where one could win entire toy runs in carnival games or get gifted all of the sci-fi Japanese toys bought for your character's space station bedroom.

Episodes.Title: Don’t Let Me Die in the Valley
Episodes.Description: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe entone about embalming, epitaphs, and unearthly things in this episode about death. To lighten the mood, they “touch grass"" by taking a field trip to “Vulture Culture Oddities,” a macabre shop in Burbank for taxidermy and other memento mori owned by a friend of Taliesin.

Episodes.Title: Blankets, Pillows, & Ouija
Episodes.Description: Come get cozy with Taliesin Jaffe and Ashley Johnson as they discuss everything from comfy socks to not sleeping because of persistent thoughts. Of course a sleepover show wouldn’t be complete without reading fortunes on Taliesin’s over-the-top “Ouija like” Ka Bala séance game.

Episodes.Title: Snake, Rattle, & Roll
Episodes.Description: It’s a timewarp of an episode here at Weird Kids as Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe catch up after the holidays. These proud maximalists celebrate their love of meaningful possessions as Taliesin discusses his treasured great-grandmother's portrait (that was once fished out of the Thames river) and Ashley has a ""share and tell"" featuring her swag bag from the grand opening of Disneyland's Indiana Jones ride.

Episodes.Title: Saturdays, Mornings, & Cartoons
Episodes.Description: Taliesin Jaffe and Ashley Johnson stay in their PJs and return to simpler times with this ode to Saturday morning cartoons. Name drops abound when these shows aren't just what you woke up to, but where you worked.

Episodes.Title: Punk is a Four Letter Word
Episodes.Description: Taliesin Jaffe takes a look back with Ashley Johnson to reminisce about the Punk and Goth scenes of Los Angeles in the 80’s and 90’s. From dead clowns on display and shoelace codes to noise rooms and stompy boot music, join the Weird Kids as they dive into the lost privacy of counterculture youthhood.

Episodes.Title: Trains, Trains, & Automo-Trains
Episodes.Description: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe love trains! They love miniature toy train sets that turn an entire room into a model town. They love large rideable trains, like the ones at the “Los Angeles Live Steamers Railroad Museum” that they frequent. They love full-size trains and the trips they’ve taken in them in Scotland and Machu Picchu.

Episodes.Title: Found Things & Strings
Episodes.Description: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe share old mementos and show new toys. Taliesin brings to the table the string toys he played with back before the dawn of time; while Ashley reminisces about her filming history at Pinewood Studios.

Episodes.Title: World Wide Weird
Episodes.Description: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe remember the world before the world wide web and then login to the early days of the future. Taliesin, our resident ancient one, of course was an early adopter; using Bulletin Board Systems and Newsgroups to find raves. Ashley, on the other hand, discovered the internet through AOL CDs and proceeded to do what we all did: catfish via chatroom.

Episodes.Title: Mega Weird Kids Challenge
Episodes.Description: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe are all over the place, both literally and figuratively, talking about their recent trips and expounding on a litany of topics. Taliesin reminisces on lost friends, death museums and his hometown: Disneyland. Ashley shows a tape from her childhood where she competed on the game show “Star Kid Challenge” at Universal Studios.

Episodes.Title: Musings on Amusing Museums
Episodes.Description: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe are off to take a field trip to The Museum of Jurassic Technology in Culver City, California. In alignment with our Weird Kids modus operandi, this collection is one part “museum”, two parts “banal whimsy”, and three parts “no cameras allowed”; a gallery that you have to see for yourself. This perfect place to inspire conversations about art and creativity is everything our hosts need to reminisce about all of their wonderfully weird histories.

Episodes.Title: Comics, Candy, & Cuisine
Episodes.Description: Inspiration comes in many shapes and forms—including Avocado Ice Cream! Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe take a culinary-inspired stroll down memory lane, from the parking lot where Ashley learned to drive to Taliesin's favorite themed electronics store to the diner where all the child actors loved to flock back in the '90s. Share & Tell features a magnifying screen showcasing Dave Heatwave and a comic book with cover art inspired by Matthew Mercer. Then they dive into a taste test of candies from around the world.

Episodes.Title: Clickbait
Episodes.Description: SCANDAL ROCKS BEACON AS FORMER CHILD STARS SHARE SHOCKING TELL-ALL! TASH CHAT DUBBED MUST CATCH! Ripped from the Headlines! Too scandalous for words! EXCLUSIVE: Former BFFs-turned-BITTER RIVALS Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe are BACK with another explosive episode of WEIRD KIDS! Your favorite ""will they/won't they"" co-hosts turned frenemies get real with each other and with audiences around the world. Taliesin's SECRET CRIMINAL PAST as an underground bootlegger EXPOSED! Ashley's DEVASTATING tabloid trauma from the 90's leaves audiences STUNNED! The Copywriter who wrote this CONFESSES to resorting to cheap sensationalism and lazy TITILLATION! What other salacious details await? Will tears be shed? Will hearts be broken? Will rage-bating and click-farming finally gain acceptance as a totally legit style of show description? TUNE IN if you DARE to witness these global influencers dish out their deepest, darkest secrets.

Episodes.Title: Our Chemical Romance
Episodes.Description: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe discuss depression, mental illness, and therapy in this heavier episode. They note that: “Even in the best of times, we are all a little bit broken” and talk about that's ok and tools they use to help.

Episodes.Title: Weird In Japan
Episodes.Description: Our wandering Weird Kid is back! Taliesin Jaffe returns from his epic 10-day Japan adventure through Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka and Ashley Johnson (who's been there too!) wants to hear ALL about it! Get ready for stories about his favorite Japanese moments, the souvenirs he couldn't resist, and of course - all the amazing food & drink that made the trip unforgettable

Episodes.Title: In Front of a Live Studio Audience
Episodes.Description: From Growing Pains to She's the Sheriff, Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe are here to fill you in on what it was really like to be a child actor in a sitcom! From P.E. classes with the boys of Home Improvement to sneaking into Universal Studios during lunch to LITERAL KIDNAPPING…they're ready to share all the juicy details - with a few commercial breaks of course.

Episodes.Title: The Weird Kids Down Under
Episodes.Description: G’day mates! Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe return from their travels to Australia! From the vegemite covered food, to the magic shops, to opal museums, to cute & deadly animals, we have the photos and stories to PROVE IT.  …Like seriously, there might be TOO many cute animals in this installment. Don’t say we didn’t warn you.

Episodes.Title: Make It Fashion
Episodes.Description: Strike a pose, dahlings. Your fave fashion friends, Taliesin Jaffe and Ashley Johnson, talk all things stylin’ in this episode of Weird Kids. From the designers and media that inspire them, to breaking down fashion trends, your local iconoclasts dish out the goods on why to look your best. So put on your best smize and sashay away beautifuls!

Episodes.Title: Hollyweird
Episodes.Description: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe are here to talk about their time on the big screen! From tricking little Ashley into thinking she'd never see Jean-Claude Van Damme again to Roy Scheider accidentally almost drowning little Taliesin in ocean riptides, they've got some pretty wild stories to share! Just don't ask them to do a press junket about it... apparently those are kind of a drag.

Episodes.Title: Tinkerin’ with Toys
Episodes.Description: Let's tinker with toys and chat! Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe attempt to master Taliesin's latest science toy, the Makey Makey, as they ramble about life, artwork, their favorite toys, and the best places to find weird cool stuff!.

Episodes.Title: Mega Mail Bag
Episodes.Description: It’s pen pal time with Ashley Johnson, Taliesin Jaffe, and you! Our Weird Kids dig into the Mail Bag to answer YOUR weird questions about everything from strange recurring dreams to personal mottos to even imaginary friends! And if that’s not enough, they also put their building skills to the test with a surprise made out of LEGO-like LUMIBRICKS (formerly known as FUNWHOLE).

Episodes.Title: A Riegel Affair
Episodes.Description: Emmy Award-winning (™) actor Sam Riegel joins Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe to share his unique upbringing as a fellow Weird Kid! With a national tour of Les Misérables, high paying Pizza Hut commercials, and a ride or die college a cappella group, Sam's childhood was anything but ordinary!

Episodes.Title: The Weirdy Awards
Episodes.Description: Welcome to the first annual(?) Weirdy Awards, where Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe hand out awards for all things weird, wonderful, and wet? You won’t want to miss out on who takes home our hand crafted Weirdy Awards. There are even a few controversial and unexpected winners! But in the end, it’s really an honor just to be nominated in this, our final episode of Season 1!

Entries.Description: The skies above our planet never stop moving. Wind, rain, drought and blizzards shape the lives of every living thing. As weather sweeps across four continents, creatures find ingenious solutions to survive our planet's wild sky.

Entries.Title: Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk
Entries.Description: Centers on Kirk Cameron and puppet Iggy, as they interact with other animated puppets, run into fun guest stars, and deal with a topic that builds character.

Episodes.Title: Injured Bird
Episodes.Description: A planned fishing trip is put on hold when Mr. Kirk and Iggy find an injured bird in the treehouse. Iggy faces a choice between his own desires and caring for a small creature in need.

Episodes.Description: When Carlos spills an embarrassing secret about Iggy, Iggy tries to get him back through elaborate pranks and lies. Can the two friends learn to forgive and restore their friendship before it's too late? To help Iggy out, he and Mr. Kirk read through "The Fox, the Fair and the Invention Scare."

Episodes.Title: Club I.G.G.Y.
Episodes.Description: Annie, Sydney, and Carlos are all having fun in Club I.G.G.Y., that is until Iggy starts kicking out members one by one. Is this the end of their friendship or can Iggy learn what it means to be a good friend?

Episodes.Title: Nice, Likable, Human Boy
Episodes.Description: All Iggy wants is to be a part of Mr. Kirk's family. But when Culture the Vulture lies to him, Iggy tries to fit in by changing everything about himself. Will Iggy learn that Mr. Kirk loves him just as he is, or will the new Iggy win out?

Episodes.Title: Invisibility Ring
Episodes.Description: Culture tricks Iggy into making a bad trade (Iggy's sunglasses for a fake invisibility ring). Now, it looks like Iggy may never see them again, while Mr. Kirk helps him learn about discernment.

Episodes.Title: Airplane Uh Oh
Episodes.Description: After breaking Mr. Kirk's plane, Iggy runs away. Can he see he's loved and forgiven no matter what?

Episodes.Title: Scary Storm

Episodes.Title: Cookie Jar

Entries.Title: Filthy Fortunes
Entries.Description: Across the United States, unclaimed valuables lie buried within ordinary people's attics, basements and garages. Matt Paxton  travels around the country in search of rare, big-ticket items hidden in some of the most cluttered, filthy homes imaginable. His priority is to clean out the overloaded properties and sell his finds as quickly and for as much money as possible to secure the ultimate payday for him and his clients.

Episodes.Title: Betting Big on Little Balls
Episodes.Description: In a modern-day treasure hunt, Matt Paxton, the "King of Hoards," gambles that he can clean out dangerously cluttered homes and find hidden riches; Matt and his team search for a vintage Mustang, military artifacts, and a $60,000 marble collection.

Episodes.Title: Hunting for Silver Bullets
Episodes.Description: Matt tackles a dangerous, ten-acre hoard in the Pennsylvania woods to hunt high-value guns and ammo; the old-school machinist's property is packed with heavy equipment and scrap metal, but $25,000 worth of precious metal could make a bet pay off.

Episodes.Title: Dirt Bike Pay Dirt
Episodes.Description: Matt addresses two hoards in California; he searches for classic motorcycles in one hazardous site and rare toys in another location; time constraints are a factor.

Episodes.Title: Amping up the Mess and Money
Episodes.Description: Matt takes on a rock star mess to find classic guitars and amps, vintage trucks and rare Harleys; the hoard's heavy metal puts the team at risk.

Episodes.Title: All the Smoke or Going Broke
Episodes.Description: Matt must turn BBQ smokers into big bucks at a Texas-sized mess in Houston, Texas; at a second job, a massive termite infestation could eat the profits.

Episodes.Title: Digging for Man Cave Treasure
Episodes.Description: Matt hunts for rare liquor, hand-rolled cigars and vintage drums in two California hoards. When the owners refuse to part with key items, Matt's bottom line is threatened. A baseball pennant misprint could be a huge score.

Episodes.Title: On a Mission for G.I. Dough
Episodes.Description: Matt and his troops head to the Pacific Northwest to search a three-barn hoard loaded with U.S. military treasures, including Willy's Jeeps and vintage uniforms. A biohazard mess hides first-generation computers and video equipment at a second location.

Episodes.Title: The Maine State of Cash
Episodes.Description: In the largest hoard he's ever tackled, Matt must find rare military plane parts, vintage records and a hidden jewelry cache to have a shot at making a profit. He brings in heavy equipment to clear the property and dig for big-ticket items.

Entries.Title: Outlores
Entries.Description: In the chaotic world of John Pork lore, some characters are crowned as icons… and others are cast aside. The Outlores is a surreal, emotional, and sometimes gritty anthology series that dives into the stories of those who were never “in the lore.” Each episode follows a different outcast, each with their own twisted journey of fame, failure, and obsession with belonging. Raheem Rat, Silas Viper, Quandale Dingle, Purr Purr Patapim and the lore

Episodes.Title: Raheem Rat
Episodes.Description: In the slums of India, Raheem Rat fights to survive and be heard. Laughed at and dismissed as a meme, Raheem dreams of one thing—lore acceptance. With a heart full of purpose, he roams the broken streets, searching for someone who believes he belongs. But in a world that mocks him, Raheem must prove that even a rat can rise.

Episodes.Title: Quandale Dingle
Episodes.Description: Once the face of the internet, Quandale Dingle now lives in the shadow of his former fame. Forgotten and outcast, he schemes his way through fake cameos and viral stunts, desperately trying to slide back into the lore. But clout comes with a price—and Quandale's past might just catch up with him.

Episodes.Title: Purr Purr Patapim
Episodes.Description: A near-perfect copy of the infamous Simon Claw, Purr Purr Patapim sets out with his crew—Tralalelo, Trallala, and Tung Tung Sauhr—on a quest to create their own version of legacy. But imitation isn't always flattery... especially when the original is watching.

Episodes.Title: Silas Viper
Episodes.Description: Silas Viper tells everyone he's in the lore. He acts like he is. Dresses like he is. But the truth? He's never been close. As a web of lies starts to crumble, Silas must choose between keeping up appearances or admitting he's never belonged—and maybe never will.

Episodes.Title: Hank Grizzle
Episodes.Description: Everyone says Hank Grizzle isn’t in the lore. But what if he always was? Calm, quiet, and calculated—Hank has watched from the sidelines, moving pieces without ever being noticed. Now, the shadows talk... and Hank steps forward to remind everyone who he really is.

Episodes.Title: The Lore
Episodes.Description: Time is running out. A literal living clock—The Lore—emerges to set the record straight. The final episode brings every thread together as the characters must confront the truth: what does it really mean to be in the lore... and who decides?

Entries.Title: Two Men on a Bike
Entries.Description: Best mates David Baddiel and Hugh Dennis pedal through France's luscious landscape, as they explore the stunning local sights, get up to mischief and have a good old chat along the way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: David and Hugh begin their journey in the beautiful seaside resort of Arcachon, before taking in Bordeaux's stunning waterfront and delicious seafood, and exploring the historic Garonne canal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: David and Hugh explore the Canal de Garonne, discover the only Rembrandt that's not in a museum, and head through Moissac into Toulouse, where they find a priceless artefact underneath the Basilica.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: David and Hugh cycle the Canal du Midi, gatecrash a local fiesta in Seuil de Naurouze and dine in the cassoulet capital of the world, before arriving at the medieval citadel of Carcassonne.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: David and Hugh head to the pretty port of Le Somail, pedal through Beziers and enjoy some wine and cheese at a Languedoc vineyard, before their final push to the town of Sète.
