Entries.Title: Honestly Cavallari: The Headline Tour
Entries.Description: TV personality Kristin Cavallari takes her hit podcast "Let's Be Honest" on the road. Each episode of the series will feature candid conversations with famous friends, Bravolebrities, memorable exes and other notable celebs from Kristin's life as they unfold the stories behind their buzziest headlines - and make new ones - with jaw-dropping revelations that set the record straight. Guests will be revealed in real time as they surprise the audience at each live show. With stops in Atlanta, Chicago, Boston and New York, the series will also follow Kristin off the stage as she explores local hot spots in each city with her friends and podcast guests.

Episodes.Title: Headlines and Heartbreak
Episodes.Description: Kristin Cavallari is fed up with clickbait headlines so she's taking matters into her own hands; first in Atlanta with guest Kim Zolciak, where they discuss what it's like to be a mom while going through a public divorce.

Episodes.Title: Laguna Breach (Of Trust)
Episodes.Description: Night two of the tour is a big one for Kristin as she gears up for the Windy City and a high school reunion like no other with her friends from Laguna Beach; the old classmates catch up and spill some 20+ year secrets.

Episodes.Title: Too Hot to Handle the Headlines
Episodes.Description: Kristin has to quickly regroup for her second show of the night in her hometown of Chicago; Harry Jowsey helps Kristin reset the vibe; a blast from Kristin's past makes her question why she's been drawn to certain men.

Episodes.Title: More Than a WAG
Episodes.Description: On her day off in Chicago, Kristin checks in on her Uncommon James store followed by a dinner with friends that takes a turn; her entourage heads to Boston where Camille Kostek joins her on stage.

Episodes.Title: Southern Un-Charmed
Episodes.Description: Kristin's alleged party girl ways lead to some charming headlines with Bravo's Craig and Austen; Kristin attempts to clear up the gossip with the "Southern Charm" cast in Boston.

Episodes.Title: Last Night in the Ring
Episodes.Description: Kristin's headline tour comes to an end at her biggest show yet in New York; a low-energy crowd leaves Kristin and her final guests, Brie and Nikki Bella, wrestling to amp up the audience.

Entries.Title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
Entries.Description: A look at the most incredible escapes and audacious escape attempts of World War 2. There are tales of ingenious plans, calculated schemes, bravery, selfless heroism and the always unrelenting human spirit that refused to concede.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Revisit Colditz Castle, a Nazi fortress where breakouts featured human catapults and clever disguises. Meet the pilots who staged the famed Great Escape from a Polish stalag, then see how 32 POWs pulled off the Warburg Wire Job in just one minute.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Relive the Flight of the Crow, an adrenalin-soaked trek across Nazi-occupied Europe. Find out how two Austrian mountaineers hiked their way out of the Himalayas, then learn why 378 Japanese POWs risked it all in Australia’s bloody Cowra Breakout.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Examine how German soldiers used an erotic painting and other decoys to distract their captors as they tunnelled out of Island Farm POW camp in Wales. See how American bombardiers were smuggled out of Russia, and study a wartime Trojan Horse plot.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Look at the bloody mass uprising that showed the world the truth about the Nazis’ secret Sobibor death camp. Learn how the Davao Dozen broke out of a harsh Japanese penal colony and explore how two plucky German pilots plotted to get out of Britain.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Dig into a thrilling escape orchestrated by two German submariners who went underground in the American desert. Meet a charming German fighter pilot who became a celebrity in enemy territory and explore a tale of two lovers who escaped Auschwitz.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Track German tank commander Georg Gaertner, who vanished from a US POW camp and eluded the FBI for 40 years. Learn how two escaped Auschwitz prisoners helped save countless lives and how Nazi officer Adolf Eichmann was finally brought to justice.

Entries.Title: Found Footage Finds
Entries.Description: A docuseries presented in found footage style, exploring the world of found footage and fake documentary movies. Each episode is broken down by subgenre, featuring recommendations, filmmaker interviews, and historical & behind-the-scenes information.

Episodes.Title: Bigfoot
Episodes.Description: Discussing the history of Bigfoot found footage film from the Patterson-Gimlin footage to modern FF films. With guest filmmakers Corey Grant, Dillon Brown, Jason Mills, and Mathew Fisher.

Episodes.Title: Screenlife
Episodes.Description: Discussing the history of Screenlife found footage film from The Collingswood Story to the films of Timur Bekmambetov. With guest filmmakers Michelle Iannantuono, Monica LaVella, Navin Ramaswaran, Matthew Toronto, Louie La Vella, and Jeremy Wechter.

Episodes.Title: Zombies
Episodes.Description: Discussing the history of Zombie found footage films from George A. Romero to V/H/S/2. With guest filmmakers Simone Kisiel, Richard Raaphorst, Robert Palmer, and Doron Paz.

Episodes.Title: Into the Woods
Episodes.Description: Discussing the history of found footage films in the woods from The Blair Witch Project to the generations of rip-offs and homages. With guest filmmakers Aaron Irons, William Howard III, Richard Parry, and Howie Askins.

Episodes.Title: Reality TV & Newscasts
Episodes.Description: Discussing the history of Reality TV & Newscast found footage films from Citizen Kane to Series 7: The Contenders. With guest filmmakers Lesley Manning, Jay Lender, Tom Seidman, and Dominic O'Neill.

Entries.Title: Ask Hank Anything
Entries.Description: A new show where celebrity guests ask Hank Green questions, he does his best to answer them, and they learn a little bit about each other in the process.

Episodes.Description: Rhett and Link join Hank to ask him about laying eggs, turning bread into gold, and weaponized laughter.

Episodes.Title: What Does Hank Think is the Coolest Fact?
Episodes.Description: Michelle Khare joins Hank to ask him about homing pigeons, knocker-uppers, and why our days are getting longer

Episodes.Title: What Is The Future of Creativity & Empathy?
Episodes.Description: Jacob Collier joins Hank to ask him how we feel the wind, what the future of carbon removal looks like, and if creativity can be measured.

Episodes.Title: Is Putting a Laptop On Your Balls Safe?
Episodes.Description: Ludwig joins Hank to ask him how his laptop could affect his fertility, what will happen if he shaves his head, and why he has to register his car.

Episodes.Title: Why do British People Sing in American Accents?
Episodes.Description: Akilah joins Hank to ask him why British musicians sing with American accents, if we will ever have flying cars, and what weed is doing to our brains?

Episodes.Title: What is the Weirdest Amphibian?
Episodes.Description: Brian David Gilbert joins Hank to ask him how we make a creature as big as Godzilla, how to impress an alien, and what is the weirdest amphibian?

Episodes.Title: Are baths dirty?
Episodes.Description: Jarvis Johnson joins Hank to ask him where DVD commentaries went, how to know when you're clean, how much power does the royal family have, and are sponges gross?

Episodes.Title: Vic Doesn’t Ask A Single Question
Episodes.Description: Vic Michaelis joins Hank to ask him if GMOs are bad, who has the most DNA, and if he will tell them a secret?

Entries.Title: Parent Wars
Entries.Description: Diving into the chaos, conflicts and comedy of modern parenting. From sideline meltdowns to schoolyard standoffs, and clashes with cops, coaches and even fellow parents, these viral moments reveal just how far parents will go to defend their kids. Packed with unbelievable footage and unexpected twists, "Parent Wars" delivers an unfiltered look at the highs, lows and absurdity of raising the next generation.

Episodes.Title: The Parent Snap
Episodes.Description: A dad fights for his daughter's rights to ride a ride; a mother defends her daughter in the porta potty line at a concert; a stranger learns...

Episodes.Title: Parents Gone Wild
Episodes.Description: Parents clash in wild, chaotic ways; from smashing school bus windows and tackling strangers to brawling at graduations and football games; chaos erupts as emotions run high!

Episodes.Title: Dial M For Mom
Episodes.Description: A dad abuses his power as a police officer to pull over his daughter's boyfriend; in Connecticut two moms throw down at the skatepark and end up in handcuffs; in Georgia, a mom destroys her kids' phones violently.

Episodes.Title: Do You Know Who My Dad Is?
Episodes.Description: In Virginia, parents come to blows at an amusement park, over cutting in line; in Las Vegas a mom runs onto a sports field to defend her son; a mom in Texas narrowly escapes her burning car with her child in tow by leaping into traffic.

Episodes.Title: Family Feuds
Episodes.Description: A Los Angeles mother threatens a man, allegedly over a parking spot, while another mom gets arrested for interfering in her son's traffic stop; two parents learn a scary lesson about gun safety, and a father in New Mexico gets caught shoplifting.

Episodes.Title: Dropoff Drama
Episodes.Description: In Florida, some parents overreact when their kids are fined by police; a girl in the Keys learns that a rich dad can't get you out of every situation; a father kidnaps his son and takes police on a car chase before a parking lot showdown.

Episodes.Title: Big Kids, Bigger Problems
Episodes.Description: In Illinois, one man calls his mother for help after he flees the scene of a car crash; in Colorado, a father saves his son from a car crash inside a donut shop; in Minneapolis, a 10-year-old drives a car through a park full of kids.

Episodes.Title: Grad Party Gone Wrong
Episodes.Description: A dad shows up to his son's homecoming after a few drinks; some high schoolers get busted at a grad party and a grown man gets rear-ended by his mother; in New Jersey, a mom steals a stroller while another leaves something very important behind.

Episodes.Title: Tough Love, Hot Temper
Episodes.Description: A mom in Ohio has some tough love for her son after he's pulled over by police and a little girl prevents catastrophe by alerting her father about a fire.

Episodes.Title: Parenting Under Pressure
Episodes.Description: In Mississippi, a woman yells at a new mother as her baby cries in a restaurant and another mother defends her daughter in a grocery store.

Episodes.Title: Parental Timeout
Episodes.Description:
In New York a mom fights off a would-be abductor, while in California, a mom speaks to her daughter’s class about bullying. In Kentwood, Michigan, bus drivers coordinate to save an allegedly kidnapped child.

Episodes.Title: When Mom Gives You Lemons
Episodes.Description: In Ocala Florida, one dad boards a school bus to confront the teacher who punished his son, and a woman brings her child’s stroller into a mall fight. In Irvine California, a woman calls the cops when she sees some kids selling lemonade.

Episodes.Title: Parenthood Pandemonium
Episodes.Description: In Wisconsin, a mom loses her cool when police remove her children from her care while on a boat, and a father and son take police on a high-speed chase that ends in a fiery crash. In New York, a mom gets heated after flight delays risk her vacation.

Episodes.Title: Raising Chaos
Episodes.Description: In Pompano Beach FL, a dad misleads the police after his son is allegedly drinking. In Myrtle Beach, parents find themselves locked out of their kids’ graduation and meltdown, while another mom confronts some teens at the swimming pool

Episodes.Title: Toddler on the Run
Episodes.Description: In West Palm Beach a daughter helps her mother fight off a would-be purse snatcher, while elsewhere in Florida, a couple who inadvertently locked their baby in the backseat receive help from an unusual source.

Episodes.Title: Emergency Parenting
Episodes.Description: In Ohio, a mom allegedly strikes a parked car and flees, only to find that her two-year-old child appears to be missing. In Alaska, a dad rushes to protect his kids during a severe earthquake.

Entries.Title: Investigation Shark Attack
Entries.Description: A team of scientists examine these apex predators from a shark’s point of view, revealing triggers, behaviors, and high-risk zones from Shark HQ.

Episodes.Title: California Great Whites
Episodes.Description: While investigating why great white shark encounters are rising in California, the team asks if humans and great whites can safely coexist.

Episodes.Title: Tigers in Hawaii
Episodes.Description: Three surfers and a kayaker encounter tiger sharks off Oahu. The team investigates their hunting patterns to see what’s causing these incidents.

Episodes.Title: Bitten in the Bahamas
Episodes.Description: Sharks in the Bahamas threaten its most popular attraction - tourism. The team reveals factors that lead Bahama sharks to mistake humans for prey.

Episodes.Title: Gulf Trouble
Episodes.Description: A rash of attacks in the Gulf of Mexico spark a major investigation. The team studies these super-rare encounters from a shark’s perspective.

Episodes.Title: Florida's Bite Capital
Episodes.Description: The team investigates a string of incidents in Florida to discover what makes a short stretch of beach the ‘shark bite capital of the world.'

Episodes.Title: Maui Mayhem
Episodes.Description: The team investigates incidents off Maui—in peak tourist season—to discover why this island has more shark encounters than the entire Hawaiian chain.

Entries.Title: Queendom Come
Entries.Description: Queendom is a cross-world/high fantasy series about a young, black woman, Sariya, who is struggling to build the typical American dream life when she soon discovers that she is anything but typical.

Episodes.Title: Happy Birthday
Episodes.Description: “Happy Birthday” - Sariya's stagnant life is disrupted by a series of events: from a birthday marred by loss to a failed attempt to reunite with her ex. Amidst her emotional turmoil, a mysterious candle and a chance encounter offer unexpected hope in her darkest hour.

Episodes.Title: Sercret AF
Episodes.Description: “Secret AF” - Sariya's day turns eerie when her disheveled ex appears. But Chelsea has her back, doesn't she? A perplexing therapy session drives Sariya to uncover ancient relics and a locked book left by her grandmother, revealing more questions about her past.

Episodes.Title: Awaken
Episodes.Description: “Awaken” - Sariya's dream visit from Gran leads to a haunting transformation, unveiling a hidden realm and family secrets. With Chelsea's guidance, she meets Zidia, who unveils powers tied to dark rituals, unsettling Sariya.

Episodes.Title: Something New, Something Wicked
Episodes.Description: “Something New, Something Wicked” - After witnessing a disturbing ritual, Sariya finds solace with Luke at a cafe. Zidia's witches appear to warn her about the dangers of her power. Seeking control over her abilities, Sariya confronts Zidia, despite her reluctance to teach further.

Episodes.Title: Laundry and Chill
Episodes.Description: “Laundry and Chill” - Suspicious of their frequent encounters, Sariya runs into Luke at her laundromat. They find solace at his apartment, deepening their bond. Meanwhile, Luke navigates a perplexing time loop until Sariya's therapist releases him, unlocking his latent powers.

Episodes.Title: Ride or Die
Episodes.Description: “Ride or Die": - Sariya prepares for a date with Luke when Phantom abducts Chelsea, leading Sariya to face The Chemist, who killed her Gran. With Luke's help, she taps into her ancestral power, saving them. Embracing her destiny, she vows to protect Ethos and the throne.

Episodes.Description: Cody Rhodes, Sami Zayn, Becky Lynch and more encounter numerous roadblocks on Raw en route to WrestleMania 40.

Entries.Title: #Somebody's Son
Entries.Description: Three charming, single, and successful men embark on a high stakes search for true love, with their mothers offering guidance, support, and a little drama.

Episodes.Title: #Game On
Episodes.Description: Joshua, an NFL player, and his Nigerian aunt Oma welcome four potential matches to the house. Tensions rise when Oma reveals she'll be living there too. How will the women adjust, and which first impressions will lead to an invitation to stay?

Episodes.Title: #PhotoFinish
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise as James and Charlease meet four new matches, including Alyssia, whose nightlife career raises questions. Joshua's photo shoot with the women tests their chemistry, while exposing their strengths, competitiveness and insecurities.

Episodes.Title: #MomKnowsBest
Episodes.Description: Chadd and his mother, Katina, begin their journey with four new women, but Chadd struggles with Katina's "mother knows best" approach. James and Charlease test the women's communication with a paintball activity, and the women battle for a solo date.

Episodes.Title: #JealousySparks
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise as Chadd confronts Katina about her choice to eliminate one woman. Charlease directs a couples' photo shoot, triggering jealousy in Bre'Von. As bonds are strengthened, Katina continues to push James' buttons. One woman wins a solo date.

Episodes.Title: #JealousyRises
Episodes.Description: The winner of the couples' photo shoot goes on a date with Joshua, leaving the other women plotting their next move. James deepens his bond with Alyssia during a flirtatious dinner, while one woman's jealousy causes her to spiral.

Episodes.Title: #BareItAll
Episodes.Description: Both houses participate in a vulnerable "bare it all" exercise, revealing hidden truths and stirring emotions. Joshua and James go on massage dates, and James grows closer to Sabranae. Lexi questions if Joshua is ready to be a stepfather, sparking doubts.

Episodes.Title: #VulnerableAF
Episodes.Description: Emotions run high as both houses navigate jealousy and vulnerability. Chadd enjoys a romantic massage date with Loren, leaving Jasmine upset. Meanwhile, Joshua deepens his bond with Chambriel during a heartfelt conversation about their pasts.

Episodes.Title: #TooManyMommas
Episodes.Description: A rock climbing outing with Chadd and Katina turns competitive as the women vie for attention. James and Charlease host a fish fry, but tension rises as the moms make surprise visits. Emotions reach a boiling point when Charlease must send someone home.

Episodes.Title: #FamilyDayDrama
Episodes.Description: A surprise family day shakes up both houses as loved ones arrive to offer advice. Joshua's brother challenges him about readiness for fatherhood, while Chadd's connection with Jasmine stirs controversy. An explosive discovery leaves the house reeling.

Episodes.Title: #FBoyVibes
Episodes.Description: Chadd gets caught in one woman's bed, leading to a surprise decision when Katina can only invite two ladies to stay. With Bre'Von gone, things calm down, until a game of Hopes and Dreams stirs tension between Charlease and Alyssia.

Episodes.Title: #IChooseMe
Episodes.Description: With Loren gone, Jasmine asks Chadd to be more truthful with his feelings, and his conversations have an impact on both women. Josh reveals his true profession and pays close attention to how Tamerras and Chambriel respond.

Episodes.Title: #DatingSomebodysSon
Episodes.Description: Tension brews between Charlease and James after Aylssia makes her feelings known. It's finally time for James and Josh to pick who they want to be exclusive with, but some of the women are still on the fence.

Entries.Description: Charting the rise and downfall of one of the most influential tech companies of the 21st century, this four-part series examines Twitter’s creation, rapid growth, and infamous sale; featuring exclusive insights from key players.

Episodes.Title: The Big Idea
Episodes.Description: In the heart of San Francisco, a group of young coders and designers come together to invent a new social media platform they name Twitter; built for simple status updates, Twitter quickly evolves beyond its original purpose.

Episodes.Title: Unfollowing the Leader
Episodes.Description: As Twitter transforms communication across the world, its founders fight for control of the company; once reserved for techies and celebrities, it evolves into a key platform for news and politics.

Episodes.Title: Making It Big
Episodes.Description: A new CEO takes over and brings back founder Jack Dorsey to help steer Twitter’s growth. Activism thrives as the platform becomes a revolutionary tool for change, but its darker side becomes more apparent as hate spreads.

Join Tony Harris and his team as they investigate compelling evidence of legendary creatures lurking in the world's waters and render a verdict.

Entries.Title: For the Win: NWSL
Entries.Description: An immersive docuseries offering unprecedented access into the 2024 National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL) playoffs and Championship

Episodes.Title: Chaos League
Episodes.Description: As the NWSL regular season comes to a close, teams fight for playoff spots. Orlando Pride rallies behind veteran captain Marta to finish out a historic run for the franchise, while Washington Spirit are buoyed by young stars like Trinity Rodman. Perennial powerhouse Portland Thorns travel to the star-studded defending champions Gotham FC – and the 2024 playoffs begin.

Episodes.Title: Win or Go Home
Episodes.Description: The quarterfinals are underway. A gritty Chicago Red Stars team travels to the nearly-perfect Orlando Pride. North Carolina Courage face the formidable Kansas City Current, whose success on the field has been fueled by big-time investors like Angie Long and Brittany Mahomes off the field. The Bay FC expansion side make their post-season debut against a Washington Spirit team plagued with injuries.

Episodes.Title: Semifinal Showdown
Episodes.Description: The perenially beleagured Orlando Pride continue to be the team to beat as they face off in the semis against their rival this season -- a Kansas City team who finished near the bottom of the table just last season. And the star-studded superteam, Gotham FC, give up a late goal against Washington Spirit, sending the second semifinal into penalty kicks.

Episodes.Title: Do You See Us Now?
Episodes.Description: Reigning champs Gotham FC crumble in a penalty shootout, sending Washington Spirit to the Championship match against Orlando Pride. In an NWSL season marked by the retirements of legends like Alex Morgan and Kelley O'Hara, will a young Spirit team lead the league into its next chapter? Or will 38-year-old Marta finally lift the Championship trophy after eight years in an Orlando jersey?

Entries.Title: Hell for Leather – The Story of Gaelic Football
Entries.Description:
Chronicling how the game has changed through more than a century of rebellion and revolution, bitter rivalries, triumphs, upsets and comebacks, the series is both a celebration and exploration of a unique arm of Irish life. Its powerful story is told through the testimonies of players, managers and expert commentators, captivating archive and stunning visuals.

Hell for Leather – The Story of Gaelic Football tells the story of a game born out of necessity, dreamt up by a nation in search of a social identity and an indigenous sport that could challenge the pre-eminence of foreign games. The game later took root in the northern counties and became a truly all-island proposition – a game of and for the Irish people. A sport with a presence in just about every village in Ireland, Gaelic football has a hugely important legacy – this is the story of that legacy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Episode One takes us from modern magicians to a journey back in time, to the rough and tumble origins of Gaelic Football.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Travel through the halcyon days of GAA radio, a controversial overseas odyssey & the Sam Maguire's first trip across the border.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Dublin and Kerry forge an epic rivalry, Mayo's chase for All-Ireland glory, the art of high fielding and the rise of women's football.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Waking sleeping giants, playing through the Troubles, Donegal's All-Ireland journey and the birth of modern football.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Managing pressure, getting physical, Cork's dynasty and the changing face of football.

Entries.Title: Salvage Code Red
Entries.Description: For one of the most treacherous jobs in the world, it takes a special kind of person to become a salvage expert. Whether a rookie or an old hand, they must be brave, tenacious, have great technical skill and be committed to saving crews and cargo from meeting a premature and watery end.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Point
Episodes.Description: The MSC Napoli was badly damaged by storm Kyrill and evacuated in a rescue operation, but left behind; salvaging this ship should become a complicated and expensive affair.

Episodes.Title: Blown Away
Episodes.Description: Two rookie salvage masters face a baptism of fire as a Russian freighter gets battered by typhoons in Japan and a stranded ferry in Mexico threatens a holiday playground with environmental disaster.

Episodes.Title: Dangerous Seas
Episodes.Description: Blocking a heavily-travelled ocean highway, a sunken freighter slows traffic off the coast of Gibraltar. The New Flame’s engine room – one of her most valuable assets – is miraculously dry, but water is seeping in at an alarming rate. To remove the ship, crews must cut the boat in half. Using special thermal lances, divers take on the exceptionally risky task of cutting cranes on board in preparation. But an approaching storm forces the crew to abandon ship and much of its equipment. Returning to the New Flame, the salvage team finds its equipment gone– the engine room is lost and it is now impossible to refloat the stern. The team must now race to cut up the ship and remove her piece by piece and save 30,000 tons of scrap metal worth millions of U.S. dollars. Off the coast of Japan, the Russian coal freighter Jane refuses to budge – beached throughout typhoon season and rapidly corroding. Divers must now assess whether the Jane is too damaged to refloat.

Episodes.Title: Graveyard Coast
Episodes.Description: Off the coast of Oregon, the impossible job: a veteran salver takes on a wreck that has defeated all others. Off Gibraltar, 700 tons of steel need to be lifted out of a shipping lane, testing a team of salver's engineering skills to the limit.

Episodes.Title: Deep Trouble
Episodes.Description: Oil on a sunken tanker threatens an environmental disaster; a salvage team fights to pump her dry using pioneering diving techniques as they battle ship fires and decompression sickness.

Episodes.Title: The Napoli
Episodes.Description: The battle for the MSC Napoli, her oil, and thousands of tons of cargo spilling onto British beaches and into the hands of looters. Challenging the toughest experts in the business; blasting, tearing, plunging into battle with the ship that would not die.

Entries.Title: 50 Ways to Catch a Killer
Entries.Description: Each episode offers unprecedented access into the step-by-step process of solving a murder case, from the first clue to the decisive moment that changes everything. Every story spotlights a unique tactic, expert insight or pivotal piece of evidence that ultimately leads to an arrest or conviction. From cutting-edge forensics to classic old-school detective work, each investigation reveals a different path to the truth. Jackson personally selects the cases, introduces the players, and guides viewers through the twists and turns, ending each story with an update on the defendant’s fate.

Episodes.Title: Fake ‘em Out
Episodes.Description: Laura Wallen of Columbia, Maryland and a former teacher of the year, is eagerly anticipating the start of a new school year and her upcoming engagement. That’s what makes it so shocking when she doesn’t show up for the first day of school. Unsure whether they have a missing person case, or a murder case, detectives zero in on three potential suspects. But as the case stalls and time runs out, detectives launch a bold and unconventional plan to uncover what really happened to Laura – and bring the truth to light.

Episodes.Title: Untangle the Lies

Episodes.Title: Step Back

Episodes.Title: Don't Buy the Alibi

Entries.Title: Ozark Law
Entries.Description: Join the Lake Ozark Police Department and Osage Beach Police Department on their daily patrols, witnessing firsthand the challenges they face in maintaining order and ensuring safety in this lively midwestern destination.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Lake
Episodes.Description: The 4th of July around the Lake of the Ozarks kicks off as Chief Boren and his officers meet an uncooperative bar patron who's had too much of a good time. On the highway, Officer Kale Keagy encounters a suspected drunk driver who makes an unexpected--and eyebrow-raising--demand. On the town's main drag, Officer Angel Macormic faces down a driver illegally parked in a handicap spot.

Episodes.Title: Aquapalooza
Episodes.Description: While crowds flock to the Lake of the Ozarks for the summer's annual Aquapalooza Music Festival during the day, Detective Sergeant Mark Kordula and Chief Boren face the wave of underage drinkers pouring into the bars with fake IDs at night. And Officer Phylicia Carson pulls over a suspected drunk driver.

Episodes.Title: Refusal to Comply
Episodes.Description: Summer around the Lake of the Ozarks heats up as Corporal Stephen Riner tries to stop a curious case of road rage. K9 officer Corporal Caleb Harvey and his four-legged partner, Donzi, search a vehicle they believe has narcotics. Corporal Isaiah Huff embarks on a manhunt, and a gas leak in a popular bar threatens to end Saturday night early.

Episodes.Title: Hot Summer Night
Episodes.Description: One of the summer season's seminal events, the Hot Summer Nights classic car show, rolls into town for a day of fun, but things turn really hot that night when there is an outbreak of bar fights. Officer Jonathan Rosenburg picks up a pair of underage shoplifters and gives them a valuable life lesson. Officer Phylicia Carson encounters a suspected drunk driver.

Episodes.Title: Fight on the Strip
Episodes.Description: The Lake of the Ozarks and police must keep a tight rein on folks looking to blow it out during the final weeks of the season as summer winds down. Lake Ozark PD K9 officer, Corporal Caleb Harvey stops a driver he suspects has meth. Later that night, Officer Karl Glascock must rescue a young man who has driven his brother's borrowed car into a ditch to avoid the countless deer roaming the roads. Over in Osage Beach, Corporal Stephen Riner arrests a grandmother whose record prohibits her from driving her granddaughter, and Officer Phylicia Carson pulls over a sober-ride taxi whose driver explains how his painful past led him to start his business. As the night winds down back on The Strip back in Lake Ozark, Chief James Boren confiscates the fake ID of an underaged drinker and adds it to his growing stack for the night, and Detective Sergeant Mark Kordula and Corporal Isaiah Huff desperately try to save the life of a man horrifically stabbed in a fight.

Episodes.Title: Shootout Boat Races
Episodes.Description: The action picks up both on the water and off as one of the summer's biggest events descends upon the Lake of the Ozarks: The Shootout powerboat races. As cigarette boats battle for speed supremacy on the lake, Chief Boren and Officers Glascock and Khachi meet a bar patron who insists she's done nothing wrong. Officer Jonathan Rosenburg confronts revelers on a party boat who are having too much fun, while Officer Phylicia Carson stops a driver who may have had too much of a night out on the town. As the weekend festivities unfold, Officer Matthew Johnson teams up with Camden County Sheriffs to confront an unruly hotel guest, and Corporal Isaiah Huff offers some advice to a young woman earning her first DWI.

Episodes.Title: Disturbance in Progress
Episodes.Description: As summer rolls on, the police officers try to keep the Lake of the Ozarks community safe. Detective Sergeant Mark Kordula gets called to the aid of a bloodied and concussed bar patron lying in the road. Officer Summer Phillips races to the scene of a multi-car accident at a gas station and must use the store's CCTV footage to crack the case. Officer Karl Glascock stops a nervous driver with a history of drug use who ends up in hot water. And Corporal Stephen Riner gets called to find a trespasser where his mother and stepfather unexpectedly serve as witnesses.

Episodes.Title: Crack the Case
Episodes.Description: Lost puppies, alleged pickpockets, and bachelor parties keep the officers policing the Lake of the Ozarks on their toes. On The Strip, Lake Ozark PD Detective Sergeant Mark Kordula must remove a rowdy woman causing trouble at one of the bars, but the real trouble begins back at the station when her flirtations kick into overdrive. Later that night, a bachelor party challenges Corporal Isaiah Huff to a footrace, while Chief Boren must get to the bottom of a curious confrontation over a missing wallet. In neighboring Osage Beach, Officer Nathan Verploeg rescues a lost puppy only to find her forever home, and Officer Phylicia Carson tries to unravel the mystery behind a bloody multi-vehicle accident.

Episodes.Title: Bikefest
Episodes.Description: 100,000 roaring motorcycles roll into the Lake of the Ozarks region for the seminal event of the season — the annual BikeFest motorcycle rally — and the Lake Ozark and Osage Beach Police Departments must team up with the state troopers and local county sheriff deputies to manage. In Lake Ozark, Corporal Isaiah Huff investigates whether a daytime crash between two bikers on The Strip is the result of too much to drink, while later that night, Chief James Boren tries to stop bikers from doing burn-outs when one accidentally launches his motorcycle into the crowd and sends an innocent bystander to the hospital with a horrific injury. Over in Osage Beach, Officer Summer Phillips gets a surprise when she pulls over a suspected DWI motorcyclist carrying a veiled bride on her bachelorette weekend.

Episodes.Title: End of Watch
Episodes.Description: The Lake Ozark and Osage Beach Police Departments must confront an unspeakable tragedy when one of their officers tragically dies in the line of duty.

Episodes.Title: The Hunt for the General

Episodes.Title: The Wheel

Entries.Title: Race to the Clouds
Entries.Description: Race to the Clouds chronicles professional driver Robb Holland’s high-stakes campaign at the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb—one of the most treacherous racing events on Earth. From the garage to the summit, the series captures the months of preparation, the challenges of high-altitude performance, and the final run up the 14,115-foot mountain in a quest to break the ten-minute barrier.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Robb Holland and his team prepare for Pikes Peak with months of testing, tuning, and pushing the limits of their race car at lower elevations.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As race week begins, dawn practice sessions reveal shifting weather, mechanical setbacks, and the mental toll of chasing perfection.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Race day arrives. With one chance to reach the 14,115-foot summit, Holland faces the mountain in his bid to break the ten-minute barrier.

Entries.Title: Denise Richards and Her Wild Things
Entries.Description: Hollywood icon and The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills alum Denise Richards is trying to balance it all as she navigates being an actress, wife and mother in the public eye.

Episodes.Title: Wild Beginnings
Episodes.Description: Denise Richards has played a few iconic roles in Hollywood, but her most challenging role yet is being a mother and raising her daughters.

Episodes.Title: Spelling It All Out
Episodes.Description: Denise catches up with her old friend Tori Spelling; for the first time, the two discuss a past love triangle, leaving Tori shocked.

Episodes.Title: Drop Dead Gorgeous Lizard
Episodes.Description: With Sami and Lola on better terms, Denise brings the girls together to help plan a memorial for a beloved member of the family, Godzilla, the 6-foot-long lizard; Denise meets up with RHOBH frenemy Erika Jayne.

Episodes.Title: Only Pans
Episodes.Description: Denise enlists Eloise and Sami to help with one of her fun cooking videos; Sami takes steps toward making a dream of her own come true: getting a new nose; Denise tags along for the consultation and is sworn to secrecy about the procedure.

Episodes.Title: Yes, Chef!
Episodes.Description: As Sami recovers from her nose job, Denise meets up with celebrity chef Brooke Williamson and things get hot in the kitchen; Denise also catches up with Kathy Hilton and they bond over raising kids with famous last names.

Episodes.Title: Video Killed the Movie Star
Episodes.Description: A friendly pickleball game with Denise, Aaron, Brooke Mueller and ex-boyfriend Patrick Muldoon takes a turn when someone loses a tooth; Patrick asks Denise to star in his music video.

Episodes.Title: My Dinner with Charlie
Episodes.Description: Denise and Aaron celebrate their sixth wedding anniversary and reminisce about how their relationship started; Denise and Lola join Charlie Sheen, Denise's ex and Lola's dad, for a surprising meal.

Episodes.Title: The Family that Photoshoots Together...
Episodes.Description: No stranger to the red carpet, Denise finds herself on one to support her friend Garcelle Beauvais' movie premiere; Denise is excited to do a magazine shoot with her daughters.

Entries.Description: Relive the 2005 criminal trial of the music legend and icon, Michael Jackson. Drawing upon court transcripts, hours of never-before-seen home video, and more than 30 interviews with jurors, attorneys, celebrity witnesses, reporters, and observers, this premium documentary is not just a saga about family, celebrity and the media, but also a story about how wealth, privilege, and power affected the pursuit of justice.

Entries.Title: Get Fatter Now
Entries.Description: Gilly, Nico and Franny live in a small and unassuming town and for whatever reason very few, even themselves don't seem to recognise their interstellar affliction. They may be stupid...

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Aliens Nico, Gilly and Franny accidentally get involved in a hit and run involving loving father William Denning. Shenanigans ensue as they try to revive him while keeping the cops from suspecting them.

Episodes.Title: Mr Egg
Episodes.Description: After receiving an invitation to a house warming party from their illustrious new neighbour Mr Egg, the gang soon finds out that this night, wasn't going to turn out how they thought.

Entries.Title: Talon
Entries.Description: A sci-fi/fantasy narrative set in the late Cretaceous period, focusing on a young misfit Dakotaraptor named Talon. Unlike her ferocious peers, she is intelligent, empathetic, and seeks camaraderie, setting her apart in a world governed by survival of the fittest.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Talon's unique traits attract Zekyr, an enigmatic otherworldly entity who, along with his acolyte Azirak, recruits Talon to help combat the Vair’un, a conquering army threatening the cosmos. As Talon embarks on a perilous journey, she faces numerous challenges that test her resolve, learning that true strength comes from understanding and friendship, resulting in a found family that will reshape the prehistoric world.

Entries.Title: Burden of Guilt
Entries.Description: Follow Tracyraquel Berns' emotional journey to unravel the convoluted excuses that were given about her baby brother Matthew's sudden death when she was just two years old.

Episodes.Title: Mishap or Murder?
Episodes.Description: Tracyraquel Berns untangles the web of lies that obscured the truth about her baby brother's death.

Episodes.Title: A Case for Justice
Episodes.Description: The exhumation of infant Matthew's body leads to his stepfather being put on trial for murder.

Episodes.Title: The Final Reckoning
Episodes.Description: The arduous trial of Jan Sandlin ends, but Tracyraquel Berns' quest for justice is far from over.

Entries.Title: Faces of Music
Entries.Description: Examines the most exciting musicians today through the lens of beauty and makeup.

Episodes.Title: Faces of Music: Chappell Roan
Episodes.Description: Serving as her own glam team, Chappell Roan recreates the look that catapulted her into stardom. Watch The Rise and Fall of A Midwest Princess come to life as Chappell shares her journey of resilience, pride, and honoring her inner child.

Episodes.Title: Faces of Music: Victoria Monét
Episodes.Description: Makeup artist Angie Mar and hairstylist JStayReady transform Victoria Monét into the theme of her last album, JAGUAR II. She reflects on her rise from behind-the-scenes songwriter to Grammy-winning star, sharing insights on motherhood and self-discovery.

Episodes.Title: Faces of Music: Becky G
Episodes.Description: Join Becky G, makeup artist Gilbert Estrada, and hairstylist Glen Oropeza as they recreate four of her most iconic career looks. Reflecting on her YouTube roots, shift to Latin music, and new album Encuentros, Becky opens up about embracing authenticity.

Entries.Title: Elemental Nexus
Entries.Description:
Elemental Nexus is an action-packed, high-stakes superhero series set in a world where elemental powers shape the balance of reality itself. When a group of diverse individuals with extraordinary abilities is brought together by fate, they must overcome their personal struggles and unite against an emerging force of darkness threatening to engulf the world. From fire-wielding heroes to those with control over nature, these individuals—known as the Manifest Destiny Team—are pushed to their limits as they battle powerful villains and confront the hidden secrets of their pasts.

At the center of the story is Logan, a young hero with a fiery suit and a haunted legacy, as he faces the tragic loss of his mother, Summer Elite, a fallen hero. As he takes up the mantle of his mother’s hero name, he must also come to terms with the darker forces trying to control him, led by the manipulative and calculating villain Z-Smoke.

Episodes.Title: "Ignition: The Rise of HellFlame
Episodes.Description: Logan, a young hero struggling with the loss of his mother and his newfound powers, faces a life-altering moment when a mysterious villain threatens his city. As the flames of his powers begin to ignite, Logan’s transformation into HellFlame marks the beginning of his journey. In this high-stakes opening episode, Logan must confront the dark forces within himself and the dangerous enemies outside, all while grappling with his growing connection to his mother's legacy. Will he embrace his destiny, or will the fire consume him?

Entries.Title: Epic Ride: The Story of Universal Theme Parks
Entries.Description: A 3-part series exploring Universal's film and theme park legacy through rare footage and celebrity interviews, leading up to Epic Universe's opening. Features exclusive archives and behind-the-scenes access.

Episodes.Title: The Foundations of Universal's Theme Parks
Episodes.Description: Universal's transition from a film studio to a theme park giant. It covers the initial concepts and development of Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure,

Episodes.Title: Evolution and Innovation
Episodes.Description: Universal's theme parks beyond the initial offerings. It highlights major expansions, new technologies, and the challenges faced in continually innovating within the theme park industry.

Episodes.Title: The Dawn of Epic Universe
Episodes.Description: Heavily centered on the creation and unveiling of Universal Epic Universe. It  provides an exclusive, behind-the-scenes look at the planning, design, and construction of this massive new theme park.

Entries.Title: Diddy on Trial: As It Happened
Entries.Description: The trial of Sean "Diddy" Combs has begun, and prosecutors allege he engaged in an extensive list of criminal activities, including federal racketeering, sex trafficking and more. Combs denies all accusations, maintaining his innocence. In this new weekly series, viewers can witness it all unfold in real time.

Episodes.Title: The Freak-Off
Episodes.Description: Witness testimony begins in Sean "Diddy" Combs' criminal trial in New York. The prosecution's star witness Cassandra Ventura takes the stand against her former boyfriend and boss.

Episodes.Title: The Assault
Episodes.Description: Cassandra Ventura details the moments before Combs assaulted her, captured in that now infamous surveillance video. Kid Cudi takes the stand, recounting the moment when he learned his car had been set on fire.

Episodes.Title: Secret Life of Sean "Diddy" Combs
Episodes.Description: Former employees take us inside Combs' empire, alleging a culture of control, recounting alleged violence and detailing disturbing details behind closed doors.

Episodes.Title: The Bribe and The Balcony
Episodes.Description: Searing testimony about the surveillance video and an allegation that Combs dangled a woman off a balcony. "Jane," an alleged sex trafficking victim, takes the stand with a story about her first freak off.

Episodes.Title: The Love Contract
Episodes.Description: A former girlfriend testifying under the pseudonym "Jane" shares details about "hotel nights" she shared with Combs and various male escorts. In cross examination, the defense questions whether it was jealousy - not trauma -

Episodes.Title: Verdict Watch
Episodes.Description: After more than six weeks of testimony and 34 witnesses, both sides rest in the criminal trial of Sean "Diddy" Combs. Now in the hands of jurors, will the mogul walk free?

Entries.Title: I'm Happy You're Here
Entries.Description: A funny, unfiltered mental health show for adults (that means there are swears and dick jokes.)

Episodes.Title: Anxiety!
Episodes.Description: This episode is all about generalized anxiety disorder: what anxiety disorders do to your nervous system, why, and what you can do to calm the f*ck down.

Entries.Title: Lamandegan
Entries.Description: The story is about three friends named Ramtin (a lover), Kourosh, and Fouad (a philosopher) who are struck by a strange theory: seeing that the tortoise lives long with laziness and peace, and the hare lives fast but has a short life, they decide to start a special lifestyle, namely "squatting" and being inactive to achieve a long life! This decision leads them to funny and interesting adventures, where they encounter a new story and different people in each episode.

Entries.Title: Rose Garden
Entries.Description: Everyone knows the small town of Moga in Punjab for 2 things; the beautiful sisters Simran & Geet and their Rose Garden. Harleen, their mother, raised them alone after her husband vanished with another woman. The family lives off the roses, but behind the garden’s beauty lies a secret that smells of pain, betrayal and perhaps even blood

Episodes.Title: Lick, Sip, Suck
Episodes.Description: Simran and Geet invite Karan over for a dangerous game of Alta Palti. The next morning however, Karan goes missing.

Episodes.Title: Bandi Ban Jaa
Episodes.Description: Simran and Geet’s bond and their dark secret; everything will be compromised when Angad arrives with a marriage proposal for Geet.

Episodes.Title: You Are A Sherni
Episodes.Description: Simran wants to play the dangerous game of Alta Palti with Angad now. But Geet is unsure. Will Angad pass or fail?

Episodes.Title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
Episodes.Description: Alta Palti is a game the sisters have played all their lives. But who taught them? And can Angad’s love for Geet  stop these games?

Episodes.Title: Do Not Trust Men
Episodes.Description: Geet is hell bent on saving Angad even if it means breaking all bonds with her family and confessing to all her sins. But just then comes yet another twist.

Episodes.Title: Modus Operandi
Episodes.Description: Will the secrets of the Rose Garden be revealed or will they stay forever hidden behind the sweet fragrance of these beautiful flowers?

Entries.Title: Lie Detector: Truth or Deception
Entries.Description: Individuals long suspected of serious crimes voluntarily submit to taking a polygraph test hoping to clear their names in the eyes of their family and community.

Episodes.Title: Shannon Price
Episodes.Description: Shannon Price agrees to take a polygraph test to confront lingering suspicions.

Episodes.Title: Matheau Moore
Episodes.Description: Matheau Moore sits down for a polygraph test with former FBI agent Olivo, hoping to clear his name.

Episodes.Title: Jesse Holton
Episodes.Description: Jesse Holton sits down for a polygraph test with retired FBI examiner George Olivo.

Episodes.Title: Eva  Hamby
Episodes.Description: Eva Hamby sits down for a polygraph test in an effort to clear her name in the eyes of her doubters.

Episodes.Title: Edward Ates
Episodes.Description: Edward Ates takes a polygraph test with former FBI agent George Olivo to show his innocence.

Episodes.Title: Raven Abaroa
Episodes.Description: Raven Abaroa puts it all on the line for a polygraph test to show he did not murder his wife, Janet.

Episodes.Title: Chris Turner
Episodes.Description: In this episode, Chris Turner takes a high-stakes polygraph test to address suspicions related to the 1984 murder of Catherine Fuller. Turner was one of eight men convicted in the case and served 25 years in prison, but he has always maintained his innocence. The episode focuses on his attempt to clear his name.

Entries.Title: Gig Work
Entries.Description: GIG WORK is an adult animated action/adventure TV show. Set in a dark and dystopian world, a group of friends struggle to make ends meet while battling their own inner demons. The show explores themes of friendship, survival, and the quest for meaning in a society teetering on the brink of collapse. It is a reflection of the experiences of Gen Z and millennials during the isolation of COVID-19 and the struggles of working in the gig economy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Being the best writer in her High School class, Malaika turns in a book report that focuses on the trials & tribulations of a sinful character named Raven.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Dealing with her own displacement issues, Raven is on a mission to recruit  a few friends that also have a traumatic past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: With the race for Mayor finally being settled, there is still tension that exists between the 2 candidates. Meanwhile, the local authorities seem to be closing in on a suspect that’s responsible for a heinous crime.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The nefarious activities of Raven & her friends are starting to make the crew unravel. Their intended purpose is not going as they had planned it to.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5

Entries.Title: Mind. Body. Money.
Entries.Description: Mind. Body. Money. follows superstar financial advisor, Eszylfie Taylor, as he navigates the challenges of providing his clientele of top athletes, celebrities, and Fortune 500 companies with world class financial services.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: In the premiere episode of Mind Body Money, host Eszylfie Taylor introduces viewers to a multifaceted approach to achieving balance in work, life, and personal growth. The episode begins with an intriguing visit from hypnotherapist Magdalena Kalley, who enlightens the audience on the importance of maintaining healthy work-life practices. Through engaging conversations and compelling demonstrations, Magdalena provides skeptics and believers alike with a deeper understanding of how hypnosis can be a powerful tool for improving focus, reducing stress, and enhancing overall well-being.

Episodes.Title: The Value of Work and Wealth
Episodes.Description:
In the enlightening second episode of Mind Body Money, Eszylfie Taylor sets the stage for a

valuable lesson in the virtues of hard work and responsibility, using everyday chores as a

practical teaching tool for his daughters. By engaging them in various household tasks, Eszylfie

demonstrates that hard work is, indeed, undefeated, instilling in his daughters the importance of diligence and perseverance in achieving success and self-satisfaction.

Episodes.Title: Notes of Finance and Harmony
Episodes.Description:
In an engaging and family-focused opening to the third episode of Mind Body Money, Eszylfie

Taylor shares a heartwarming scene of playing basketball with his three daughters. This playful

yet symbolic start showcases the balance between work, family, and personal well-being, setting the tone for an episode that explores the convergence of financial literacy, career aspirations, and personal growth.

Episodes.Title: From Field to Finance
Episodes.Description:
In this captivating episode of Mind Body Money, Eszylfie Taylor embarks on a journey of

exploration and discovery, starting with a moment of reflection as he stretches his legs in a

scenic locale, symbolizing the transition from the fast-paced world of finance to the introspective and thoughtful world of personal growth and investment.

Episodes.Title: Financial Foundations and Community Connections
Episodes.Description:
In this enlightening episode of Mind Body Money, Eszylfie Taylor embarks on a mission to

instill the values of money management and financial planning in his daughters—Zoe, Nya, and

Shae—through a practical and engaging learning experience. The episode opens with a family

shopping trip, but this is no ordinary spree. Eszylfie turns the outing into an educational journey,

using real-life scenarios to teach his daughters about budgeting, the importance of saving, and

making informed spending decisions. The girls are tasked with identifying the difference

between wants and needs, understanding the value of money, and the principles of living within

one’s means.

Episodes.Title: Social Savvy and Industry Insights
Episodes.Description:
In this riveting episode of Mind Body Money, host Eszylfie Taylor takes an innovative leap by involving his daughter in a unique exploration of the digital landscape. The episode kicks off with the Wilking Sisters, renowned for their formidable presence on social media, sharing their

insider secrets on becoming influential online personalities. They offer a comprehensive

workshop, providing hands-on guidance on content creation, audience engagement, and the

nuances of building a personal brand on various platforms. Eszylfie and his daughter eagerly

absorb the knowledge, applying these influencer techniques with the hope of maximizing their

social media impact.

Entries.Title: Carl Weber's The Family Business: New Orleans
Entries.Description: Welcome to a new branch of the Duncan family tree, known for their popular casino / nightclub ‘Midnight Blues' where tourists, titans of industry, and trap kings & queens party side-by-side. But the club also holds secrets so dark that it could turn the vibrant city of New Orleans upside down. Facing threats at every turn, the Duncans try to keep their family safe and put their complicated pasts to the side for the greater good of their enduring legacy in the NOLA.

Episodes.Title: Surprise, Surprise
Episodes.Description: When a dead body shows up in Midnight Blues the casino, run by Big Shirley Duncan, her brother Floyd and her son Marquis, all hell breaks loose when his brother Jean puts out a $100K reward for information.

Episodes.Title: Rest No Peace
Episodes.Description: As the LeBlancs lay Pierre to rest, the Duncans do their best to clean up the mess as reinforcements arrive from New York.

Episodes.Title: Mask on
Episodes.Description: As the city enjoys the Midnight Blues' annual masquerade ball, the night's events create romances that cross dangerous lines between families, and Jean LeBlanc gets some disturbing news.

Episodes.Title: Truth, Lies and Secret Ties
Episodes.Description: Skunk reveals the truth to Jean about his brother Pierre; the Duncans and LeBlancs are finally headed for a showdown; Big Shirley meets a man from a past she thought she had all but erased.

Episodes.Title: The Hunt is On
Episodes.Description: The walls close in on the Duncans as their past choices begin to haunt them in the most unexpected ways, while present-day choices could have crushing consequences.

Episodes.Title: Two Sides to a Story
Episodes.Description: Marie and Curtis must make a big decision as Jean is released from prison, Prince considers a dangerous revelation, and Gabriel pursues a different route to Shirley's heart.

Episodes.Title: Things Come to a Head
Episodes.Description: Jean shows everyone that he's playing chess, not checkers, as he finally makes moves to own a piece of Midnight Blues.

Episodes.Title: Burn, Nola, Burn
Episodes.Description: Malicious secrets are revealed as Big Shirley, Marquis and the Duncan clan get dragged further into a brutal power struggle between the city's most dangerous people on both sides of the law.

Entries.Title: Jerry Springer: Fights, Camera, Action
Entries.Description: This jaw-dropping documentary goes behind the scenes of America's most controversial talk show to expose its biggest scandals, both on- and off-camera.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ex-politician and news anchor Jerry Springer's talk show becomes the most controversial thing ever seen on TV at the hands of a ruthless new producer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: No scandal is too big to damage "The Jerry Springer Show" — until the pressure of finding increasingly sensational stories takes its toll on the team.

Entries.Title: Donors
Entries.Description: Vampires face extinction without human donors. A system matches willing humans, elevating their status. Vampire factions undermine it. Nyla is chosen by Prince Octavian, thrust into a world where humans resist being treated as livestock.

Episodes.Title: Thirst
Episodes.Description: Octavian finds himself in need of a new donor. Nyla gets a visitor. The city prepares for All Donors Day celebrations. Octavian meets with vampire elders to broker a truce between covens. Octavian meets with vampire elders for a truce.

Episodes.Title: All Donors Day
Episodes.Description: HLM Rebels have plans for All Donors Day. The rest of the world is celebrating in honor of the vampires who ended the war with the donor program.

Episodes.Title: Brotherly Bond
Episodes.Description: Demitrius and Alexander, specifically the latter, struggle with the new law of the land. Demitrius lives a plush life with his donor, Heather.

Episodes.Title: Broken Laws
Episodes.Description: Tatiana pretends to be an enforcer of the new system to spy on the brothers. Octavian plays politician and goes on a donor campaign of interviews.

Episodes.Title: Awaken
Episodes.Description: Six reflects on the new world after hibernation. The city is in chaos. 1200s Europe. A Young Six awakens with a fright. Someone is there.

Episodes.Title: Victory
Episodes.Description: Octavian insists Nyla now lives at the Korvich Manor. Octavian, Sorin, Six, and the Armigers take out a threat of newly turned vampires in the city.

Entries.Title: Alphabet Soup
Entries.Description: Alphabet Soup is a raw, emotionally honest docuseries about queer dating in NYC, following singles and couples as they navigate love, hookups, and heartbreak-unfiltered and unscripted.

Episodes.Title: Swipe Right, Ghost Left
Episodes.Description: Troy and Nova's date at Stonewall doesn't go as planned. Shalimar is ghosted by Kiykiy. Ray shares his personal story and reconnection with Troy. Nova reflects on past relationships and transitioning.

Episodes.Title: Triple Play
Episodes.Description: Troy and Ray pursue a throuple with CeCe. Nova and Saturn bond through text. Shalimar confronts his crush on Atari. Saturn's health scare deepens emotional ties with Atari.

Episodes.Title: The Pie Incident
Episodes.Description: Nova and Saturn's first date reveals chemistry and red flags. Adrianna preps for a possible throuple. A conflict over a stolen pie escalates Saturn's tensions with Andrea.

Episodes.Title: Falling Hard
Episodes.Description: Nova and Saturn navigate intimacy and HIV disclosure. Shalimar and Atari connect physically but remain distant emotionally. Troy and Ray bond with Adrianna over dinner.

Episodes.Title: Pharmacy Fallout
Episodes.Description: Nova and Saturn are tested by real-world challenges. Shalimar and Allan talk things through. Saturn and Atari's friendship ends publicly. Saturn opens up post-breakup.

Episodes.Title: If You Wanted To, You Would
Episodes.Description: Troy and Ray reflect on missed chances. Shalimar and Atari go non-monogamous. Saturn moves forward. The cast shares philosophies on love, dating, and future goals.

Conflict begins when Zarita, an influencer at the peak of her career, is not yet ready to take on the responsibility of being a mother.

Entries.Description: Explores the tactics and psychology of skilled negotiators in high-stakes, life-or-death situations, revealing the secrets to de-escalation and successful outcomes.

Episodes.Description: A pro bono team of hostage negotiators tries to help free 26 fishermen held hostage by Somali pirates for over four years.

Episodes.Title: Taipei Hostage Crisis
Episodes.Description: One of Taiwan’s most dangerous criminals has kidnapped a South African diplomat’s family. Can negotiators rescue them?

Episodes.Title: Sydney Siege
Episodes.Description: An armed couple holds 27 people at gunpoint, seeking the return of their 3-month-old child. Police negotiators step in to try to keep the peace.

Episodes.Title: Embassy Under Siege
Episodes.Description: In Bangkok’s Myanmar embassy, 89 people are held hostage by university students. Can a group of Thai negotiators prevent tragedy?

Episodes.Title: The Negotiators vs. Rogue Cop
Episodes.Description: In 1996, Louisiana Sheriff’s Deputy Chad Louviere held six women hostage inside a bank where his ex-wife works.

Episodes.Title: The Negotiators vs. Boko Haram
Episodes.Description: Mu’azu Bawa, along with nine others, is taken hostage at gunpoint in the stronghold of the notorious terrorist group Boko Haram in Nigeria.

Entries.Description: 12-year-old daydreamer Sam Curtain is signed up by his parents to Miss Jessop's Drama Academy for talented kids, where he discovers that anything is possible, if you imagine it hard enough.

Entries.Title: Nyahata
Entries.Description: "Nyahata" follows the adventures of Nova, a quirky orange cat with an insatiable love for fish. In the pilot episode, "Jerry's Bait Shop", Nova's quest for her favorite snack leads her on an unexpected journey from her hometown to Instanbul, encountering a series of humorous and unpredictable events along the way.

Episodes.Title: Jerry's Bait Shop
Episodes.Description: Jerry's Bait Shop is the first episode and pilot of Nyahata, where Nova sees a fish advertisement and goes to Jerry's Bait Shop, landing in the window. She steals a fish and then runs away from the cashier, who later blows up the Shop. Nova then enters a train, but people inside throw her out and Nova lands in a desert, where she uses a cactus to propel herself back to her hometown, Nova thinks she is back, but she is in Istanbul.

Entries.Title: Vera Maari Trip
Entries.Description: In Vera Maari Trip, the ASS interns, now full-time employees, decide to go on a road trip inspired by an influencer’s travel vlog. The group encounters unexpected challenges, meets intriguing strangers, and navigates an unpredictable journey. Adding to the tension is a looming deadline to submit a crucial proposal for their company’s new merger. Will they manage to complete the trip?

Episodes.Title: The Escape Plan
Episodes.Description: Overwhelmed full-time employees of ASS Solutions plan a trip to Varkala to escape work stress but are saddled with a crucial matrimonial app project. Their plans take a twist when Maari unexpectedly joins, bringing tension and chaos.

Episodes.Title: Roadblocks and Revelations
Episodes.Description: Maari rents a car from his friend Varghese, unaware it belongs to Kutti, an eccentric and possessive owner obsessed with it. As the team heads to Varkala, their trip quickly unravels with unexpected barricades and chaos at every turn. Will they make it to their destination, or is this just the beginning of their troubles?

Episodes.Title: Stranded in Varkala
Episodes.Description: The team finally reaches Varkala, but their excitement is cut short when the police stop them. Just as they think the trip is turning around, they face another setback - no rooms available, leaving them stranded.

Episodes.Title: Room for Trouble
Episodes.Description: The gang struggles to find a room in Varkala, and their first day becomes even more challenging for them. Maari meets Paaru, the solo traveller instantly connects with her. Both boys and girls plan their must-do activities. Will things go as planned?

Episodes.Title: Thrills and Chills
Episodes.Description: The Gang begins their trip by exploring the adventurous activities in Varkala, Such as Surfing, Boating and paragliding. The Gang decides to go for a team lunch, but it doesn’t go as expected. Maari and solo traveller Paaru share a meaningful conversation that brings them closer.

Episodes.Title: Waves of Change
Episodes.Description: Krish, Jenny and Maari try to prank Maari by pushing him in the waves, but their prank takes a turn when Maari gets swept away by the current. The gang leaves Maari behind and heads to a pub, but Maari ends up finding a better company to party with.

Episodes.Title: Party Time
Episodes.Description: Just when everyone thinks Maari has been left behind at the pub, he surprises them by showing up with someone special. The party takes an unexpected turn when local thugs arrive and start causing trouble for the group.

Episodes.Title: The Surprise Call
Episodes.Description: Maari and Simbu hilariously fall victim to a scam by a local trickster. Meanwhile, the entire group is invited to Sridhar's place, making the trip even more memorable with every unique person they meet along the way.

Episodes.Title: Spin the bottle
Episodes.Description: The team plays a game of spin the bottle, leading to surprising revelations and secrets from everyone. In the meantime, Krish and Jenny's boat suddenly capsizes, leaving them stranded in the middle of the water.

Episodes.Title: The Unexpected Turn
Episodes.Description: Simbu brainwashes Maari into trying the exotic massage in Varkala, but when they arrive. Things take an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Krish and Jenny get stranded on their boat and are rescued by someone, but they are not who they expected.

Episodes.Title: The Love Triangle
Episodes.Description: The Kerala and Tamil boys have the party of a lifetime. When Jenny thinks their relationship is going well, she discovers Nithya, Krish's ex-lover, is in Varkala. Things get even more heated when Krish invites Nithya to their campfire.

Episodes.Title: Secrets and Revelations
Episodes.Description: Secrets are revealed around the campfire, and unexpectedly, the police arrive searching for Paaru. The whole gang is shocked as Paaru reveals her dark secret to everyone. Later, Maari proposes to Paaru.

Episodes.Title: New Beginnings
Episodes.Description: The whole gang sends the solo traveller, Paaru, off with an eye-opener, and something beautiful begins to spark between Maari and Paaru. Just when the team thought their trip was over, Jenny was urgently called home to Kerala.

Episodes.Title: Unexpected Orders
Episodes.Description: Keshavan orders the gang to the office the next day for a presentation on the merger. Jenny's father instructs her to stay home instead of going to the office, and this news shatters the gang

Episodes.Title: The Unveiling
Episodes.Description: Keshavan orders the gang to be in the office the next day for a presentation on the merger. Jenny's father instructs her to stay home instead of going to the office, and this news shatters the gang.

Entries.Title: The Grudge
Entries.Description: Inside sports’ fiercest rivalries, every game is more than a contest — it’s a battle for pride, redemption, and legacy.

Episodes.Title: Shaq vs Kobe
Episodes.Description: When Shaq and Kobe joined the Lakers, a dynasty seemed certain. But clashing egos, contrasting styles, and Hollywood pressure made their partnership a ticking time bomb.

Episodes.Title: Clemens vs Piazza
Episodes.Description: Mike Piazza and Roger Clemens' rivalry peaked in the 2000 World Series when Clemens threw a broken bat at Piazza, following a fastball to his head, sparking an iconic brawl.

Episodes.Title: Farve vs Rogers
Episodes.Description: Brett Favre, Aaron Rodgers, and Ted Thompson's clash sparked a fiery rivalry. As Favre's reign faded, tension, media chaos, and power struggles tore apart the Packers forever.

Episodes.Title: Avalanche vs Red Wings
Episodes.Description: In the 1996 NHL Western Conference Finals, Detroit's 41-year Cup drought collided with the new-look Colorado Avalanche. A brutal hit and Lemieux's sucker punch ignited chaos.

Episodes.Title: Terrell Owens vs Donovan McNabb
Episodes.Description: By the 2003-2004 season, the Eagles were primed for a Super Bowl run, but tensions between Terrell Owens and Donovan McNabb escalated, dividing the team and fueling a rivalry.

Episodes.Title: Conor McGregor vs. Khabib Nurmagomedov
Episodes.Description: Conor McGregor and Khabib Nurmagomedov's rivalry, fueled by insults and a cultural divide, explodes before UFC 229, sparking a post-fight brawl.

Episodes.Title: Brooks Koepka vs. Bryson DeChambeau
Episodes.Description: Brooks Koepka and Bryson DeChambeau's feud makes golf a battleground of egos; what begins as jabs spirals into chaos, viral moments, and nonstop drama.

Episodes.Title: Ronda Rousey vs. Miesha Tate
Episodes.Description: Ronda Rousey and Miesha Tate's rivalry defines women's MMA; Ronda's Judo clashes with Miesha's wrestling in two title fights, boiling over into The Ultimate Fighter and beyond.

Episodes.Title: Mayweather vs. Pacquiao
Episodes.Description: Mayweather and Pacquiao's rivalry builds up to the 2015 Fight of the Century, a clash of styles, drama and anticipation that defines boxing supremacy.

Episodes.Title: Jose Bautista vs. Rougned Odor
Episodes.Description: The Blue Jays-Rangers rivalry ignites in the 2015 ALDS with Bautista's bat flip; in 2016, tensions explode when he is hit, slides hard into second, and takes Odor's brutal punch.

Episodes.Title: Lewis Hamilton vs. Max Verstappen
Episodes.Description: Hamilton and Verstappen's rivalry is one of F1's fiercest; as Hamilton chases a record 8th title, Verstappen fights for his first, igniting a brutal battle for supremacy.

Episodes.Title: Pat Riley vs. The Knicks
Episodes.Description: Pat Riley's shocking '90s exit from the Knicks, resigning via fax to join the Heat sparks a fierce rivalry, fueling a decade of bad blood, playoff wars, and brutal clashes.

Entries.Title: Stick with Mick
Entries.Description: Focusing on one location at a time, this show presents children with a comprehensive look at the elements that differentiate one location from another and helps place specific objects in specific locations. We focus on what objects in each place look like, their names, and also how they are used in that location. It is important to build up a child’s vocabulary using groups of objects by location, which contributes to his or her understanding and ability to communicate about his or her surroundings.

Entries.Title: Let's Play Blind
Entries.Description: Let’s Play Blind is set in the flashy and risky world of gambling. Three rich friends—Mohini, Neeta, and Shanaya—play not just for money but for power & control. And also to fill the voids that exist in their lives. Things change when a mysterious man, Mohak, and his clever partner Kavya join the game with a hidden plan. In private rooms full of secrets, seduction, and lies, hidden cameras record everything—and the real game begins. With every round, the players lose more than just money. Pride, secrets, and even lives are at stake. When murder and blackmail enter the picture, no one knows who to trust. Who’s playing who—and who will survive the Blind Game?

Episodes.Title: Aiyyash Queens
Episodes.Description: On Diwali night, Mohini, Neeta, and Shanaya play a dangerous high-stakes game of power and pleasure, only to find themselves trapped in betrayal, greed, and a dangerous wild card.

Episodes.Title: Bluff Master
Episodes.Description: The queens get caught in a deadly trap. Secrets unravel as betrayal leads to devastating consequences, leaving no one untouched.

Episodes.Title: Dhoke Ka Daav
