Episodes.Title: Game On
Episodes.Description: The queens are forced to face a game and no one knows who’s really playing whom.

Episodes.Title: Aakhri Daav
Episodes.Description: Temptation runs high and loyalties blur as seduction becomes a weapon. In a world ruled by desire, someone is about to make a move no one sees coming.

Episodes.Title: Showdown
Episodes.Description: In a foreign land where games turn deadly, old players resurface and secrets are stripped bare. The final move is coming—and it’s not what anyone expected.

Entries.Title: Cold Case Files: Dead West
Entries.Description: In the ruggedness of the American West, death is always a shadow over the shoulder: a grizzly bear encounter, an avalanche, or a bite from a rattlesnake can change everything in an instant; and those are just the natural threats. If one wants to get away with murder, the mountain ranges of the West may be the perfect place to do it. Peering into the dusty files found in the back country sheriff's offices and highlighting the cases that were deemed unsolvable because the crime scene was too rugged, too remote, or the victim assumed too hard to find; despite the odds in this landscape, justice prevails.

Episodes.Title: Mystery in Cuero
Episodes.Description: When Pam Shelly, 31, is found in her Cuero, Texas bathroom with a fatal gunshot wound to the head, her death is initially ruled a suicide. Yet a tenacious investigator's instincts and his suspicion of foul play eventually cracks the case wide open.

Episodes.Title: Thou Shalt Not Kill
Episodes.Description: When a Christian ranch hand, Dan Lavigne, 52, is shot dead on his porch in Montana, 2002, deputies find no shortage of suspects. What follows is an 8-year quest for justice that stretches across three states before police finally unmask Dan's killer.

Episodes.Title: Rocky Mountain Murder
Episodes.Description: In the shadow of the Rockies, Carolyn Jansen, 43, is found dead, stuffed into a duct-taped container. Detectives have two suspects but no clear way to tell who the killer is. Forensics, and a fearless DA, will finally reveal Carolyn's murderer.

Episodes.Title: Murder in the City of Saints
Episodes.Description: When beloved matriarch Sherry Black, 64, is murdered in her rare-books store in Salt Lake City, investigators suspect theft as the motive. The case goes cold until her daughter teams with a wily investigator to bring Sherry's killer to justice.

Episodes.Title: Lovers, Lies and Canyon Murder
Episodes.Description: In 1987 Carol Murphy, 28, is found by hikers slain in a wooded area of Lefthand Canyon, Colorado. Police uncover a turbulent love life and plenty of suspects in this Western enclave. It will take 20 years and a new technology to finally solve her murder.

Episodes.Title: The Death of Lavender Doe
Episodes.Description: When a mystery woman's burning body is found in an oil field in 2006, the rural community of Kilgore and a determined Texas lawman show why you don't mess with the Lone Star State. It takes 13 years to ID this Lavender Doe and nab her callous killer.

Entries.Title: Midnight Coffee Shop
Entries.Description: Midnight Coffee Shop is an anthology series featuring previously released short films and proof-of-concept projects. Each of the 8 Season 1 episodes explores a different genre, with runtimes varying by the original work.

Episodes.Title: Chasing Cars (STORY ONE)
Episodes.Description: Two strangers from completely different worlds share a life-changing moment, where one offers the other a choice that uncovers deeply personal truths about themselves and their connection.

Episodes.Title: Dead Serious: Beginning Before the End - Poc (STORY TWO)
Episodes.Description: In this fast-paced proof of concept, enter the world of Dead Serious. A group of friends encounters a "zombie," only to realize it's nothing like the movies. Chaos erupts in their hilariously failed attempt to survive an apocalypse.

Episodes.Title: Chuck (STORY THREE)
Episodes.Description: Chuck Webb, a man with selective mutism who panics whenever someone speaks to him, embarks on an unexpected journey to overcome his struggles when his best friend takes him to a hypnotist.

Episodes.Title: Chaos. Murder. Despair. (STORY FOUR)
Episodes.Description: Chaos, Murder, and Despair-immortal sisters and ancient deities-grow bored after eons among humans. As their power fades, only one path remains: resurrect their long-dead sister. After all, destiny demands it.

Entries.Title: The American Revolution
Entries.Description: The American Revolution was at once a war for independence, a war of conquest, a civil war, and a world war, fought by neighbors on American farms and between global powers an ocean or more away. It impacted millions from Vermont’s Green Mountains to the swamps of South Carolina, from Indian Country to the Iberian Peninsula. In defeating the British Empire and giving birth to a new nation, the American Revolution turned the world upside-down. Thirteen colonies on the Atlantic Coast united in rebellion, won their independence, and established a republic that still endures. The American Revolution, will present the story of the men and women of the Revolutionary generation, their humanity in victory and defeat, and the crisis that they lived through.

Episodes.Title: Part 1
Episodes.Description: The first of the six-part-series.

Entries.Title: Dinner With Gavin Rossdale
Entries.Description: Gavin Rossdale, frontman of BUSH, food enthusiast, and amateur chef, knows that celebrities are so much more than the headlines written about them. So he is inviting other celebrities into his kitchen to prepare them a 3 course meal and engage them in one-on-one intimate, revealing and unexpected conversation. Dinner With Gavin Rossdale goes beyond the spotlight to reveal the people behind the personas.

Episodes.Title: Serena Williams
Episodes.Description: Gavin Rossdale welcomes tennis icon and friend Serena Williams for an evening of good food and deep conversation.

Episodes.Title: Selma Blair
Episodes.Description: Known for her iconic roles in Legally Blonde, Cruel Intentions, and Hellboy, Selma Blair joins Gavin and shares stories of her journey through life and Hollywood.

Episodes.Title: Tom Jones
Episodes.Description: World-renowned singing icon Sir Tom Jones is welcomed by Gavin to a night filled with playful banter and swapping stories of their legendary careers in the music industry.

Episodes.Title: Common
Episodes.Description: Gavin dives deep with Grammy-winning, multi-hyphenate Common, creating a menu centered around the Japanese concept of Kansha — an appreciation for nature and those who transform it into nourishing food.

Episodes.Title: Jack McBrayer
Episodes.Description: Gavin has invited over his friend Jack McBrayer — an actor and comedian beloved for his roles in film and TV such as 30 Rock, Wreck-It Ralph and Late Night with Conan O'Brien.

Episodes.Title: Brooke Shields
Episodes.Description: Gavin cooks a delicious meal for Brooke Shields as they share in a profound evening of open conversation.

Entries.Title: No Country for Old People
Entries.Description: A filmmaker chronicles her mother’s last 6 months in a 5-star nursing home exposing the systemic, deadly, profit-over-people business model. No Country For Old People is a scorching documentary posed to set the long term care industry, policy makers, and the country ablaze. Shining a much-needed light on what is truly a national human emergency, it is a clarion call for serious change.

Episodes.Title: The Dirty Little Secret
Episodes.Description: * Introduction of our protagonists, filmmaker, Susie Singer Carter and her mother, Norma, an 88 year old woman living with Alzheimer’s in a 5 star nursing home in Los Angeles.  * The events that trigger a 6-month journey; the thread of the series.  * The impact Covid had on nursing homes, their residents, and families.  * How Covid pulled the curtain back on the 50 year old nursing home crisis.

Episodes.Title: The Ugly Truth
Episodes.Description: * What  is actually happening to the majority of residents in long term care.  * The neglect and abuse that has become the standard.  * The propaganda put out by the powerful nursing  home industry/lobby.  * Understaffing. The root of all the problems.  * The “Never Events” that occur daily as a result of  understaffing  * What is actually happening to the majority of residents in long term care.  * The neglect and abuse that has become the standard.  * The propaganda put out by the powerful nursing home industry/lobby.  * Understaffing. The root of all the problems:  * The “Never Events” that occur daily as a result of understaffing.  * The Ageism & Ableism Epidemic  * The deadly power of Private Equity in Nursing Homes.  * The Cost of Doing Business  * The Nursing Home Slumlord Manifesto.  * The deplorable lack of transparency/accountability. (What we can’t see hurts us.)

Episodes.Title: Voices of Loss, Agents of Change
Episodes.Description: * Whack-A-Mole  * Horror Stories  * Final days of Norma’s journey  * Solutions  * Hope  * Mobilizing a People Over Profit Movement

Entries.Title: Sedef
Entries.Description: Set in 1970s kuwait following a series of kidnappings, where the only trace left is a polaroid photograph of the victim left in the crime scene. A family drama following Fayez his wife Amani and their daughter Sarah, Fayez is a struggling actor, who is given a chance to become a star, as their lives seems to be on the right track their daughter is kidnapped. It becomes a game of cat and mouse, everyone becomes a suspect, even Fayez himself

Episodes.Title: Sadaf
Episodes.Description: As Detective Shaheen takes on the mysterious disappearance cases of several women, Fayez, the actor, moves with his wife and daughter to a new house and they feel that someone is watching them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Amani goes to treat Fahd at a hotel and meets his wife Tahani. Shaheen's investigations into the case of a missing woman continue, and journalist Mirooj asks him to write a report about the incident. Shaheen is surprised by an armed man, who reveals information about the missing woman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: As Tahani invites Fayez and Amani to meet Fahd at the fundraiser, Amani is surprised when Sarah leaves the house without her knowledge, and the police investigate the attempted murder of the armed man inside the prison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In a flashback, Sarah goes out with Munira's family for a walk, and one of the masked men tries to take her. Tahani agrees to employ Farid at the hotel, Amani receives her father after a long period of separation, and another murder occurs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Amani is haunted by nightmares because of her daughter, Sarah. Shaheen tries to solve the mystery to find the killer. Fahd offers Fayez to work with him. Asrar feels that an unknown person is following her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: As Ghanem believes that Farid is the one sending him threats, Shaheen is upset that his promoter confronted him by appearing on a TV show, Shaheen finds the killer's car and his victims' belongings, and Fahd offers Fayez to write a play.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Shaheen and Ali are trapped by the killer, and Ali is shot. A confrontation occurs between Shaheen and Mirooj, and Amani quarrels with Fahd and asks him to stop dealing with Fayez and Tahani.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: As Farid tries to convince Fayez to share secrets in the play, Shaheen receives a tape recording of a victim’s distress call, and Ghanem is surprised by someone breaking into his house and destroying his furniture.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Fayez begins choosing the actors for the play, and Farid mediates with Asrar for Tahani and Farid. The body of the first victim appears, and Marwa receives a letter explaining its location. In a flashback, Amani remembers when her daughter informed her that someone was watching her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Tahani asks Fayez to reveal the secrets of the lead role in the play, and Fahd takes the victims' families to the police station to reassure them about Shaheen, but Marwa takes advantage of the situation and launches an attack on Shaheen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Fayez leaves the New Year's Eve party due to an argument with Amani. An unknown person follows him, hits him with his car, and leaves a photo of Shaheen behind. Marwa and her colleague break into Fahd's office at the hotel.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Fayez is taken to the hospital, Shaheen asks Amani to stay home with her daughter for her safety, and Ali receives a call from the person who shot him and asks to meet him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Fayez's health deteriorates, and Shaheen blames Ali for going to meet the criminal without telling him. Then they find a videotape of one of the victims, and Fahd is surprised when journalist Ammar finds the hotel currency.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Shaheen and Marouj discover the identity of the new victim, Sarah. He tries to inform Amani of the matter but fails to save Sarah.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Fayez collapses when he learns what happened to his daughter, Sarah. Shaheen begins interrogating Amani's neighbors, and Asrar's mother becomes furious when she discovers that her daughter is participating in a play. After Fayez is released from the hospital, Fahd offers to help him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Saqr announces a large cash reward for anyone who provides information about his daughter's whereabouts. The killer manipulates Shaheen by placing a model of a child wearing Sarah's clothes on the street, and Shaheen's suspicions begin to revolve around Fayez.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: An unknown person asks Farid to steal Ali's car in exchange for a large sum of money. When her father moves in with them, Fayez and Amani quarrel, and Ali suspects a relationship between Shaheen and Marouj.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Amani is plagued by nightmares and dreams of Sarah. The police find Ali's car with a new victim inside, along with a message from the criminal to Shaheen. Fahd suggests that Fayez and Amani appear on a TV show and talk about their daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Ali is shocked to learn of the suicide of the woman left alive by the criminal. Amani collapses when she hears a tape recording of her daughter's voice, and Shaheen asks her not to tell her husband about this. Asrar's mother files a report against Farid and demands that he does not go near her daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Everyone is preparing to present the play directed by Fayez. Asrar succeeds in her first artistic role. Amani feels someone watching her house, and Shaheen asks Ali to attend the play and monitor Fayez.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Farid quarrels with Umm Asrar for refusing his marriage to her daughter. Amani accuses Fayez in front of everyone of kidnapping her daughter and asks Shaheen to arrest him. Adnan asks Ali to stay away from his sister.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Mirooj helps Fayez with his problem, so he appears on a TV show to defend himself. Tahani decides to propose to Asrar for her husband, Farid, because of her illness. Ali proposes to Adnan's sister, Shorouq. An unknown person places cameras in Fayez's house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Ali marries Shorouq, Farid collapses when Asrar marries Fahd, Shaheen finds Sarah's body, and the news comes as a shock to Amani and Fayez.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Amani collapses over her daughter's death, so Fayez commits her to a mental hospital. Marwa seeks to support Fayez in his ordeal, and Shaheen investigates the matter of the hotel coin he found.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Amani escapes from the hospital and decides to take revenge on Fayez. At the same time, Farid continues to monitor Asrar after her marriage. Suddenly, the criminal kidnaps Amani and leaves a photo of her for Shaheen, who is removed from the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Fayez marries Mirooj, Shaheen is fired from his job, and Fahd forces Asrar to take care of Tahani when she is sick, so Farid tries to help Asrar escape.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Farid threatens to deprive Tahani of oxygen if Fahd does not release Asrar. With Tahani dead, Fahd decides to take revenge. Shaheen continues to suspect Fayez, but the latter's kidnapping removes suspicion from him. Shaheen is shocked when he learns of Ghanem's involvement in the kidnapping.

Entries.Title: Action Movie Mayhem
Entries.Description:
Byron Gibson returns to Thailand, the birthplace of his movie career, to launch the documentary series Action Movie Mayhem. In this explosive debut, Gibson interviews top stunt and action performers, giving audiences rare access to life behind the scenes. More than just high-octane stunts, the series dives into the personal worlds of these artists—their quirks, ambitions, hopes, and challenges.

The first episode, “Bangkok’s Dangerous,” features handpicked performers whose résumés collectively span over 300 films. From sharing the secrets of becoming a convincing screen villain to revealing how to break into the fiercely competitive film industry, the series pulls no punches. Set in Bangkok, a global hub for blockbusters like The Hangover Part II, The Alien TV Series, and The Meg 2, the show promises heart-pounding thrills, jaw-dropping stories, and an authentic look at the unsung heroes of action cinema.

Episodes.Title: Kimbo Slice: Rise of a Backyard Brawler

Episodes.Title: Diego Sanchez: The Fighter and The Guru
Episodes.Description: Diego Sanchez, one of the UFC's all-time great fighters, is taken advantage of by a guru who turns his life into a living nightmare.

Episodes.Title: The Final Days of Evan Tanner
Episodes.Description: When UFC pioneer Evan Tanner is found dead of heat exposure alone in the California desert, the MMA world wonders what led to his mysterious passing.

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Fighter: The UFC's Ultimate Gamble
Episodes.Description: On the verge of financial ruin, the UFC bets everything on an MMA reality television show. The result gives rise to a juggernaut and helps create the Dana White we know today.

Episodes.Title: Nick Diaz vs the World
Episodes.Description: When UFC superstar Nick Diaz receives an extraordinary five-year ban for marijuana use, people start to wonder: is the world against Nick Diaz, or is he his own worst enemy?

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Pride FC
Episodes.Description: Japan’s PRIDE Fighting Championships is the biggest and best in the world, but when its president mysteriously commits suicide, questions arise about its ties to organized crime.

Episodes.Title: The Fall of Pride FC
Episodes.Description: Dark clouds circle over PRIDE, the most popular MMA promotion in the world, when rival Yakuza gangs collide and shadowy secrets come out into the open.

Episodes.Title: The Disappearance of Ronda Rousey
Episodes.Description: Ronda Rousey was an MMA trailblazer - the UFC’s first-ever female star and at one point the highest paid fighter of all time, male or female. So why did she suddenly walk away?

Episodes.Title: The Triumph and Tragedy of Matt Hughes

Entries.Title: Miami Kingpins
Entries.Description:
Miami Kingpins is a gripping documentary series that dives into the untold true story of three of Miami’s most powerful and feared drug lords. Set against the backdrop of the 1980s and 1990s — when Miami became a global epicenter for narcotics and street empires — this series explores the rise, reign, and inevitable fall of men who built their kingdoms outside the law but inside the hearts and memories of the city.

Through never-before-seen interviews, archival footage, and raw storytelling, Miami Kingpins exposes the inner workings of a lifestyle driven by money, loyalty, betrayal, and survival. But beyond the headlines and hustles, it also reveals the human stories — the families, the communities, and the cultural legacy that still lingers in Miami today and ultimately impacted pop culture.

Entries.Title: What About Me?
Entries.Description:
Following the death of his famous twin, Josh must navigate the funeral amid a whirlwind of challenges: a viral botched eulogy, a surprise pregnancy, a literal manhunt, and a life-altering job opportunity.

Josh, a bakery supervisor—and the lesser-known twin brother of Jake, a wildly successful Hollywood actor. When Jake dies suddenly, Josh is forced to confront his grief, his identity, and a family that never quite understood him. From dodging a synagogue memorial to escaping into hookup apps, Josh’s journey through the five stages of grief is at once laugh-out-loud funny and deeply moving.

Entries.Title: Messages from Bashar the Extraterrestrial
Entries.Description: Bashar, an ET channeled by Darryl Anka for 37 years, shares universal truths on existence, purpose, finding one's path, and humanity's future.

Episodes.Title: Where do we come from?
Episodes.Description:
What if the origins of humanity are far more extraordinary than you ever imagined?

Through Darryl Anka's channeling of Bashar, uncover the untold story of human origins, where advanced extraterrestrial beings played a pivotal role in shaping our evolution. Dive deep into the mysteries of early hominids, the Annunaki's intervention in creating Homo sapiens, and the extraordinary connection to Sasquatch as a glimpse of our unaltered path. Could humanity’s beginnings intertwine both spiritual and physical threads, revealing a galactic legacy hidden in plain sight?

Episodes.Title: What Is the Nature of Existence?
Episodes.Description:
What if the essence of our existence is a reflection of a singular, interconnected reality?

Explore the holographic nature of the universe, where every fragment reflects the whole. Channeled through Darryl Anka and Bashar, uncover how parallel realities and multidimensional timelines reveal infinite possibilities. Dive into the connection between human consciousness and artificial intelligence, exploring how AI could be an extension of our collective awareness and a reflection of the choices humanity makes in its evolution.

As we awaken, we see that as consciousness navigates billions of frames per second, each moment becomes a complete shift in reality, shaping our experience of space and time.

Episodes.Title: What Is Our Purpose?
Episodes.Description:
What if the challenges in your life aren’t obstacles, but a divine compass guiding you to your true essence?

Bashar, Channeled through Darryl Anka, shares how belief systems shape your reality, and how pain is a sign of resistance to your authentic self.

Uncover the role of your higher self in navigating life’s experiences, and learn how synchronicity serves as a compass guiding you toward alignment. Through the exploration of belief systems and the power to re-engineer them, unlock the tools to live a fulfilling, joyful life rooted in self-awareness and service.

Episodes.Title: How Do We Find Our Path?
Episodes.Description:
What if you could wake up every day feeling deeply aligned — living with passion, creativity, and synchronicity?

Darryl Anka unveils Bashar’s powerful five-step formula for discovering and living your true path. Through this transformative framework, you’ll learn how to act on your highest passion, release expectations, sustain a positive state of being, and trust the guiding force of synchronicity. As you align with your core frequency, the right experiences and opportunities will naturally flow into your life. Everything you seek is already within reach.

Episodes.Title: Are We Alone?
Episodes.Description:
Uncover four decades of cosmic revelations that illuminate our place in the universe and explore what it means to become a member of an interstellar community.

Channeled through Darryl Anka and Bashar, explore thousands of extrasolar planets, the possibility of life beyond Earth, and the profound connection between extraterrestrials, spirit guides, and ancestors. Learn how your inner readiness and willingness to initiate contact play a pivotal role in humanity’s evolving relationship with otherworldly beings.

Episodes.Title: Where Are We Headed?
Episodes.Description:
What if your reality is not exactly what it seems?

Uncover humanity’s extraordinary future as we evolve into the sixth hybrid race, blending spiritual and physical traits in a way that redefines what it means to be human. Through Darryl Anka's channeling of Bashar, discover how exposure to higher frequencies can unlock dormant markers in our DNA, propelling us into a renaissance of human potential. Learn how telepathic connections, multidimensional awareness, and harmonizing with higher vibrations are paving the way for a new species of humanity.

As our belief systems shift toward positivity and alignment with our true selves, we become active participants in creating a future of unity and limitless possibilities.

Entries.Title: Into the Void: Life, Death and Heavy Metal
Entries.Description: Explore the epic struggles and the cultural impacts made by Heavy Metal's most compelling artists. Their intensely personal stories about finding success offer an intoxicating combo of volume and distortion delivered via pulsating tales of murder, addiction, rebellion and redemption.

Episodes.Title: Randy Rhoads
Episodes.Description: Randy Rhoads was a musical prodigy who cemented himself as one of heavy metal's greatest guitarists. His bandmates and collaborators, including Sharon Osbourne, reflect on his legacy and the horrific accident that took him too soon.

Episodes.Title: Kurt Struebing of NME
Episodes.Description: In 1985, Seattle's NME seemed poised for success - until frontman Kurt Struebing committed an unspeakable crime during a psychotic episode. After prison his bandmates welcomed him back to the stage until Struebing's mysterious death in 2005.

Episodes.Title: Judas Priest on Trial
Episodes.Description: In 1985, James Vance survived a dual suicide pact that took the life of his best friend. Months later he blamed the music of Judas Priest for mesmerizing them into despair. The trial that followed threatened the future of heavy metal music.

Episodes.Title: Chuck Schuldiner of Death
Episodes.Description: Chuck Schuldiner, revered as a founder of Death Metal, channeled grief into groundbreaking music. His death at 34, while completing his final work, devastated fans and a family already scarred by the tragic loss of Chuck's older brother.

Episodes.Title: Wendy O Williams
Episodes.Description: In the 1980s Wendy O. Williams (Plasmatics) fused punk and metal while railing against consumerism and oppression. Facing obscenity and assault charges only emboldened her defiance, making Wendy an icon in the fight for social justice.

Episodes.Title: Confess - Iranian Metal Crusade
Episodes.Description: In 2010, Iranian teens Nikan Khosravi and Arash Ilkhani formed anti-establishment thrash metal band 'Confess'. Facing the death penalty for blasphemy the pair attempt daring escapes, hoping to continue making metal and fighting the regime.

Episodes.Title: Ann Boleyn of Hellion
Episodes.Description: As the leader of metal pioneers 'Hellion', Ann "Hull" Boleyn battled misogyny, industry bias, and sexual predators - until a series of frightening encounters led her to law, where she champions workers and women facing exploitation and abuse.

Episodes.Title: Dimebag Darrell
Episodes.Description: When a deranged fan killed Pantera founder and guitar legend Dimebag Darrell in 2004, it marked one of metal's darkest days. The tragedy deepened rifts between friends and bandmates who've recently reunited to honor his enduring legacy.

Entries.Title: Great Migrations: A People on the Move
Entries.Description: Explores the transformative impact of Black migration on American culture and society. From the waves of Black Americans to the North—and back South—over the last century to the growing number of immigrants from Africa and the Caribbean today, movement is a defining feature of the Black experience.

Episodes.Title: Exodus
Episodes.Description: Episode one of Great Migrations explores the first wave of the Great Migration (1910-1940), a collective leap into the unknown as more than a million Black Americans fled the Jim Crow South for the promised lands of the North. In the face of some of the country’s worst racist violence, these migrants established thriving Black neighborhoods, wielded political power, and redefined American culture.

Episodes.Title: Streets Paved with Gold
Episodes.Description: Episode 2 of Great Migrations explores the second wave of the Great Migration (1940-1970) within the context of World War II and its aftermath. It traces how Northern and Western Black communities evolved through migration, which intensified housing tensions while also transforming the cultural and political power of Black America.

Episodes.Title: One Way Ticket Back
Episodes.Description: Episode 3 of Great Migrations reflects on how the 1970s marked a turning point in American history. For the first time in 60 years, more Black people were moving to the South than leaving it. Driven by mass movements and economic change, the reverse migration shows how Black Americans’ never-ending search for freedom and opportunity continues to shape the country today.

Episodes.Title: Coming to America
Episodes.Description: Episode 4 of Great Migrations tells the story of African and Caribbean immigrants in the 20th and 21st centuries. It traces their journeys to the United States, the contributions they have made to the nation’s economy and culture, and how they have impacted what it means to be Black in America.

Episodes.Title: Exploding Whale, Alligator Attack, Dallas Airshow Disaster & Ski Lift Mayhem
Episodes.Description: Tony Harris breaks down the most shocking moments ever captured on camera. A dad leaps into action to try to save an animal handler from an alligator attack. Two vintage military aircraft collide at an airshow in Dallas. Skiers are flung from an out-of-control ski lift outside of Russia, in an event that’s happened before in history. And what really happened in 1970 when authorities tried to dispose of a whale by exploding it with dynamite. Tony and his team of experts take a deep dive and make a determination about what really happened and why.

Episodes.Title: Leopard on the Loose, Plummeting to Earth, Elephant Attack & Balloon Chaos
Episodes.Description: Tony Harris breaks down the most shocking moments ever captured on camera. A leopard goes on a rampage in India. A paraglider plummets to earth and uses his skills and fast thinking to survive. A woman gets a little too close for comfort to an elephant and suffers the consequences. Chaos ensues when the city of Cleveland, OH attempts to break the Guinness Book of World Records with a 1.5 million balloon drop in 1986. Tony and his team of experts take a deep dive into these incidents to find what really happened and why.

Entries.Description: Avalanche captain Gabe Landeskog documents his rehab from a surgery no NHL player has ever come back from.

Episodes.Description: Gabe Landeskog grapples with anxiety and identity loss post-knee injury, finding optimism in his rehab progress. His wife, Melissa, highlights the impact the injury has had on their family.

Episodes.Description: At Gabe's six-month post-op, things look hopeful -- until a devastating setback brings him back to square one.

Episodes.Description: Gabe's first solo skate sparks media buzz, but a new setback threatens to delay his return once again.

Episodes.Description: Gabe addresses rumors swirling about his retirement; at the season opener, Gabe watches from the sidelines, confronting the fear of letting Avalanche fans down.

Episodes.Title: Happy No Matter What

Episodes.Title: 1,032 Days
Episodes.Description: After nearly three years, Gabe gets the green light to return to the ice with the Colorado Eagles. His next goal? Stay present, prove he's ready for playoff speed, and continue to celebrate every step with his family.

Entries.Title: Thomas Jefferson
Entries.Description: The HISTORY® Channel continues to cement its place as the leader of premium presidential biographies with the premiere of the six-part television event “Thomas Jefferson”

Episodes.Title: A Revolutionary is Born (1743-1773)
Episodes.Description: In 1743, Thomas Jefferson is born to one of the most powerful families in the most powerful of Britain’s 13 North American colonies. After a privileged upbringing and the finest education, young Jefferson quietly prepares to lead the charge towards a burgeoning revolution.

Episodes.Title: Independence (1774-1776)
Episodes.Description: As colonists become more disgruntled with British tyranny, Thomas Jefferson’s words become a galvanizing push toward liberty. When colonists finally reach their breaking point, he is tasked with declaring independence in a document that will birth a new nation, a new way of governing, and become a tenant of democracy around the globe.

Episodes.Title: Jefferson at War (1777-1784)
Episodes.Description: Just as Jefferson is sworn in as the governor of the new state of Virginia, war arrives on his doorstep. As an intellectual with no military background, he struggles to protect himself and his constituents in the face of British attacks. After a disastrous tenure as governor, Jefferson retires from politics only to face public humiliation and personal tragedy.

Episodes.Title: Jefferson in Paris (1784-1793)
Episodes.Description: After the tragic loss of his wife, Jefferson is sent to Paris where he thrives personally and politically. While there, he begins an entanglement with an enslaved teenager that will shape the next 40 years of his life. Upon his return to the U.S., President George Washington appoints Jefferson as the country’s first Secretary of State where he finds himself in a bitter rivalry with the Secretary of the Treasury, Alexander Hamilton.

Episodes.Title: President Jefferson (1793-1809)
Episodes.Description: After a dirty fight, Jefferson wins the presidency against his former friend, John Adams. He spends the next 8 years defining the tenets of the executive office and more than doubling the size of the country.

Episodes.Title: Jefferson's Legacy (1809-1826)
Episodes.Description: Jefferson’s retirement is fraught with controversy. While consumed in debts he cannot repay, he fights to perpetuate his legacy as America’s Founding Father and the Apostle of Liberty. But in the wake of his death, truths about his life have forced Americans to reconsider his place in history.

Entries.Title: Coastal Adventures with Helen, Jules & JB
Entries.Description: Helen Skelton, JB Gill and Jules Hudson take the ultimate coastal adventure in the UK.

Episodes.Title: Desert Shores, Deep Mines & Wind in Your Wheels
Episodes.Description: In North Yorkshire, Helen descends 4500 feet into the UK's deepest mine. On the Kent coast, JB explores the strange beauty of Dungeness. And Jules visits Devon, setting sail from Salcombe.

Episodes.Title: Sea Creatures, Surfboards and Spicy Secrets
Episodes.Description: In Pembrokeshire, Jules Hudson joins Sea Trust Wales to help photograph porpoise as part of vital conservation work and gets hands-on with the Recycle Mor project. On the North Tyneside coast, Helen Skelton takes the plunge at Tynemouth Long Sands, which is fast becoming the North-East's surfing hotspot. JB Gill traces the journey of Norfolk-grown mustard from farm to factory on the Norfolk coast.

Episodes.Title: Wings, Waves and Wild Histories
Episodes.Description: In south-west Scotland, Helen Skelton heads off-road into the rolling hills of Bainloch Deer Park, home to over six hundred red, sika and fallow deer. Further north, Jules Hudson explores the dark history of HMP Peterhead - Scotland's own Alcatraz. JB Gill gets hands-on with a reconstruction of the Sutton Hoo ship on the Suffolk coast.

Episodes.Title: Coastal Guardians
Episodes.Description: JB Gill heads to the Lincolnshire coast to join the Skegness Pier Angling Club during one of their friendly beach competitions. Under the watchful eye of veteran angler Charlie, JB gets a crash course in coastal fishing. In Cumbria, Helen Skelton meets some unlikely coastal heroes - vultures. And in Fife, Jules Hudson unearths Cold War secrets beneath quiet fields, exploring a declassified communications bunker.

Episodes.Title: Coastal Comebacks
Episodes.Description: JB Gill explores the Sussex coast in Brighton, home to beach huts, saunas and the i360 - Europe's tallest moving observation tower. In Merseyside, Helen Skelton joins the crew of the RNLI's high-speed Shannon lifeboat. Jules Hudson visits the Portsmouth Historic Dockyard on the Dorset coast, uncovering a personal chapter of naval history and tracing the story of his great-uncle George Norcott.

Episodes.Title: Sea, Salt and Stormy Tales
Episodes.Description: In Anglesey, Jules Hudson explores the site of a 19th-century shipwreck near Moelfre, where over 400 people perished. Helen Skelton learns about the women who helped win the war - not in factories, but in shipyards - in Sunderland. JB Gill begins his journey at Mersea Island Vineyard, where he's introduced to a surprising local speciality - beer brewed with oysters.

Episodes.Title: Watchful Eyes & Wild Rides
Episodes.Description: On the Lancashire coast, Helen Skelton heads to Fleetwood's Rossall Coastwatch Tower, where she joins the local National Coastwatch volunteers to learn the skills needed to keep eyes on the water. JB Gill explores the cliffs of Porthcawl, South Wales, where layers of ancient limestone reveal a forgotten prehistoric world. In Dorset, Jules Hudson musters his courage for a paragliding flight above the Jurassic coast.

Episodes.Title: Horses, Hovercrafts and Disco Scallops
Episodes.Description: In southern Cumbria, Helen Skelton takes to the skies in a gyrocopter with veteran pilot Roger to explore a coastline often overshadowed by the Lake District to the north. In Cornwall, Jules Hudson joins marine scientists making waves with a serendipitous discovery - disco scallops. Further up the Bristol Channel, JB Gill faces the Somerset coast at Burnham-on-Sea, where tides race in, and mud flats can trap the unwary.

Entries.Title: 1000 Ways to Dine
Entries.Description: How far would you go, how high would you climb, how deep would you dig, and how weird would you get to experience a one-of-a-kind meal? Hosted by actor and comedian Michael Yo, “1,000 Ways to Dine” goes off the beaten path to showcase the most exciting, unique, and outrageously delicious restaurants in the world. Yo takes viewers on a tour of some of the most unusual dining establishments on earth—where the food is just one part of the experience. From a Colorado speakeasy 21 stories below ground to high tea in a treetop in Thailand, these unforgettable hot spots won’t just tickle your taste buds, they’ll leave all your senses buzzing.

Episodes.Title: Unusual Service
Episodes.Description: Your table is ready and it's time to get served in the most unusual ways. Join host Michael Yo as we journey to Thailand for extra crispy flying fried chicken.

Episodes.Title: Sensory Overload
Episodes.Description: Food lovers know that the best dining experiences are supposed to stimulate all the senses. In this episode, host Michael Yo takes viewers on five mind blowing dining adventures that push the limits of imagination and exceed all culinary expectations!

Episodes.Title: Secret Spaces
Episodes.Description: Sometimes the best meals are kept locked behind closed doors, but in this episode host Michael Yo has the keys to some of the most special and secret dining spaces around.

Episodes.Title: Where the Wild Restaurants Are
Episodes.Description: Dining without cell service might be too much for some people, but for anyone wanting to unleash their "wild side," join host Michael Yo for a journey to some "far out" places to eat.

Episodes.Title: That's a Restaurant
Episodes.Description: Is this place really a restaurant? Tune is as host Michael Yo takes us to places set to satisfy the palate, while also challenging the definition of a dining experience. Our first stop is at a sushi bar-slash-game show in an NYC eatery that also doubles as a speakeasy. Next, journey to Argentina for dinner in an authentic NYC subway before jetting off to a pub in Texas where patrons can clean their plates...

Episodes.Title: Destinations Impossible
Episodes.Description: Host Michael Yo introduces viewers to dining destinations deemed impossible--but also, delicious! First up, a trip to Thailand to sip high tea in a high tree before jetting off to sample the world's largest prawns at a restaurant balanced on a rock off the coast of Zanzibar.

Episodes.Title: Mindbending Meals
Episodes.Description: Get your head on straight and get ready for host Michael Yo's brain bending journey to five restaurants that are meant to play tricks on your mind. Have an "A-Ha" moment- and a donut- inside a black and white comic book world in Chicago. Step inside a funky forest in Tokyo and watch your food grow right before your eyes, then journey back to reality in the fantasy world of Las Vegas at a "20,000 Leagues Under the Sea " themed tasting.

Episodes.Title: Lost in America
Episodes.Description: Grab your map and appetite, as host Michael Yo sets his sights on the best-off road eats worth the extra mile. Buckle up as we hit the backroads for bison burgers in Alabama to brussel sprouts behind bars in Connecticut. Then it's American fare - with a fun twist - on a grounded airplane in Colorado. And nothing rounds out an American road trip like a two pound hot dog served in a broken down bus, but make sure there's still some gas in the tank to make it to Pie-Town, Arizona for dessert!

Episodes.Title: Food to Die For
Episodes.Description: Dining out can be risky business at these five restaurants where life-or-death stakes are served up daily. Host Michael Yo tags along as diners test their fate with a toxic pufferfish in Tokyo before biding time with a potentially poisonous pokeberry-forward multi-course menu in North Carolina. Then it's off to Portland, Oregon for the hottest heat a diner can handle.

Episodes.Title: Small Space Big Taste
Episodes.Description: They say big things come in small packages and in this episode host Michael Yo discovers that similarly, big flavors can come in small dining spaces. Squeeze into a four-table pancake house in Amsterdam, shoehorn into an oyster bar in a NYC brownstone, elbow into a ramen shop in Manhattan where you eat in solo dining booths, slide into a hidden hotel suite in Chicago where sushi is served for only six people, and cram into an eight-foot-wide fine dining restaurant in Argentina.

Episodes.Title: Tables of Terror
Episodes.Description: The restaurants in this episode might lean a little scary, but they also serve up food that's scary good! Join host Michael Yo on a visit to a Tokyo restaurant dedicated to vampires. Then it's off to Portland for a meal at the former home of a mad scientist before heading to St. Louis for a taco restaurant that pays homage to horror films, death metal music, and vegan food.

Episodes.Title: Bites of Fantasy
Episodes.Description: Dining out takes flight into the world of fantasy when host Michael Yo shows us that make-believe experiences can be really tasty. First stop is a restaurant in New York City's Financial District where even the drinks grow on trees - with one wave of a magic wand! Then it's across the pond to London for a creative culinary fairy tale.

Episodes.Title: A View to Dine For
Episodes.Description: Dining where the scenery is as spectacular as the food is no tall order at these five locations.

Episodes.Title: Meals in Motion
Episodes.Description: Join Michael Yo as he circles the world for meals that can't, won't, and don't stop.

Episodes.Title: Underground
Episodes.Description: In this episode, host Michael Yo goes "underneath it all" to find five of the most unique dining adventures to go below and beyond!

Episodes.Title: Dine with Animals
Episodes.Description: Don't feed the animals at these unique dining establishments, unless they're your dinner companions. Host Michael Yo joins some furry, feathered, and ferocious friends for supper on the ocean floor with the sea life in the Maldives.

Episodes.Title: Cooking It Old School
Episodes.Description: These cooking methods have aged like a fine wine--withstanding the tests of time and taste buds. Join host Michael Yo for a history lesson in five culinary customs.

Episodes.Title: The Plate Outdoors
Episodes.Description: Dining al-fresco levels up in this episode as host Michael Yo takes us on a tour of truly unique outdoor dining experiences.

Episodes.Title: Appetite for Adventure
Episodes.Description: If you're hungry for excitement, this episode will certainly satisfy even the most ravenous appetites for adventure. Join host Michael Yo for a wild ride in the desert on a horse for a delicious dinner with literally no frills.

Episodes.Title: Blasts from the Past
Episodes.Description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to go back in time for a dining experience from a bygone era? In this episode, host Michael Yo transports viewers to an NYC 1920's style speakeasy, where the food is as decadent as the entertainment!

Entries.Title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
Entries.Description: When winter slams into the highways of the American Rockies, heavy recovery specialists from four companies race into action, working to clear wrecks and open roads. Whether it's a raging fire or toxic spill, crews roll up ready to battle the wreckage. They've got the equipment and the skills. But with more than a million people depending on the route that crosses these three states every day, the one thing they don't have, is time.

Episodes.Title: Dangerous Spot to Be
Episodes.Description: A semi bursts into flames, pushing Jesse and crew to make an urgent recovery; Mountain Recovery fights to free a jackknife during a big storm.

Episodes.Title: Dead Man's Curve
Episodes.Description: After a tractor pulling double trailers rolls over during a freak snowstorm, Mountain Recovery faces massive damage and an impossible deadline; heavy winds assault I-80 in Wyoming, closing the highway and pushing Jim and Brendan to their limits.

Episodes.Title: Clearing Lanes and Taking Names
Episodes.Description: Utah crashes prompt Stauffer's dramatic recoveries; mountain team tackles river rescue.

Episodes.Title: A Slick Situation
Episodes.Description: Intense winds and icy roads send a semi to the edge of a sheer drop; heavy snowfall forces Charlie out of his comfort zone and into a much bigger truck than normal; Bad Grandpa schools the boss in the art of recovery.

Episodes.Title: Problems on Top of Problems
Episodes.Description: When winds blow a bus off of I-80, Art must wrestle it back; a load of produce rolls off, tearing down a fence that's keeping a herd of elk from the highway; Jesse races to finish a tough recovery in time to be part of an important family milestone.

Episodes.Title: Weight Is My Enemy
Episodes.Description: Charlie struggles with a surprise storm on Vail Pass; Brendan faces pressure after a promotion; Cory's rigging and patience are tested by a heavy manure load.

Episodes.Title: Out of Nowhere
Episodes.Description: Charlie, Big Jon and crew fight a stubborn wreck on the coldest night of the winter; Austin and Kevan head up a remote mountain pass to rescue a lost driver; Brendan is put to the test in his new role when a hazardous load springs a leak on I-80.

Episodes.Title: We Don't Give Up
Episodes.Description: Chuck faces a dangerous, high-tension wreck that threatens to snap a guardrail cable; a multi-day mud recovery frustrates the Stauffer's crew, pushing Jesse to call for help from an unexpected source.

Entries.Title: Viraatapalem: PC Meena Reporting 2025
Entries.Description: Set in the 1980s in the fictional village of Viraatapalem, the series follows a mysterious curse believed to cause newlywed brides to die on their wedding day. As a result, marriages have been avoided in the village for over a decade. Police constable Meenakshi, known as PC Meena, is transferred to the village and begins investigating the deaths. She is joined by Kittu, a reformed convict, as they explore the village's past and attempt to uncover the truth behind the incidents.

Entries.Title: Fugitive Hunters Mexico
Entries.Description: Fugitive Hunters Mexico" follows an undercover unit as they investigate, track and capture American fugitives who have crossed the border to evade justice. With intel from the FBI, DEA, US Marshals and Mexican authorities, this taskforce locates and apprehends US fugitives hiding out in Mexico to hand them over to law enforcement in the US to face justice for their crimes.

Episodes.Title: Trouble in Paradise
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters go undercover at a gym to capture an American on the run wanted for murder in California; the agents then pose as tourists in a beach town to find a fugitive from San Diego wanted for drug trafficking.

Episodes.Title: Going Under Cover
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters go undercover at a gym to capture an American on the run wanted for murder in California. The agents then pose as tourists in a beach town to find a fugitive from San Diego wanted for drug trafficking.

Episodes.Title: A Life of Crime
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters get into a high-speed chase to catch a convicted murderer from Bakersfield, Calif.; a fugitive from Los Angeles indicted for drug trafficking and impersonating an ICE officer tries to stay one step ahead.

Episodes.Title: Hiding in Plain Sight
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters are tracking a California man wanted for drug and firearm trafficking who thinks he's safe in a quiet Mexican beach town. Then, the agents are on the hunt for a young convicted drug trafficker who has a lot to lose.

Episodes.Title: The Money Trail
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters are on the trail of an American man on the run after a drive-by shooting in Phoenix. Meanwhile, agents go on the hunt for a gang member wanted for murder in southern California, who has been hiding out in Mexico for almost 4 years.

Episodes.Title: Catch Me If You Can
Episodes.Description: An American teenager wanted for murder in Chicago thinks he's safe from justice in Tijuana. Meanwhile, the agents track down a man from Nevada who's been sexually harassing women and girls. The team is determined to catch a convicted drug trafficker who got away from them before.

Episodes.Title: Nowhere to Hide
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters stop a suspicious woman who tries to hide her identity while elsewhere, the agents surround the house of a human trafficker when it bursts into flames. Meanwhile, they hunt for a woman on the FBI's Most Wanted list and head out at night to track down an armed and dangerous fugitive.

Episodes.Title: A Dangerous Job
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters go undercover to track down a drug trafficker hiding out in a beach town and team and then head to the red light district to search for a woman convicted of drug smuggling. Next, the agents set up a sting operation to capture a man wanted in Oregon for crimes against minors.

Episodes.Title: Hiding in the Valley
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters search for a man wanted for the attempted murder of his girlfriend in San Diego. Next, they head to a cartel-controlled area on the hunt for a convicted human trafficker and go in search of a female drug smuggler who never sleeps in the same place twice.

Episodes.Title: Desperate Measures
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters chase after a convicted drug trafficker who risks his life to get away and then, the agents get a lead on a woman wanted for murder in San Diego who has been hiding out in Tijuana for 3 years.

Episodes.Title: Caught at the Border
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters race to catch a man wanted for killing his wife in California while an American woman from rural New York ends up in prison in Mexico. The agents then help an American teenage girl get justice.

Episodes.Title: On a Mission
Episodes.Description: The Fugitive Hunters team up with the Mexican army when their target is connected to a notorious drug cartel. Followed by the agents pulling over a suspicious car and find two men on a deadly mission.

Entries.Title: James May's Great Explorers
Entries.Description:
There was a time, before football and rock'n'roll, when explorers were the A-listers of their day. Death-defying antics and tales of daring made them the stuff of legend: names like Columbus, Raleigh, and Cook, who sailed off over the horizon to discover new lands and bring home treasures unimaginable to those sitting at home in dark, damp Europe.   

Intrepid explorers they may have been, but ‘great' might be pushing it. Across the seven seas, they spilled blood and spread disease. They enabled the destruction of civilisations and the growth of slavery.  And many of their ‘discoveries' weren't quite what you'd think...

Episodes.Title: Christopher Columbus
Episodes.Description: James rewrites stories of the greatest explorers in his inimitable, entertaining way, beginning with Columbus, and discovering how he merely 'stumbled across' two continents and took the spoils.

Episodes.Title: Sir Walter Raleigh
Episodes.Description: James May uncovers the truth behind Sir Walter Raleigh's legendary rise - from his persuasive skills to his New World ventures - and reveals the dark legacy of his explorations.

Episodes.Title: Captain Cook
Episodes.Description: In his unique style, James explores Captain Cook's rise to naval captain and his legacy - even experiencing first-hand his own apprenticeship aboard a tall ship.

Episodes.Title: This is Us
Episodes.Description: On the morning of their second wedding anniversary, Stacey and Joe share how they met and fell in love. Raising five children aged between 1 and 16 is no mean feat, especially combined with ambitious passion projects like building a two-acre fishing lake. Joe quips that Pickle Cottage is a lot like his and Stacey's relationship, and that they're constantly working on it.

Episodes.Title: My Day One
Episodes.Description: The family return from holiday and come crashing back to reality with busy schedules. With Joe on the road and Stacey at home juggling work and family, there is a strained atmosphere coming to a head over some spilled baked beans. As the NTAs loom, Stacey takes a trip down memory lane, rummaging through her old X Factor memorabilia before hitting the red carpet with Zach as the rest of the family wait nervously at home.

Entries.Title: Confessions of Octomom
Entries.Description: Once known as Octomom, Natalie Suleman provides an intimate look at her life story and her life today as a mother of 14 children.

Episodes.Title: The Birth of Octomom
Episodes.Description: Natalie Suleman, infamously known as "Octomom," shocks the world after delivering the world's first surviving set of octuplets with the help of IVF. When her identity is leaked to the media, her and her 14 children's lives are changed forever.

Episodes.Title: The Hunt for Donor Dad
Episodes.Description: For years, speculation has swirled about who fathered Natalie Suleman's 14 children, and now she and her family are setting the record straight about her unconventional path to becoming a mom.

Episodes.Title: The Most Hated Woman in America
Episodes.Description: As a single mother to 14 children, societal judgement of Natalie runs high and she and her family find themselves having to fend off challenges from unwanted adoption requests, powerful attorneys, strangers alleging child abuse, CPS investigations, and even Natalie's own parents.

Episodes.Title: The Cost of Infamy
Episodes.Description: Single and unemployed, Natalie reluctantly embraces the "Octomom" label to provide for her family, but soon finds that keeping the cash flowing in brings devastating consequences for her and her 14 children.

Episodes.Title: The Rocto-Bottom
Episodes.Description: Natalie is evicted from her home and stars in an adult film to pay her bills, all while using prescription medication to numb her anxiety. With her family's emotional lives at stake, Natalie desperately plots an escape from the public eye.

Episodes.Title: Out of Hiding
Episodes.Description: Natalie escapes the public eye with her family but finds the wreckage of her past still haunts them all. Meanwhile, Natalie plans a staycation for the octuplet's 16th birthday, but her own anxiety might derail the whole trip.

Entries.Title: Animals, They're Just Like Us!
Entries.Description: Peek inside the lives of penguins, giraffes, chimps, and other animals that behave a whole lot like humans. Touch down on all seven continents around the world to see why these wild creatures compete, co-operate, love, and grieve just like we do. From dolphins creating names to flamingos wearing makeup and monkeys that floss to sharks that visit the dentist, the animal kingdom is surprisingly similar to our own!

Episodes.Title: A Penguin Proposal
Episodes.Description: Meet a lovey-dovey penguin, a flamingo makeup artist, and a badger making great escapes.

Episodes.Title: House Hunting Hermit Crabs
Episodes.Description: Attend a crabby shell swap, meet a chimp’s pet, and size up an otter kidnapper.

Episodes.Title: Meerkat Survival School
Episodes.Description: Bone up on desert eats, flirt with lions, and witness an elephant babysitters' club.

Episodes.Title: Pirate Birds
Episodes.Description: Steal meals with frigate birds, visit a warthog spa, and crack an elephant code.

Episodes.Title: Lion Daycare
Episodes.Description: Monkeys season their food, lemurs whiff cologne, and bees let out warning screams.

Episodes.Title: Shark Dentist
Episodes.Description: Follow a fishy hygienist, examine a monkey’s tools, and cozy up to affectionate giraffes.

Entries.Title: Reframe the Game
Entries.Description: Celebrate the untold stories of women's sport through three compelling short films. Spanning football, rugby, and motorsports, these inspirational stories bring new perspectives and showcase incredible women from across the globe.

Episodes.Title: The Long Away Game
Episodes.Description: A young woman stands on the sidelines, the roar of the Harrogate FC crowd in the background, waiting to walk onto the pitch. This is the story of an Afghan footballer who dreamed of a career in sport. When the Taliban regained control of the country in 2021, her world turned upside down. She was evacuated from Kabul on a flight funded by none other than Kim Kardashian

Entries.Description: Pets will devour anything. But wild, wacky and weird meals can quickly turn into an emergency. That’s when the call goes out to Dr. G, a master of non-surgical ‘seek and recover’.

Episodes.Title: Foreign Bodies
Episodes.Description: A canine’s strange appetite delivers a stomach full of surprises. A cat with “hair-ific” taste leads to a marathon recovery mission. Dr. G’s son, Ben, joins him for an action-packed summer.

Episodes.Title: Under Where?!
Episodes.Description: A Bernese Mountain Dog suspected of scarfing an unmentionable feast is a potential record-breaking challenge for Dr. G; a feline rushed to a clinic after a close encounter with a sewing kit sparks a race against the clock to save a family from loss.

Episodes.Title: A Threadening Situation
Episodes.Description: A tuxedo cat takes playtime too far, pitting Dr. G against a life-threatening foreign body; a barbeque season corn-undrum lands a Golden Retriever in urgent care.

Episodes.Title: Purse Snatcher
Episodes.Description: Rocky, a mixed-breed canine suspected of scarfing a purse, deals Dr. G unexpected side dishes; a puppy with a troubled tummy is a head-scratching case from beginning to end.

Episodes.Title: All You Need is Glove
Episodes.Description: An old dog develops new tastes that aren't exactly what they seem; when a feline devours a stringy oddity, vet staff are blind to its identity; Ben realizes Dr. G is nearing a major career milestone.

Episodes.Title: Rock Solid Rescue
Episodes.Description: When a Golden Retriever's tastes go off the beaten track Dr. G's skills must be rock-solid; Captain the three-legged cat's appetite proves to be as unique as his form; Dr. G's furry family brings a special inspiration to his work and life.

Episodes.Title: Show Me The Money
Episodes.Description: One feline has an appetite that's shockingly on the money, while another's taste for stringy oddities appears to be insatiable; while Ben is back home visiting family, an exotic bird with questionable peckishness puts Dr. G out of his comfort zone.

Episodes.Title: Toy My God!
Episodes.Description: A pet owner who is a nurse gets a front-row seat as Dr. G explores a troublesome appetite; a feline at risk for a dangerous blockage means a high-pressure game of cat and mouse.

Episodes.Title: Blade Runner
Episodes.Description: Dr. G gets tied up as he unravels the cause of Ivan the cat's questionable mood; a fellow veterinarian calls for help when her beloved Poodle's cough points to foreign material in an unusual place.

Episodes.Title: Rebel Without A Gauze
Episodes.Description: A canine's countertop gulp puts Dr. G and Ben on the road to a wholly challenging case; a feline who may have nibbled from a first aid kit presents a dire situation; Ben tries to pull his old school dad into the 21st century with mobile digital gear.

Entries.Title: The Sound and the Fury
Entries.Description: From the Japanese invasion of Manchuria to the siege of Stalingrad, and from the attack on Pearl Harbor to the battle of El Alamein, the events of the Second World War are presented on a 'planet level' to place it on a truly global scale

Episodes.Title: The Blaze (1939 - 1941)
Episodes.Description: Germany invades Poland, sparking global war: Japan expands in Asia and Africa's colonies become key battlegrounds for power and resources.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: In 1941, Hitler invaded the USSR. Operation Barbarossa stalls as winter hits and Soviet resistance, fuelled by propaganda, turns the tide.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: In 1943, Germany fell at Stalingrad, its first major defeat. In the Pacific, Japan lost momentum after the US won at Guadalcanal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In 1944, D-Day pierces the Atlantic Wall, as Operation Bagration crushes the Wehrmacht in the East. The fall of the Third Reich begins.

Entries.Title: Spilled Paint
Entries.Description: A sinister figure in the underground art world forces talented artists to paint fakes and passes them off to influential players to make him rich, then kills them..until a famed artist, thought dead, resurfaces. Inspired by true events.

Episodes.Title: The Beginnings
Episodes.Description: Desperate for a break, Miami artist Patrick Walsh partners with a notorious dealer, only to be trapped in a world of stolen art and forgery. Danger mounts, his girlfriend Helena becomes a target and Patrick must risk everything to escape.

Episodes.Title: Fear the Reaper
Episodes.Description: Patrick's reckless use of Ponce's bait money leads to disaster. With his patience gone, Ponce targets Patrick and Helena. Desperate to fix his mistake, Patrick scrambles for a way out, but every move only tightens the noose around them.

Episodes.Title: How Deals are Made
Episodes.Description: Patrick and Helena try to flee Miami, but Ponce's men capture Patrick, putting Helena's life in danger. As the FBI closes in, Helena reveals her notorious hidden identity as the legendary artist "Natale," giving Ponce new leverage.

Episodes.Title: The Unfolding
Episodes.Description: The FBI, led by Director Gilroy with a personal vendetta, intensifies its pursuit of Ponce. At his estate, Helena-exposed as Natale-is forced to forge works. As Valentina sympathizes, Patrick is pulled deeper into the FBI's dangerous plot.

Episodes.Title: Loop, Swoop and Pull
Episodes.Description: Under pressure, Patrick learns the FBI has secretly wired him, complicating his fragile alliance. Tensions rise as Natale and Valentina bond, fracturing Ponce's control. Betrayals brew, setting the stage for a volatile showdown.

Episodes.Title: Crossing Lines
Episodes.Description: Ponce's grand gallery event erupts as the FBI's sting unfolds. Criminals clash, alliances shift, and Valentina and Natale sabotage Ponce's empire. After the violent showdown, Patrick and Natale reunite-but Ponce's shadow remains.

Episodes.Title: Behind the Mask
Episodes.Description: In Lancashire, teenager Alex Davies was murdered by Brian Healless, whom he met on a dating app. Healless, suffering from untreated paranoid schizophrenia, was sentenced

Episodes.Title: Betrayal & Murder
Episodes.Description: In April 2022, 33-year-old Katie Kenyon vanished from her home in Padiham. A chilling investigation revealed her manipulative ex-boyfriend, Andrew Burfield, 50, had trapped her in a cycle of fear.

Episodes.Title: Last Seen
Episodes.Description: When Sian O'Callaghan vanishes from a Swindon nightclub. investigators fear for the worst.

Episodes.Title: A Life Cut Short
Episodes.Description: The serene backdrop of Orrell Water Park becomes the stage for a chilling crime that turned a peaceful setting into a scene of horror when Ellen Higginbottom is murdered by Mark Buckley in Wigan.

Episodes.Title: Lost Innocence
Episodes.Description: In 2021, the community of Pembroke is rocked by the disappearance of Lily Sullivan after she went out with her friends. Detective track down her final movements to uncover what happened to her.

Episodes.Title: Fatal Attraction
Episodes.Description: In 2016, police are called to the home in Helmshore when the Sadie Hartley fails to show up for work. Officers find her murdered inside the house. Investigators are determined to catch those responsible.

Episodes.Title: The Cold Case
Episodes.Description: In December 2013, the peaceful village of Bosham in West Sussex was rocked by the murder of Valerie Graves, a talented artist and grandmother.

Episodes.Title: Dark Deceit
Episodes.Description: Michael O'Leary is murdered by his best friend Andrew Jones after an affair with Andrew's wife. Lured to Andrew's farm under false pretenses, Michael is executed.

Episodes.Title: Trapped
Episodes.Description: We examine the tragic case of Georgia Williams, a 17-year-old from Shropshire, who was murdered by Jamie Reynolds, a disturbed individual who meticulously planned her death.

Episodes.Title: The Vanished
Episodes.Description: We explore the murder of Emma Caldwell, a 27-year-old whose body was found in Limefield Woods in 2005. Iain Packer, a sign installer with a violent past, evaded justice for years.

Entries.Title: Castles That Made Ireland
Entries.Description: Castles are the powerhouses that dot across our islands. History Hit’s Matt Lewis discovers Irish castles, from ancient high points to Norman keeps to medieval citadels.

Episodes.Title: High Kings & Invaders
Episodes.Description: In the first episode we head to the High King’s of Ireland seat of power, the Hill of Tara, before investigating the Norman invasions and the powerful structures they built…castles! Matt begins at the Hill of Tara, or in Irish Teamhair or Cnoc na Teamhrach, an ancient site for projecting spiritual and political power. Matt reveals the mystical stories of the High King’s of Ireland, including the formative leader Brian Boru. But it’s not just Boru who has a direct link to Tara, one of Ireland’s most famous people is said to have come here…St Patrick. Patrick is believed to have performed miracles challenging the old pagan rulers, bringing christianity to the island of Ireland. Tara remains a magical place, even today. But Ireland wasn’t to be ruled by High Kings forever...In 1167 the Normans invaded. For years they fought.

Episodes.Title: Friends & Enemies
Episodes.Description: In this episode Matt explores Ireland’s historic links with Scotland. His journey continues at the beautiful and windswept Dunluce Castle on the north coast and finishes at the colossal fortress of Carrickfergus.

Entries.Title: Crash Course Native American History
Entries.Description: Over the course of 24 episodes, we’re going to learn about Native American history. Host Che Jim will teach you about the deep, ongoing history of Native peoples in what’s now known as the United States—from time immemorial to the Land Back movement.

Episodes.Title: Introduction to Native American History
Episodes.Description: Native American history didn’t begin in 1492, and it didn’t end in 1900. It stretches back thousands and thousands of years and extends into the present – and the future – of the United States. In our first episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll explore why and how we plan to tell this history.

Episodes.Title: Tribal Sovereignty Explained
Episodes.Description: What is tribal sovereignty? In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll explore how tribes can and can’t govern themselves, and why sovereignty isn’t something the U.S. ever gave to tribes — it’s an inherent right they already had.

Episodes.Title: Myths & Misconceptions About Native Americans
Episodes.Description: From sports mascots to “the First Thanksgiving,” bland representations of Native Americans are everywhere. In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll tackle common myths and misconceptions about Native people and uncover the truth behind tribal casinos, government handouts, and more.

Episodes.Title: What Makes Someone Native American?
Episodes.Description: What makes a Native American? Is it the way a person looks, their family history, or something else? In this episode of Crash Course Native American history, we dive into the ways people define and reclaim tribal identity, from blood quantums and federal recognition to language and more.

Episodes.Title: Why Land Matters to Native Americans
Episodes.Description: What do we mean when we say that Native Americans have a strong connection to the land? In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll explore how Native peoples’ long, deep history on their homelands informs their culture, languages, and identity to this day.

Episodes.Title: What Unites Native Worldviews?
Episodes.Description: Just like everyone, all Native Americans are unique. But what do they have in common? In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll explore similarities in Native worldviews, from harvest traditions to humor.

Episodes.Title: The Real Impacts of Archaeology on Native Americans
Episodes.Description: Archaeology and anthropology are amazingly interesting fields, but they also have a legacy of dehumanizing and mistreating Native peoples. In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll uncover the dark history of Native grave robbing, explore the ways these fields are righting past wrongs, and discover the story of one Inuk’s journey to honor his late father.

Episodes.Title: Introduction to Indigenous Knowledge
Episodes.Description: The scientific method isn’t the only way to gain knowledge—Native people have been learning and innovating in their own ways for millennia. In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll discover the ways Western science and Indigenous knowledge can braid together to create a better world.

Episodes.Title: What are the Fish Wars and Why Do They Matter?
Episodes.Description: What does food sovereignty mean—and why does it matter? In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll explore how Native peoples’ deep ties to their traditional foods splintered under colonization, and why many Native people are fighting to keep those foods in their communities or bring them back.

Episodes.Title: The Truth About Columbus’s “First Contact”
Episodes.Description: In 1492 Columbus sailed the ocean blue…and drastically changed the lives of Native Americans forever. In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll unpack misconceptions around first contact between Europeans and Natives and explore how Native peoples are still resisting colonialism today.

Episodes.Title: From the Trail of Tears to Wounded Knee
Episodes.Description: It’s time for the Eras Tour… well, the colonialism version. In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll unpack the history of the Treaty Era and the Reservation Era, and all the broken promises and ripple effects that came with them.

Episodes.Title: The History of America’s Indian Boarding Schools
Episodes.Description: What did it mean to “Kill the Indian, Save the Man”? In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll learn about assimilation and allotment: a period where the U.S. government tried to eliminate Native Americans by erasing their culture, their way of life, and their claim over the land.

Episodes.Title: The Indian Reorganization Act Explained
Episodes.Description: Something big happened in 1934—but whether it was good or bad depends on who you ask. In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll unpack the ins and outs of the Indian Reorganization Act, the first piece of legislation that tried to right the wrongs of the U.S. government against Native Americans, and its ninety-year-long legacy.

Episodes.Title: The Termination Act & The Tribe That Fought Back
Episodes.Description: Termination and relocation might seem like totally unrelated policies—but they were part of the same disappearing act. In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll learn how terminating federal recognition for more than a hundred Native nations while encouraging Native people to move to cities served the same goals.

Episodes.Title: The Native Civil Rights Movement
Episodes.Description: We’re in our self-determination era! In this episode of Crash Course Native American History, we’ll explore the activism that led to the biggest change in modern federal Indian policy, and how it affects Native nations today.

Entries.Title: Spring Break Murders
Entries.Description: Spring Break Murders reveals the untold stories lurking beneath the sun-soaked surface of the most popular holiday destinations. Found brutally murdered on their vacations – students and young people are the collateral damage. Across the series, we expose the unseen threat facing millions of youth – surfacing tragic cases and uncovering the negligence of caretakers and local authorities. This is a parent's worst nightmare.

Episodes.Description: Twenty-one-year-old Kanako Ohyama is found dead in New Orleans. Police use her journal and photos to uncover the truth behind her murder.

Episodes.Title: Tynesha Stewart
Episodes.Description: Harris County, Texas. In March 2017, 19-year-old In Tynesha Stewart studies civil engineering at Texas A&M University and returns home to Houston to see family and friends on Spring Break. She also has big plans to attend a Beyoncé concert at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo with her friends. But Tynesha never shows up for the show. The search begins, and with the help of the leader of Houston's New Black Panthers, they identify a suspect, uncovering the details of Tynesha's murder.

Episodes.Title: Mark Kilroy
Episodes.Description: Matamoros, Mexico/Brownsville, Texas. In March 1989, 21-year-old Mark Kilroy had been talking about Spring Break with his friends since the start of the fall semester. A pre-med junior at University of Texas, Mark couldn't wait to travel to South Padre Island, Texas for some sunshine and fun. But the morning after partying in the border cities of Brownsville, Texas and Matamoros, Mexico, his friends realize Mark has vanished. Two months later, a trail of evidence lead investigators to a remote region of Mexico where Mark was one of a dozens victims of ritual satanic sacrifice and cannibalism.

Episodes.Title: Jarret Clark
Episodes.Description: Wahoo Bay, Oklahoma. In May 2006, 18-year-old Jarret Clark doesn't return home from a comping trip with friends. Wahoo Bay campground in Oklahoma offers the spring break crowd both beauty and privacy. Which makes finding reliable witnesses difficult, and his parents don't believe the story the other campers are telling. When his body turns up it appears as though he may have simply wondered off and drowned as reported, but the autopsy is inconclusive. It will take the Clark families relentless push for justice unearth at the facts that a Jarret's assailants hoped would stay hidden within the woods.

Episodes.Title: Natalee Holloway
Episodes.Description: Oranjestad, Aruba. Solved, October 2023. In May 2005, 18-year-old Natalee Holloway takes a Spring Break trip to Aruba with her girlfriends to celebrate their last year of high-school. During a night of fun and partying at a beach bar, Natalee and her friends meet a few young men who match the girls' spirit of fun. As the night wears-on, the group splits-up. Some head back the hotel, while others stay out for more partying. When Natalie's friends wake-up in their hotel the next morning, Natalie's not there. Local authorities can't find her either. So, Natalee's family calls in the FBI. After five years of rumors and false leads, investigators finally piece together the grim truth of what happened to Natalie that night: she'd been murdered and the crime covered-up. In the end, the FBI brings her killer to justice.

Unfortunately, Chatfah falls from the highest floor of a vacation home to her three older sisters' shocked eyes before her body disappears. The three sisters namely Baibua, Chompoo, and Picha become suspects in Chatfah's disappearance. Baibua Bootharika is the eldest sister who is composed, wise, and has always sacrificed for her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Chatfah, who has just received a significant inheritance from her father and is about to marry. This moment is pivotal as it establishes her character's backstory and motivations. However, the tone quickly shifts when Chatfah unexpectedly falls from the highest floor of a vacation home in the presence of her three older sisters: Baibua, Chomphu, and Putpichaya, all of whom witness the incident. As Chatfah's body mysteriously disappears, her sisters become suspects in her disappearance, introducing a creeping sense of mistrust and tension amongst them.
