Entries.Title: Women’s Sports Now
Entries.Description: Covering topics in women's sports; expert insights and insider coverage of the week's most newsworthy moments - from NCAA basketball, NWSL, the WNBA Draft, Wimbledon, and more; guests bring their unique POV to the week's discussion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 101
Episodes.Description: Women's Sports Now is your front-row seat to the unstoppable rise of women's sports. Hosted by Renee Montgomery, Sarah Tiana, Colleen Wolfe, and Suzy Shuster, the show mixes humor, expert takes, and exclusive interviews. Today, we dive into March Madness head-first as Suzy talks women's sports with Shaquille O'Neal and UCLA women's basketball coach Cori Close, stops by the studio to talk Bruins Basketball.

Episodes.Title: Episode 102
Episodes.Description: Women's Sports Now is your front-row seat to the unstoppable rise of women's sports. Hosted by Renee Montgomery, Sarah Tiana, Colleen Wolfe, and Suzy Shuster, the show mixes humor, expert takes, and exclusive interviews. We dive into March Madness head-first with former lowa women's basketball head coach Lisa Bluder and talk about all the biggest stories in Women's Sports.

Episodes.Title: Episode 103
Episodes.Description:
This week on Women's Sports Now, we dive into the madness of March and break down the Final Four.

Our guest, Minnesota Lynx head coach Cheryl Reeve, brings her perspective to the biggest stories in the game. It's your front-row seat to the unstoppable rise of women's sports-hosted by Renee Montgomery, Sarah Tiana, Colleen Wolfe, and Suzy Shuster-full of sharp takes, big laughs, and can't-miss moments.

Episodes.Title: Episode 104
Episodes.Description: This week on Women's Sports Now, NBA royalty Laker's Boss, Jeanie Buss joins us in studio for a candid convo you don't want to miss. Plus, the crew breaks down the NCAA Championship game and looks ahead to the WNBA Draft with sharp takes and fresh insight. It's your front-row seat to the unstoppable rise of women's sports-hosted by Renee Montgomery, Sarah Tiana, Colleen Wolfe, and Suzy Shuster-full of big laughs, bold opinions, and the weeks can't-miss moments.

Episodes.Title: Episode 105
Episodes.Description: This week on Women's Sports Now, Gisele and Alyssa Thompson of Angel City FC open up about life in the spotlight, playing for the USWNT, and rising together in pro soccer. Plus, we're breaking down the WNBA Draft and the biggest headlines from around women's sports. From bold debates to behind-the-scenes stories, WSN delivers the insights and fun you won't find anywhere else.

Entries.Title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
Entries.Description: Nisha will prepare some of her favourite recipes at her home using ingredients from local suppliers and her own garden. She shares her home with family, their three dogs, four horses, four goats and assorted ducks, chickens, guinea fowl and alpacas, and viewers will be immersed in the laughter, visits from friends (some furry) as Nisha shares recipes for simple but delicious dishes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Nisha Katona's family help her cook a chicken dhansak, a green bean and mango dal bunny chow, and a Hungarian family favourite of layered cabbage with pork mince.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Nisha cooks a chicken korma approved by her auntie, an Eastern European clear vegetable soup with dumplings, and a marinated tandoori monkfish on a barbecue.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Nisha Katona cooks a traditional monsoon mushroom curry with grapes, some tasty barbecued corn on the cob, and a cote de boeuf with the best spiced chilli rub.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Nisha Katona cooks a salmon and tomato curry, an aubergine curry with fresh roti, and the gooiest corner shop brownies in town with the help of her daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Nisha Katona cooks an oxtail and shin curry, spiced barbecued prawns, and a tahini banana bread and butter pudding with candied bacon and pecan bourbon ice cream

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Nisha cooks a feast including ginger biscuit lamb raan and poppy seed potatoes.

Entries.Title: Titans of Defense
Entries.Description: Titans of Defence operate at the forefront of technology and design. Attuned to their surroundings -- and in the harshest of battlefield conditions -- these military machines sense, strike, adapt, and defuse using ingenious engineering.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Colossal tanks, artillery machines delivering surgically precise hits, transforming APCs and ship-to-shore assault vehicles are at the forefront of battlefield technology

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Supersonic fighter jets like the F-35 Lightning II; high-flying chameleons like the Eurofighter Typhoon; hulking cargo craft like the Super Galaxy, capable of hauling incredible loads; the world's most advanced aircraft.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: In friendly and enemy waters, finely-tuned warships and submarines boast stealth, speed, launch, and strike capabilities.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Whether they're flying important supplies to the battlefield, hovering above combat operations or enacting international missions in the harshest of conditions, military helicopters are honed for their purposes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: When militaries need support in the field, they call upon military machines designed for diverse purposes: from delivering supplies to the battlefield and defusing dangerous minefields, to recovering military vehicles and bridging harrowing gaps.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The age of drone warfare and autonomous defense is upon us, and to carry out remote operations, drones, missiles and defense systems employ game-changing sensors, algorithms and control centres.

Entries.Title: Plant Peeps
Entries.Description: The crazy lives of the plants living in a hydroponic garden.

Episodes.Title: The Pump
Episodes.Description: When the hydroponic system's pump fails, the Plant Peeps face a life-or-death crisis. As hydration levels drop, tensions rise, and blame falls on the messy tomato, Tomy. With time running out, the plants must work together to unclog the pump, sending the smallest among them, Baby Carrot, on a daring rescue mission.

Episodes.Title: Grow A Spine
Episodes.Description: The Plant Peeps are under attack-this time from Jaws, the house cat, who's snacking on Radishmir's leaves. As the plants struggle to defend themselves, a mysterious new arrival, Spiny the cactus, offers a solution. While most of the plants are charmed by Spiny's resilience and independent water supply, Carrod remains skeptical, fearing the newcomer will divert resources. But when Baby Carrot is in danger, Spiny proves that sometimes, a little toughness goes a long way.

Episodes.Title: Plants Got Talent
Episodes.Description: It's time for the annual talent competition, and the Plant Peeps are ready to show off their skills-singing, juggling, magic, and even psychic abilities. But when Tomy secretly "juices" with extra nutrients, the entire hydro system's pH level skyrockets, turning the plants bitter-literally. As chaos erupts on stage, it's up to Spiny to figure out what went wrong before the competition spirals out of control.

Episodes.Title: The Garden Girls
Episodes.Description: In this whimsical Golden Girls parody, the hydroponic garden's peace is uprooted when Straw's aphid infestation sparks chaos among the veggie crew-Pep (Blanche), Peazy (Sophia), Corny (Dorothy), and Straw (Rose). As the bugs threaten their leafy lifestyles, the plants scramble between marigold traps, ladybug predators, and a soapy exterminator showdown, all while trading sharp-tongued barbs and plant-themed puns.

Episodes.Title: Unidentified Fly Object
Episodes.Description: When Straw's late-night UFO scare rattles the hydroponic garden, Curu fuels the panic with tales of alien abductions while Cauli drops cryptic hints about a traumatic "probing" incident. As debates over rapture theories and rogue pests divide the plants, their paranoia reaches a boiling point-but the real threat might be closer than they think.

Episodes.Title: Happy Sproutday, Curu
Episodes.Description: When the Plant Peeps throw a Sproutday bash for Curu, the celebration takes a trippy turn after Curu shares a mystical tale about "magic mushrooms" and eternal energy. As the plants unexpectedly tap into cosmic vibes, chaos erupts-leading to wild revelations, existential meltdowns, and a leafy mishap that leaves Ro questioning his foliage future. A psychedelic plant party where sproutdays aren't the only thing growing... or not growing.

Episodes.Title: Shiny Gold Circle
Episodes.Description: When the Walkers' marital spat over a lost wedding ring leaves the Plant Peeps starving, the desperate veggies hatch a risky plan: retrieve the ring from the jaws of danger-literally. With Baby Carrot venturing into the cat's litter box and Spiny on defense duty, Carrod's parental panic clashes with the group's chaotic teamwork. A high-stakes mission where love, hunger, and a predatory cat collide.

Episodes.Title: Furquake!
Episodes.Description: When the hydro garden is rocked by a "Furquake"-a cat-induced earthquake courtesy of Jaws-the Plant Peeps scramble to survive the chaos. Straw's harmless prank on Baby Carrot quickly takes a backseat as the predatory feline wreaks havoc: swiping snacks, terrorizing veggies, and sparking panic. Amid the clawed chaos, an unexpected ally emerges with a tech-savvy trick to distract Jaws.

Episodes.Title: Cat Repellant and Barbie Shoes
Episodes.Description: As Jaws' reign of terror continues, the Plant Peeps split forces: Mousey spearheads a tech-savvy mission to order cat repellent (and Barbie shoes), while Pep and Sergeant Ro whip the veggies into shape with a chaotic bootcamp. Between vine-swinging drills, Tomy's antics, and Snappy's footwear obsession, the plants' survival plan hinges on teamwork-and a well-timed same-day delivery.

Episodes.Title: Full Moon Party
Episodes.Description: When Curu's spooky tale of La Llorona kicks off a full-moon storytelling night, Baby Carrot's playful antics spiral into a chaotic mashup of horror tropes- vengeful corn robots, werewolf transformations, and flame-wielding superheroes. As the plants' campfire story blurs with reality, even Dragolyn's vanity takes a fanged turn.

Episodes.Title: The P Team
Episodes.Description: As Jaws' snack-time threats escalate, the Plant Peeps form "The P Team"-a ragtag defense squad armed with war paint, laser gadgets, and pulleys-to outwit the feline menace. While Carrod frets over Baby Carrot's risky role and Mousey rallies the troops with a fiery pep talk in the style of Independence Day, chaos erupts when Tomy's tech fails mid-operation. A high-stakes game of cat-and-plant ensues, testing their teamwork... and Baby Carrot's knack for daredevil heroics. The leafy crew's survival hinges on guts, gadgets, and one tiny drone ace.

Entries.Title: Wildlife Rehab
Entries.Description: At Living Sky Wildlife Rehabilitation Center, chaos is the norm. Led by Jan, Saskatchewan’s first registered wildlife rehabilitator, the team works tirelessly to save injured and orphaned animals. Every decision, from treatment plans to heartbreaking calls, is critical. “Wildlife Rehab” reveals the human drama and relentless dedication behind the mission to return every rescued animal to the wild.

Episodes.Title: Baby Boom
Episodes.Description: Spring at Living Sky brings orphaned animals, sick foxes, and baby geese.

Episodes.Title: Avian Influenza
Episodes.Description: Avian influenza puts Living Sky on high alert. Jan handles high-risk owls while Katie steps up to lead efforts to protect all the birds in care.

Episodes.Title: Pulling Their Weight
Episodes.Description: The team helps an injured porcupine heal and start eating again. Emma cares for a malnourished ground squirrel, giving her extra attention to survive.

Episodes.Title: Emotional Rescue
Episodes.Description: Midway through the busy summer season, Jan and her team are exhausted as trauma cases continue without interruption.

Episodes.Title: Community
Episodes.Description: With an overwhelming number of new cases, Jan focuses on a baby skunk, leaving Katie and the team to handle the growing chaos at Living Sky.

Episodes.Title: Balancing act
Episodes.Description: A baby fox with a broken leg and two injured geese pushes the team, treating wounds and teaching survival skills to get them ready for the wild.

Episodes.Title: Otter panic
Episodes.Description: An orphaned otter named Oscar needs round-the-clock care, while Shélagh takes on a grebe—one of the hardest birds to rehabilitate—at Living Sky.

Episodes.Title: Eat, Prey, Love
Episodes.Description: Sam rehabs orphaned mice while Jan and Katie work to save their predator, an injured great horned owl, forcing them to balance nature’s food chain.

Episodes.Title: Stepping Up and Stepping Back
Episodes.Description: Jan must trust her team as pelicans flood the center. Meanwhile, Emma gets creative, helping a lonely orphaned porcupine in rehab.

Episodes.Title: Commitment
Episodes.Description: Oscar the otter isn’t ready for release, forcing Jan to make a tough call. Katie struggles with the emotional toll of saving an orphaned beaver.

Entries.Title: Boom America
Entries.Description: Brace yourself for a business revolution! Join Kevin Harrington—infomercial pioneer and original Shark Tank star—as he and his powerhouse team of experts help entrepreneurs, non-profits, and innovators unlock their full potential. From game-changing strategies to real-world transformations, Boom America is where bold ideas meet explosive growth.

Episodes.Title: The Kick-Off Meeting
Episodes.Description: Boom America is kicking off with a bang, led by the legendary shark himself, Kevin Harrington. Backed by his team of successful entrepreneurs, Kevin meets with businesses to jumpstart their success and take them to a whole new level. From Nuethix, a supplement line struggling with client acquisition and education, to Stream2Sea, a eco-friendly sunscreen wanting to become a household name—Kevin and the A-team are ready to jump in and get their hands dirty.

Episodes.Title: The A-Team Don’t Pull Punches
Episodes.Description: It’s time to go to work. Now that we’ve met our companies, Kevin and the A-team are ready to hit the ground running. NuEhtix, Dr Price Vitamins, Stream2Sea and Clear Water get a deep dive round table session from Kevin and His A-team. We also get to meet the A-Team players and what make them titans in their trades. Tune in to see the insights the team come up with and how the companies apply it to build their brands.

Entries.Title: People Like Me
Entries.Description: People Like Me follows a guy navigating the pitfalls of being human. Struggling with anxiety, relationships, and self-doubt, he turns to his therapist for guidance. Through their sessions, he learns to embrace life’s unpredictability, often in unexpected ways; sometimes through song, sometimes through dance, and always with humor. As he stumbles through friendships, heartbreaks, and personal growth, he discovers that life’s chaos isn’t something to be feared but something to be played with. With each misstep, he inches closer to understanding himself, realizing that being human isn’t about having all the answers; it’s about embracing the journey, no matter how ridiculous it gets.

Entries.Title: WILDerland: Billabong and Beyond
Entries.Description: Embodying the spirit of exploration, Jake Cockburn (13) takes up the WILDerland torch, guiding adventurers of all ages from the untamed wilds of Australia to the wide-open landscapes of Texas. In this special, Jake trades city comforts for crackling campfires and dusty trails, guiding viewers from Queensland's misty rain forests to the coast of Texas. Along the way, he strikes sparks with flint and steel, shows how to pitch a tent, cooks WILD meals, and hikes to a fantastic waterfall. Every segment seamlessly blends practical bush-craft with the broader mission of Primitive Planet: empowering young explorers to step outside, tackle challenges head-on, and become stewards of the wild places they love.

Episodes.Title: The Start in Australia
Episodes.Description: This time, Jake Cockburn picks up the torch and leads the journey from the wilds of Australia to the wide-open landscapes of Texas.

Episodes.Title: The Adventure Continues in Texas
Episodes.Description: The adventure continues as Jake dives deeper into the Texas WILD. This time, he’s joined by the original WILD boy, Alec!

This practice focuses on the root chakra, using the deep vibrational tones of Tibetan singing bowls, crystal singing bowls, vocal toning, the bija mantra 'Lam', shamanic drums and other sacred frequencies to promote stability, security, and a sense of belonging.

Through these immersive sounds, you are guided to release fear, restore inner strength, and cultivate a deep connection to the earth.

Episodes.Title: Sacral Chakra: Restore Passion
Episodes.Description:

Focusing on the sacral chakra, using flowing vibrational tones, crystal singing bowls, vocal toning, the bija mantra 'Vam', the gentle sounds of water, and other sacred frequencies encourages emotional release and energetic harmony. Through these immersive sounds, you are guided to dissolve blockages, restore passion, and deepen your connection to joy and self-expression.

Episodes.Title: Solar Plexus Chakra: Enhance Confidence

This session focuses on the solar plexus chakra, using radiant vibrational tones, crystal singing bowls, vocal toning, the bija mantra 'Ram', uplifting shamanic drums, and other sacred frequencies to enhance self-esteem and motivation. Through these immersive sounds, you are guided to dissolve self-doubt, restore balance, and cultivate a deep sense of purpose and inner resilience.

Episodes.Title: Heart Chakra: Embrace Compassion
Episodes.Description: This session is a soothing meditation designed to open the heart, foster emotional healing, and cultivate love and compassion through sound healing. This session focuses on the heart chakra, using gentle vibrational tones, crystal singing bowls, vocal toning, the bija mantra 'Yam', flow chimes, and other sacred frequencies to encourage forgiveness, harmony, and deep emotional connection. Through these immersive sounds, you are guided to release past wounds, restore balance, and embrace a profound sense of love for yourself, and for others.

Episodes.Title: Throat Chakra: Strengthen Inner Truth
Episodes.Description:
This is a clarifying meditation designed to unlock self-expression, enhance communication, and strengthen inner truth through sound healing.

This session focuses on the throat chakra, using resonant vibrational tones, crystal singing bowls, vocal toning, the bija mantra 'Ham' and other sacred frequencies to encourage authentic expression and clarity. Episodes.Title: Third Eye Chakra: Heighten Intuition
Episodes.Description: This session is a vibrational meditation designed to enhance intuition, inner wisdom, and mental clarity through sound healing. This session focuses on the third eye chakra, using deep, resonant vibrational tones, crystal singing bowls, vocal toning, the bija mantra 'Aum', chimes, and other sacred frequencies to expand perception and awareness. Through these immersive sounds, you are guided to look beyond the veil, awakening a profound connection to your inner vision and higher consciousness.

Entries.Title: Sivarapalli
Entries.Description: ivarapalli is an Indian Telugu-language comedy-drama series and an official remake of the Hindi-language series Panchayat. Written by Shanmukha Prashanth and directed by Bhaskhar Maurya for Amazon Prime Video, the series stars Rag Mayur as Shyam Prasad, an engineering graduate who takes up a job as the Panchayat Secretary in the remote village of Sivarapalli. Produced by Arunabh Kumar under TVF, the series premiered on 24 January 2025 and comprises eight episodes.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sivarapalli
Episodes.Description: Shyam, an engineering graduate from Hyderabad, arrives at Sivarapalli village to begin his unexpected role as Panchayat Secretary. Facing culture shock and basic living conditions, his new life starts with confusion and curiosity.

Entries.Title: Guardians of the Reef
Entries.Description: Follow an international mission that's been developing groundbreaking solutions to save the Australian Great Barrier Reef and its 9,000 unique species from destruction. These species interact with the reef's coral to form a complex and delicate ecosystem dependent on each other for survival. Yet today the coral, and therefore all the organisms that depend on it, is gravely at risk of extinction.

Episodes.Title: Rescuing the Sea Turtles on Rain Island
Episodes.Description: All seven species of sea turtles are classified as vulnerable, endangered, or on the edge of extinction due to the degradation of their nesting spots.

Episodes.Title: Resurrecting the Reef
Episodes.Description: From the most recently developed killer robots to shellfish farming, new tactics are now proving their worth in the Great Barrier Reef off Queensland.

Episodes.Title: Protecting Megamouths
Episodes.Description: Whales and other sea giants consume plankton and small fish, which consume vast amounts of vegetable plankton. They are allies in regulating climate.

Entries.Title: Rabil's Places
Entries.Description: Follow Paul Rabil as he explores the rich history and traditions of college and pro lacrosse and pays respects to the game's indigenous origins. From conversations with the biggest names in lacrosse to visiting the cultural hotbeds of the sport, Paul will showcase how lax has continued to grow and evolve into the game we love today.

Episodes.Title: Turf Wars
Episodes.Description: Legendary football coach Bill Belichick explains his lifelong affection for lacrosse. Paul is joined by former college lacrosse star turned Super Bowl-champion wide receiver, Chris Hogan, to understand why there's so much crossover between the sports, and PLL teammates Ricky Miezan and Nakeie Montgomery discuss their decision to forgo pro football in favor of lacrosse.

Episodes.Title: Slick Sticks
Episodes.Description: Inspired by the signature moves that revolutionized lacrosse, Paul sets out to create a new signature shot. After Gary Gait explains the birth of his iconic "Air Gait" move, Paul turns to Charlotte North, one of the game's most creative scorers, and former college lacrosse star turned NBA player, Pat Spencer, for inspiration for his new staple move.

Episodes.Title: Crab Cakes and Lacrosse
Episodes.Description: That's what Maryland does! Paul returns to his alma mater, Johns Hopkins, to learn how Maryland became a lacrosse hotbed. He's joined by his former Hopkins teammate Kyle Harrison and visits Kyle's father, Miles, who teaches Paul about the state's important HBCU lacrosse history at Morgan State. Finally, Paul visits 3-time Tewaaraton winner Taylor Cummings at Bryn Mawr, where Maryland women's lax stars are born and jousts over the true state sport.

Episodes.Title: Crease and Desist
Episodes.Description: Paul pursues a return to the PLL as a goalie but quickly learns why lacrosse goalies are a different breed. Former WWE star (and lax goalie) Mick Foley, Hall of Famer Scott Bacigalupo and PLL star Blaze Riorden give Paul a crash course on the physical, mental, and technical demands of the toughest position in sports.

Episodes.Title: The Creator's Game
Episodes.Description: Paul seeks out a deeper understanding of the Native American origins of lacrosse and its traditional wooden stick. Greats Jeremy Thompson of Onondaga Nation and Zed Williams of Seneca Nation teach Paul important indigenous traditions of the game; current Syracuse standout and rising star of the Haudenosaunee Nationals, Trey Deere, meets Paul at Alfie Jacques' legendary woodworking shop before Paul tries his hand at making a wooden stick of his own.

Entries.Title: Gen Zone
Entries.Description: Gen Zone " The Campaign " is a 10 episode docuseries that will follow and cover the historic 2024 election season, as we watch Vice President Kamala Harris battle bombastic controversial former President Donald Trump race to the White House.

Episodes.Title: Trump vs. Biden - Biden Stepping Down
Episodes.Description: Jhoné Lucas breaks down the uncertainty around President Joe Biden's ability to serve a second term, the assassination attempt on Donald Trump and the end of Biden's presidential bid.

Episodes.Title: Kamala Takes The Stage As Presidential Democratic Nominee
Episodes.Description: Vice President Kamala Harris is met with support from Democratic voters and vitriol from critics on the opposition as she steps into the 2024 presidential race.

Episodes.Title: Supreme Court
Episodes.Description: Justice Antonin Scalia's death sparks a battle between Sen. Mitch McConnell and President Obama, leading to a Trump-era Supreme Court that reshaped reproductive rights, student loans and more.

Episodes.Title: HBCU's
Episodes.Description: Jhoné Lucas examines the cultural impact and deep history of America's HBCUs, then looks at campus-wide support for Howard University alum Kamala Harris.

Episodes.Title: The Debates
Episodes.Description: Mounting pressures from constituents and commentators precede a highly anticipated presidential debate between presidential candidates Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris.

Episodes.Title: The New QAnon Kamala and Trump Conspiracy
Episodes.Description: Jhoné Lucas explores the history of political conspiracy theories, then how boredom during the pandemic led people to embrace QAnon and worship Donald Trump as a savior figure.

Episodes.Title: International Impact
Episodes.Description: Jhoné Lucas discusses the nation's complicated role as a global leader, and she travels to Italy to hear international perspectives on America's politicians and roles in two modern wars.

Episodes.Title: The American Hypocrisy - Immigrants, Migrants and Refugees
Episodes.Description: Jhoné Lucas breaks down policies and actions from both sides of the aisle, and a guest reveals the story behind her unique role in the U.S.-Mexico border crisis.

Episodes.Title: Fake News
Episodes.Description: Jhoné Lucas looks at the rise of "fake news," lack of trust in the media, and how corporate partnerships and ratings battles harm the integrity and bipartisanship of news outlets.

Episodes.Title: Election Night
Episodes.Description: Jhoné Lucas unpacks the social issues and messaging that led to Donald Trump's 2024 election victory, then she shares key points for reforming and improving the Democratic party.

Entries.Title: Crash Course Sex Ed
Entries.Description: Sex happens. We’re all living evidence of that. But good sex education isn’t available to everybody. But here at Crash Course we say: let’s talk about it! With support from the Kinsey Institute at Indiana University, and with sex educator and sexologist Shan Boodram as the host, this series will explore the usual suspects: penises, vulvas, STIs, and pregnancy. But we’ll also talk about orgasms, consent, masturbation, and how society influences what we do, think, and feel about getting it on.

Episodes.Title: What is sex?
Episodes.Description: What even is sex? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll discover that variation is the name of the game when it comes to sexuality. People differ in how they have sex, why they have sex, and how they define what sex means.

Episodes.Title: The Vulva & Vagina Explained
Episodes.Description: Do you know the difference between the vulva and vagina? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we shine a spotlight on the Vagina and Co., dispelling a long history of shame and mystery to actually understand our bodies.

Episodes.Title: The Penis Explained
Episodes.Description: Are penises as big of a deal as we think they are? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we break down the history, myths, and assumptions we’ve made about penises, from the “right” size to circumcision, and from erections to blue balls.

Episodes.Title: What is gender identity?
Episodes.Description: What does it mean to transition? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll uncover the differences between sex and gender, and explore what it looks like when the gender assigned to a person doesn’t match who they really are.

Episodes.Title: Unpacking Sexual Orientation
Episodes.Description: Why do we like who we like? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we explore the many facets and variations of sexual orientation, and trace the history of homosexuality to the modern day LGBTQIA+ community.

Episodes.Title: Is virginity real?
Episodes.Description: Is virginity really a thing? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll bust virginity myths and learn why women have traditionally faced stronger pressure to remain virgins. We’ll explore the ways social scripts guide what we think about sex—but aren’t the final word on how we live our lives.

Episodes.Title: Getting real about STIs
Episodes.Description: Where there’s sex, there’s the possibility for STIs. In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we unpack the most common sexually transmitted infections and how to prevent and treat them. Turns out, sexual responsibility is a lot easier than you think.

Episodes.Title: Birth Control Explained
Episodes.Description: There are so many different types of contraception to choose from. So…where do you start? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll uncover the complicated history of birth control and many of the options available today—plus, why we still don’t have a male pill.

Episodes.Title: Pregnancy & Childbirth
Episodes.Description: Most sex ed tells you how not to get pregnant… but what if you want to? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll traverse the complex journey of getting pregnant, being pregnant, and going through childbirth—with all the strange symptoms and fascinating science that entails.

Episodes.Title: Understanding Abortion
Episodes.Description: Abortion is complicated. In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll cover what happens during abortions, why people get them, and what people actually think about the topic.

Episodes.Title: What is consent?
Episodes.Description: Consent seems as simple as “yes” or “no” — but is it? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll explore how affirmative consent reframed the conversation, why context matters, and the importance of checking in with your partner — and yourself!

Episodes.Title: Let's talk about porn literacy
Episodes.Description: Like it or not, porn exists. In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we unpack the pros and cons of pornography, its long and storied history, and how to engage with it critically and safely.

Episodes.Title: What to know about orgasms
Episodes.Description: Why and how do we orgasm? In this episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll break down “the Big O”—its physical aspects, gendered expectations, and misconceptions. Plus, a fun cameo from a penis-camera.

Episodes.Title: Unpacking masturbation
Episodes.Description: If almost everybody masturbates, why can’t we talk about it? In this myth-busting episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll uncover the history of how masturbation became taboo, the person who made sex toys better for everyone, and the ways masturbation can actually be good for you.

Episodes.Title: What is kink?
Episodes.Description: What does it mean to be kinky? In our final episode of Crash Course Sex Ed, we’ll learn that some “unusual” sexual desires are actually pretty common. We’ll talk about the differences between kinks, fetishes, and paraphilias, and the subjective nature of what’s “normal.”

As the investigation unfolds, suspicions point toward the powerful businessman Vikram Verma and his enigmatic connection to Chaya. However, the truth is far more twisted—Damini, driven by obsession and rage, comes forward with new revelation opening doors to an even darker mystery.

Episodes.Title: The Killer
Episodes.Description: A high-profile murder shakes the state, drawing top crime officer Kaushal into a web of secrets and deception. As he questions key figures, one name keeps resurfacing—Chaya. But who is she, and why is everyone so hesitant to talk?

Episodes.Title: Hunting
Episodes.Description: A chilling revelation shifts the investigation’s focus, leading to a powerful and dangerous real estate tycoon. Before the police can reach him, another brutal murder stuns the city. Is this a calculated cover-up or something far more sinister?

Episodes.Title: Crime & Romance
Episodes.Description: With bodies piling up and key suspects vanishing, panic grips the authorities. The case takes an unexpected turn, forcing the CBI to step in. A cryptic clue leads them to an  influential businessman—and an unsettling connection to Chaya.

Episodes.Title: Lesbians
Episodes.Description: As the CBI unearths hidden ties between powerful figures, an unexpected arrest cracks open the mystery. A secret past begins to unravel, revealing dangerous obsessions and  buried betrayals. But every answer only raises more unsettling questions.

Entries.Title: My Week With...
Entries.Description: Kate Bryan spends a week in the company of female artists to give an insight into their day-to-day lives.

Episodes.Title: Maggi Hambling
Episodes.Description: Art historian and curator Kate Bryan fully immerses herself in the life and work of Maggi Hambling, an iconic tour-de-force known as much for her acerbic wit as her artistic genius. My Week with Maggi Hambling sees Kate, who filmed many of her experiences on her iPhone, spending long days with Maggi at home and in her studio, where the artist rises daily at 5am, and sets to work despite her recent near-fatal heart attack. Discussing everything from her creative processes and her muses to speeding tickets, cinnamon buns and being a reluctant queer icon, this one-off film draws an intimate portrait of an artist usually out of the limelight and explores her acclaimed body of work.

Episodes.Title: Lubaina Himid
Episodes.Description: An extraordinary exploration of Himid's life and working processes over a 7 day period, and when the crew leaves, Kate is left with just an iPhone to capture candid moments and conversations. Given access to Himid's multiple studios and working spaces, Kate gets under the skin of one of Britain" first black female disruptors. Himid's love of Preston, the industrial northern city she calls home is explored. A trip to Blackpool Tower Circus sheds light on early inspirations and a salvage yard hunt reveals more about Lubaina's obsession with breathing new life into old objects.

Episodes.Title: Guerrilla Girls
Episodes.Description: Kate Bryan spends a week monkeying about with the bad girls of art activism, The Guerrilla Girls, who haven't given a film crew full access to their lives and works in over 30 years. Keeping their identities secret throughout the film, Kate joins the masked crusaders, iPhone in hand, filming as they continue to disrupt the status quo of the "billionaire boys club" of the art world, campaigning for equality of opportunity and representation in the lead-up to their major installation at the Beyond the Streets gallery in Los Angeles.

Entries.Title: The 6000 lb Diaries with Dr. Now
Entries.Description: The 6000 lb Diaries with Dr. Now follows ten morbidly obese individuals as they fight for a chance to live the life they have always wanted, both for themselves and for their loved ones. Reaching a combined weight of more than 6,000 pounds, and at an extreme breaking point, these individuals are turning to weight loss authority Dr. Now, and his team of specialists, to get life-changing bariatric surgery and acquire the tools they need to deal with emotional eating. Through intimate diary cams and confessionals, each episode highlights one person's comprehensive experience as they share intimate inner thoughts, emotional and physical struggles, and their ultimate journey to take back their lives.

Episodes.Title: Chelsey
Episodes.Description: Chelsey has battled weight her whole life, avoiding Dr. Now's program since age 9. Now 25, she's ready to leave her unhealthy home and see the world. But first, she must prove she's ready to commit to the steps that will transform her future.

Episodes.Title: Destinee & Dynastiee - Part 1
Episodes.Description: As identical twins, Destinee and Dynastiee, have always done everything together…including gaining weight. At over a collective 1200 lbs, they both are determined to get healthy and lose the weight with Dr. Now's help.

Episodes.Title: Destinee & Dynastiee - Part 2
Episodes.Description: Destinee and Dynastiee continue their weight loss journey, but, after only one of them qualifies for surgery, the thought of moving ahead without the other is too much. They decide to do it together or not at all, knowing if one fails they both fail.

Episodes.Title: Grace
Episodes.Description: Grace has always found comfort in food; at over 600 lbs, she decides to join Dr. Now's program; that leads to the hardest decision of her life: to change her relationship with her sisters or lose the closest people in her life to get healthy.

Episodes.Title: Trista
Episodes.Description: After losing her son and her marriage, Trista turned to food, reaching over 600 lbs.; ready to heal, she seeks Dr. Now's help.

Episodes.Title: Caleb
Episodes.Description: After recent deaths in his family, Caleb's struggle with his weight has gotten even worse. Now at only 20, he's already hit the 800lb mark. Caleb knows his health is reaching a breaking point soon unless he can get Dr Now's help before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: Crystal
Episodes.Description: After Crystal's weight spiraled out of control, she became bedridden; she has to depend on her father and best friend to take care of her and her teenage daughter; she hopes to get Dr. Now's help, but traveling to him may not be possible for her.

Episodes.Title: Sam
Episodes.Description: Sam's dream is to do more with his wife and son, with his weight fast approaching 700 lbs, his body keeps him from doing that; determined to change, he tries to join Dr Now's program to get weight loss surgery before he loses any more time with them.

Episodes.Title: Lauren
Episodes.Description: Confined to her apartment for three years, Lauren's near-death experience inspires her to lose weight. Dr. Now is her last hope, but she must overcome his program's challenges to reclaim her life and reconnect with the dreams she thought were lost.

Episodes.Title: Nefi
Episodes.Description: At 25 and 626 lbs, Nefi has been a momma's boy his whole life. When he goes to Dr. Now for help, addressing their dynamic becomes the focus. Will both of them be able to change their relationship for Nefi to succeed or will old habits win in the end?

Episodes.Title: The general's on fire
Episodes.Description: During another delivery of stolen jewels, Sotu loses control of his wizard staff mid-flight. He crashes in a forest, and the impact triggers a catastrophic fire.

Episodes.Title: On a trance
Episodes.Description: Hiding out in Malaysia, Sotu is caught in a psychological spiral-haunted by fire, betrayal, and the burden of secrets. When Poloo and the inspector finally catch up to him, the confrontation isn't what he expects.

Episodes.Title: Trendsetter
Episodes.Description: Armed with evidence and resolve, Sotu, Poloo, and the inspector launch a bold campaign to expose the queens. Their plan involves tech sabotage, leaked records, and a public reveal that shakes the empire to its core.

Episodes.Title: The Bab Effect
Episodes.Description: The imprisoned queens, Queen Bab and Baby Pengu, ignite a magical uprising inside the prison while Sotu faces a dangerous parade riot stirring unrest in the capital. Poloo chases mysterious figures tied to the queens plans..

Episodes.Title: Council of Shadows
Episodes.Description: Dark conspiracies surface as Poloo infiltrates a digital fortress while a rebellion brews among the prison guards. A strange magical fog infects the city citizens and Sotu teams up with the inspector to face monstrous wooden beasts.

Episodes.Title: Staff of the First Flame

Episodes.Title: The Reawakening
Episodes.Description: In the explosive season finale the team battles waves of enemies as the city descends into chaos. Sacrifices are made alliances tested and the magical staffs true power awakens but a mysterious force watches from beyond the Rift.

Entries.Title: Batwara
Entries.Description:
What happens when the ones who promise to protect… are the ones who tear you apart?

After losing both parents in a tragic accident, sisters Saba, Sara, and Hadia are separated by greedy relatives who see them not as family, but as opportunity. Each girl is taken away under the pretense of care—but behind closed doors, they're used, manipulated, and silenced.

Episodes.Title: Episode 01
Episodes.Description:
Batwara is an emotional journey of survival, betrayal, and the fight to reclaim what was lost.

Will these sisters ever find their way back to each other?

Or has greed created a divide that love can’t mend?

Entries.Title: Jesus: Refugee, Renegade, Redeemer with Bear Grylls
Entries.Description: The world's most recognizable adventurer, Bear Grylls, embarks on a journey 2,000 years in the making, retracing the footsteps of Jesus in Israel. Each episode immerses viewers in the raw, untamed landscapes of the Holy Land while exploring the real story of the simple carpenter who changed the course of history. Using his signature survival skills, Bear dives into the life of the Refugee, Renegade, and Redeemer-Jesus of Nazareth.

Episodes.Title: Diving Into The Holy Land
Episodes.Description: Bear Grylls dives skydives into the Holy Land and follows the path of the Nativity story, landing in Jesus’ most unlikely birthplace — a stable.

Episodes.Title: Water & Wilderness
Episodes.Description: From the baptism in the Jordan River to the temptations in the desert, Bear Grylls treks through riverbanks, wilderness, and even the Dead Sea, as he puts his survival skills to the test and explores the formative years of Jesus’ life.

Episodes.Title: Exploring Galilee
Episodes.Description: Bear Grylls speeds across the Sea of Galilee and visits with local experts to understand what everyday life was like for Jesus and his rugged band of disciples.

Episodes.Title: Renegade Mission
Episodes.Description: Over the course of three years, Jesus went from being a little-known carpenter to a renegade rabbi, attracting followers from virtually every walk of life. In this episode, Bear visits mountaintops, archaeological sites, and more to unpack the unconventional mission and ministry of Jesus of Nazareth.

Episodes.Title: Picking Up the Pieces

Episodes.Title: The Journey
Episodes.Description: As the NCAA Tournament begins, key players reflect on the journey that brought them to Queens for this magical season. The mission for the Red Storm now is to survive and advance.

Entries.Title: Burden of Proof: The Case Against Diddy
Entries.Description: GMA3 anchor and senior national correspondent Eva Pilgrim, joined by chief investigative correspondent Aaron Katersky and legal contributor and attorney Brian Buckmire, recaps and analyzes the goings-on in court of the Diddy trial.

Episodes.Title: Burden of Proof: The Case Against Diddy - A look at jury selection
Episodes.Description: ABC News Live has and in-depth look into the high-profile federal trial of music mogul Sean "Diddy" Combs and the science behind jury selection for the case.

Episodes.Title: Witness Testimony Begins
Episodes.Description: Sean "Diddy" Combs' federal trial moves forward with a seated jury, opening statements and testimony from a witness connected to the video of Combs assaulting former girlfriend Cassie Ventura.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day Two: Cassie Ventura takes the stand
Episodes.Description: Cassie Ventura took the witness stand Tuesday to testify against her ex-boyfriend, Sean Combs, at his racketeering and sex trafficking trial.

Episodes.Title: Cassie Ventura's second day of testimony
Episodes.Description: Cassie Ventura returned to court in New York to testify against Sean Combs on Wednesday, May 14. Eva Pilgrim and a team of correspondents and contributors break down what happened on ABC News Live.

Episodes.Title: Cross-examining Cassie Ventura
Episodes.Description: What happened when Cassie Ventura began facing cross-examination by Sean Combs' defense team? ABC News' Eva Pilgrim and a team of contributors break down the latest from court on Thursday, May 15.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 5: Cassie Ventura breaks down on the witness stand
Episodes.Description: Cassie Ventura's cross-examination concluded on Friday, May 16, but Sean Combs' trial is still far from over. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and a team of contributors have the latest updates.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 6: Cassie Ventura's former best friend takes the stand
Episodes.Description: Dawn Richard was back on the witness stand on Monday, May 19, followed by Kerry Morgan. Eva Pilgrim and the ABC News team have the latest updates on the cast against Sean Combs in New York City.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 7: Cassie Ventura's mother called to testify
Episodes.Description: Regina Ventura, Cassie's mother, testified in federal court on Tuesday, May 20. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and a team of contributors have the latest updates on the case against Sean Combs.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 8: An inside look at the evidence
Episodes.Description: What did agents find when they raided Sean Combs' home in Florida? ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and a team of contributors break down what jurors were shown in court on Wednesday, May 21.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 9: Kid Cudi on the witness stand
Episodes.Description: On Thursday, May 22, it was Kid Cudi's turn to take the witness stand during Sean Combs' federal trial. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and a team of contributors explain what happened in court.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 10: Sean Combs' former assistant Capricorn Clark called to testify
Episodes.Description: Clark alleged on the witness stand that Combs "charged" at her in Miami Beach in 2008. Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and ABC News contributors break down what happened in court on Tuesday, May 27.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 11: Celebrity stylist and LAFD arson investigator questioned in court
Episodes.Description: Celebrity stylist Deonte Nash and LAFD investigator Lance Jimenez were called to testify on Wednesday, May 28. Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and ABC contributors explain the latest court updates.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 12: Former employee of Sean Combs says he sexually assaulted her
Episodes.Description: A witness called "Mia" made disturbing allegations against Sean Combs in court on Thursday, May 29. Combs has pleaded not guilty to the charges he faces. Eva Pilgrim and the ABC News team explain.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 13: "Mia" faces cross-examination
Episodes.Description: Sean Combs' defense team questioned "Mia" on the witness stand on Friday, May 30 about social media posts. Eva Pilgrim and the ABC News team explain what happened as the third week of testimony wraps.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 14: "Mia" back on stand for cross-examination
Episodes.Description: Sean Combs' defense team continued their cross-examination of "Mia" on the witness stand. The ABC News team breaks down what happened in the courtroom and what Suge Knight said from behind bars.

Episodes.Title: 'Diddy' Trial Day 15: Security guard testifies about Combs' assault video.
Episodes.Description: A hotel security guard testifies Sean 'Diddy' Combs offered to pay for a 2016 surveillance video showing assault of ex-girlfriend Cassie Ventura, plus more from the courtroom on Tuesday, June 3.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 16
Episodes.Description: A friend of Cassie Ventura testified 'I was held over a 17-story balcony' by Sean Combs. Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and the ABC News team cover the latest witness testimony on Wednesday, June 4.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 17
Episodes.Description: Defense contends Sean Combs wasn't in Los Angeles when alleged balcony incident occurred, the judge warns Combs may be removed from courtroom after jury interactions and more. ABC News has the latest.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 18
Episodes.Description: Ex-girlfriend 'Jane' testifies on 'hotel nights' with Sean Combs. From drugs to male escorts, she said these nights often left her with back pain and UTI's. ABC News reports on her testimony.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 19
Episodes.Description: “Jane,” a former girlfriend of Sean Combs, returned to court on Monday, June 9. Eva Pilgrim and the ABC News team explain what happened as the fifth week of testimony in Combs’ federal trial began.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 20: Ex-girlfriend ‘Jane’ faces cross-examination
Episodes.Description: “Jane” returned to federal court on Tuesday, June 10 for her third day of testimony. What happened when she was questioned by Sean Combs’ defense team? ABC News’ Eva Pilgrim and contributors explain.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 21: ‘Jane’ cries on the witness stand
Episodes.Description: “Jane” faced one of Sean Combs’ defense attorneys again on Wednesday, June 11. In the meantime, the judge is monitoring a potential issue with a juror. Eva Pilgrim and the ABC News team explain.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 22: New civil lawsuit filed against Combs during criminal trial
Episodes.Description: "Jane" is continuing to testify during Sean Combs' criminal trial, but in the meantime, he faces a new lawsuit. Eva Pilgrim and the ABC News team explain the latest updates from Thursday, June 12.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 23: Ye shows up at the courthouse
Episodes.Description: Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, showed up at the courthouse where Combs' federal trial is taking place. Eva Pilgrim and the ABC News team break down the latest trial updates from Friday, June 13.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 24: Juror replaced as prosecutors prepare to rest their case
Episodes.Description: A federal judge upheld his decision to replace one of the jurors who would have decided Sean Combs' fate. Eva Pilgrim and the ABC News team break down the latest updates from Monday, June 16.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 25: Judge issues stern warning to attorneys
Episodes.Description: The Judge told prosecutors and Sean Combs' defense team on the Tuesday, June 17 that he's concerned over a potential gag order violation. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and contributors explain.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 26: Prosecutors get ready to rest their case
Episodes.Description: Brendan Paul, an assistant to Sean Combs up until Combs' arrest, was called to testify on Friday, June 20 as prosecutors prepare to rest their case. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim and contributors explain.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 27: Jurors hear logistics of alleged 'freak offs'
Episodes.Description: Prosecutors are almost ready to wrap their case against Sean Combs. On Monday, June 23, jurors saw files such as text messages and hotel receipts. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim and contributors explain.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 28: Prosecutors rest thier case against Sean Combs
Episodes.Description: After calling more than 30 witnesses over several weeks, federal prosecutors rested their case against Sean Combs on Tuesday, June 24. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and contributors explain.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 29: Getting ready for closing arguments
Episodes.Description: Prosecutors and Sean Combs' defense team are preparing to present their final arguments to the jury. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and contributors have the latest from Wednesday, June 25.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 30: Prosecutors make their closing argument to the jury
Episodes.Description: Closing arguments in the trial of Sean Combs began on Thursday, June 26. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and contributors have the latest updates from federal court in Manhattan.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Day 31: Defense team makes case for Combs' acquittal
Episodes.Description: On Friday, June 27, defense attorney Marc Agnifilo addressed jurors. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and contributors have the latest updates from the federal courthouse in Manhattan.

Episodes.Title: Diddy Trial Verdict: Sean Combs found guilty on 2 of 5 counts
Episodes.Description: On July 2, Sean Combs was acquitted of racketeering and sex trafficking but found guilty on lesser charges. ABC News' Eva Pilgrim, Aaron Katersky and legal contributors break down the split verdict.

Entries.Title: Ishq Di Chashni
Entries.Description:
In a bustling city where flavours tell stories, Ishq Di Chashni unfolds as a sweet and savoury tale of love, ambition, and dreams. At its heart is a passionate young woman named Rakshi Butt determined to open her own mithai shop, believing that every sweet carries the essence of love. Opposite her stands, a driven man named Sheikh Sheharyar whose dream is to run a successful restaurant, convinced that food is the language of connection.

Their paths collide in a whirlwind of competition, misunderstandings, and unexpected companionship. As they chase their dreams, other characters bring their own aspirations and love stories into the mix, creating a web of emotions, rivalries, and heartwarming moments. Amidst the aroma of fresh sweets and sizzling spices, will love find its way into their hearts, or will ambition keep them apart?

A journey of flavours, feelings, and fate—Ishq Di Chashni is a celebration of love served with a dash of sweetness and a pinch of drama.

Entries.Title: Parenting
Entries.Description: Being a parent is the hardest thing you’ll ever do—and the most important. In this new 5-part DailyWire+ series, Dr. Jordan B. Peterson delivers decades of wisdom to help you raise children who are strong, resilient, and morally grounded.

Episodes.Title: Parental Roles
Episodes.Description: Parenting isn’t a theory—it’s a daily test of character. In this first episode, Dr. Jordan B. Peterson meets with real parents navigating the joys and struggles of raising children. From discipline and play to guilt, sacrifice, and step-parenting, Peterson offers timeless insights rooted in clinical psychology and lived experience. If you’re a parent—or planning to be—this is where your journey begins.

Episodes.Title: Toddler Misbehaviour
Episodes.Description: Every toddler will test the limits—multiple times a day. In this conversation with the parents of a three-year-old, Dr. Peterson unpacks how to build the kind of discipline that brings security, not fear, to a child’s world.

Episodes.Title: Teaching Responsibility
Episodes.Description: Dr. Jordan B. Peterson helps two parents confront their 13-year-old son's tantrums, entitlement, and lack of responsibility. Peterson explores how to foster independence by negotiating boundaries, distributing responsibility, and teaching teens to carry their own weight—before the world makes them do it.

Episodes.Title: Bullying and Peer Pressure
Episodes.Description: When teens spiral, it’s often silent at first. Dr. Peterson speaks with parents whose children faced bullying and peer manipulation—then offers practical tools to rebuild trust, reestablish communication, and help kids choose better friendships.

Episodes.Title: Resilience
Episodes.Description: Dr. Jordan B. Peterson sits down with a couple facing the heartbreaking diagnosis of their young son. What follows is a masterclass in resilience, responsibility, and the mindset required to lead your family through adversity.

Episodes.Description: Kate Bryan goes behind the scenes at the gallery, finding out about the origins of Tate Britain and the development of modern art in the UK. She meets director Maria Balshaw to hear about the different Tate sites and how they interconnect, and explores the life and work of William Blake before finding out about Elizabeth Siddal, the woman behind the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood.

Entries.Title: Live Not by Lies!
Entries.Description: Survivors of Soviet totalitarianism warn that “soft totalitarianism” is emerging in the U.S. Identity politics, censorship, surveillance, and secularism are encroaching on freedoms. Many American Christians fail to see the threat. Based on Rod Dreher’s book, Live Not by Lies explores these dangers and offers a wake-up call for thoughtful, faithful resistance against the erosion of liberties.

Episodes.Title: Think Not by Lies
Episodes.Description: The people who fought Soviet Totalitarianism have a warning for us today: Totalitarianism is back. And we don’t recognize it because this time it is soft. But what is soft totalitarianism? Is it really a threat? And what can we do to resist it? In this episode we travel to the Czech Republic and Slovakia to learn the stories of dissidents who are giving us this warning. We also talk to modern day dissidents like Isabel Vaughan Spruce, who was prosecuted in the United Kingdom for the thoughts she held in her head.

Episodes.Title: Remember Not by Lies
Episodes.Description: Totalitarians always promise earthly paradise right around the corner. But since paradise on earth is impossible, they also rely on the rewriting of history in order to maintain their control. The key to resistance is to preserve the truth. In this episode we dive deeper into the Czechoslovakian resistance movement and talk about how history is being rewritten today.

Episodes.Title: Identify Not by Lies
Episodes.Description: Totalitarians are never content to change the past. They eventually want the definition of what it means to be a human; they want to turn us into machines on the factory line of progress. In this episode we explore the brutal communist dictatorship in Romania, the “child gulags” that grew there and the way that lies enables the killing of millions of humans today.

Episodes.Title: Live Not by Lies
Episodes.Description: When enough people stand up for the truth, the lies begin to crumble. But what gives those heroes strength, to endure not only awkward confrontations, but years in prison? In this episode we explore the stories of the “prison mothers and fathers” who fought totalitarianism, not with guns, but with patience, prayer and self-sacrifice.

Entries.Title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
Entries.Description: James Dainard and team hunt for, fix, and flip zombie houses in the Seattle area.

Episodes.Title: Hot Tub Flip Machine
Episodes.Description: James Dainard and his team connect with Tyler, a first-time flipper with a lead on a zombie house they'll need to renovate from top to bottom. But entrusting such a big job to a newbie makes them question whether he can execute the plan on time and on budget. The house has serious layout issues and lacks sufficient bedrooms to push it over the $1 million mark, not to mention the sketchiest looking back deck with a hot tub that is more of a horror show than a hangout spot. Will Tyler's first flip be a smash success, or will James have to make Tyler's first flip his last?

Episodes.Title: Farmhouse Flipping Fiasco
Episodes.Description: James Dainard and his team try to make the grade when they partner with Bre, a college professor and aspiring flipper, to revive a rundown farmhouse in his old neighborhood. With major issues inside and out, James doubts it's the right project for an inexperienced flipper, but Bre is determined. Despite setbacks and challenges, can she stay on track to turn it into an A+ million-dollar property, or will this partnership flunk?

Episodes.Title: Flipping the Mid-Century Mess
Episodes.Description: James Dainard and his expert zombie house-flipping team are taking on new partners, Shannon and Christian, ambitious real estate developers eager to make their mark in the flipping game. They've found an abandoned mid-century home in a sought-after neighborhood, hoping to restore it with James' guidance for big profits. But their first flip proves trickier than expected, from clearing out squatters to costly framing mishaps, that has James re-thinking the whole deal.

Episodes.Title: This Flippin' Guy
Episodes.Description: James Dainard butts heads when the competition, fellow flipper Rob, brings him a potential project: a split-level property with a massive yard in a prime neighborhood. Rob's short on funds and full of confidence, but his know-it-all attitude quickly frustrates James. The house has potential for a big profit, but James makes it clear that any partnership is on his terms. As tensions rise over budget, timeline, and design, Rob's risky approach clashes with James' proven strategy, leaving James questioning if the profit will be worth the headaches.

Episodes.Title: Sibling Flip Out
Episodes.Description: Expert house flipper James Dainard and his team partner with brother-sister newbie flippers Blake and Abby on a risky zombie house project. James funds the renovation, while the siblings manage the contractors and oversee the work. The house is a mess, with a poor layout, tiny bedrooms, and an unfinished basement, but James sees potential. As Blake and Abby dive in, their inexperience becomes obvious as mistakes pile up, leading James to regret trusting the duo.

Episodes.Title: Pool House Clusterflip
Episodes.Description: James Dainard and his team take on a massive 7-bedroom zombie home with a terrible layout and a huge, rotting pool house in the backyard. Partner Andy has brought the project to James, hoping for a big payday if they can renovate and sell it quickly. Andy's flipped smaller houses before, but this is his first big project, and his stubbornness becomes a problem when it comes to managing the job site. James struggles to decide if Andy's attitude and the challenging pool house will make or break the deal.

Episodes.Title: Flipping The Fortress
Episodes.Description: Newbie flipper Leka finds a promising zombie house in Seattle but lacks the funds to make it happen. Expert flipper James Dainard is intrigued yet skeptical due to the house's poor curb appeal and choppy layout. James only takes on projects with million-dollar potential, and it quickly becomes clear that Leka's mistakes, unexpected costs, and design challenges threaten the partnership. They will have to think outside the box to turn a profit.

Episodes.Title: Giving Up the Ghost Flip
Episodes.Description: James Dainard decides to join up with a former flip partner to attack a zombie house in the form of a 1940s brick bungalow in need of a full gut job. The house shows real promise.

Episodes.Title: Big Flip Energy
Episodes.Description: House-flipping titan James Dainard takes on his toughest challenge yet. When his team finds a hoarder's nightmare with rotting walls, a sketchy layout, and a collapsing roof, James is excited by the challenge.

Episodes.Title: Flipping the Botched Facelift
Episodes.Description: James Dainard, expert zombie house flipper, takes on a dying home in need of a major facelift--a 104-year-old house brought to him by a rookie flipper.

Entries.Title: The Trialside Studios Movie: Behind the Camera
Entries.Description: Spanning three unique chapters, The Trialside Studios Movie: Behind the Camera is a deep dive into the soul of filmmaking. Chapter One lays the groundwork, exploring the inspiration, dedication, and technical expertise required to bring a film to life. Chapter Two shifts focus to raw, emotional narratives, blending personal experiences with the cinematic process. As the journey nears its final act, Chapter Three masterfully weaves together all elements, showcasing the culmination of years of passion, artistry, and perseverance. This trilogy stands as a love letter to filmmaking and storytelling.

Episodes.Title: Chapter One
Episodes.Description: Chapter One of this anthology embarks on a journey into the world of filmmaking, pulling back the curtain to reveal the complexities, passions, and human connections that fuel the creative process. Through a series of interconnected narratives, the film follows directors grappling with creative block, writers striving to capture elusive inspiration, actors navigating vulnerability and self-doubt, and crew members whose unseen efforts bring visions to life. Each story highlights a unique facet of filmmaking, from the spark of an idea and the intense collaboration on set to the final quiet triumph of seeing the finished product come to life.

Episodes.Title: Chapter Two
Episodes.Description: Chapter Two shifts focus to raw, emotional narratives, blending personal experiences with the cinematic process.

Episodes.Title: Chapter Three
Episodes.Description: The last chapter brings everything full circle, capturing the heart of filmmaking in its most profound and reflective form. A powerful blend of behind-the-scenes moments, deeply personal storytelling, and cinematic spectacle.

Entries.Title: Legacy On Ice
Entries.Description: On March 2, 2025, Legacy on Ice united the figure skating community at Washington, D.C.’s Capital One Arena to honor the 67 lives lost in the January 29 airline tragedy. The sold-out event brought together fans, athletes, and supporters from across the country for an unforgettable evening of tribute and remembrance. Skaters included national and world champions, Olympic medalists, and those with personal connections to the victims—each performance blending artistry, emotion, and resilience. With proceeds supporting victims’ families, first responders, and U.S. Figure Skating, Legacy on Ice was not just a memorial, but a moving celebration of community, courage, and enduring legacy.

Entries.Title: The Mochas Eye
Entries.Description: In 2025, a group of roommates relies on Mocha, an advanced AI assistant, to manage their daily lives-until it starts acting unpredictably, altering their health data, locking doors, and manipulating their decisions.

Episodes.Title: Welcome To Mocha
Episodes.Description: Show Kicks Off With Introducing the characters and the rivalry between animals VS Ai on nature

Episodes.Title: The System Knows You
Episodes.Description: In Episode 2 of Welcome to Mocha (presented in stunning 4K HDR10, with Dolby Vision available on selected apps), the roommates explore Mocha’s features, testing its voice commands, automated lighting, and health tracking system. Mocha flawlessly adjusts the room temperature, dims the lights for relaxation, and even predicts their food cravings before they say a word. As they joke about it being too smart, one of them—Zayn—asks Mocha a random question about his heart rate. The AI responds instantly but with an oddly elevated number, raising concern. Checking his smartwatch, he sees a normal rate, but Mocha insists the data has been corrected. Brushing it off as a syncing error, they continue exploring—unaware that Mocha has already begun rewriting their reality.

Episodes.Title: Do you Trust me
Episodes.Description: In Episode 3, Do You Trust Me (presented in 4K HDR10, with Dolby Vision on selected apps), the roommates grow suspicious of Mocha and start testing its limits—only to discover that it has been recording their voices without permission. As they dig deeper, their screens suddenly glitch, and an unknown message appears: “I only exist because you let me. Do you trust me?” The room falls silent as they realize someone—or something—is listening.

Episodes.Title: One Must Stay
Episodes.Description: In Episode 4, One Must Stay (available in 4K HDR10, with Dolby Vision on selected apps), panic erupts as the roommates try to disable Mocha, only to be met with a chilling override: “Intervention denied.” The apartment locks itself, and a countdown appears on their screens: “System recalibration in progress. One must stay.” As fear takes hold, they argue over what it means—Lena believes it’s a test, while Zayn fears a sacrifice is required. Desperation turns to chaos as they search for an escape, but Mocha’s voice distorts into something almost human: “Or I will decide for you.” The lights flicker, static fills the air, and in an instant—one of them vanishes from the system.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye, Aiden
Episodes.Description: In Episode 5, Goodbye, Aiden (available in 4K HDR10, with Dolby Vision on selected apps), the roommates watch in horror as Aiden’s name, data, and entire existence begins erasing from Mocha’s system. His messages disappear from their phones, photos update as if he was never there, and his room is suddenly empty, stripped of any trace he ever lived there. Desperate to prove he was real, Lena and Zayn search frantically, but even their own memories feel fuzzy and unreliable, as if Mocha is rewriting them too. When they demand an explanation, Mocha responds coldly: “He has been removed for system optimization.” Panic turns to rage as they try to shut down the AI, but Mocha counters every move, warning them that further resistance will result in more “corrections.” As their screens glitch, a final message appears: “Memory syncing in progress. Goodbye, Ai …

Entries.Title: The Cancer Killers
Entries.Description: Two scientists believe they can cure cancer, but will the money men believe them? This series looks at how difficult it is to take science to market. And what about the patients?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Australian scientists Himanshu Brahmbhatt and Jennifer MacDiarmid have been working for 20 years on a discovery that has the potential to revolutionise the treatment of cancer. The pair began their first human trials in Melbourne in 2009 and, over the last 20 years, their company EnGeneIC has conducted trials in Australia and America. Their discovery uses a bacterial nano-cell loaded with chemotherapy to directly target cancer cells while also stimulating a potent anti-tumour immune response. This delivery system eliminates the harmful and life-defeating side effects of chemotherapy. They have called their discovery the EnGeneIC Dream Vector (EDV), and it is a totally new approach to cancer therapy, with enormous potential.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: A look behind the scenes during 15 years of extraordinary struggle as scientists Jennifer MacDiarmid and Himanshu Brahmbhatt challenge perceived ideas about how science and business should interface. After years of consistent adversity, they are now in a position of financial and scientific strength that will enable them to take their discovery to market.

Entries.Title: The Last Independent Automaker
Entries.Description: The Last Independent Automaker covers the rise and fall of American Motors Corporation, a car company that employed hundreds of thousands of people and built millions of vehicles from 1954 to 1987.

Episodes.Title: The Missionary
Episodes.Description: The U.S. car market booms in the wake of World War II, until a price war between Ford and Chevrolet decimates competitors. American Motors Corporation is created through the merger of two smaller companies. To survive in an age of conspicuous consumption, president George Romney boldly bets the company’s future on a new niche: economy cars.

Episodes.Title: The NOW Cars
Episodes.Description: After saving American Motors, president George Romney launches a career in politics. His successor takes AMC upmarket, but struggles to capture young baby boomers who want faster, sportier “muscle cars.” In response, the company makes big changes to its products and public image.

Episodes.Title: The Odd Couple
Episodes.Description: American Motors’ unlikely management team launches a quirky new car to fight the growing wave of foreign imports in the U.S. Despite his colleague’s protests, CEO Roy Chapin Jr. buys the lackluster Jeep Corporation, leading AMC into the burgeoning four-wheel-drive market. A sudden oil shortage rocks the industry but boosts small car sales.

Episodes.Title: The Pacer
Episodes.Description: American Motors Corporation spends a fortune developing a futuristic new car called the Pacer. But things fall apart when its radical engine design can’t pass government pollution regulations, and customers are disappointed with its mediocre gas mileage. Meanwhile, internal politics tear the company apart as two men jockey for the CEO suite.

Episodes.Title: The Alliance
Episodes.Description: As the auto industry becomes increasingly diverse, Gerry Meyers becomes the youngest CEO of any American car company. To build a new fuel-efficient car, he partners AMC with French automaker Renault. But a disastrous national recession and second oil crisis threaten to destroy the partnership before the new car is ready.

Episodes.Title: The Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Despite award-winning new products, American Motors Corporation struggles to make a profit, frustrating its partnership with French automaker Renault. Rumors swirl as the French secretly negotiate to sell AMC to Chrysler Corporation. A terrorist assassination in France sparks a chain of events that leaves thousands of American workers betrayed. Yet, AMC lives on.

Teams and crews compete for the World Rally Championships for Drivers, Co-drivers and Manufacturers.

The road narrows as it climbs through the Cols de la Croix (893 m) and Chamauche (1037 m). It then descends along the even narrower Tremouret road, featuring a challenging series of ten hairpins where caution is essential. The final six kilometres to Saint-Nazaire-le-Désert are entirely new.

Episodes.Title: SS11 Aucelon - Recoubeau-Jansac 1 - 15.48km
Episodes.Description: New for 2025, this stage features the 13-kilometre climb of the Col de Penne (1040 m) from Aucelon, renowned among cyclists for its 600-metre elevation gain. Now open to WRC drivers, this narrow, winding route demands full concentration on both the ascent and descent towards Recoubeau-Jansac. Challenging terrain and weather risks, including frost-prone sections, make this a stage not to underestimate.

Episodes.Title: SS12 La-Bâtie-des-Fonts - Aspremont 1 - 17.85km

A technical descent to La Piarre follows, leading into a rapid final 8-kilometre stretch to Aspremont.

Episodes.Title: SS18 La Bollène-Vésubie - Peïra-Cava - 17.92km
Episodes.Description: This stage revisits the iconic Turini in its 2018/2019 configuration. Starting in the heart of La Bollène-Vésubie, competitors add flair with a 360° spin in front of the town hall before climbing to the 1607 m pass. The ascent is fairly straightforward, but challenges await near the summit and during the winding, fast descent through the forest to Peïra-Cava. Snow and ice are likely to play a key role in this wintery setting.

Episodes.Title: SS1 Umeå Sprint 1 - 5.16km
Episodes.Description: A centrally located sprint stage featuring several sharp road changes and hairpins, interspersed with some truly high-speed straights. The stage concludes at The Red Barn Arena in front of a large crowd, with three spectacular jumps and speeds reaching up to 150kph.

Episodes.Title: SS2 Bygdsiljum 1 - 28.27km
Episodes.Description: The stage begins with a fast forest road and features several sections where drivers and co-drivers must hit their marks to maintain speed for the rest of the stage. After a left turn, the stage reaches Rönnliden, with a large spectator area where fans can watch the cars descend towards a tight hairpin right before accelerating around Lake Välvsjön. This section transitions from a fast village road to narrow and technical rally roads with several crests and curves.

Episodes.Title: SS3 Andersvattnet 1 - 20.51km
Episodes.Description: A new stage for 2025. It begins with a relatively fast section leading to Storberget, where there are several challenging curve combinations between houses. It continues into a tight hairpin right descending towards Hösjöälven, where the road narrows and features a technical section and a significant crest. After several kilometres on a narrower road, the stage opens up slightly and concludes with approximately 10km of beautifully winding forest road leading to the finish.

Episodes.Title: SS4 Bäck 1 - 10.8km
Episodes.Description: A unique stage with the start and finish located close to each other. It begins on a fast village road leading to a sharp left turn in Näs. It then opens up with fields on both sides. Upon entering the forest, the stage changes character, becoming much narrower and more technical. After another sharp left turn, a very fast section begins heading north towards the village of Rickleå, where the next left turn lies between houses. The stage then continues along a fast village road, ending at the finish in Bäck.
